fluffInfo.value: A Soulbound Host is the physical body of an apothecary who has willingly allowed an extraplanar creature to possess them, trapping the powerful outsider in a mortal form. Powerful yet vulnerable, Soulbound Hosts loathe their creators. They wander the world for the means to reverse the curse of mortality placed upon them and return to their otherworldly domains.

Exorcist and Alienist apothecaries do not primarily study the body, and rarely practice the type of magic and science which leads to mutant horrors and flesh-stitched abominations. They are instead concerned with the supernatural forces of the mind and soul. Many research and contact powerful extraplanar entities, eager to possess mortals as a means of entering the material world. These apothecaries learn how to create Soulbound Hosts as a powerful means to contain and fight back against these dangerous otherworldly foes.

fluffInfo.name: Desperate Gambit
fluffInfo.value: A Soulbound Host is usually created under truly desperate circumstances, such as when a heroic apothecary faces a dangerous otherworldly being such as a demon, fey, spirit, or inscrutable entity from the Space Between Worlds. Not only are these planar invaders pernicious foes, many are effectively immortal—often these creatures simply reform when killed outside their native planes. Thus, an apothecary who lacks the ability to defeat the demon on their own, or who wishes to defeat a powerful outsider in a more permanent fashion, may instead decide upon a heroic act of self-sacrifice by turning themselves into a Soulbound Host.

fluffInfo.name: Preparing the Trap
fluffInfo.value: Using an array of implanted metals, ingested tinctures, mental preparations, and occult incantations, a skilled apothecary may willingly prepare their body for possession. During the process, the apothecary can weave a unique spiritual trap. It then falls to the apothecary to convince the otherworldly creature to possess them, an act that many outsiders are eager to do. Thus, the canny apothecary preys on the ego of the monster itself.

fluffInfo.name: Mortal Curse
fluffInfo.value: When the outsider inhabits the body, the apothecary's soul departs, leaving the extraplanar creature to take their place spiritually. If this mortal form is killed or destroyed, the bound creature does not simply return to their plane of origin. Instead, the spirit departs to the afterworlds like any other mortal soul, losing their accumulated otherworldly power forever. Thus, the Soulbound Host becomes both a prison and a death sentence for the other wielding being tricked into the apothecary's body.

fluffInfo.name: Rogue Hosts
fluffInfo.value: Unfortunately, this act of self-sacrifice is not without its imperfections. The apothecary's body is filled with otherworldly essence, and while the creature's power is greatly diminished, they often remain extremely dangerous—allies of the departed apothecary may still find it challenging to slay the Soulbound Host. Many escape, wandering the world with stolen lives and even assuming the identity of their host while they search for the means to escape their now mortal form. All bound outsiders are painfully aware of their new mortality, frustrated that returning to their planes of origin is not a simple matter of destroying their flesh-cage or switching their essence into a different host, one which lacks the binding wards placed by the apothecary.

fluffInfo.name: Price of Freedom
fluffInfo.value: Trapped outsiders can win their freedom by calling back the soul of the apothecary who trapped them, and resurrecting them into their body. This is a thing many outsiders are loathe to do out of fiendish ego, since it puts the original soul in a bargaining position. In this way, the apothecary can force the spirit to accept a bargain which requires them to remain in their own worlds for at least the duration of the apothecary's lifetime.

fluffInfo.name: Study the Foe

fluffInfo.value: You know the Soulbound Host's type and damage Resistances.

fluffInfo.name: (15+) Extraplanar Magic
fluffInfo.value: Depending on the type of spirit, you learn either the Hellfire Chain, Illusory Assault, or Psychic Barrage actions, as well as the Spellcasting trait of the host.

fluffInfo.name: (20+) Cursed Fate
fluffInfo.value: You recognize its desperation caused by its spirit-bound mortality and its Reactions.

fluffInfo.name: Combat Tactics
fluffInfo.value: A Soulbound Host is a careful combatant. Though powerful, the last thing they want is to be killed in their mortal form. If they are seriously injured, they often attempt to bargain, offering power and knowledge to assailants who spare them.

fluffInfo.value: *His mouth isn't moving but I can hear everything he's saying, I guess it's time to silence the voices.*

An Alienist seeks to master the mysteries of the mind. Having devoted years to studying the inner workings of the brain to unlock its latent potential, an Alienist is able to bend reality, read thoughts, and manipulate the thoughts of others. They tap into unfathomable realities and shift the world to their will using the psychic energies they call upon from eldritch lore and arcane knowledge.

fluffInfo.name: Alienist Minions
fluffInfo.value: Alienists keep several experiments of their own on hand. They have been known to keep __Wretched Patients__, their minds melted by the Alienist's inhuman experimentation, turning them into obedient and loyal servants. __Disembodied Psyches__ and __Cerebrografts__ are a few of their higher-end creations, having removed the brain of a creature and given it a unique and bespoke form of sentience, these creatures serve as guards to an Alienist's work, or minions capable of complex thought and aid.

entries: **Personality Trait:** I can't help but analyze every person who comes before me. I want to know what they think, and why they are the way they are.
**Bond:** I study the mind for scientific advancement. How easily this muscle can be manipulated, altered, and used in unforeseen ways is fascinating research that must be explored.
**Ideal:** I am the only one capable of this level of advanced mental research, someone else would have gotten it wrong
**Flaw:** My unbound intellect means that I can never be fooled, tricked, or manipulated, and thus I can never be outsmarted, to think I could is laughable.

traits.name: Unmatched Intellect
traits.value: The alienist adds its Intelligence modifier to its Initiative rolls.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The alienist makes three Mind Thrust attacks.

actions.name: Mind Thrust
actions.value: *Melee or Ranged Attack Roll:* +8, reach 5 ft. or range 120 ft. *Hit:* 26 (**4d10 + 4**) Force damage, and the target is pushed 10 feet in any horizontal direction.

actions.name: Mass Manipulation (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: *Intelligence Saving Throw:* DC 16, up to six creatures within 60 feet of the alienist that can see and hear it. *Failure:* The target must use its Reaction to move up to its Speed and make a weapon attack or cast a cantrip. The alienist chooses the direction of the movement and the target of the attack or cantrip.

actions.name: Nerve Gas (1/Day)
actions.value: The alienist creates a 10-foot radius Sphere of psychoactive fog centered on a point it can see within 60 feet. The fog spreads around corners and renders its area Heavily Obscured. It lasts for 1 minute or until a strong wind disperses it.

A creature that enters the fog for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there is subjected to the following effect. *Intelligence Saving Throw:* DC 16. *Failure:* 35 (**10d6**) Psychic damage, and the target has the Incapacitated condition until the start of its next turn. *Success* Half damage only.

bonusActions.name: Teleport
bonusActions.value: The alienist teleports to an unoccupied space it can see within 60 feet.

fluffInfo.name: Study the Foe
fluffInfo.value: Characters proficient in *History* or *Nature* gain Advantage on Intelligence (*Arcana*) checks when they take the Study action to examine an Allopine, learning the following based on the result.

fluffInfo.name: (5+) Flying Aberration
fluffInfo.value: You know the creature's type, and movement speeds.

fluffInfo.name: (10+) Shifty
fluffInfo.value: You are aware of the creature's Nimble Escape Bonus Action.

fluffInfo.name: (15+) Agile but Meek
fluffInfo.value: They learn the creature's highest and lowest ability scores.

fluffInfo.name: Combat Tactics
fluffInfo.value: Allopines are not warriors, but they are hostile to creatures who enter their territory and will fire Quills at anyone who comes too close. They do not stick around in a fight by themselves, and if they are with a flock, they will prefer to take to the air and fire Quills from afar.

fluffInfo.name: Animus:
fluffInfo.value: Aberration.

fluffInfo.name: Fluid:
fluffInfo.value: Contaminated Ichor.

fluffInfo.name: Organs:
fluffInfo.value: Guts.

fluffInfo.name: Bones:
fluffInfo.value: Skull, Spine, Ribs.

fluffInfo.name: Natural Weapons:
fluffInfo.value: Needles.

fluffInfo.name: Hide:
fluffInfo.value: Scales, Webbed Membrane.

fluffInfo.name: Dust:
fluffInfo.value: Aberrant Dust.

entries: **Languages**: understands Deep Speech but can't speak

traits.name: Fully Contaminated
traits.value: The allopine is immune to Contamination and has Advantage on saving throws against contaminated spells. The allopine may cast contaminated spells even though it does not gain Contamination levels.

traits.name: Delerium Healing
traits.value: As an action, the allopine can touch a delerium shard to regain 10 (3d6) Hit Points. Once the allopine has used a delerium shard in this way, the shard can't be used in this manner again for 24 hours.

traits.name: Alien Intellect
traits.value: The allopine is immune to any effect that would sense its emotions or read its thoughts, as well as any divination spell that it refuses. Wisdom (*Insight*) checks made to ascertain the allopine's intentions or sincerity have Disadvantage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The allopine makes three Quill attacks.

actions.name: Quill
actions.value: *Melee or Ranged Attack Roll:* +4, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft. *Hit:* 5 (**1d6 + 2**) Piercing damage.

bonusActions.name: Nimble Escape
bonusActions.value: The allopine takes the Disengage or Hide action.

entries: **Languages**: speaks all languages but doesn't understand any

traits.name: Immutable Form
traits.value: The amalgam is immune to any power, spell, or effect that would alter their form.

traits.name: Lake Rebirth
traits.value: If destroyed, the amalgam reforms in the Lake of Rot 24 hours later with all their hit points.

traits.name: Primordial Influence
traits.value: A dazed enemy who starts their turn within 20 feet of the amalgam must make a DC 16 Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, that creature's body is altered in an otherworldly way of the GM's choice—they might flicker in and out of reality, sprout miniature fingers from their fingers, or have their physical form altered in a similarly alien way. This alteration doesn't affect the creature's game statistics. A cure ailment power of 4th order or higher, a __greater restoration__ spell, or a similar supernatural effect reverses this alteration.

While altered in this way, a creature must repeat the saving throw whenever they finish a long rest. On a failed save, their previous alteration worsens or they experience another chaotic alteration of the GM's choice. If a creature fails this saving throw three times after their initial alteration, they transform into an amalgam controlled by the GM, and only a __wish__ spell can restore the creature to their original form.

traits.name: Viscous Vicinity
traits.value: The amalgam envelops their surroundings in their shifting reality. The area within 20 feet of them is difficult terrain for other creatures.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The amalgam makes two Reality Rend attacks. They can replace one attack with a use of Pull.

actions.name: Reality Rend
actions.value: *Melee Power Attack:* +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 15 (**2d10 + 4**) psychic damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 16 Wisdom saving throw or be dazed until the start of the amalgam's next turn.

actions.name: Pull
actions.value: The amalgam warps reality around up to three creatures they can see within 60 feet of them. Each target must succeed on a DC 16 Strength saving throw or be pulled up to 30 feet directly toward the amalgam.

fluffInfo.name: Study the Foe
fluffInfo.value: Characters who have one or more mutations, or who are afflicted with any form of madness gain Advantage on Intelligence (*Arcana*) checks when they Study the Amalgamation, learning the following based on the result:

fluffInfo.name: (20+) Multidimensional
fluffInfo.value: You recognize its Immunities, and its Rejuvenation, Malignancy, and Immutable Form traits.

fluffInfo.name: (25+) Insatiable Hunger
fluffInfo.value: You know of the creature's Bite attack, as well as its Mind-Breaking Whispers ability.

fluffInfo.name: (30+) Beyond Comprehension
fluffInfo.value: You are aware of its strongest and weakest ability scores and saving throws.

fluffInfo.name: Combat Tactics
fluffInfo.value: The Amalgamation is a formidable foe capable of grappling multiple targets and eating them or throwing them around the battlefield. It constantly summons __Pyknic Maunders__ as additional support while it uses Mind-Breaking Whispers to shatter the minds of its greatest threats.
The Amalgamation does not fear any mortal creature, believing itself indestructible to mortal means. It does not flee or cower.

fluffInfo.name: Animus:
fluffInfo.value: Aberration.

fluffInfo.name: Fluid:
fluffInfo.value: Monster Blood, Contaminated Ichor, Goopy Ooze, Acidic Bile.

fluffInfo.name: Organs:
fluffInfo.value: Eyes, Heart, Flesh, Guts.

fluffInfo.name: Natural Weapons:
fluffInfo.value: Tentacles, Teeth.

fluffInfo.name: Hair:
fluffInfo.value: Hair.

fluffInfo.name: Hide:
fluffInfo.value: Skin.

fluffInfo.name: Dust:
fluffInfo.value: Aberrant Dust.

fluffInfo.name: Trophy:
fluffInfo.value: The Crown of Westemär

entries: **Immunities**: psychic; charmed, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, stunned

traits.name: Contaminating Presence
traits.value: A creature that starts its turn within 120 feet of the Amalgamation is subjected to the following effect. *Constitution Saving Throw:* DC 20. *Failure:* The target gains a Contamination level. *Failure or Success*: 14 (**4d6**) Necrotic damage.

traits.name: Immutable Form
traits.value: The Amalgamation has Immunity to any spell or effect that would alter its form.

traits.name: Malignancy
traits.value: The Amalgamation can't be teleported or travel to another plane against its will.

traits.name: Rejuvenation
traits.value: If the Amalgamation is destroyed in the Mortal World, it reappears 1d10 days later with all of its Hit Points unless its roots in the Space Between Worlds are also destroyed.

traits.name: Ultimate Corruption
traits.value: Necrotic damage dealt by the Amalgamation ignores __Resistance__ and treats Immunity as Resistance instead.

actions.name: The Amalgamation always takes its turn on Initiative count 20
actions.value: On its turn, the Amalgamation can use its movement and interaction as normal. However, it does not take an action or Bonus Action on its turn unless forced to do so by a spell or other effect. Instead, the Amalgamation takes one of the following Epic Actions at the end of each player character's turn

actions.name: Bite
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +17, reach 10 ft. *Hit:* 36 (**4d12 + 10**) Force damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature Grappled by the Amalgamation, the grapple ends and the target is swallowed. While swallowed, the target has the Blinded and Restrained conditions, has Total Cover from effects originating from outside the Amalgamation, and takes 42 (**12d6**) Necrotic damage and gains a Contamination level at the start of each of the Amalgamation's turns.

If the Amalgamation takes 50+ damage in a single turn from a creature inside it, it must succeed on a DC 25 Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate all swallowed creatures, which land in spaces within 10 feet of the Amalgamation and have the Prone condition. If the Amalgamation dies, a swallowed creature no longer has the Restrained condition and can escape the corpse using 15 feet of its movement, exiting with the Prone condition.

actions.name: Tentacle
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +17, reach 60 ft. *Hit:* 28 (**4d8 + 10**) Force damage, and the target has the Grappled condition (escape DC 25). While Grappled, the target has the Restrained condition. The Amalgamation has twelve tentacles, each of which can grapple one target. Fling. One Large or smaller object held or creature Grappled by the Amalgamation is thrown up to 60 feet, landing with the Prone condition. If the target strikes a solid surface, it takes 35 (**10d6**) Force damage. If the target is thrown at another creature, that creature must succeed on a DC 25 Dexterity saving throw or take the same damage and have the Prone condition.

actions.name: Mind-Breaking Whispers (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: *Intelligence Saving Throw:* DC 25, one creature within 120 feet of the Amalgamation. *Failure:* The target becomes insane until it finishes a Long Rest. While insane, the target can't take actions, understand other creatures, read, or speak anything but gibberish. A Greater Restoration or __Heal__ spell ends the effect early. *Failure or Success*: 70 (**20d6**) Psychic damage.

actions.name: Forced Mutation (1/Round)
actions.value: Each creature within 120 feet of the Amalgamation with one or more Contamination levels takes 10 (**3d6**) Necrotic damage and gains a randomly determined mutation.

actions.name: Piper at the Gate (1/Round)
actions.value: A Pyknic Maunder appears in an unoccupied space within 30 feet of the Amalgamation, acting after the Amalgamation on Initiative count 20 and under the Amalgamation's direct control. The Amalgamation can have up to ten Pyknic Maunders under its control at a time.

actions.name: Epic Resistance
actions.value: The Amalgamation chooses one condition, spell, or other effect currently affecting them and rolls 1d20. On an 11+, the effect ends on it. The Amalgamation can use this Epic Action even if it would otherwise be unable to take actions, its actions are being controlled by another creature, or if a spell or effect alters its game statistics.

traits.name: Fully Contaminated
traits.value: The dragon is immune to Contamination and has Advantage on saving throws against contaminated spells. The dragon may cast contaminated spells even though it does not gain Contamination levels.

traits.name: Delerium Healing
traits.value: As an action, the dragon can touch a delerium shard to regain 10 (3d6) Hit Points. Once the dragon has used a delerium shard in this way, the shard can't be used in this manner again for 24 hours.

traits.name: Alien Intellect
traits.value: The dragon is immune to any effect that would sense its emotions or read its thoughts, as well as any divination spell that it refuses. Wisdom (*Insight*) checks made to ascertain the dragon's intentions or sincerity have Disadvantage.

traits.name: Haze Aura
traits.value: A creature that starts its turn within 30 feet of the dragon takes 21 (**6d6**) Necrotic damage.

traits.name: Order Over Chaos
traits.value: Whenever the dragon is present when a roll is made on the [Arcane Anomalies](https://5e.tools/tables.html#arcane%20anomalies_monstersofdrakkenheim), Drakkenheim Madness, or [Mutations](https://5e.tools/tables.html#mutations_monstersofdrakkenheim) table, the dragon makes an additional roll on the table and chooses which result applies.

actions.name: The dragon always takes its turn on Initiative count 20
actions.value: On its turn, the dragon can use its movement and interaction as normal. However, it does not take an action or Bonus Action on its turn unless forced to do so by a spell or other effect. Instead, the dragon takes one of the following Epic Actions at the end of each player character's turn:

entries: **Bite**: *Melee Attack Roll:* +18, reach 10 ft. *Hit:* 36 (**4d12 + 10**) Force damage, and if the target is a Huge or smaller creature, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 26). While Grappled, the target has the Restrained condition.
**Claw**: *Melee Attack Roll:* +18, reach 10 ft. *Hit:* 17 (**2d6 + 10**) Force damage.

actions.name: Tail
actions.value: *Strength Saving Throw:* DC 26, one creature within 20 feet of the dragon. *Failure:* 24 (**4d6 + 10**) Force damage, and if the target is a Huge or smaller creature, it has the Prone condition.

actions.name: Mindfire
actions.value: *Wisdom Saving Throw:* DC 25, one creature the dragon can see within 120 feet. *Failure:* The target takes 22 (**4d10**) Psychic damage and has the Burning condition (2d8 Psychic). *Success* Half damage only.

actions.name: Wing Blast (1/Round)
actions.value: *Strength Saving Throw:* DC 25, each creature in a 30-foot Cone. *Failure:* 20 (**3d6 + 10**) Bludgeoning damage, and the target is pushed up to 20 feet away from the dragon. *Success* Half damage only.

actions.name: Terrifying Roar (Recharges after a Short Rest)
actions.value: *Wisdom Saving Throw:* DC 25, each creature in a 120-foot Emanation originating from the dragon that can hear it. *Failure:* 18 (**4d8**) Thunder damage, and the target has the Frightened condition (save ends).

actions.name: Breathe Deep (1/Round)
actions.value: The dragon's Breath Weapon recharges. The dragon can only use this Epic Action if it's the first Epic Action it has taken this round. After using this Epic Action, the dragon can't use its Bite or Terrifying Roar until the start of the next round.

actions.name: Breath Weapon (Special Recharge)
actions.value: The dragon can only use this Epic Action if it's the last Epic Action it takes this round. It chooses one of the following effects:

actions.name: Octarine Breath
actions.value: The dragon breathes a 120-foot cone of prismatic rays. Each ray is a different color and has a different power and purpose. Choose one ability score, then choose Cold, Fire, Lightning, Necrotic, Psychic, or Radiant damage. Each target must succeed on a DC 25 saving throw using the chosen ability score; it takes 105 (**30d6**) damage of the chosen type on a failed saving throw, or half as much on a successful one.

actions.name: Mutation Breath
actions.value: *Constitution Saving Throw:* DC 25, each creature in a 120-foot Cone. *Failure:* 90 (**20d8**) Necrotic damage, and the target gains one Contamination level. Instead of rolling to determine if it gains a mutation, the target automatically gains a mutation. *Success* Half damage only.

actions.name: Madness Breath
actions.value: *Intelligence Saving Throw:* DC 25, each creature in a 120-foot Cone. *Failure:* 83 (**15d10**) Psychic damage, and the target has the Dazed condition (save ends). Failure by 5 or More: 165 (**30d10**) Psychic damage, and the target instead has the Incapacitated condition (save ends). *Success* Half damage only.

actions.name: Wild Magic Breath
actions.value: *Dexterity Saving Throw:* DC 25, each creature in a 120-foot long, 5-foot wide Line. *Failure:* 83 (**15d10**) Radiant damage, and the target triggers an [Arcane Anomalies](https://5e.tools/tables.html#arcane%20anomalies_monstersofdrakkenheim) centered on itself. *Success* Half damage only.

actions.name: Epic Resistance
actions.value: The dragon chooses one condition, spell, or other effect currently affecting them and rolls 1d20. On an 11+, the effect ends on it. The dragon can use this action even if it would otherwise be unable to take actions, its actions are being controlled by another creature, or if a spell or effect alters its game statistics.

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.value: The eel can breathe air and water. They can survive out of water for up to 24 hours.

traits.name: Foudroyant Majesty (3/Day)
traits.value: When the eel fails a saving throw, they can succeed instead. When they do, they can't take the Multiattack action on their next turn.

traits.name: Slippery
traits.value: The eel has advantage on ability checks and saving throws made to avoid or end the grappled condition on themself.

traits.name: Stormsurge
traits.value: Other lightning eels within 30 feet of the ancient eel deal an extra 4 (**1d8**) lightning damage with their weapon attacks and Electric Pulse.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The eel makes one Bite attack and uses Electric Pulse.

actions.name: Bite
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 12 (**2d6 + 5**) piercing damage plus 9 (**2d8**) lightning damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 17). While grappled, the target is restrained and the eel can't make a Bite attack against another target.

actions.name: Electric Pulse
actions.value: The eel channels energy toward a creature within 60 feet of them. The creature must make a DC 16 Constitution saving throw, made with disadvantage if the target is touching the eel. On a failed save, a creature takes 27 (**6d8**) lightning damage and is dazed until the end of their next turn. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage and isn't dazed.

bonusActions.name: Coiling Storm
bonusActions.value: The eel coils around a creature within 5 feet of them. The target must succeed on a DC 17 Dexterity saving throw or be grappled (escape DC 17).

traits.name: Arcanomagnetic Repulsion
traits.value: Attacks against the dragon made with ferrous weapons or ammunition have disadvantage. The area within 30 feet of the dragon is difficult terrain for creatures wearing ferrous armour.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.value: If the dragon fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Superconductor
traits.value: If the dragon takes 15 or more fire damage in a single instance, its flying speed is reduced by 30 feet until the end of its next turn. If its flying speed is reduced to 0 feet, it immediately falls 100 feet, and falls a further 100 feet at the start of its next turn.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The dragon makes three attacks: one with its Bite and two with its Claws, or three with its Sword Shot.

actions.name: Bite
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +15 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. *Hit:* 19 (**2d10 + 8**) piercing damage plus 9 (**2d8**) force damage.

actions.name: Claws
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +15 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 15 (**2d6 + 8**) slashing damage.

actions.name: Sword Shot
actions.value: *Ranged Weapon Attack:* +15 to hit, range 60/180 ft., one target. *Hit:* 17 (**2d8 + 8**) piercing damage.

actions.name: Breath Weapons (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: The dragon uses one of the following breath weapons.

entries: **Storm of Swords**: The dragon fires a torrent of sharp metal objects in a 90-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 22 Dexterity saving throw, taking 70 (**20d6**) piercing damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

**Repulsion Breath**: The dragon exhales repulsion energy in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 22 Strength saving throw. On a failed save, the creature is pushed up to 60 feet away from the dragon. A creature wearing ferrous armour has disadvantage on this saving throw.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.value: If the owlbear fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Observer Mimic
traits.value: If the owlbear is in dim light or darkness, it appears to be an observer, a type of powerful, floating eye tyrant.

traits.name: Photometabolise
traits.value: If the owlbear is in direct sunlight, it regains 15 hit points at the start of its turn.

traits.name: Radiant Absorption
traits.value: Whenever the owlbear is subjected to radiant damage, it takes no damage and instead regains a number of hit points equal to the radiant damage dealt.

traits.name: Supernova (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
traits.value: If the owlbear would be reduced to 0 hit points, its current hit point total instead resets to 138 hit points, it recharges its Solar Beam, it immediately uses its Blinding Flash legendary action option (without expending any actions), and a small sun coalesces 10 feet above the owlbear and follows it for the next hour, shedding bright sunlight in a 30-foot radius and dispelling magical darkness created by spells of 3rd level or lower in the area. Additionally, the owlbear can use the options in the "Mythic Actions" section for 1 hour. Award a party an additional 11,500 XP (21,500 XP total) for defeating the owlbear after its Supernova activates.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The owlbear makes two attacks: one with its Beak and one with its Claws.

actions.name: Beak
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +11 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 19 (**3d8 + 6**) piercing damage.

actions.name: Claws
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +11 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 13 (**3d4 + 6**) slashing damage.

actions.name: Solar Beam (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: The owlbear exhales a beam of irradiating energy in a 5-foot-wide, 60-foot-long line. Each creature in the area must make a DC 18 Dexterity saving throw, taking 35 (**10d6**) radiant damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.value: The blade can breathe air and water.

traits.name: Slippery
traits.value: Opportunity attacks against the blade are made with disadvantage.

traits.name: Toxiferous
traits.value: When a creature hits the blade with a melee attack while within 5 feet of them or touches the blade, that creature takes 2 (**1d4**) poison damage.

actions.name: Machete
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 5 (**1d6 + 2**) slashing damage.

actions.name: Dart
actions.value: *Ranged Weapon Attack:* +4 to hit, range 20/60 ft., one target. *Hit:* 4 (**1d4 + 2**) piercing damage.

bonusActions.name: Wild Hop
bonusActions.value: The blade jumps a number of feet up to their walking speed. If the blade uses this bonus action to jump at least 10 feet straight toward a creature, the next Machete attack the blade makes against that creature on the same turn is made with advantage.

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.value: The needler can breathe air and water.

traits.name: Sniper
traits.value: If the needler misses with a ranged weapon attack while they are hidden, they remain hidden. Additionally, if the needler makes a ranged weapon attack with advantage and hits, the attack deals an extra 3 (**1d6**) damage.

traits.name: Toxiferous
traits.value: When a creature hits the needler with a melee attack while within 5 feet of them or touches the needler, that creature takes 2 (**1d4**) poison damage.

actions.name: Poison Shortsword
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 7 (**1d6 + 4**) piercing damage plus 7 (**2d6**) poison damage.

actions.name: Blowgun
actions.value: *Ranged Weapon Attack:* +6 to hit, range 25/100 ft., one target. *Hit:* 1 piercing damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned for 1 minute (save ends at end of turn). While poisoned in this way, the target takes 14 (**4d6**) poison damage at the start of each of their turns.

bonusActions.name: Hop and Hide
bonusActions.value: The needler jumps a number of feet up to their walking speed, then takes the Hide action.

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.value: The seer can breathe air and water.

traits.name: Third Eye
traits.value: Creatures within 30 feet of the seer can't hide from the seer. Creatures who can't be targeted by divination magic are immune to this effect.

traits.name: Toxiferous
traits.value: When a creature hits the seer with a melee attack while within 5 feet of them or touches the seer, that creature takes 2 (**1d4**) poison damage.

actions.name: Acid Grasp
actions.value: *Melee Spell Attack:* +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 14 (**4d6**) acid damage. If the target is a creature and they attack the seer before the start of the seer's next turn, the target takes 14 (**4d6**) acid damage.

actions.name: Refulgent Beam
actions.value: The seer fires two magical beams of radiant energy, each beam targeting a creature the seer can see within 120 feet of them. Each target must succeed on a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw or take 13 (**3d8**) radiant damage and shed dim light in a 10-foot radius for 1 minute (save ends at end of turn). While shedding light in this way, attack rolls against the target have advantage, the target can't benefit from being invisible, and they can't take the Hide action.

actions.name: Noxious Bubble (1/Day)
actions.value: The seer creates a 5-foot-radius sphere filled with toxic gas in an unoccupied space they can see within 60 feet of them. If undisturbed, this bubble lasts for 1 minute then dissipates harmlessly. If a creature attacks the bubble, touches it, enters its space, or otherwise disturbs it, the bubble bursts, and each creature within 15 feet of it must make a DC 15 Constitution saving throw, taking 27 (**6d8**) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

actions.name: Psychedelic Drone (1/Day)
actions.value: Each enemy within 60 feet of the seer who can hear them must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or take 10 (**3d6**) psychic damage and be dazed for 1 minute (save ends at end of turn).

bonusActions.name: Hop
bonusActions.value: The seer jumps a number of feet up to their walking speed.

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.value: The slink can breathe air and water.

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.value: The slink can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

traits.name: Toxiferous
traits.value: When a creature hits the slink with a melee attack while within 5 feet of them or touches the slink, that creature takes 2 (**1d4**) poison damage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The slink makes one Poison Dagger attack and one Tongue Nab attack.

actions.name: Poison Dagger
actions.value: *Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack:* +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. *Hit:* 5 (**1d4 + 3**) piercing damage plus 10 (**3d6**) poison damage, and the target can't take reactions until the start of their next turn.

actions.name: Tongue Nab
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +5 to hit, reach 10 ft., one Medium or smaller creature. *Hit:* The slink grabs one Small or Tiny object the slink can see that the target is holding or carrying. The slink can catch the object if they have a free hand, otherwise it lands at the slink's feet.

bonusActions.name: Hop and Hide
bonusActions.value: The slink jumps a number of feet up to their walking speed, then takes the Hide action.

traits.name: Acid Burst
traits.value: When the tadpole is reduced to 0 hit points, their body pops, spraying acid around them. Each creature within 5 feet of the tadpole takes 1 acid damage.

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.value: The tadpole can breathe air and water.

traits.name: Minion
traits.value: If the tadpole takes damage from an attack or as the result of a failed saving throw, their hit points are reduced to 0. If the tadpole takes damage from another effect, they die if the damage equals or exceeds their hit point maximum; otherwise they take no damage.

traits.name: Noxious Skin
traits.value: When a creature starts their turn within 5 feet of three or more tadpoles, that creature must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or be poisoned until the start of their next turn. The DC for this saving throw equals 10 plus the number of tadpoles within 5 feet of the creature.

actions.name: Bite (Group Attack)
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +3 to hit, one target. *Hit:* 1 piercing damage.

entries: **HP**: Seven times their level (number of d8 Hit Dice equal to their level)
**Skills**: acrobatics +3 plus PB, athletics +0 plus PB, stealth +3 plus PB, survival +2 plus PB

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.value: The angulotl yegg can breathe air and water.

actions.name: Signature Attack (Poison Knife)
actions.value: *Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack:* +3 plus PB to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. *Hit:* **1d4 plus PB** piercing damage plus 7 (**2d6**) poison damage. Beginning at 7th level, the yegg can make this attack twice, instead of once, when they take the Attack action on their turn.

actions.name: 3rd Level: Death from Above! (3/Day)
actions.value: As a bonus action, the yegg jumps up to their walking speed without provoking opportunity attacks. If they leap over an enemy during this jump, the yegg can make a signature attack with advantage against that enemy. On a hit, this attack deals an extra **PB** piercing damage.

actions.name: 5th Level: Lay Low (3/Day)
actions.value: When the yegg hits a creature with a signature attack while hidden, the yegg can use their reaction to remain hidden.

actions.name: 7th Level: Excoriating Acid (3/Day)
actions.value: As an action, the yegg throws a flask of acid at a point they can see within 20 feet of them. The flask shatters, and each creature within 10 feet of that point must make a DC 10 plus PB Dexterity saving throw, taking **PBd10** acid damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

fluffInfo.name: Study the Foe
fluffInfo.value: Characters proficient in *Nature* gain Advantage on Intelligence (*Arcana*) checks when they Study an Animated Delerium Sludge, learning the following based on their result:

fluffInfo.name: (10+) Malleable and Resilient
fluffInfo.value: You learn of the creature's Immunities.

fluffInfo.name: (15+) Contamination by Contact
fluffInfo.value: You are aware of its Contaminated Touch and Engulf actions.

fluffInfo.name: (20+) Easy to Outwit
fluffInfo.value: You know the elemental's mental ability scores and saving throws.

fluffInfo.name: Combat Tactics
fluffInfo.value: Animated Delerium Sludge often lies dormant in bodies of water before attempting to Engulf an unsuspecting creature. If reduced to less than 20 Hit Points, it attempts to slip back into the nearby sludge and Hide, hoping to be left alone.

fluffInfo.name: Animus:
fluffInfo.value: Elemental.

fluffInfo.name: Fluid:
fluffInfo.value: Contaminated Ichor, Goopy Ooze.

fluffInfo.name: Dust:
fluffInfo.value: Elemental Dust.

entries: **Immunities**: necrotic, poison; exhaustion, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, restrained, unconscious

traits.name: Invisible in Sludge
traits.value: The elemental has the Invisible condition while fully submerged in delerium sludge.

traits.name: Sludge Form
traits.value: The elemental can enter a Hostile creature's space and stop there. It can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch without squeezing.

actions.name: Contaminated Touch
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +7, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 10 (**3d6**) Necrotic damage. *Constitution Saving Throw:* DC 15. *Failure:* The target gains one Contamination level.

actions.name: Engulf
actions.value: *Strength Saving Throw:* DC 15, each Large or smaller creature in the elemental's space. *Success* The target is pushed out of the elemental's space. *Failure:* The target has the Grappled condition (escape DC 15). While Grappled, the target has the Restrained condition. The elemental can grapple one Large creature or two Medium or smaller creatures at a time.

At the start of each of the elemental's turns, the target takes 28 (**8d6**) Necrotic damage and is subjected to the following effect. *Constitution Saving Throw:* DC 15. *Failure:* The target gains one Contamination level.
A creature within 5 feet of the elemental can take an action to pull a creature or object out of it with a successful DC 15 Strength (*Athletics*) check.

traits.name: Disoriented Resistance (2/Day)
traits.value: When the ankheg fails a saving throw, they can succeed instead, and they can't use bonus actions until the end of their next turn.

traits.name: Earth Walk
traits.value: Difficult terrain composed of earth and stone doesn't cost the ankheg extra movement.

traits.name: Soft Underbelly
traits.value: When a prone creature within 5 feet of the ankheg attacks the ahkheg, the attack is made with advantage instead of disadvantage.

traits.name: Unstable Tunneler
traits.value: While burrowing, the ankheg leaves a 10-foot-diameter tunnel in their wake. Each section of tunnel collapses 1 minute after the ahkheg leaves that space.

actions.name: Bite
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 7 (**1d6 + 4**) slashing damage plus 2 (**1d4**) acid damage. If the target is Large or smaller, they are grappled (escape DC 14). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained and the ankheg can't make a Bite attack against another target.

actions.name: Claw
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 13 (**2d8 + 4**) slashing damage.

actions.name: Acid Spit (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: The ankheg spits acid in a 30-foot long, 5-foot-wide line. Each creature in that area must make a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 7 (**2d6**) acid damage and is bathed in acid. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage and suffers no other effect.

A creature who is bathed in acid takes 3 (**1d6**) acid damage at the start of each of their turns for 1 minute (save ends at end of turn). A creature can use their action to wipe the acid off themself or another creature within their reach, ending the effect early.

bonusActions.name: Earth Eruption
bonusActions.value: While burrowing within 10 feet of the surface, the ankheg erupts (without spending movement) into a 10-foot square on the ground directly above them. This area becomes difficult terrain, and each creature on the ground in this area must make a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a creature is pushed 5 feet to an unoccupied space of the ankheg's choice and is restrained by rubble. A creature can use their action to free themself or another creature within their reach. On a successful save, a creature is moved 5 feet to an unoccupied space of the creature's choice and is not restrained.

fluffInfo.name: Study the Foe
fluffInfo.value: Characters proficient in *Animal Handling* or *Survival* gain Advantage on Intelligence (*Arcana*) checks to Study an Anomollusk, learning the following based on the result:

fluffInfo.name: (10+) Powerfully Protected
fluffInfo.value: You learn its Resistances as well as its Shell Reflection Reaction.

fluffInfo.name: (15+) Dangerous Slime
fluffInfo.value: You are aware of its Snail Trail and Creep abilities.

fluffInfo.name: (20+) Slow and Simple Minded
fluffInfo.value: You recognize its strongest and weakest ability scores and saving throws.

fluffInfo.name: Combat Tactics
fluffInfo.value: Drawn to magic, Anomollusk's view spellcasters and those equipped with magic items as delicious morsels. It attacks by first using its Creep action before it tries to Slobber on them. If threatened, it tries to cover the enemy and its territory in acidic slime. If reduced to less than half Hit Points, it attempts to flee.

fluffInfo.name: Animus:
fluffInfo.value: Monstrosity.

fluffInfo.name: Fluid:
fluffInfo.value: Monster Blood, Contaminated Ichor, Goopy Ooze, Acidic Bile, Mucus.

fluffInfo.name: Organs:
fluffInfo.value: Eyes, Guts, Glands.

fluffInfo.name: Hide:
fluffInfo.value: Shell, Skin.

entries: **Resistances**: Damage from Spells; bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from Magical Attacks

traits.name: Snail Trail
traits.value: When the anomollusk moves through a space, it fills the space with contaminated mucus that remains for 10 minutes. A creature that ends its turn in the mucus is covered in goop and subjected to the following effect. *Dexterity Saving Throw:* DC 17. *Failure:* 20 (**8d4**) Acid damage, and the target has the Slowed condition. Each time the creature ends its turn with the Slowed condition, it gains a Contamination level. A creature within 5 feet can take an action to clean away the goop, ending the Slowed condition.

actions.name: Slobber
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +8, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 20 (**8d4**) Acid damage.

actions.name: Creep
actions.value: The anomollusk moves up to its Speed, and can enter the spaces of Large or smaller creatures as it does. Each creature whose space it enters is subjected once to the following effect. *Strength Saving Throw:* DC 17. *Success* The target is pushed 5 feet away from the anomollusk into a space of its choice. If the target chooses not to move, it suffers the effects of a failure. *Failure:* The target has the Prone condition and is subjected to Snail Trail.

traits.name: Supernatural Resistance
traits.value: Anthracia has advantage on saving throws against powers, spells, and other supernatural effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: Anthracia makes three attacks using Stone Touch, Missile Thorn, or both. She can also use Tree Teleport, if available.

actions.name: Stone Touch
actions.value: *Melee Spell Attack:* +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 13 (**3d8**) necrotic damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 17 Constitution saving throw or be restrained (save ends at end of turn) as their limbs become heavy. If this attack reduces a creature to 0 hit points, they become stable and are petrified into a withered stone tree featuring their tortured likeness. The petrification lasts until the creature is restored by a cure ailment power of 4th order or higher, a __greater restoration__ spell, or a similar supernatural effect.

actions.name: Missile Thorn
actions.value: *Ranged Spell Attack:* +9 to hit, range 90 ft., one target. *Hit:* 7 (**2d6**) piercing damage plus 7 (**2d6**) poison damage.

actions.name: Tree Teleport (3/Day; 5th-Level Spell)
actions.value: Anthracia touches a living tree. She instantly teleports to an unoccupied space within 5 feet of another living tree within 500 feet of the first.
Both trees must be Medium or larger.

actions.name: Wall of Poison (1/Day)
actions.value: Anthracia conjures an opaque wall of poisonous gas centered on a point she can see within 150 feet of her. The wall can be up to 50 feet long, 15 feet high, and 5 feet thick. The wall lingers in the air for 1 minute and its area is heavily obscured. Each creature who is in that area when the wall appears or who enters it for the first time on a turn must make a DC 17 Constitution saving throw, taking 26 (**4d12**) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. Creatures who don't need to breathe automatically succeed on this saving throw. A moderate wind (at least 10 miles per hour) disperses the wall after 4 rounds. A strong wind (at least 20 miles per hour) disperses it after 1 round.

fluffInfo.name: Perfect Transmogrification
fluffInfo.value: Amongst __Mutagenists__, the quest for genetic perfection can become an all-consuming obsession. Those who seek to achieve this so-called superior state refer to it as the "Apex" and describe the transformation as creating the ultimate humanoid specimen.

Through years of study and trials, Mutagenists have perfected their Transmogrifying Elixir to harness the ultimate power of mortal potential. This formula allows them to amplify their natural capabilities to the peak physical form while maintaining their unbound intellect. There is no telling how many long years a Mutagenist has spent in their lab, and how many unwilling test subjects had to suffer the fates of their imperfect formulae before they arrived at the ultimate conclusion of their research. This is the pinnacle of their scientific study, the perfected Transmogrifying Elixir: the Apex Formula.

fluffInfo.name: Permanent Transformation
fluffInfo.value: The process renders the Mutagenist permanently altered. Energy courses through their veins, their strength and agility extended to the very limits of human capabilities. Their form is able to shift and adapt to incoming threats, and they are able to perceive events around them with great precision. Their mind, although it remains intellectually intact by the process, is inherently and irrevocably shattered. No Mutagenist who takes the Apex Formula could ever perceive or admit to the fracturing of their mind. Regardless of their vast intelligence, a sickening madness takes hold of their psyche; one that plunges the apothecary-turned-Apex creature into a hostile, madness-filled rage. They still hold onto the threads of their vast scientific mind, using that as a justification for their actions, unaware of the deranged mental state they now reside within.

fluffInfo.name: The Folly of Perfection
fluffInfo.value: Even Mutagenists who achieve the Apex state have a gnawing question in the back of their minds: is it truly enough? Could they become even more? Their seemingly perfect form is not without subtle flaws, broken psyche, and weaknesses. Many Mutagenists can never truly be satisfied with their results, and even the Apex Formula can never fulfill the unattainable desire for absolute perfection. It is this obsession that has led many Mutagenists to lunacy in the face of their achievements. For even an Apex may spend eternity bound to their workshop, kidnapping unwilling subjects to continue to test and experiment, seeking a perfection that will never truly be achieved.

fluffInfo.name: Roleplaying Traits
fluffInfo.value: The following traits can be used to inspire roleplaying the Cacophonous Chimera:

entries: **Personality Trait:** I am humanity perfected! All beings are beneath me, for I am the apex of physical existence. All should cower in my glory
**Bond:** Science has granted us this gift! This research is the most valuable scientific discovery in the world and must be protected!
**Ideal:** Do not try and stop me, for I am offering perfection to all of humanity. Can't you see? The Apex Form will cure the world of all sickness, all flaws, all weakness!
**Flaw:** There cannot be a weakness in my design. If there is, I will solve it — I just need more time!

fluffInfo.name: Study the Foe
fluffInfo.value: Characters proficient in *Medicine*, *Survival*, or *Arcana* gain Advantage on Wisdom (*Insight*) or Intelligence (*Investigation*) checks to Study the Apex. , learning the following based on the result:

fluffInfo.name: (15+) Adapts to Threats
fluffInfo.value: You recognize the Apex's Rapid Adaptation Reaction and Regeneration trait.

fluffInfo.name: (20+) Harness the Elements
fluffInfo.value: You are aware of its Bonus Action attacks.

fluffInfo.name: (25+) Perfect Form but Fragile Mind
fluffInfo.value: You know the Apex's weakness to Necrotic and Psychic damage.

fluffInfo.name: Combat Tactics
fluffInfo.value: The Apex will often be accompanied by several abominations of its own creation. Lab assistants, failed experiments, and __Wretched Patients__ are often by its side.

An Apex begins combat by unleashing one of its Bonus Action attacks. It quickly analyzes the battlefield, looking for the most optimal use of its energy. It observes the arrangement of its enemies and decides if it is best to use its lightning, fire, or cold attack based on what will deliver the most damage to the most targets.
It then uses its speed to move close to a target to smash it with its Slam attacks. The Apex prefers to target Frozen enemies with its Slams.

The Apex is unwilling to see its own flaws, but it is not stupid. If reduced below 60 Hit Points, it unleashes a final attack and attempts to distance itself from its enemies, hoping to escape and recuperate.

fluffInfo.name: Animus:
fluffInfo.value: Monstrosity.

fluffInfo.name: Fluid:
fluffInfo.value: Monster Blood, Contaminated Ichor, Elemental Fluid.

fluffInfo.name: Organs:
fluffInfo.value: Eyes, Heart, Brain, Guts.

fluffInfo.name: Bones:
fluffInfo.value: Skull, Spine.

fluffInfo.value: Skin.

fluffInfo.name: Dust:
fluffInfo.value: Elemental Dust.

entries: **Skills**: acrobatics +10, athletics +10, intimidation +10, medicine +10, nature +10, perception +10

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.value: The Apex regains 20 Hit Points at the start of its turn. If the Apex takes Necrotic damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of its next turn. The Apex dies only if it starts its turn with 0 Hit Points and doesn't regenerate.

traits.name: Standing Leap
traits.value: The Apex's Long Jump is up to 50 feet and its High Jump is up to 30 feet, with or without a running start.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The Apex makes two Slam attacks.

actions.name: Slam
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +10, reach 10 ft. *Hit:* 27 (**4d10 + 5**) Bludgeoning damage.

bonusActions.name: Lightning Bolt
bonusActions.value: *Dexterity Saving Throw:* DC 18, each creature in a 120-foot long, 5-foot wide Line. *Failure:* 22 (**4d10**) Lightning damage, and the target has the Shocked condition until the end of its next turn. *Success* Half damage only.

bonusActions.name: Fire Blast
bonusActions.value: *Ranged Attack Roll:* +10, range 120 ft. *Hit:* 23 (**4d8 + 5**) Fire damage, and the target and each creature within 10 feet of it is subjected to the following effect. *Dexterity Saving Throw:* DC 18. *Failure:* The target has the Burning condition (4d8 Fire).

bonusActions.name: Cold Snap
bonusActions.value: *Constitution Saving Throw:* DC 18, one creature the Apex can see within 120 feet. *Failure:* 45 (**10d8**) Cold damage, and the target has the Frozen condition (DC 18). *Success* Half damage only.

entries: **Immunities**: poison; blinded, charmed, dazed, deafened, exhaustion, flanked, frightened, grappled, paralyzed, poisoned, prone, restrained, stunned

traits.name: Antimagic Lethargy
traits.value: While in the area of an __antimagic field__ spell, the amalgam's speed is halved and they can't use reactions. Additionally, if targeted by the __dispel magic__ spell, the amalgam must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw against the caster's spell save DC or be unable to use reactions for 1 minute.

traits.name: Arcane Tracker
traits.value: If the amalgam comes within 30 feet of a creature or object affected by magic, the amalgam can unerringly track that target for the next 24 hours.

traits.name: Explosive Enhancement
traits.value: After the amalgam is hit with an attack using a mundane melee weapon, that weapon becomes charged with vibrating energy. For the next minute, the weapon gains a cumulative +1 bonus to damage rolls. If this bonus increases to +3, the weapon explodes and is destroyed, and the creature wielding it takes 10 (**3d6**) force damage.

traits.name: False Appearance
traits.value: While the amalgam remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from a puddle of muck.

traits.name: Swarm
traits.value: The amalgam can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and the amalgam can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing. The amalgam can't regain hit points or gain temporary hit points.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The arcane amalgam makes two Bite attacks.

actions.name: Bite
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +6 to hit, reach 0 ft., one target. *Hit:* 14 (**4d6**) acid damage, or 7 (**2d6**) acid damage if the amalgam has half their hit points or fewer.

actions.name: Wild Surge (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: The unstable compounds that form the amalgam react violently to each other. Each creature within 10 feet of the amalgam must make a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 22 (**4d10**) damage of a random type (roll a d6 for each creature): 1, acid; 2, cold; 3, fire; 4, force; 5, necrotic; 6, poison. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage.

fluffInfo.name: Study the Foe
fluffInfo.value: Characters proficient in *Arcana* gain Advantage on Intelligence (*Religion*) checks to Study an Arcane Wraith, learning the following based on the result:

fluffInfo.name: (5+) Contaminated Undead
fluffInfo.value: You know the Arcane Wraith's Immunities and Resistances.

fluffInfo.name: (10+) Spellcaster's Spirit
fluffInfo.value: You are aware of its Comet Shards and Nightmare Pattern actions.

fluffInfo.name: (15+) Unstable Intellect
fluffInfo.value: You recognize the monster's strongest ability scores and saving throws.

fluffInfo.name: Combat Tactics
fluffInfo.value: Arcane Wraiths take advantage of their Incorporeal Movement, gliding through walls and small openings, before blasting targets with Comet Shards from above. They use Nightmare Pattern to control foes and focus attacks on those unaffected by the illusion. Occasionally, they collaborate with other undead, such as Haze Husks and Haze Wights, commanding them like apprentices or minions.

fluffInfo.name: Animus:
fluffInfo.value: Undead.

fluffInfo.name: Fluid:
fluffInfo.value: Contaminated Ichor, Ectoplasm.

fluffInfo.name: Dust:
fluffInfo.value: Undead Dust.

fluffInfo.name: Items:
fluffInfo.value: Arcane Wraiths often have 1d3 uncommon potions or spell scrolls collected nearby and may occasionally have a spellbook with 2d6 wizard spells of 3rd level and lower scribbled inside.

entries: **Resistances**: acid, cold, fire, lightning, thunder; bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from Nonmagical Attacks that aren't Silvered
**Immunities**: necrotic, poison; charmed, exhaustion, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, restrained
**Languages**: The languages it knew in life

traits.name: Incorporeal Movement
traits.value: The arcane wraith can move through other creatures and objects as if they were Difficult Terrain. It takes 5 (**1d10**) Force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The arcane wraith makes three Comet Shard attacks.

actions.name: Comet Shard
actions.value: *Melee or Ranged Attack Roll:* +6, reach 5 ft. or range 120 ft. *Hit:* 21 (**4d8 + 3**) Force damage, and the target is pushed 10 feet away from the arcane wraith.

actions.name: Nightmare Pattern (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: *Intelligence Saving Throw:* DC 14, each creature in a 30-foot Cube centered on a point the arcane wraith can see. *Failure:* The target has the Blinded condition (save ends). While Blinded, the target has the Immobilized condition. The effect ends for the target if it takes damage or another creature takes an action to shake it out of its nightmare. When the effect ends, the target takes 14 (**4d6**) Psychic damage.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.value: Argan has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Pervasive Magic
traits.value: Damage from Argan's spell attacks ignore the target's damage resistances.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: Argan makes three Arcane Lance attacks.

actions.name: Arcane Lance (Cantrip)
actions.value: *Melee or Ranged Spell Attack:* +10 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 90 ft., one target. *Hit:* 17 (**5d6**) force damage, and Argan moves the target up to 15 feet horizontally.

actions.name: Lightning Volley (3rd-Level Spell)
actions.value: Argan calls down lightning on up to three creatures he can see within 30 feet of him. Each target must make a DC 18 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a target takes 21 (**6d6**) lightning damage and their speed is halved until the end of their next turn. On a successful save, a target takes half as much damage and their speed is not halved.

actions.name: Fireball (1/Day; 7th-Level Spell)
actions.value: Argan sculpts a fiery explosion centered on a point within 90 feet of him. Each creature of his choice in a 20-foot-radius sphere centered on that point must make a DC 18 Dexterity saving throw, taking 42 (**12d6**) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

bonusActions.name: Misty Step (2/Day; 2nd-Level Spell)
bonusActions.value: Argan teleports up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space he can see.

traits.name: Charm Resistant
traits.value: Aronar has advantage on saving throws he makes to avoid or end the charmed condition on himself.

traits.name: Delusions of Grandeur
traits.value: Whenever Aronar is affected by an effect (such as the __hold person__ spell) that allows him to make a saving throw at the end of his turn, he can also repeat that saving throw at the start of his turn. Additionally, whenever Aronar succeeds on a saving throw against an effect, he ends that effect on himself and any ally within 30 feet of him under the same effect.

traits.name: Sun Eater's Grace (3/Day)
traits.value: When Aronar is within 30 feet of Athmia and casts a spell that restores hit points to another creature, Athmia regains the same number of hit points.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: Aronar makes three Divine Mace attacks, or he makes one Divine Mace attack and one God Complex attack.

actions.name: Divine Mace
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +11 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 11 (**1d6 + 8**) bludgeoning damage plus 7 (**2d6**) necrotic damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 19 Constitution saving throw or be blinded until the start of their next turn.

actions.name: God Complex (3/Day; 3rd-Level Spell)
actions.value: *Ranged Spell Attack:* +11 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. *Hit:* 28 (**8d6**) necrotic damage, and the next attack roll made against this target before the end of Aronar's next turn has advantage.

actions.name: Cure Wounds (3/Day; 3rd-Level Spell)
actions.value: Aronar touches a creature and the target regains 21 (3d8 + 8) hit points.

bonusActions.name: Vainglory (3/Day; 3rd-Level Spell)
bonusActions.value: A creature of Aronar's choice within 60 feet of him regains 15 (3d4 + 8) hit points.

traits.name: Aura of Dread
traits.value: A creature that starts its turn within 30 feet of Vladimir von Drakken takes 21 (**6d6**) Necrotic damage.

traits.name: Daywalker
traits.value: Vladimir von Drakken doesn't possess any Vampire Weaknesses from the Monsters of Drakkenheim.

traits.name: Reborn Transformation
traits.value: When he finishes a Long Rest, Vladimir von Drakken reverts to his Reborn Vladimir von Drakken form.

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.value: Vladimir von Drakken regains 30 Hit Points at the start of his turn if he has at least 1 Hit Point remaining.

traits.name: Rejuvenation
traits.value: If Vladimir von Drakken is reduced to 0 Hit Points or dies, he drops to 1 Hit Point instead unless he is killed by a creature with the blood of House von Drakken within them.

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.value: Vladimir von Drakken can climb difficult surfaces, including along ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

actions.name: Vladimir von Drakken always takes his turn on Initiative count 20
actions.value: On his turn, Vladimir von Drakken can use his movement and interaction as normal. However, he does not take an action or Bonus Action on his turn unless forced to do so by a spell or other effect. Instead, Vladimir von Drakken takes one of the following Epic Actions at the end of each player character's turn:

entries: **Bloodmourne**: *Melee Attack Roll:* +15, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 35 (**6d8 + 8**) Force damage, and the target has the Bleeding condition (4d4).
**Claws**: *Melee Attack Roll:* +15, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 26 (**4d8 + 8**) Necrotic damage, and if the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 23).

actions.name: Bite (1/Round)
actions.value: *Constitution Saving Throw:* DC 23, one creature within 5 feet that is willing or has the Grappled, Incapacitated, or Restrained condition. *Failure:* 70 (**20d6**) Necrotic damage, and the target has the Weakened condition (DC 22 Constitution save ends). Vladimir von Drakken regains Hit Points equal to the Necrotic damage dealt. A Humanoid killed by this damage rises on its next turn as a Vampire Spawn under Vladimir von Drakken's control.

actions.name: Soul Rending (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: *Constitution Saving Throw:* DC 23, each creature in a 60-foot Cone. *Failure:* 54 (**12d8**) Necrotic damage. Failure by 5 or More: Double damage. *Success* Half damage.

actions.name: Terrifying Glare
actions.value: *Wisdom Saving Throw:* DC 23, one creature Vladimir von Drakken can see within 120 feet. *Failure:* 25 (**6d6 + 4**) Psychic damage, and the target has the Frightened condition until the end of its next turn. Failure by 5 or More: While Frightened, the target has the Paralyzed condition.

actions.name: Wing Blast (1/Round)
actions.value: *Strength Saving Throw:* DC 23, each creature in a 15-foot Emanation originating from Vladimir von Drakken. *Failure:* 14 (**4d6**) Bludgeoning damage, and the target is pushed 10 feet away from Vladimir von Drakken and has the Prone condition. *Failure or Success*: Before or after using this Epic Action, Vladimir von Drakken can move up to half his Fly Speed without provoking Opportunity Attack action.

actions.name: Aerial Maneuver (1/Round)
actions.value: Vladimir von Drakken moves up to his Fly Speed without provoking Opportunity Attack action.

actions.name: Epic Resistance
actions.value: Vladimir von Drakken chooses one condition, spell, or other effect currently affecting him and rolls 1d20. On an 11+, the effect ends on him. He can use this action even if he would otherwise be unable to take actions, his actions are being controlled by another creature, or if a spell or effect alters his game statistics.

entries: **Immunities**: necrotic, poison; charmed, dazed, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned
**Languages**: understands the languages of their creator but can't speak

traits.name: Corpse Carrier
traits.value: The hoarder carries 6 (1d6 + 3) corpses, which they can use with Corpse Bomb and Create Zombies.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The hoarder makes two Arm attacks. If both attacks hit the same creature, they can use Impale on the target.

actions.name: Arm
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. *Hit:* 15 (**3d6 + 5**) bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing damage (hoarder's choice).

actions.name: Impale
actions.value: The hoarder attempts to impale one Larger or smaller creature they can see within 10 feet of them on their spikes. The target must succeed on a DC 17 Strength saving throw or take 16 (**3d10**) piercing damage and be restrained. A creature restrained in this way takes 16 (**3d10**) necrotic damage at the start of each of their turns, and if this damage reduces them to 0 hit points, they die and become an additional corpse for the hoarder's Corpse Carrier. A creature can use their action to make a DC 17 Strength (*Athletics*) check, and on a success, they free themself or a creature within reach who is restrained by the hoarder. If the hoarder is destroyed, each creature restrained by them is freed.

actions.name: Corpse Bomb
actions.value: The hoarder hurls a corpse up to 60 feet, destroying it and releasing necrotic energy in a 20-foot-radius sphere centered on the corpse. Each creature in this area must make a DC 17 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 33 (**6d10**) necrotic damage and can't regain hit points until the start of the hoarder's next turn. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage and isn't prevented from regaining hit points.

bonusActions.name: Create Zombies
bonusActions.value: The hoarder drops any number of corpses from their Corpse Carrier. Each dropped corpse rises as a zombie in an unoccupied space within 10 feet of the hoarder and takes their turn immediately after the hoarder's.

This reduction lasts until the target finishes a long rest or is targeted by a cure ailment power of 4th order or higher, a __greater restoration__ spell, or a similar supernatural effect. The target dies if this effect reduces their hit point maximum to 0.

traits.value: When Atæshia fails a saving throw, a willing creature within 60 feet of her who can see her can give their life to protect her. This creature dies instantly, and Atæshia succeeds on the saving throw.

traits.name: Reborn From War
traits.value: When Atæshia is reduced to 0 hit points, she disintegrates into ash on a solemn wind. For the next 100 years, if a Celestial, an Elemental, or a Humanoid whose challenge rating or level is 5 or higher dies within 60 feet of where Atæshia died, Atæshia returns to life where she died with 25 hit points.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: Atæshia makes three Pale Flame attacks. She can replace one attack with a use of Moment of Loss, if available.

actions.name: Pale Flame
actions.value: *Melee or Ranged Spell Attack:* +13 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 120 ft., one target. *Hit:* 20 (**4d6 + 6**) radiant damage plus 14 (**4d6**) fire damage. If this attack reduces a creature to 0 hit points, they die and all their remains burn to nothing.

actions.name: Moment of Loss (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: Atæshia transforms one creature she can see within 60 feet of her into the form of a living ash cloud. While transformed to ash, the target is immune to all damage, can't provide cover to other creatures, and can't take reactions. At the start of the target's next turn, they reform and must make a DC 21 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the target is reduced to 1 hit point. On a successful save, the target takes 44 (**8d10**) necrotic damage. This damage can't reduce the target's hit points below 1.

actions.name: From Death, Life (1/Day)
actions.value: Atæshia uses her Kindled Sacrifice villain action, even if it is unavailable, to sacrifice herself.

bonusActions.name: Flickering Flame
bonusActions.value: Atæshia forms into a cloud of ash, teleports to an unoccupied space she can see within 60 feet of her, and reforms into her true form. Each creature within 5 feet of the space she left must succeed on a DC 21 Dexterity saving throw or take 5 (**1d10**) fire damage.

traits.value: When Athmia hits a creature with her Soul Blade attack, she can assault their mind. The target must succeed on a DC 19 Intelligence saving throw or expend one spell slot of the highest level available with no effect. A creature who fails this saving throw but can't expend a spell slot must instead spend 3 of their Hit Dice with no effect, or if they can't, take an extra 10 (**3d6**) psychic damage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: Athmia makes two Soul Blade attacks.

actions.name: Soul Blade
actions.value: *Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack:* +11 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30/60 ft., one target. *Hit:* 25 (**5d6 + 8**) psychic damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 19 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened of Athmia until the end of her next turn.

actions.name: Psychic Frenzy (1/Day)
actions.value: Athmia clouds the minds of her foes.
Each enemy within 60 feet of her must succeed on a DC 19 Wisdom saving throw or be dazed until the start of her next turn. Athmia gains 5 temporary hit points for each creature who fails this save.

bonusActions.name: Cunning Action

bonusActions.name: Sun Eater's Gift (3/Day)
bonusActions.value: While within 30 feet of Aronar, Athmia swaps places with him if he is willing.

traits.name: Abyssal Resistance (Costs 2 Souls)
traits.value: When Aurumvas fails a saving throw, he succeeds instead.

traits.name: Lethe
traits.value: When Aurumvas's soul count is 0, he has advantage on attack rolls, disadvantage on saving throws, and his Intelligence score becomes 3 (-4). Additionally, Aurumvas must use his movement on each of his turns to move as close as possible to the nearest creature he can sense with his soulsight, and then if he is able, he must use his action to attack and attempt to kill that creature. Aurumvas can't act with any other purpose until he adds 1 to his soul count.

traits.name: Soul Devourer
traits.value: When Aurumvas reduces a creature who isn't a Construct or an Undead to 0 hit points or deals damage to a dying creature, the creature must make a DC 11 Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, Aurumvas consumes the creature's soul and adds 1 to his soul count. A creature whose soul is consumed in this way immediately dies, and they can't be restored to life by any means short of a __wish__ spell.

traits.name: Soul Weapons
traits.value: While Aurumvas's soul count is 2 or higher, his weapon attacks are magical, and allies within 60 feet of him deal an extra 5 (**1d10**) psychic damage with weapon attacks.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: Aurumvas makes three attacks using Greedy Hands, Covetous Bolt, or both.

actions.name: Greedy Hands
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +12 to hit, reach 10 ft., one creature. *Hit:* 14 (**2d6 + 7**) bludgeoning damage plus 10 (**3d6**) psychic damage. Aurumvas can burn 1 soul to gain temporary hit points equal to the psychic damage dealt.

actions.name: Covetous Bolt
actions.value: *Ranged Spell Attack:* +11 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. *Hit:* 22 (**5d8**) force damage. If the target has spell slots, Aurumvas can burn 2 souls to force the target to expend their highest-level spell slot available with no effect.

bonusActions.name: Greed Is Good
bonusActions.value: Aurumvas chooses an object he can see within 30 feet of him that is worth at least 100 gp. He teleports to an unoccupied space within 5 feet of that object.

actions.name: Claw

actions.name: Powerful Swipe (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 10 (**1d12 + 4**) bludgeoning damage. If the target is Medium or smaller, they are shoved up to 10 feet away and knocked prone. If the target hits a solid surface, they take an extra 7 (**2d6**) bludgeoning damage.

traits.name: Exceptional Smell

traits.name: Familiar Territory
traits.value: The bear has advantage on Dexterity (*Stealth*) and Wisdom (*Survival*) checks made in their native terrain (as determined by you and the GM).

actions.name: 1st Level: Tenacious Strike (2 Ferocity)
actions.value: The bear makes a signature attack. On a hit, the attack deals an extra **PB** damage. On a miss, the bear deals PB slashing damage to the target and gains 2 ferocity.

actions.name: 3rd Level: Pummel (5 Ferocity)
actions.value: The bear makes a signature attack. On a hit, the target is also grappled (escape DC 10 plus PB). While grappled in this way, the bear's attacks (including the triggering attack) deal an extra **PB** damage, the target is restrained if they are Large or smaller, and the bear can't make a signature attack against another target.

actions.name: 5th Level: Clawing Frenzy (8 Ferocity)
actions.value: The bear makes a signature Claw attack against PB creatures of their choice within 5 feet of them. At the end of their turn, the bear gains 1 ferocity for every attack that missed.

bonusActions.name: Hunt by Scent
bonusActions.value: The bear detects the location of each living creature within 10 × PB feet of them, unless the creature is hiding their scent by supernatural means.

fluffInfo.name: (10+) Watch Out for that Horn!

fluffInfo.name: (15+) Slow and Unintelligent

fluffInfo.name: Combat Tactics
fluffInfo.value: The Beetle Knight is surprisingly agile, rarely standing still in battle. They charge during the first round, flinging enemies aside or attempting to grapple. If possible, they back up to charge again but will otherwise defend with their arm blades. They attempt to flee losing battles where their Hit Points fall below half their maximum.

actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +6, reach 10 ft. *Hit:* 13 (**2d8 + 4**) Slashing damage.

If the target is Medium or smaller, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 14). While Grappled, the target has the Restrained condition and the beetle knight can't use its Pincer Horn against another target.

bonusActions.name: Fling
bonusActions.value: *Strength Saving Throw:* DC 14, one creature Grappled by the beetle knight. *Failure:* The target is thrown up to 1d6 × 10 feet, landing with the Prone condition. If the target strikes a solid surface, it takes 3 (**1d6**) Bludgeoning damage for every 10 feet it was thrown. If the target is thrown at another creature, that creature must succeed on a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw or take the same damage and have the Prone condition.

fluffInfo.name: Study the Foe

fluffInfo.name: (5+) Accustomed to the Dark
fluffInfo.value: You understand the Belfray's damage Resistances and Immunities.

fluffInfo.name: (10+) Flying Blood-Drinker
fluffInfo.value: You recognize its Flyby and Keen Hearing features, and Enfeebling Bite attack.

fluffInfo.name: (15+) Weak Mind
fluffInfo.value: You know the Belfray's strongest and weakest ability scores and saving throws.

fluffInfo.name: Combat Tactics
fluffInfo.value: The Belfray attempts to strike with a Sonic Blast from the shadows before engaging. Once a target is weakened, it swoops in with its claws. When damaged, Belfrays Bite, feeding on the blood of their victims to regain strength. It uses movement to stay away from threats, diving to attack before flying to a safe distance. If reduced below half of its maximum Hit Points, it attempts to fly away.

actions.name: Sonic Blast (Recharge 5-6)

bonusActions.name: Shadow Stealth

fluffInfo.name: Study the Foe
fluffInfo.value: Characters proficient in *Nature* or *Survival* gain Advantage on Intelligence (*Arcana*) checks to Study Big Linda, revealing the following based on their result:

fluffInfo.name: (10+) Hard to Kill
fluffInfo.value: You know Big Linda's damage Immunities as well as its Rejuvenation and Regeneration traits.

fluffInfo.name: (15+) Acidic Mucus!
fluffInfo.value: You're aware of her Acid Spew attack.

fluffInfo.name: (20+) Big, Clumsy, and Dumb
fluffInfo.value: You recognize Big Linda's highest and lowest ability scores and saving throws.

fluffInfo.name: Combat Tactics
fluffInfo.value: Big Linda sends Acid Spew against groups of opponents. She then tries to optimize her Bite and Tail attacks by placing herself within her enemies. She is hesitant to leave the Deep Haze but is also not smart enough to resist chasing those who antagonizing her. She rarely flees unless severely wounded, wherein she will seek the safety of the Deep Haze to recover.
