traits.name: Rejuvenation
traits.value: If Big Linda is destroyed and her corpse is left within an area of the Deep Haze for 1 hour, she is revived with all of her Hit Points.

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.value: When Big Linda starts her turn in an area of the Deep Haze, she regains 10 Hit Points. Big Linda dies only if she starts her turn with 0 Hit Points and doesn't regenerate.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: Big Linda makes one Bite attack and one Tail attack.

actions.name: Bite
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +11, reach 10 ft. *Hit:* 33 (**4d12 + 7**) Piercing damage, and if the target is Medium or smaller, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 19). While Grappled, the target has the Restrained condition and Big Linda can't Bite another target.

actions.name: Tail
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +11, reach 10 ft. *Hit:* 20 (**3d8 + 7**) Bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Acid Spew (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: *Dexterity Saving Throw:* DC 16, each creature in a 30-foot Cone. *Failure:* 63 (**14d8**) Acid damage. *Success* Half damage.

traits.name: Rejuvenation
traits.value: If Bigger Linda is destroyed and her corpse is left within an area of the Deep Haze for 1 hour, she is revived with all of her Hit Points.

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.value: When Bigger Linda starts her turn in an area of the Deep Haze, she regains 20 Hit Points. Bigger Linda dies only if she starts her turn with 0 Hit Points and doesn't regenerate.

traits.name: Haze Aura
traits.value: A creature that starts its turn within 30 feet of Bigger Linda is subjected to the following effect. *Constitution Saving Throw:* DC 22. *Failure:* The target gains a Contamination level. *Failure or Success*: 14 (**4d6**) Necrotic damage.

traits.name: Siege Monster
traits.value: Bigger Linda deals double damage to objects and structures.

traits.name: Immutable Form
traits.value: Bigger Linda has Immunity to any spell or effect that would alter her form.

actions.name: Bigger Linda always takes her turn on Initiative count 20
actions.value: On her turn, Bigger Linda can use her movement and interaction as normal. However, she does not take an action or Bonus Action on her turn unless forced to do so by a spell or other effect. Instead, Bigger Linda takes one of the following Epic Actions at the end of each player character's turn:

entries: **Bite**: *Melee Attack Roll:* +15, reach 10 ft. *Hit:* 35 (**4d12 + 9**) Piercing damage, and if the target is Large or smaller, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 23). While Grappled, the target has the Restrained condition and Bigger Linda can't Bite another target.

**Tail**: *Melee Attack Roll:* +15, reach 15 ft. *Hit:* 22 (**3d8 + 9**) Bludgeoning damage, and if the target is Large or smaller, it is pushed 20 feet away from Bigger Linda and has the Prone condition.
**Stomp**: *Melee Attack Roll:* +15, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 25 (**3d10 + 9**) Bludgeoning damage. *Constitution Saving Throw:* DC 23. *Failure:* The target has the Staggered condition (save ends).

actions.name: Breathe Deep
actions.value: Bigger Linda's Breath Weapon recharges. Bigger Linda can only take this Epic Action as the first Epic Action she uses this round. After using this Epic Action, Bigger Linda can't take her Bite Epic Action until the start of the next round.

actions.name: Breath Weapon (Special Recharge)
actions.value: *Dexterity Saving Throw:* DC 22, each creature in a 60-foot long, 5-foot wide Line. *Failure:* 31 (**7d8**) Necrotic damage plus 31 (**7d8**) Force damage, and the target gains a Contamination level. *Success* Half damage only.

actions.name: Trampling Rampage (Recharges When *Bloodied*)
actions.value: Bigger Linda moves up to her Speed in a straight line, moving through the space of Large or smaller creatures in her path. She makes one Stomp attack against each creature she moves through.

actions.name: Teleport (1/Round)
actions.value: Bigger Linger teleports up to 120 feet to an unoccupied space she can see within the Deep Haze.

actions.name: Epic Resistance
actions.value: Bigger Linda chooses one condition, spell, or other effect currently affecting them and rolls 1d20. On an 11+, the effect ends on her. Bigger Linda can use this Epic Action even if she would otherwise be unable to take actions, her actions are being controlled by another creature, or if a spell or effect alters her game statistics.

traits.name: Exceptional Vision
traits.value: The bird has a +10 bonus to Wisdom (*Perception*) checks that rely on sight.

traits.name: Flyby
traits.value: The bird doesn't provoke opportunity attacks when they fly out of an enemy's reach.

traits.name: High-Speed Dive (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
traits.value: If the bird descends at least 30 feet on their turn, they can take the Dash action as a bonus action. When they do, they have advantage on the next attack they make before the end of their turn.

actions.name: Beak
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 5 (**1d4 + 3**) piercing damage.

actions.name: Talons
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 5 (**1d4 + 3**) slashing damage. If the target is a Tiny creature, they are grappled (escape DC 12). If the target is a Small or larger creature, the bird attaches to them. While attached, the bird's Beak attacks against that target are made with advantage, and the bird can't attack another target. The target or a creature who can reach them can attempt to detach the bird as an action by making a DC 12 Strength (*Athletics*) check. On a failed check, the attached target takes 2 (**1d4**) slashing damage. On a successful check, the attached target takes 2 (**1d4**) slashing damage and is no longer attached. The bird can detach by spending 5 feet of their movement.

bonusActions.name: Spot
bonusActions.value: The bird makes a Wisdom (*Perception*) check.

entries: **Skills**: deception +7, insight +4, perception +2, persuasion +7, sleight of hand +7, stealth +7

traits.name: Evasion
traits.value: If Blackjack Mel is subjected to an effect that allows him to make a Dexterity saving throw to take only half damage, he instead takes no damage if he succeeds on the saving throw and only half damage if he fails, provided he doesn't have the Incapacitated condition.

actions.name: Knife
actions.value: *Melee or Ranged Attack Roll:* +5, reach 5 ft. or range 30 ft. *Hit:* 6 (**1d4 + 4**) Piercing damage.

fluffInfo.value: You know the creature is an Aberration with a Swim speed, and it can breathe underwater.

fluffInfo.name: (10+) Slow and Polluted
fluffInfo.value: You recognize the Bloated Dreg's Acid Spray attack.

fluffInfo.name: (15+) Mockery of Humanity
fluffInfo.value: You are aware of the Bloated Dreg's highest and lowest ability scores and saving throws.

fluffInfo.name: Combat Tactics
fluffInfo.value: The Bloated Dreg shuffles aimlessly through Drakkenheim, stopping to rest in places where contaminated water has built up, or in pools of delerium sludge. It produces large amounts of acidic bile in its guts that it expels when threatened. A Bloated Dreg will retreat to its watery home when threatened, trying to hide amongst the contaminated liquids.

actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +5, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 10 (**2d6 + 3**) Bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Acid Spray (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: *Dexterity Saving Throw:* DC 11, each creature in a 15-foot Cone. *Failure:* 5 (**2d4**) Acid damage and is Burning (2d4 Acid).

entries: **Languages**: All languages known before the curse

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.value: The Bloated Gastromorph regains 10 Hit Points at the start of each of its turns. If the Bloated Gastromorph takes Acid or Fire damage, this trait doesn't function on the Bloated Gastromorph's next turn. The Bloated Gastromorph dies only if it starts its turn with 0 Hit Points and doesn't regenerate.

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.value: The Bloated Gastromorph can climb difficult surfaces, including along ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The Bloated Gastromorph makes three Claw attacks. It can replace one attack with a Tongue attack.

actions.name: Claw
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 18 (**3d8 + 5**) Slashing damage, and the target has the Grappled condition (escape DC 15) and is moved up to 5 feet toward the Bloated Gastromorph.

actions.name: Bite
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 27 (**4d10 + 5**) Piercing damage.

If the Bloated Gastromorph takes 40 damage or more on a single turn from a creature inside it, it regurgitates all swallowed creatures at the end of that turn, each of which falls in a space within 10 feet of the gastromorph and has the Prone condition. If the Bloated Gastromorph dies, any swallowed creature no longer has the Restrained condition and can escape from the corpse using 15 feet of movement, exiting with the Prone condition.

actions.name: Tongue (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +9 to hit, reach 25 ft., one target. *Hit:* 31 (**4d12 + 5**) Acid damage. A creature that is hit by this attack is subjected to the following effect. *Constitution Saving Throw:* DC 17. *Failure:* The target has the Paralyzed condition and is moved up to 20 feet toward the gastromorph. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.

bonusActions.name: Swallow
bonusActions.value: *Strength Saving Throw:* DC 17, one Large or smaller creature Grappled by the gastromorph (it can have up to two creatures swallowed at a time). *Failure:* The target is swallowed by the gastromorph, and the Grappled condition ends. A swallowed creature has the Blinded and Restrained conditions, has Total Cover against attacks and other effects outside the gastromorph, and taks 21 (**6d6**) Acid damage at the start of each of the gastromorph's turns.

fluffInfo.name: Study the Foe
fluffInfo.value: Characters proficient in *Nature* or *Survival* gain Advantage on Intelligence (*Arcana*) checks to Study a Bloated Hive, recognizing the following based on their result:

fluffInfo.name: (5+) Sightless Awareness
fluffInfo.value: You know the creature's Immunities and senses.

fluffInfo.name: (10+) Endless Insects!
fluffInfo.value: You are aware of the creature's Spawn Swarm action and Disrupt the Hive trait.

fluffInfo.name: (15+) Frail
fluffInfo.value: You recognize the Bloated Hive's strongest and weakest ability scores and saving throws.

fluffInfo.name: Combat Tactics
fluffInfo.value: The Bloated Hive is usually a solitary creature that spends its time cowering in dark corners living out its cursed life as nothing more than a conduit for its colony. In combat, they focus entirely on keeping their distance from threats and spawning swarms of insects to defend themselves. If cornered, the Bloated Hive uses its Claws and Distracting Swarm before moving back into the shadows and attempting to escape and find a new nest.

Larger packs of Bloated Hives are much braver and more violent, and actively hunt and pursue targets until their numbers are less than their prey. Places where large colonies gather are dangerous. The Bloated Hives work in unison to protect their nests. Only if they become outnumbered do they flee.

traits.name: Insect Swarm
traits.value: The bloated hive emits a 10-foot Emanation of buzzing insects. A creature that starts its turn in the Emanation takes 10 (**3d6**) Necrotic damage.

traits.name: Disrupt the Hive
traits.value: When the bloated hive dies, it immediately spawns a __Swarm of Contaminated Insects__ in its space.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The Bloated Hive makes two attacks.

actions.name: Claws
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +5, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 12 (**2d8 + 3**) Slashing damage.

actions.name: Spawn Swarm (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: The bloated hive creates a __Swarm of Contaminated Insects__, which appears in an unoccupied space within 5 feet. The swarm takes its turn immediately after the bloated hive.

bonusActions.name: Distracting Swarm
bonusActions.value: The bloated hive causes its Insect Swarm to fly in the face of a creature within 5 feet of it. The target can't take Reactions until the end of the bloated hive's turn.

entries: **HP**: 6 + six times caregiver's level (number of d8 Hit Dice equal to their caregiver's level)

traits.name: Keen Sight
traits.value: The hawk has advantage on Wisdom (*Perception*) checks that rely on sight.

actions.name: Signature Attack (Beak)
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +3 plus PB to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* **1d6 plus PB** piercing damage.

actions.name: 1st Level: Distracting Attack (2 Ferocity)
actions.value: The hawk makes a signature attack. On a hit, the next attack made against the target before the start of the hawk's next turn has advantage.

actions.name: 3rd Level: Swooping Attack (5 Ferocity)
actions.value: The hawk moves up to their speed without provoking opportunity attacks. During or after this move, they can make a signature attack against one target. On a hit, the target must succeed on a DC 10 plus PB Strength saving throw or drop one item they are holding.

actions.name: 5th Level: Storm of Talons (8 Ferocity)
actions.value: The hawk moves up to their speed without provoking opportunity attacks, then they can dive onto one creature within 5 feet of them. The target must make a DC 10 plus PB Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, the target takes **PBd10** slashing damage and is blinded until the end of the hawk's next turn. On a successful save, the target takes half as much damage and isn't blinded.

traits.name: Aquatic Camouflage
traits.value: The leech has Advantage on Dexterity (*Stealth*) checks made to hide in aquatic terrain.

traits.name: Blood Bags
traits.value: The leech has three blood bags in its body. When encountered, roll 1d3 to determine how many blood bags are filled with blood. The rest are empty.

actions.name: Attach
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +3, reach 0 ft. *Hit:* The leech attaches to the target. While attached, the leech doesn't attack, and moves with the target, using none of the leech's movement. The leech can detach itself using 5 feet of movement, and detaches immediately if its blood bags are filled or if the target dies.

A creature within 5 feet can take an action to detach the leech with a successful DC 13 Wisdom (*Medicine*) check. *Failure:* The leech is still detached, but the target has the Bleeding condition (2d4). Failure by 5 or More: The leech isn't detached and the target takes 8 (**2d4 + 3**) Piercing damage.

bonusActions.name: Blood Drain
bonusActions.value: The leech can use this Bonus Action only when it is attached to a creature. The attached creature loses 10 (3d6) Hit Points due to blood loss, and the blood leech fills one of its empty blood bags with some of the target's blood.

bonusActions.name: Blood Transfusion
bonusActions.value: The leech can use this Bonus Action only when it is attached to a creature and has at least one filled blood bag. The attached creature regains 10 3d6 Hit Points, and the leech empties one of its filled blood bags.

entries: **HP**: Seven times their level (number of d8 Hit Dice equal to their level)
**Skills**: medicine +0 plus PB, persuasion +1 plus PB

actions.name: Signature Attack (Blood Curse)
actions.value: *Melee or Ranged Spell Attack:* +3 plus PB to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 60 ft., one target. *Hit:* **1d4 plus PB** necrotic damage, and the target is poisoned until the end of the seneschal's next turn. Beginning at 7th level, the seneschal can make this attack twice, instead of once, when they take the Attack action on their turn.

actions.name: 3rd Level: Coagulate (3/Day)
actions.value: As an action, the seneschal empowers the blood of up to PB creatures within 30 feet of them. Each target can expend 1 Hit Die, rolling it and regaining hit points equal to twice the result plus their Constitution modifier.

actions.name: 5th Level: Blood Puppet (3/Day)
actions.value: As an action, the seneschal chooses a creature they can see within 60 feet of them. The target must succeed on a DC 10 plus PB Wisdom saving throw or move up to their speed in a direction of the seneschal's choice. During this movement, the seneschal can force them to make one attack against a creature of the seneschal's choice (no action required).

actions.name: 7th Level: Blood Bondage (1/Day)
actions.value: As an action, the seneschal arrests the hearts of up to PB creatures within 30 feet of them. Each target must make a DC 10 plus PB Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes **PBd6** necrotic damage and is paralyzed for 1 minute (save ends at end of turn). On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage and isn't paralyzed.

traits.name: Amorphous
traits.value: The ooze can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

traits.name: False Appearance
traits.value: While the ooze remains motionless, they are indistinguishable from a pool of blood.

actions.name: Pseudopod
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 4 (**1d4 + 2**) bludgeoning damage plus 2 (**1d4**) necrotic damage. If the target is a creature who isn't a Construct or an Undead, they must succeed on a DC 11 Constitution saving throw or the ooze melds into the target's body.
While inside a creature, the ooze has total cover against attacks and other effects originating outside that host.

If the host creature takes 5 damage or more on a single turn from a source other than the ooze, the ooze must succeed on a DC 12 Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or exit the host, entering the nearest unoccupied space of the ooze's choice. A cure ailment power, __protection from poison__ spell, or __lesser restoration__ spell cast on the host also forces the ooze out. By spending 5 feet of their movement, the ooze can voluntarily leave the host's body.

actions.name: Crimson Feast (Inside Host Only)
actions.value: The ooze consumes their host creature's bodily fluids. The host must make a DC 11 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the host takes 5 (**2d4**) necrotic damage and is poisoned until the end of their next turn. On a successful save, the host takes half as much damage and isn't poisoned.

traits.name: Amorphous
traits.value: The ooze can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

traits.name: False Appearance
traits.value: While the ooze remains motionless, they are indistinguishable from a pool of blood.

actions.name: Pseudopod
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 4 (**1d4 + 2**) bludgeoning damage plus 2 (**1d4**) necrotic damage. If the target is a creature who isn't a Construct or an Undead, they must succeed on a DC 11 Constitution saving throw or the ooze melds into the target's body.
While inside a creature, the ooze has total cover against attacks and other effects originating outside that host.

If the host creature takes 5 damage or more on a single turn from a source other than the ooze, the ooze must succeed on a DC 12 Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or exit the host, entering the nearest unoccupied space of the ooze's choice. A cure ailment power, __protection from poison__ spell, or __lesser restoration__ spell cast on the host also forces the ooze out. By spending 5 feet of their movement, the ooze can voluntarily leave the host's body.

actions.name: Crimson Feast (Inside Host Only)
actions.value: The ooze consumes their host creature's bodily fluids. The host must make a DC 11 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the host takes 5 (**2d4**) necrotic damage and is poisoned until the end of their next turn. On a successful save, the host takes half as much damage and isn't poisoned.

entries: **HP**: 6 + six times caregiver's level (number of d8 Hit Dice equal to their caregiver's level)

traits.value: The ooze can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

actions.name: Signature Attack (Pseudopod)
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +3 plus PB to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* **1d6 plus PB** bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: 1st Level: Distracting Attack (2 Ferocity)
actions.value: The ooze makes a signature attack. On a hit, the attack deals its normal effects, and the next attack made against the target before the start of the ooze's next turn has advantage.

actions.name: 3rd Level: Clever Goop (5 Ferocity)
actions.value: The ooze takes the Hide action and makes a signature attack (in either order). If the attack hits a Large or smaller creature, the target is knocked prone. While the ooze is hidden in this way, they can approach a creature or move where they're clearly visible without automatically giving away their position.

actions.name: 5th Level: Crimson Feast (8 Ferocity)
actions.value: The ooze attempts to enter the body of a creature they can see within 5 feet of them who isn't a Construct or an Undead. The target must make a DC 10 plus PB Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the ooze melds into the target, who takes **PBd6** necrotic damage, becomes the ooze's host, and is poisoned until the ooze exits the host.
While melded, the ooze has total cover against attacks and other effects originating outside the host, and they can't take any action except to exit the host as a bonus action.

At the start of each of the ooze's turns, the host must make a DC 10 plus PB Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the host takes **PBd6** necrotic damage and remains melded. On a successful save, the host takes half as much damage and the ooze exits the host. If the host dies or is subject to a cure ailment power, a protection from poison or __lesser restoration__ spell, or a similar supernatural effect, the ooze exits the host.
When the ooze exits the host, they enter an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the host.

bonusActions.name: Parasitic Symbiosis
bonusActions.value: If the ooze's caregiver is within 5 feet of them, the ooze moves inside their caregiver. While inside their caregiver, the ooze has total cover against attacks and other effects originating outside the caregiver. The ooze can exit the caregiver by using another bonus action, entering an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the caregiver.

bonusActions.name: Quick Cure (1/Day)
bonusActions.value: While inside their caregiver (see Parasitic Symbiosis), the ooze cleanses their caregiver's blood, ending the paralyzed and poisoned conditions on the caregiver.

entries: **Languages**: the languages they knew in life

traits.name: Minion
traits.value: If the vampire takes damage from an attack or as the result of a failed saving throw, their hit points are reduced to 0. If the vampire takes damage from another effect, they die if the damage equals or exceeds their hit point maximum; otherwise they take no damage.

traits.name: Radiant Weakening
traits.value: The vampire has disadvantage on saving throws against effects that deal radiant damage.

actions.name: Feeding Frenzy (Group Attack)
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 2 piercing damage plus 3 necrotic damage. If two or more vampires joined the attack, the target's hit point maximum is reduced by a number equal to the necrotic damage dealt. The reduction lasts until the target finishes a long rest or is targeted by a cure ailment power, a __lesser restoration__ spell, or a similar supernatural effect. The target dies if this attack reduces their hit point maximum to 0.

traits.name: Infernal Ichor
traits.value: When Varrox dies, his corpse unleashes a spray of burning orange ichor. Each creature within 5 feet of him takes 5 fire damage.

traits.name: Infernal Sacrifice (3/Day)
traits.value: When Varrox fails a saving throw, he can call on Hell to succeed instead. When he does, each ally within 60 feet of him takes 5 necrotic damage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: Varrox makes three attacks using Soulsword, Death Skulls, or both.

actions.name: Soulsword
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 11 (**2d6 + 4**) slashing damage plus 10 (**3d6**) necrotic damage. If the target is a creature, they can't regain hit points until the start of Varrox's next turn.

actions.name: Death Skulls
actions.value: *Ranged Weapon Attack:* +7 to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. *Hit:* 8 (**1d8 + 4**) piercing damage plus 9 (**2d8**) fire damage, and Varrox can teleport to an unoccupied space he can see within 5 feet of the target.

bonusActions.name: Advance and Attack
bonusActions.value: Varrox barks orders at one ally within 60 feet of him who can hear him. That ally can use their reaction to move up to their speed and make a weapon attack.

entries: **Languages**: all languages known before the curse, and all languages known by its host

traits.name: Electric Invigoration
traits.value: Whenever a Body Snatcher would take Lightning damage, it absorbs the energy and instead gains Temporary Hit Points equal to half the damage, rounded down. The Body Snatcher also immediately recharges its Electric Torrent ability.

traits.name: Skin Sack
traits.value: The Body Snatcher is physically indistinguishable from its host and cannot be detected by nonmagical means. If the Body Snatcher is reduced to 0 Hit Points, and it has been inside its current host for less than 24 hours, the host regurgitates it then has the Unconscious condition and 1 Hit Point.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The Body Snatcher makes two Slam attacks.

actions.name: Invade
actions.value: *Strength Saving Throw:* DC 15; one Humanoid creature Grappled by the Body Snatcher. *Failure:* The Body Snatcher departs its current host and moves into the Grappled creature. It then regains all Hit Points and recharges Electric Torrent. If it had been inside its previous host for less than 24 hours, that creature has the Unconscious condition and 1 Hit Point. Otherwise, the previous host body becomes a lifeless skin sack.

actions.name: Electric Torrent (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: The Body Snatcher unleashes a large electric pulse. *Dexterity Saving Throw:* DC 15, each other creature within 20 feet of the Body Snatcher. *Failure:* 28 (**8d6**) Lightning damage. *Success* Half damage.

fluffInfo.name: Study the Foe
fluffInfo.value: Characters proficient in *Medicine* gain Advantage on Wisdom (*Insight*) or Intelligence (*Investigation*) checks to Study a Body Snatcher, learning the following based on the result:

fluffInfo.name: (10+) Emotionless Undead
fluffInfo.value: You know the Body Snatcher's condition Immunities.

fluffInfo.name: (15+) Shadowy Energy
fluffInfo.value: You are aware of its Clinging Shadows trait.

fluffInfo.name: (20+) In the Dark of Night
fluffInfo.value: You recognize the Body Snatcher's Sunlight Weakness trait.

fluffInfo.name: Combat Tactics
fluffInfo.value: The Body Snatcher sticks to dimly lit areas or places of complete darkness. It teleports up to a creature and attempts to grapple it, teleporting away as soon as it has one or two targets in its hands. Often the Body Snatcher will emerge from tunnels or secret entrances to its lair. They do not travel far from the labs they were created in and often have easy points of escape to disappear once they have a victim in hand.

fluffInfo.name: Animus:
fluffInfo.value: Undead.

fluffInfo.name: Fluid:
fluffInfo.value: Monster Blood, Contaminated Ichor.

fluffInfo.name: Organs:
fluffInfo.value: Eyes, Heart, Brain, Guts.

fluffInfo.name: Bones:
fluffInfo.value: Skull, Spine.

fluffInfo.name: Hair:
fluffInfo.value: Stitches, Hair.

fluffInfo.name: Hide:
fluffInfo.value: Skin.

fluffInfo.name: Dust:
fluffInfo.value: Undead Dust.

entries: **Languages**: understands the languages of its creator but can't speak

traits.name: Clinging Shadows
traits.value: A creature in Dim Light or Darkness has Disadvantage on ability checks to escape the body snatcher's grapple. Each time a creature attempts to escape the body snatcher's grapple while it is in Dim Light or Darkness, the creature takes 18 (**4d8**) Necrotic damage. If this Necrotic damage reduces the target to 0 Hit Points, the target is stabilized but has the Paralyzed condition for 1 hour, even if it regains Hit Points.

traits.name: Sunlight Weakness
traits.value: The body snatcher takes 10 (**3d6**) Radiant damage if it ends its turn in sunlight, and has Disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks while in sunlight.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The body snatcher makes four Grabbing Hands attacks.

actions.name: Grabbing Hands
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +7, reach 10 ft. *Hit:* 11 (**2d6 + 4**) Bludgeoning damage, and if the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 15). Until this grapple ends, the body snatcher can't use this hand against another target. The body snatcher has four hands, each of which can grapple one target.

bonusActions.name: Shadow Teleport
bonusActions.value: The body snatcher teleports up to 120 feet to an unoccupied space that it can see that is in Dim Light or Darkness. It can bring any Medium or smaller creature it is grappling, teleporting that creature to an unoccupied space it can see within 5 feet of its destination that is also in Dim Light or Darkness. An unwilling creature can make a DC 13 Charisma saving throw to resist being teleported. On a successful save, neither the creature nor the body snatcher __Teleport__.

entries: **Languages**: understands the languages they knew in life but can't speak

traits.name: Acidic Blood
traits.value: A creature who deals piercing or slashing damage to the bog body while within 5 feet of them takes 3 (**1d6**) acid damage.

actions.name: Slam
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 6 (**1d6 + 3**) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, they are grappled (escape DC 13). Until this grapple ends, the bog body can't make a Slam attack against another target.

actions.name: Sling Mud
actions.value: *Ranged Weapon Attack:* +5 to hit, range 30 ft., one target. *Hit:* 5 (**1d4 + 3**) bludgeoning damage plus 3 (**1d6**) acid damage.

actions.name: Submerge
actions.value: If the bog body is in swampy terrain, they can submerge themself beneath the water and mud. While submerged, the bog body is heavily obscured.

If the bog body is grappling a target when they submerge, the target submerges with them. While submerged, the target is heavily obscured, restrained, and unable to breathe, and takes 4 (**1d8**) acid damage at the start of each of their turns.
A bog body can resurface as a bonus action. When they do so, a target they have grappled also resurfaces.

fluffInfo.name: Study the Foe
fluffInfo.value: Characters proficient in *Nature* or *Survival* gain Advantage on Intelligence (*Arcana*) checks to Study a Bojack, learn the following based on their result:

fluffInfo.name: (10+) Parasitic Mutation
fluffInfo.value: You recognize the Bojack's Immunities and senses.

fluffInfo.name: (15+) Acidic Ambusher
fluffInfo.value: You're aware of the creature's Corrosive Mucus and Impaling Limbs attacks.

fluffInfo.name: (20+) Fast and Cunning
fluffInfo.value: You know the Bojack's strongest and weakest ability scores and saving throws.

fluffInfo.name: Combat Tactics
fluffInfo.value: The Bojack is an ambush skirmisher. It waits for the opportune moment to strike, attempting to surprise as many targets as possible. After it surprises its prey, it attacks with its Impaling Limbs or Corrosive Mucus and uses its Predatory Cunning to move out of melee range.

The Bojack can climb walls and will try and skitter up buildings or behind walls, springing back out to attack before escaping again. If brought below 20 Hit Points, the Bojack attempts to Dash away and Hide.

fluffInfo.name: Animus:
fluffInfo.value: Monstrosity.

fluffInfo.name: Fluid:
fluffInfo.value: Monster Blood, Contaminated Ichor, Acidic Bile, Mucus.

fluffInfo.name: Organs:
fluffInfo.value: Heart, Guts, Glands.

fluffInfo.name: Bones:
fluffInfo.value: Spine.

fluffInfo.name: Natural Weapons:
fluffInfo.value: Blades.

fluffInfo.name: Hair:
fluffInfo.value: Fur, Hair.

fluffInfo.name: Hide:
fluffInfo.value: Skin.

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.value: The bojack can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

traits.name: False Appearance
traits.value: While the bojack remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from a normal animal corpse.

traits.name: Sudden Death
traits.value: Creatures that haven't yet taken a turn in combat are Helpless against attacks made by the bojack.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The bojack makes two attacks, using Impaling Limbs or Corrosive Mucus in any combination.

actions.name: Impaling Limbs
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +7 to hit, reach 10 ft. *Hit:* 18 (**4d6 + 4**) Piercing damage and the target is Bleeding (2d6). While Bleeding in this way, the target is also Slowed.

actions.name: Corrosive Mucus
actions.value: *Ranged Attack Roll:* +7 to hit, range 30/60 ft. *Hit:* 14 (**4d4 + 4**) Acid damage and the target is Burning (2d4 Acid). While Burning in this way, the target's AC becomes 10 + its Dexterity modifier.

bonusActions.name: Predatory Cunning
bonusActions.value: The bojack takes the Dash, Disengage, or Hide action.

traits.name: Go for the Throat
traits.value: The bonemonger deals an extra 21 (**6d6**) damage when it hits a target with a bite attack and has advantage on the attack roll.

traits.name: Insightful Telepathy
traits.value: The bonemonger is constantly under the effects of the __detect thoughts__ spell (save DC 20). As a bonus action, it can probe deeper into the mind of any creature it can detect in its lair. If the creature fails its saving throw, the bonemonger has advantage on attack rolls against that creature until the start of the bonemonger's next turn.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.value: If the bonemonger fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Osteomancer (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
traits.value: If the bonemonger would be reduced to 0 hit points, its current hit point total instead resets to 246 hit points, it gains 100 temporary hit points as bones coalesce around it, and it regains any expended uses of Legendary Resistance. Additionally, the bonemonger can now use the options in the "Mythic Actions" section for 1 hour. Award a party an additional 41,000 XP (63,000 XP total) for defeating the bonemonger after its Osteomancer activates.

actions.value: The bonemonger makes one Bite attack and uses Mi.

actions.name: Bite

actions.name: Mi

traits.name: Bones of the Lost
traits.value: The bonestalker starts with 5 (2d4) skulls, which they can destroy to fuel their actions and reactions.
Choose or roll a d4 to determine each skull's creature type: 1, Beast; 2, Fey; 3, Humanoid; 4, Monstrosity.

traits.name: Skull Resistance
traits.value: While the bonestalker possesses at least one skull, they have advantage on saving throws against powers, spells, and other supernatural effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The bonestalker makes two Touch of the Felled or two Scream of the Forsaken attacks, and they can use Grief of the Bygone.

actions.name: Touch of the Felled
actions.value: *Melee Spell Attack:* +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 12 (**2d6 + 5**) necrotic damage. The bonestalker can destroy a Humanoid or Monstrosity skull to deal an extra 10 (**3d6**) psychic damage to the target.

actions.name: Scream of the Forsaken
actions.value: *Ranged Spell Attack:* +8 to hit, range 60 ft., one target. *Hit:* 15 (**3d6 + 5**) psychic damage.

The bonestalker can destroy a Fey skull to force the target to make a DC 16 Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the target is frightened of the bonestalker until the start of the bonestalker's next turn.

actions.name: Grief of the Bygone
actions.value: The bonestalker destroys two skulls of any type, creating a 15-foot-radius sphere of magical darkness centered on a point they can see within 60 feet of them.
The darkness spreads around corners and lasts for 1 minute.

A creature with darkvision can't see through this darkness, and mundane light can't illuminate it. The bonestalker is unaffected by the darkness and has advantage on attack rolls against creatures in the darkness.Any creature who starts their turn in the darkness must make a DC 16 Wisdom saving throw, taking 14 (**4d6**) psychic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

traits.name: Boog Rampage
traits.value: If Boog sees another Abomination reduced to 0 hit points, Boog rampages for 1 minute. While rampaging, Boog's melee attacks deal an extra 2 damage.

traits.name: Boog Charge
traits.value: If Boog moves at least 10 feet straight toward a Medium or smaller creature and then hits them with a Gore attack on the same turn, the target is impaled on Boog's horn and is grappled (escape DC 15). While grappled in this way, the target is restrained and takes 3 (**1d6**) piercing damage at the start of each of their turns, and Boog can't make a Gore attack against another target.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: Boog makes two Slam attacks.

actions.name: Slam
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 10 (**1d10 + 5**) bludgeoning damage or 12 (1d10 + 7) if rampaging.

actions.name: Gore
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 8 (**1d6 + 5**) piercing damage or 10 (1d6 + 7) if rampaging.

actions.name: Boog's Ball
actions.value: Boog throws a 3-inch-radius magic ball at a point they can see within 60 feet of them. If that point is 30 feet or less from Boog, the ball grows to a 5-foot radius. If that point is more than 30 feet from Boog, the ball grows to a 10-foot radius. Each creature in the ball's area when it reaches that point must succeed on a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw or take 14 (**4d6**) bludgeoning damage. After the ball reaches that point, it shrinks back to its 3-inch radius and teleports into the hand Boog used to throw it.

traits.name: Brainmuncher
traits.value: The brainmuncher likes to eat the brains of Tiny beasts, like household pets. If left unattended, it will attempt to do so (GM's discretion).

actions.name: Tentacles
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 4 (**1d4 + 2**) psychic damage.

actions.name: Levitate
actions.value: The brainmuncher casts the __levitate__ spell on itself.

entries: **Senses**: blindsight 60 ft. (blind beyond this radius in true form)
**Languages**: Common, Giant (can't speak in true form)

traits.name: Headless (True Form Only)
traits.value: The bredbeddle can't be blinded or deafened.

traits.name: Rejuvenation
traits.value: If the bredbeddle dies, they return to life in 1d6 months with all their hit points. If their body was destroyed, it reforms in an unoccupied space nearest to where they died. Only a __wish__ spell or finding and destroying the bredbeddle's true head can prevent this trait from functioning.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The bredbeddle makes two Executioner's Axe attacks.

actions.name: Executioner's Axe
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 23 (**3d10 + 7**) slashing damage.

actions.name: Beheading Strike (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +10 to hit, reach 15 ft., one Large or smaller Giant or Humanoid with a head. *Hit:* 40 (**6d10 + 7**) slashing damage, and the target must make a DC 15 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the bredbeddle cuts off the target's head, which lands at the target's feet. A creature beheaded in this way remains alive unless reduced to 0 hit points, but they are blinded and deafened, and they can't speak. A creature can use an action to place a beheaded creature's head back on their neck, reattaching the head and ending the effect. A beheaded creature dies if they are separated from their head for more than 24 hours.

bonusActions.name: Get a Head
bonusActions.value: The bredbeddle picks up a severed Giant or Humanoid head within 15 feet of them and places it on the bredbeddle's neck. The bredbeddle then polymorphs into that Giant or Humanoid creature. While polymorphed, the bredbeddle's statistics change as follows:

entries: Their size changes to match the creature whose head they bear.
They can see normally, and they gain any special senses the creature's head had.
Any equipment they are wearing or carrying temporarily changes to match their size, but the equipment's statistics do not change.

bonusActions.value: The bredbeddle reverts to their true form if they die, if their head is removed, or after 24 hours. When they revert, the head falls off and can't be reattached to the bredbeddle.
A creature who can reach the bredbeddle can use an action to make a DC 18 Strength (*Athletics*) check, removing the head from the bredbeddle on a success.

bonusActions.name: Toss Head (Polymorphed Form Only)
bonusActions.value: The bredbeddle removes their head, reverting to their true form, and throws the head at a creature they can see within 60 feet of them.
The head lands in the target's space, and the target must succeed on a DC 18 Dexterity saving throw or take 18 (**2d10 + 7**) bludgeoning damage.

entries: **Immunities**: poison; charmed, exhaustion, frightened, poisoned, prone

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.value: The chrysalis can breathe air and water.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)

Whenever the charmed target takes damage, the target can repeat the saving throw. On a success, the effect ends. No more than once every 24 hours, the target can also repeat the saving throw when it is at least 30 feet away from the broodling.

fluffInfo.name: Roleplaying Traits
fluffInfo.value: The following traits can be used to inspire roleplaying the Cacophonous Chimera:

entries: **Personality Trait:** "Just ONCE can we chat with someone a little before we eat them? RARGH! STOP TALKING! RIP AND TEAR! NO! NO! NO! Our stomach is FOUR TIMES bigger than it used to be! I'm STARVING!"
**Bond:** "We're fused together. Although each of us wants to be separated, in truth we're afraid of what would happen if we were ever torn apart."
**Ideal:** "I make such wonderful music! Each howl, shriek, and chitter resonates to form a deadly orchestra. I can't stand silence!"
**Flaw:** "We're constantly arguing. Our internal strife often distracts us from opportunities or leads us into traps, as we can't agree even on the simplest decisions."

fluffInfo.name: Study the Foe
fluffInfo.value: Characters proficient in *Nature* or *Survival* gain Advantage on Intelligence (*Arcana*) checks when they Study a Cacophonous Chimera, learning the following based on their result:

fluffInfo.name: (15+) Freakish Fusion
fluffInfo.value: You're aware of the chimera's Epic Resistance Epic Action.

fluffInfo.name: (20+) Fighting for Control
fluffInfo.value: You recognize the chimera's Cacophony Epic Action, noting that if the creature could be silenced, it would be far less formidable.

fluffInfo.name: (25+) Powerful but Distracted
fluffInfo.value: You understand its strongest and weakest ability scores and saving throws.

fluffInfo.name: Combat Tactics
fluffInfo.value: Desperate to eat and consume, the Cacophonous Chimera viciously attacks prey on sight despite the desires of its harpy head to engage in a little conversation first. The Cacophonous Chimera is not a very subtle hunter. Its prey can hear it coming by the sound of its droning cacophony from at least a city block away, which may give them opportunity to prepare, hide, or flee.

The range of its Cacophony can affect creatures before they can see the chimera itself. By the time the chimera arrives, its prey may be shaken and immobilized by the sound. Depending on how ravenous and furious it is, the chimera closes with its prey and tears them apart using its Claws, Bite, and Tail.

Against a target that shows resilience to its cacophony or who retaliates with formidable attacks of their own, the chimera keeps a middle distance, trying to keep out of melee range while leaving its foes in its Cacophonous Chorus aura. However, its ravenous Garmyr head and Ratling head can often get in the way of the better judgment here, prompting the chimera to engage in melee even when it would not be advantageous.

Furthermore, the three creatures are generally too busy arguing or overconfident to think twice about the actual danger and stakes they might be facing, and so may need to be grievously wounded before fleeing is an option.

traits.name: Cacophonous Chorus
traits.value: The cacophonous chimera creates a 30-foot Emanation of noise. A creature that starts its turn in the Emanation that can hear it takes 10 (**3d6**) Thunder damage.

traits.name: Keen Sight and Smell
traits.value: The cacophonous chimera has Advantage on Wisdom (*Perception*) checks that rely on sight or smell.

actions.name: The cacophonous chimera always takes its turn on Initiative count 20
actions.value: On its turn, the cacophonous chimera can use its movement and interaction as normal. However, it does not take an action or Bonus Action on its turn unless forced to do so by a spell or other effect. Instead, the cacophonous chimera takes one of the following Epic Actions at the end of each player character's turn:

entries: **Claws and Talons**: *Melee Attack Roll:* +11, reach 10 ft. *Hit:* 11 (**1d10 + 6**) Slashing damage, and if the target is Large or smaller, it has the Prone condition.

**Contaminated Bite (1/Round)**: *Melee Attack Roll:* +11, reach 10 ft. *Hit:* 17 (**2d10 + 6**) Piercing damage plus 10 (**3d6**) Necrotic damage. *Constitution Saving Throw:* DC 17. *Failure:* The target gains a Contamination level.

actions.name: Lamprey Tail
actions.value: Melee Attack Roll:+11, reach 30 ft. *Hit:* 13 (**2d6 + 6**) Piercing damage, and the target has the Bleeding condition (2d4).

actions.name: Aerial Maneuver (1/Round)
actions.value: The cacophonous chimera flies up to its Speed without provoking Opportunity Attack action.

actions.name: Cacophony (1/Round)
actions.value: The cacophonous chimera's three heads sing a discordant song. The effect of the song varies based on which of the chimera's head is taking the lead. Each time the cacophonous chimera uses this Epic Action, it can't use the same effect it chose last round.

actions.name: Bewildering Chitter (Ratling)
actions.value: *Intelligence Saving Throw:* DC 17, each creature in a 300-foot Emanation originating from the chimera that can hear it. *Failure:* 10 (**3d6**) Psychic damage, and the target has the Bewildered condition (save ends).

actions.name: Chilling Howl (Garmyr)
actions.value: *Wisdom Saving Throw:* DC 17, each creature in a 300-foot Emanation originating from the cacophonous chimera that can hear it. *Failure:* 10 (**3d6**) Cold damage, and the target has the Immobilized condition (save ends).

actions.name: Staggering Screech (Harpy)
actions.value: *Charisma Saving Throw:* DC 17, each creature in a 300-foot Emanation originating from the cacophonous chimera that can hear it. *Failure:* 10 (**3d6**) Necrotic damage, and the target has the Staggered condition (save ends).

actions.name: Wing Blast
actions.value: *Strength Saving Throw:* DC 17, each creature within 15 feet of the cacophonous chimera. *Failure:* 13 (**2d6 + 6**) Thunder damage, and the target is pushed 10 feet away from the chimera. *Success* Half damage only.

actions.name: Epic Resistance
actions.value: The cacophonous chimera chooses one condition, spell, or other effect currently affecting them and rolls 1d20. On an 11+, the effect ends on it. The cacophonous chimera can use this Epic Action even if it would otherwise be unable to take actions, its actions are being controlled by another creature, or if a spell or effect alters its game statistics.

actions.name: Manifestation (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: Caithas calls on his connection with Qazyldrath, and the dragon manifests in Caithas's space and exhales dark energy in a 30-foot line that is 5 feet wide. Each creature in that line must make a DC 19 Dexterity saving throw, taking 18 (**4d8**) acid damage plus 18 (**4d8**) necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. Additionally, that area is filled with magical darkness for 1 minute. A creature with darkvision can't see through this darkness, and supernatural light can't illuminate it. The manifestation of Qazyldrath then disappears.

bonusActions.name: Gaze of the Decay (1/Day)
bonusActions.value: Caithas chooses a creature he can see within 60 feet of him, magically marking them for 24 hours. While Caithas and the marked creature are on the same plane of existence, he always knows the distance and direction to them. Additionally, a marked creature can't hide from him, and if the marked creature becomes invisible, they gain no benefit from that condition against Caithas.

fluffInfo.value: The Cerebrograft is a horrific attempt to combine two creatures into a singular form, a nightmarish combination of brains and brawn. Through surgical implantation and flesh-melding, an apothecary creates a forced symbiosis, fusing their nervous systems and unlocking potent psionic abilities.

fluffInfo.name: Improved Lackeys
fluffInfo.value: A Cerebrograft is often the "reward" granted to a pair of loyal lab assistants, a means of "removing deficiencies" by combining their bodies and minds, frequently named a portmanteau of its constituent beings.

fluffInfo.name: Dominant Personality
fluffInfo.value: Although intended to be a symbiosis of two minds, typically, the implanted creature subsumes the psyche of its host, fully controling the new form. However, sometimes, the two beings form a constituent mind combining elements of the originals, or even a bicameral mind where the original two debate internally over what action to take.

fluffInfo.name: Delicate Work
fluffInfo.value: Thanks to their psionic abilities, Cerebrografts are well suited to controlling other test subjects. Apothecaries find their precise telekinetic powers especially useful in surgical procedures and laboratory experiments.

fluffInfo.name: Study the Foe
fluffInfo.value: Characters proficient in *Medicine* gain Advantage on Wisdom (*Insight*) or Intelligence (*Investigation*) checks to Study a Cerebrograft, learning the following based on the result:

fluffInfo.name: (10+) Occult Fleshmending
fluffInfo.value: You uncover the Cerebrograft's Dual Minds trait.

fluffInfo.name: (15+) Powerful Psionics
fluffInfo.value: You recognize its Telekinetic Grip and Psychic Crush.

fluffInfo.name: (20+) Powerful, Clumsy, and Slow
fluffInfo.value: You learn the Cerebrograft's ability scores and saving throws.

fluffInfo.name: Combat Tactics
fluffInfo.value: Despite its physical and psionic might, Cerebrografts prefers fighting alongside allies of its apothecary master. When confronted with multiple foes, it tries to overwhelm their minds using Psychic Crush to escape and find reinforcements.

A Cerebrograft uses its Telekinetic Grip to hold its enemies, unruly test subjects, and wild experiments at bay. It typically focuses on one target, allowing allies to pummel the Restrained foe. If it can, it uses the environment to its advantage, moving foes to restrain them such as into mancles, cages, or surgery tables.

traits.name: Dual Minds
traits.value: The cerebrograft has Advantage on saving throws to avoid or end the Blinded, Charmed, Deafened, Frightened, Stunned, and Unconscious conditions.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The cerebrograft makes two Slam attacks and uses Telekinetic Grip.

actions.name: Slam
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +9, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 23 (**4d8 + 5**) Bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Telekinetic Grip
actions.value: The cerebrograft reaches out with its mind to hold one creature or object it can see within 120 feet of it in its psychic grasp. If the target is a creature, it is subjected to the following effect. *Strength Saving Throw:* DC 16. *Failure:* The target is moved up to 30 feet in any direction and has the Restrained condition until the start of the cerebrograft's next turn or until the cerebrograft has the Incapacitated condition.

If the target is an object weighing 300 pounds or less that isn't being worn or carried, it is telekinetically moved up to 30 feet in any direction. The cerebrograft can also exert fine control on objects with its telekinesis, such as manipulating a simple tool or opening a door or a container.

actions.name: Psychic Crush (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: *Intelligence Saving Throw:* DC 16, each creature in a 20-foot Emanation originating from the cerebrograft. *Failure:* 22 (**4d10**) Psychic damage, and the target has the Dazed condition (save ends). Failure by 5 or More: The target instead has the Stunned condition (save ends). *Success* Half damage only.

fluffInfo.value: *The only chemists I admire are the ones who make Caspian cinnamon rolls. This is not one of them.*

Chemists indulge in the science of the alchemical, often harnessing the raw potential of elemental formulae while creating unique compounds and reagents. They have been known to dabble in the science behind the creation of elementals and oozes, and perfecting explosives and acids.

fluffInfo.name: Chemist Minions
fluffInfo.value: Although Chemists often do not dabble in creating creatures, any apothecary can make use of minions. Simple elementals and oozes can be found in a Chemist's lab. __Tankers__ work as a good lab assistant for administering large amounts of chemical formulae for the scientist, while __Living Biohazards__ are often the failed early experiments many Chemists. A __Chemystral__ is the ultimate pride and joy of many chemists.

entries: **Personality Trait:** I revel in the chaos and destruction that my concoctions cause, watching the flames and corrosion with maniacal laughter and a crazed gleam in my eyes.
**Bond:** Creativity is born from chaos; the most groundbreaking discoveries require pushing boundaries, no matter the dangers involved.
**Ideal:** I am obsessed with avenging my mentor, who was persecuted by those who feared our knowledge and power.

**Flaw:** My obsession with perfecting destructive formulae often leads me to take careless risks, sabotaging my own work and safety. I've burned down my own workshop more times than I can remember, and I'll do it again.

fluffInfo.name: Study the Foe
fluffInfo.value: Characters proficient in *Medicine* gain Advantage on Wisdom (*Insight*) or Intelligence (*Investigation*) checks to study a Chemist, learning the following based on the result:

fluffInfo.name: (10+) Resistance from Exposure
fluffInfo.value: You know of the Chemist's damage Resistances and Immunities.

fluffInfo.name: (15+) Masters of Compounds
fluffInfo.value: You learn the Chemist's Critical Condition trait and Explosive Compound action. (20+) Mental, not Physical, Prowess. You are aware of the Chemist's AC and saving throws.

fluffInfo.name: Combat Tactics
fluffInfo.value: Chemists opt to start things off with a bang, unleashing their Explosive Concoction on the first round, especially against a grouped together party. They use Acid Rain to create a dangerous zone between them and their enemies and default to unleashing their Chemical Spray on enemies stuck in the difficult area. If a creature closes the distance on the Chemist, they use their Caustic Grip. If they find themselves surrounded or outnumbered in close quarters, they attempt to escape.

traits.name: Critical Condition
traits.value: A creature that rolls a natural 1 on a saving throw against the chemist's attacks or effects takes maximum damage from the attack or effect.

traits.name: Special Immunities
traits.value: Chemist is immune to the Burning condition.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The chemist makes one Caustic Grip attack and uses either Chemical Spray or Explosive Concoction, if available.

actions.name: Caustic Grip
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +9, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 24 (**8d4 + 4**) Acid damage, and the target has the Grappled condition (escape DC 17). Until the grapple ends, the target has the Restrained condition and the chemist can't use Caustic Grip against another target. At the end of each of its turns, the target takes 24 (**8d4 + 4**) Acid damage.

actions.name: Chemical Spray
actions.value: *Dexterity Saving Throw:* DC 17, each creature in a 30-foot Cone. *Failure:* 28 (**8d6**) Acid, Cold, Fire, or Lightning damage (the chemist's choice). *Success* Half damage.

actions.name: Explosive Concoction (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: *Dexterity Saving Throw:* DC 17, each creature in a 20-foot radius Sphere centered on a point within 120 feet of the chemist. *Failure:* 45 (**10d8**) Acid, Cold, Fire, or Lightning damage (the chemist's choice), and the target has the Burning condition (4d6, same damage type). *Success* Half damage only.

actions.name: Acid Rain (1/Day)
actions.value: The chemist conjures a storm of acid rain in a 20-foot radius, 20-foot tall Cylinder centered on a point it can see within 120 feet. Exposed flames in the area are doused. Chemical pools accumulate in the area and emit thick fumes, rendering it Difficult Terrain and Lightly Obscured. The storm and the pools evaporate after 1 minute.

A creature that enters the area for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there is subjected to the following effect. *Dexterity Saving Throw:* DC 17. *Failure:* 30 (**12d4**) Acid damage, and the target has the Prone condition. *Success* Half damage only.

bonusActions.name: Emergency Dose
bonusActions.value: The chemist administers a restorative poultice to itself or a creature it can see within 5 feet that isn't a Construct or Undead. The target regains 35 10d6 Hit Points. Once a creature benefits from Emergency Dose, it can't do so again until it finishes a Short or Long Rest.

fluffInfo.value: One of a __Chemist__'s ultimate creations, the Chemystral is a perfectly balanced sentient compound capable of altering its physiology to adapt to surrounding threats. The horrific ooze has the ability to stick to any surface and even propel itself into the air and fly. It is impervious to nearly all forms of elemental attack. Much like a chameleon changing its color to blend into its surroundings, the Chemystral changes itself at a cellular level to adapt to environmental changes and elemental threats, gaining properties to better combat predators. Even with its inherent resilience, the Chemystral is unable to adapt to the cold, or deal with intense sound.

fluffInfo.name: Study the Foe
fluffInfo.value: Characters proficient in *Medicine* gain Advantage on Wisdom (*Insight*) or Intelligence (*Investigation*) checks to Study a Chemystral, learning the following based on the result:

fluffInfo.name: (15+) Living Chemical Reaction
fluffInfo.value: You know the Chemystral's

fluffInfo.value: You uncover the Chemystral's Elemental Reaction trait.

fluffInfo.name: (25+) Weakness to Cold
fluffInfo.value: You recognize the Chemystral's Cold Vulnerability trait.

fluffInfo.name: Combat Tactics
fluffInfo.value: The Chemystral attempts to Engulf as many victims as it can. It cares little about taking elemental damage and only thinks to retreat if it is consistently taking Cold damage.

traits.name: Amorphous Form
traits.value: The chemystral can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch without squeezing.

traits.name: Cold Vulnerability
traits.value: If the chemystral takes Cold damage, it becomes Frozen (DC 15). While it has the Frozen condition, it loses its Immunities to Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage and its Resistance to Force damage, and it gains Vulnerability to Thunder damage. In addition to the normal means, the Frozen condition ends if the chemystral takes 20 points of Force, Piercing, Thunder, or Slashing damage.

traits.name: Elemental Reaction
traits.value: If the Chemystral takes Acid, Fire, Lightning, Poison, or Necrotic damage, it takes on elemental properties which change the damage type of its Chemical Spray and Engulf actions to match that damage type. In addition, it causes an additional effect when it hits with its Chemical Spray attack:

traits.name: Acid
traits.value: On a hit, the target has the Burning condition (4d6 Acid).

traits.name: Fire
traits.value: On a hit, the target has the Burning condition (4d6 Fire).

traits.name: Lightning
traits.value: On a hit, the target has the Shocked condition until the end of its next turn.

traits.name: Poison
traits.value: On a hit, the target has the Poisoned condition until the end of its next turn.

traits.name: Necrotic
traits.value: On a hit, the chemystral regains Hit Points equal to the Necrotic damage dealt.

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.value: The chemystral regains 25 Hit Points at the start of its turn. If the chemystral takes Cold or Thunder damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of its next turn. The chemystral dies only if it starts its turn with 0 Hit Points and doesn't regenerate.

traits.name: Sonic Neutralization
traits.value: When the chemystral takes Thunder damage, it loses any active benefit from its Elemental Reaction trait.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The chemystral makes two Chemical Spray attacks and uses Engulf.

actions.name: Chemical Spray
actions.value: *Melee or Ranged Attack Roll:* +9, reach 5 ft. or range 30/120 ft. *Hit:* 35 (**10d6**) Acid damage.

actions.name: Engulf
actions.value: The chemystral moves up to its Speed. While doing so, it can enter Large or smaller creatures' spaces. Whenever the chemystral enters a creature's space, the creature is subjected to the following effect. *Dexterity Saving Throw:* DC 17. *Success* The creature can choose to be pushed 5 feet back or to the side of the chemystral. A creature that chooses not to be pushed suffers the consequences of a failed saving throw.

*Failure:* The chemystral enters the creature's space, and the creature takes 35 (**10d6**) Acid damage and is engulfed. The engulfed creature can't breathe, has the Restrained condition, and takes 35 (**10d6**) Acid damage at the start of each of the chemystral's turns. The engulfed creature has Total Cover from effects outside the chemystral. When the chemystral moves, the engulfed creature moves with it.

The chemystral can hold only one Large creature or up to four Medium or smaller creatures inside it at a time. An engulfed creature can take an action to escape with a successful DC 17 Strength check, entering a space of its choice within 5 feet of the ooze.

traits.name: Nimble Escape
traits.value: The chicken can take the Disengage or Hide action as a bonus action.

actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 1 piercing damage.

actions.name: 1st Level: Ram's Defense (2 Ferocity)

actions.name: 3rd Level: Lion's Leap (5 Ferocity)
actions.value: The chimera moves up to half their speed without provoking opportunity attacks. If they end this movement on the ground, each creature within 5 feet of them must succeed on a DC 10 plus PB Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

traits.name: Lethe
traits.value: While the chimeron's soul count is 0, they have advantage on attack rolls, disadvantage on saving throws, and their Intelligence score becomes 3 (-4). Additionally, the chimeron must use their movement on each of their turns to move as close as possible to the nearest creature they can sense with their soulsight, and then if they are able, they must use their action to attack and attempt to kill that creature. The chimeron can't act with any other purpose until they add 1 to their soul count.

traits.name: Soul Devourer
traits.value: When the chimeron reduces a creature who isn't a Construct or an Undead to 0 hit points or deals damage to a dying creature, the creature must make a DC 11 Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the chimeron consumes the creature's soul and adds 1 to the chimeron's soul count. A creature whose soul is consumed in this way immediately dies, and they can't be restored to life by any means short of a __wish__ spell.

traits.name: Soul Resistance
traits.value: While the chimeron's soul count is is 2 or higher, they have advantage on saving throws against powers, spells, and other supernatural effects.

actions.name: Multiattack

A creature who is on fire at the start of their turn takes 7 (**2d6**) fire damage. If a creature who is already on fire is set on fire again on a subsequent turn, the damage isn't cumulative.

fluffInfo.name: Combat Tactics
fluffInfo.value: Chitinous Dregs often charge into the front lines of combat. It positions itself between other Dregs and their foes almost as if it was defending its allies. Chitinous Dregs attempt to draw the combat towards itself at all times, using its Bone Blades to keep the focus on it, and its Sentinel Strike Reaction and No Escape trait to ensure creatures facing it cannot get away. The Chitinous Dreg is a warrior and rarely retreats: it is too enraged with a protective bloodlust when thrust into battle to worry about its own wellbeing.

fluffInfo.name: Combat Tactics
fluffInfo.value: Chitters often attack in a small group. Usually two to three that form a family will stick together. The mutated squirrels have been known to be quite territorial and hostile, even to other Chitter families who try to infringe on their territory.

Chitters are excellent climbers, capable of falling a great distance without fear of hurting themselves. It is not uncommon for Chitters to be found in tall buildings, or up on the top floor of ruined houses, or hard-to-reach rooftops or attics. Chitters charge their enemies and leap at them, attempting to disable them with their chittering, and relying on their Claws and Bite. Chitters protect their homes with determined ferocity, but if reduced to less than a third of their Hit Points, they leap and clamber away.

traits.value: As long as the chitter has moved 20+ feet this turn, it has a high jump and long jump of 30 feet.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The chitter makes two Sharpened Claws attacks and one Acrid Bite attack. It can also use Chitter, if available.

actions.name: Acrid Bite
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +5, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 7 (**1d8 + 3**) Piercing damage plus 14 (**4d6**) Necrotic damage.

actions.name: Sharpened Claws
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +5, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 6 (**1d6 + 3**) Slashing damage.

actions.name: Chitter (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: *Wisdom Saving Throw:* DC 13, each creature within 120 feet of the chitter that can hear it. *Failure:* The target has the Dazed condition until the end of the chitter's next turn.

bonusActions.name: Aggressive
bonusActions.value: The chitter moves up to its Speed toward a Hostile creature it can see. If it ends this movement adjacent to the creature, it gains Advantage on attack rolls against that creature until the end of its turn.

entries: **Immunities**: poison, psychic; charmed, exhaustion, frightened, grappled, paralyzed, poisoned, prone, restrained, stunned

traits.name: Swarm
traits.value: The swarm can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and the swarm can move through an opening large enough for a Small creature. The swarm can't regain Hit Points or gain Temporary Hit Points.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The swarm makes two Slam attacks.

actions.name: Psychic Slam
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +5, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 13 (**4d4 + 3**) Psychic damage.

traits.name: Hold Breath
traits.value: The clawfish can hold their breath for 15 minutes.

actions.name: Claw
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 4 (**1d4 + 2**) slashing damage, and if the target is a Small or larger creature, the clawfish can pull themself into the target's space and attach to the target. While attached, the clawfish moves with the target without provoking opportunity attacks, and the clawfish can't make Claw attacks. A creature who can reach the clawfish can use an action to make a DC 12 Strength (*Athletics*) or Dexterity (*Acrobatics*) check. On a success, the clawfish is detached and shunted into an unoccupied space of the clawfish's choice within 5 feet of the target. The clawfish also detaches if they become grappled, incapacitated, prone, or restrained, or if they use 5 feet of movement to detach.

actions.name: Electrocute (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: Each creature touching the clawfish takes 7 (**2d6**) lightning damage. If the clawfish is immersed in water, each other creature within 10 feet of the clawfish who is touching the same body of water must succeed on a DC 11 Dexterity saving throw or take the same damage.

actions.name: 1st Level: Overwhelming Attack (2 Ferocity)
actions.value: The clawfish makes a signature attack. On a hit, the attack deals an extra **PB** lightning damage, and the target can't take reactions until the start of the clawfish's next turn.

actions.name: 3rd Level: Coiling Claws (5 Ferocity)
actions.value: The clawfish makes a signature attack against a Medium or smaller creature. On a hit, the target is grappled (escape DC 10 plus PB). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained and the clawfish can't make a signature attack against another target.

actions.name: 5th Level: Lightning Bomb (8 Ferocity)
actions.value: Each creature within 10 feet of the clawfish must make a DC 10 plus PB Dexterity saving throw, taking **PBd8** lightning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

traits.name: Exploit Opening (3/Day)
traits.value: When Cloak makes an attack, she has advantage on the attack roll.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: Cloak makes two Shortsword attacks.

actions.name: Shortsword
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 8 (**1d6 + 5**) piercing damage plus 3 (**1d6**) poison damage, and the target is poisoned until the start of Cloak's next turn.

actions.name: Light Crossbow
actions.value: *Ranged Weapon Attack:* +7 to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. *Hit:* 8 (**1d8 + 5**) piercing damage. If the target is a creature who hasn't moved since the end of Cloak's last turn, the attack deals an extra 7 (**2d6**) piercing damage.

actions.name: Iron Ring (2/Day)
actions.value: If not in the Cyst, Cloak teleports to the Cyst. If in the Cyst, she teleports to a place she has visited.

bonusActions.name: Cunning Action
bonusActions.value: Cloak takes the Dash, Disengage, or Hide action.

traits.name: Dispersal
traits.value: When the congregation is reduced to 0 Hit Points, it leaves behind 2d4 Pilgrims in its place.

traits.name: Mob
traits.value: The congregation can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and the congregation can move through any opening large enough for a Medium Humanoid. The congregation can't regain Hit Points or gain Temporary Hit Points.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The congregation makes one attack against each creature in its space.

actions.name: Torches
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +8, reach 0 ft. *Hit:* The target has the Burning condition (4d6 Fire).

actions.name: Pitchforks
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +8, reach 0 ft. *Hit:* 28 (**8d6**) Piercing damage, or 14 (**4d6**) Piercing damage if the congregation has the *Bloodied* condition. The target has the Prone condition.

bonusActions.name: Trample
bonusActions.value: *Dexterity Saving Throw:* DC 16, one creature in the congregation's space that has the Prone condition. *Failure:* 17 (**2d10 + 6**) Bludgeoning damage. *Success* Half damage.

traits.name: Shielded Mind
traits.value: The couatling is immune to scrying and to any effect that would sense its emotions, read its thoughts, or detect its location.

actions.name: Bite
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 5 (**1d6 + 2**) piercing damage.

actions.name: Goodsense (1/Day)
actions.value: The couatling casts __detect evil and good__, requiring no material components.

entries: **Skills**: deception +12, history +11, intimidation +12, perception +9, persuasion +12, stealth +11
**Resistances**: necrotic; bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from mundane attacks

traits.name: Resting Place
traits.value: When Rhodar drops to 0 hit points and isn't in his resting place, he teleports to his resting place. While in his resting place, Rhodar is stable. After spending 1 hour in his resting place with 0 hit points, he regains 1 hit point.

traits.name: Spear Sacrifice (3/Day)
traits.value: Rhodar is surrounded by three floating spears of shimmering darkness, which he can summon to a free hand on his turn (no action required). When Rhodar fails an ability check or saving throw, he can choose to destroy one of these spears and succeed on the ability check or saving throw instead. Once Rhodar destroys all three spears, he can't use his Spear of the Damned attack or Spear Sacrifice until the next dusk, when he manifests any destroyed spears.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: Rhodar makes two Sanguinus attacks, and he can make one Spear of the Damned attack for each Spear Sacrifice use he has remaining.

actions.name: Sanguinus
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +12 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 13 (**2d6 + 6**) slashing damage plus 14 (**4d6**) necrotic damage. If the target is a creature, their hit point maximum is reduced by a number equal to the necrotic damage taken, and Rhodar regains hit points equal to that number. This reduction lasts until reversed by a cure ailment power of 4th order or higher, a __greater restoration__ spell, or a similar supernatural effect.
The target dies if this effect reduces their hit point maximum to 0. A humanoid slain in this way rises the following midnight as a vampire spawn under Rhodar's control.

actions.name: Spear of the Damned
actions.value: *Ranged Spell Attack:* +12 to hit, range 60 ft., one target. *Hit:* 10 (**3d6**) force damage, and if the target is a creature, they are knocked prone and restrained as a spear of darkness impales them. A creature can attempt to free themself or another creature within their reach by using an action or a bonus action to make a DC 20 Strength (*Athletics*) check. On a success, the creature is freed and the restrained condition ends for them. The creature is also freed if Rhodar summons that spear to attack another target or destroys it using Spear Sacrifice.

bonusActions.name: Beguile
bonusActions.value: Rhodar targets one creature he can see within 30 feet of him and who can see him. The target must make a DC 20 Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the creature uses their reaction, if available, to move up to their speed to a location chosen by Rhodar, then either makes a melee attack against a target of Rhodar's choice or falls prone (Rhodar's choice).

bonusActions.name: Inhuman Agility
bonusActions.value: Rhodar moves up to his speed without provoking opportunity attacks.

fluffInfo.name: Study the Foe
fluffInfo.value: Characters proficient in *Nature* or *Survival* gain Advantage on Intelligence (*Arcana*) checks when they Study a Crater Wurm, learning the following based on their result:

fluffInfo.name: (15+) Subterranean Threat
fluffInfo.value: You know it has Tremorsense and that it creates tunnels when digging through rock.

fluffInfo.name: (20+) Earth Shaker
fluffInfo.value: You're aware of the Crater Wurms' Breach and Bite attacks.

fluffInfo.name: (25+) Blunderous Brute
fluffInfo.value: You recognize the Crater Wurms' strongest and weakest ability scores and saving throws.

fluffInfo.name: Combat Tactics
fluffInfo.value: Crater Wurms disregard other creatures, viewing them as only morsels to consume. All are as the dust of the earth to it—simply food. These wurms understand that creatures they devour often try to flee. Their favored tactic is to remain buried until their Tremorsense detects movement. They then surface with its Breach action, making Bite attacks, swallowing nearby Prone creatures. They dive beneath the ground once at least one creature is swallowed, or if reduced to half its Hit Point maximum.

fluffInfo.value: Teeth, Needles.
