traits.name: Tunneler
traits.value: The crater wurm can burrow through solid rock at half its Burrowing Speed and leaves a 10-foot diameter tunnel in its wake.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The crater wurm makes a Bite attack, then makes Bite attacks against each creature adjacent to the first target.

actions.name: Bite
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +14, reach 10 ft. *Hit:* 35 (**4d12 + 9**) Piercing damage, and if it is Large or smaller, the target is subjected to the following effect. *Dexterity Saving Throw:* DC 22. *Failure:* The target is swallowed by the wurm. The target has the Blinded and Restrained conditions, has Total Cover against effects originating from outside the wurm, and takes 36 (**8d8**) Necrotic damage at the start of each of the wurm's turns. A creature that takes this Necrotic damage must also succeed on a DC 19 Constitution saving throw or gain one Contamination level.

If the wurm takes 30+ damage on a single turn from a creature inside it, it must succeed on a DC 21 Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate all swallowed creatures, which land in spaces within 10 feet of the wurm with the Prone condition. If the wurm dies, a swallowed creature no longer has the Restrained condition and can escape from the corpse using 20 feet of movement, exiting with the Prone condition.

actions.name: Breach
actions.value: The wurm moves up to its Speed, entering the spaces of Large or smaller creatures. Each creature whose space it enters is subjected once to the following effect. At the end of its movement, the wurm can make one Bite attack against a Prone creature as a Bonus Action. *Strength Saving Throw:* DC 22. *Success* The target is pushed 5 feet away from the wurm into a space of its choice. If the target chooses not to move, it suffers the effects of a failure. *Failure:* 35 (**10d6**) Bludgeoning damage, and the target is pushed 10 feet away from the wurm and has the Prone condition.

entries: **Languages**: understands the languages they knew in life but can't speak

traits.name: Minion
traits.value: If the claw takes damage from an attack or as the result of a failed saving throw, their hit points are reduced to 0. If the claw takes damage from another effect, they die if the damage equals or exceeds their hit point maximum; otherwise they take no damage.

actions.name: Claw (Group Attack)
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 1 piercing damage. If three or more crawling claws joined the attack, the target must succeed on a DC 10 Constitution saving throw or contract a disease called gravefilth. Whenever a power, a spell, or a similar supernatural effect causes a creature with gravefilth to regain hit points, the number of hit points they regain is halved. A creature with gravefilth can repeat the saving throw whenever they finish a long rest. On a successful save, the disease is cured.

entries: **HP**: 6 + six times caregiver's level (number of d8 Hit Dice equal to their caregiver's level)
**Skills**: stealth +3 plus PB, sleight of hand +3 plus PB

traits.name: Fingers for Feet
traits.value: While the claw is holding an object, their speed is halved. If the claw is knocked prone, they drop anything they are holding.

actions.name: Signature Attack (Claw)
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +3 plus PB to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* **1d6 plus PB** slashing damage.

actions.name: 1st Level: Thieving Attack (2 Ferocity)
actions.value: The claw makes a signature attack. On a hit, the attack deals an extra **PB** slashing damage, and the claw takes a random object (determined by the GM) from an easily accessed pocket, pouch, backpack, or similar container the target is wearing or carrying.

actions.name: 3rd Level: Dazing Slash (5 Ferocity)
actions.value: The claw makes a signature attack. On a hit, the attack deals an extra **PB** slashing damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 10 plus PB Constitution saving throw or be dazed until the start of the claw's next turn.

actions.name: 5th Level: Filthy Scratch (8 Ferocity)
actions.value: The claw scratches a creature they can see within 5 feet of them. The target must make a DC 10 plus PB Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the target takes **PBd8** poison damage and is poisoned until the start of the claw's next turn. While poisoned in this way, the target can't regain hit points. On a successful save, the target takes half as much damage and isn't poisoned.

bonusActions.name: Fast Hand (3/Long Rest)
bonusActions.value: The claw moves up to their speed toward the caregiver without provoking opportunity attacks. The claw can take the Use an Object action once during this movement.

traits.name: Draconic Infusion
traits.value: The damage type that the turret's Bite, Breath Bolt, and Breath Weapon deals depends on the dragon breath sac with which it was infused: acid (black or copper); cold (silver or white); fire (brass, gold, or red); lightning (blue or bronze); or poison (green).

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.value: The turret can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

actions.name: Bite
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +6 to hit, reach 5ft., one target. *Hit:* 7 (**1d6 + 4**) piercing damage plus 3 (**1d6**) damage (see Draconic Infusion).

actions.name: Breath Bolt
actions.value: *Ranged Spell Attack:* +7 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. *Hit:* 11 (**2d10**) damage (see Draconic Infusion).

actions.name: Breath Weapon (1/Day)
actions.value: The turret exhales elemental energy in a 20-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 16 Dexterity saving throw, taking 21 (**6d6**) damage (see Draconic Infusion) on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

fluffInfo.name: Study the Foe
fluffInfo.value: Characters proficient in *Nature* or *Survival* gain Advantage on Intelligence (*Arcana*) checks when they take the Study action to examine Crimson Countess, learning the following based on the result:

fluffInfo.name: (5+) Arcane Resistance
fluffInfo.value: You know of the creature's Immunities.

fluffInfo.name: (10+) Dangerous Talons
fluffInfo.value: You recognize the creature's Pluck trait.

fluffInfo.name: (15+) Bold and Nimble
fluffInfo.value: You are aware of the creatures highest and lowest ability scores.

fluffInfo.name: Combat Tactics
fluffInfo.value: The Countess only leaves her clock tower to join in on hunts with her valkyries, but otherwise she prefers the defendable position at the towers highest floor. From here any adventurer who makes it past her soldiers and into her lair can easily be grabbed and thrown off the open balconies, falling to their death.

She is overconfident and will do anything to protect her advantageous position in the city. She only flees if all her minions are dead and she is below 25 Hit Points. If she flees, she will attempt to gather more soldiers and return to reclaim the clock tower at a later date.

traits.name: Aura of Storms
traits.value: A creature that starts its turn within 30 feet of the Crimson Countess takes 10 (**3d6**) Lightning damage.

traits.name: Pluck
traits.value: The Crimson Countess doesn't need to spend extra movement to drag a Medium or smaller creature Grappled by it.

actions.name: The Crimson Countess always takes their turn on Initiative count 20
actions.value: On their turn, the Crimson Countess can use their movement and interaction as normal. However, they do not take an action or Bonus Action on their turn unless forced to do so by a spell or other effect. Instead, the Crimson Countess takes one of the following Epic Actions at the end of each player character's turn:

entries: **Grasping Talons**: *Melee Attack Roll:* +8, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 7 (**1d4 + 5**) Piercing damage, and if the target is Medium or smaller, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 15).
**Lightning Javelin**: *Melee or Ranged Attack Roll:* +8, reach 5 ft. or range 30/60 ft. *Hit:* 14 (**2d8 + 5**) Lightning damage.

actions.name: Aerial Acrobat
actions.value: The Crimson Countess flies up to her Speed without provoking Opportunity Attack action.

actions.name: Frightful Screech (1/Round)
actions.value: *Wisdom Saving Throw:* DC 15, one creature within 120 feet of the Crimson Countess that can hear them. *Failure:* 14 (**4d6**) Psychic damage, and the target has the Frightened condition (save ends). While Frightened, the target must take the Dash action and move away from the Crimson Countess by the safest available route on each of its turns unless there is nowhere to move.

actions.name: Lightning Strike (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: *Dexterity Saving Throw:* DC 15, each creatures in a 60-foot long, 5-foot wide Line. *Failure:* 36 (**8d8**) Lightning damage, and the target has the Shocked condition until the end of its next turn. *Success* Half damage only.

actions.name: Epic Resistance
actions.value: The Crimson Countess chooses one condition, spell, or other effect currently affecting them and rolls 1d20. On an 11+, the effect ends on them. The Crimson Countess can use this action even if they would otherwise be unable to take actions, their actions are being controlled by another creature, or if a spell or effect alters their game statistics.

fluffInfo.name: Study the Foe
fluffInfo.value: Characters proficient in *History* or martial melee weapons gain Advantage on Intelligence (*Religion*) checks when taking the Study action to examine a Crimson Knight, learning the following based on the result.

fluffInfo.name: (10+) Elite Spawn
fluffInfo.value: You know the Crimson Knight's damage Resistances.

fluffInfo.name: (15+) Unholy Magic
fluffInfo.value: You recognize the Crimson Knight can unleash a variety of powerful smites.

fluffInfo.name: (20+) Weaknesses
fluffInfo.value: You are aware the vampire's regeneration is temporarily halted by Radiant damage, and its Vampire Weaknesses.

fluffInfo.name: Combat Tactics
fluffInfo.value: Crimson Knights form units with other minions and thralls of their vampire masters. Several Crimson Knights may form an elite guard, or one might be attached to lead a contingent of vampire thralls.

In battle, Crimson Knights seek out the most formidable melee combatants to meet head on, disarming them with Crackling Smite. They make use of Unholy Smite to prevent their target from healing, and terrorize them using Wrathful Smite.

A Crimson Knight will give their undead existence to defend their master and hold fast even as they are cut down. If they encounter a foe capable of dealing Radiant damage, they make them the target of their attacks to ensure they can continue to regenerate.

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.value: The vampire regains 10 Hit Points at the start of its turn if it has at least 1 Hit Point and isn't in sunlight or running water. If the vampire takes Radiant damage or damage from holy water, this trait doesn't function at the start of the vampire's next turn.

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.value: The vampire can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

traits.name: Vampire Weaknesses
traits.value: The vampire has the traits described in the "Vampire Weaknesses" sidebar in the Monsters of Drakkenheim.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The vampire makes three attacks. It can replace one attack with a Bite.

actions.name: Claws
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +7, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 9 (**2d4 + 4**) Slashing damage, and if the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 15).

actions.name: Crimson Axe
actions.value: *Melee or Ranged Attack Roll:* +7, reach 5 ft. or range 30/90 ft. *Hit:* 11 (**1d12 + 4**) Force damage, and the target suffers one of the following effects of the vampire's choice. *Hit or Miss:* After being thrown, the axe returns to the vampire's hand.

actions.name: Crackling Smite
actions.value: *Strength Saving Throw:* DC 16. *Failure:* 10 (**3d6**) Thunder damage, and the target has the Shocked condition until the end of its next turn. *Success* Half damage only.

actions.name: Unholy Smite
actions.value: *Constitution Saving Throw:* DC 16. *Failure:* 10 (**3d6**) Necrotic damage, and the target can't regain Hit Points until the end of the vampire's next turn. *Success* Half damage only.

actions.name: Wrathful Smite
actions.value: *Wisdom Saving Throw:* DC 16. *Failure:* 10 (**3d6**) Psychic damage, and the target has the Frightened condition (save ends). *Success* Half damage only.

actions.name: Bite
actions.value: *Constitution Saving Throw:* DC 15, one creature within 5 feet that is willing or has the Grappled, Incapacitated, or Restrained condition. *Failure:* 14 (**3d6 + 4**) Necrotic damage, and the vampire regains Hit Points equal to the Necrotic damage dealt.

bonusActions.name: Charge
bonusActions.value: The vampire moves up to its Speed toward a Hostile creature it can see. If it ends this movement within 5 feet of the creature, it has Advantage on the next attack roll it makes against that creature before the end of its turn.

traits.name: Ablaze
traits.value: The crux sheds bright light in a 20-foot radius and dim light for an additional 20 feet, and they can't benefit from being invisible. A creature who starts their turn grappling or grappled by the crux takes 7 (**2d6**) fire damage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The crux makes two Flame Tongue or two Sulfurous Rake attacks.

actions.name: Sulfurous Rake
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 10 (**2d6 + 3**) slashing damage, and the target can't take reactions this turn.

actions.name: Flame Tongue
actions.value: *Ranged Spell Attack:* +6 to hit, range 100 ft., one target. *Hit:* 13 (**2d12**) fire damage. If the target is a flammable object that isn't being worn or carried, it ignites.

bonusActions.name: Convocation of Fire (1/Day)
bonusActions.value: The crux imbues the power of fire in themself or another Elemental they can see within 30 feet of them, granting one of the following effects of that Elemental's choice:

entries: **Flame Bloom.** The Elemental launches a seed of flame at a point they can see within 60 feet of them. A 10-foot radius sphere centered on that point erupts with fire and burns for 1 minute. Each creature who enters that area for the first time on a turn or starts their turn there takes 10 (**3d6**) fire damage.

**Smoke Screen.** The Elemental exudes an aura of smoke 10 feet in every direction for 1 minute or until dispersed by a moderate or stronger wind. The smoky area is heavily obscured for all creatures who aren't fire elementals.

bonusActions.name: Flame Jet (1/Day)
bonusActions.value: The crux gains a flying speed of 30 feet until the end of their turn and can move up to their speed.

entries: **Languages**: Aquan, Common, plus the languages known by a creature reflected by Frosted Reflection

traits.name: Scintillating
traits.value: The crux can't benefit from being invisible.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The crux makes two Rimeglass Touch attacks, and they can use Frosted Reflection or It Stares Back, if available.

actions.name: Rimeglass Touch
actions.value: *Melee or Ranged Spell Attack:* +7 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 60 ft., one target. *Hit:* 17 (**3d8 + 4**) cold damage, and the target can't see or hear creatures other than themself and the crux until the start of the crux's next turn.

actions.name: Frosted Reflection
actions.value: The crux reflects the appearance of a specific Medium or Small creature they've seen within the last week. This appearance is illusory and imperfect, showing a frostbitten version of the creature. The illusion lasts until the crux takes thunder damage, uses this action again, or is incapacitated. For the duration, the crux additionally knows any languages that creature knows.

actions.name: It Stares Back (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: The crux imposes fragility on a creature within 60 feet of them who is reflected by the crux's Frosted Reflection. If the target can see the crux, the target must make a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the target is frightened of the crux for 1 minute (save ends at end of turn), or until the crux stops reflecting them. While frightened in this way, whenever the target takes damage, they take an extra 11 (**2d10**) psychic damage. On a successful save, the target isn't frightened, and they are immune to the It Stares Back of all cruxes for 24 hours.

bonusActions.name: Convocation of Ice (1/Day)
bonusActions.value: The crux imbues the power of ice in themself or another Elemental they can see within 30 feet of them, granting one of the following effects of that Elemental's choice:

entries: **Frigid Sheen.** The Elemental gains a mirror sheen that reflects damage for 1 minute. When the Elemental is hit with an attack by a creature they can see within 30 feet of them, the Elemental can use a reaction to reflect the attack. The Elemental is unaffected by the attack, and the attacker must make a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, the attack's damage and effects are reflected back at the attacker as if the attack originated from the Elemental, turning the attacker into the target. On a successful save, the attacker takes half as much damage, but suffers no other effect.

**Frost Squall.** Frost swirls around the Elemental for 1 minute. For the duration, each non-Elemental creature who starts their turn within 15 feet of the Elemental has their speed reduced to 15 feet unless it is already lower until the end of their turn, and the first time they willingly move before the start of their next turn, they take 10 (**3d6**) cold damage.
**Languages**: Aquan, Common, plus the languages known by a creature reflected by Frosted Reflection

traits.name: Aura of Dread
traits.value: A creature that starts its turn within 30 feet of Vladimir von Drakken takes 10 (**3d6**) Necrotic damage.

traits.name: Reborn Transformation
traits.value: When Vladimir von Drakken consumes the blood of six living creatures of level or challenge rating 10 or higher, he transforms into Reborn Vladimir von Drakken. His Initiative doesn't change. If he is destroyed before he can feed sufficiently, he must begin the process again when he rejuvenates.

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.value: Vladimir von Drakken regains 30 Hit Points at the start of his turn if he has at least 1 Hit Point remaining.

traits.name: Rejuvenation
traits.value: If Vladimir von Drakken is destroyed in his crypt-starved form, he crumbles into ash and reforms 1d10 days later with all of his Hit Points. His new body appears within his crypt in the Brachenwald. Casting Hallow on the druidic shrine prevents his new body from returning so long as the spell remains in effect.

traits.name: Vampire Weaknesses
traits.value: The vampire has the traits described in the "Vampire Weaknesses" sidebar in the Monsters of Drakkenheim.

actions.name: Vladimir von Drakken always takes his turn on Initiative count 20
actions.value: On his turn, Vladimir von Drakken can use his movement and interaction as normal. However, he does not take an action or Bonus Action on his turn unless forced to do so by a spell or other effect. Instead, Vladimir von Drakken takes one of the following Epic Actions at the end of each player character's turn:

entries: **Bloodmourne**: *Melee Attack Roll:* +10, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 26 (**6d6 + 5**) Force damage, and the target has the Bleeding condition (4d4).
**Claws**: *Melee Attack Roll:* +10, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 19 (**4d6 + 5**) Necrotic damage, and if the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 18).

actions.name: Bite (1/Round)
actions.value: *Constitution Saving Throw:* DC 18, one creature within 5 feet that is willing or has the Grappled, Incapacitated, or Restrained condition. *Failure:* 40 (**10d6 + 5**) Necrotic damage. The target's Hit Point Maximum decreases by an amount equal to the Necrotic damage taken, and Vladimir von Drakken regains Hit Points equal to that amount. A Humanoid killed by this effect and then buried in the ground rises the following night as a Vampire Spawn under Vladimir von Drakken's control.

actions.name: Terrifying Glare
actions.value: *Wisdom Saving Throw:* DC 18, one creature Vladimir von Drakken can see within 120 feet. *Failure:* 21 (**6d6**) Psychic damage, and the target has the Frightened condition until the end of its next turn. Failure by 5 or More: While Frightened, the target has the Paralyzed condition.

actions.name: Shadow Step (1/Round)
actions.value: Vladimir von Drakken teleports to an unoccupied space he can see within 60 feet that is in Dim Light or Darkness. He has Advantage on the next melee attack he makes before the end of this round.

actions.name: Epic Resistance
actions.value: Vladimir von Drakken chooses one condition, spell, or other effect currently affecting him and rolls 1d20. On an 11+, the effect ends on him. He can use this action even if he would otherwise be unable to take actions, his actions are being controlled by another creature, or if a spell or effect alters his game statistics.

fluffInfo.name: Study the Foe
fluffInfo.value: Characters proficient in *Survival* or *Nature* gain Advantage on Intelligence (*Arcana*) checks to Study a Crystalline Dreg, learning the following based on their result:

fluffInfo.name: (5+) Light Absorption
fluffInfo.value: You recognize the creaturea has Resistance to Radiant damage.

fluffInfo.name: (10+) Reflecting Attacks
fluffInfo.value: You learn of the Dreg's Refracted Beam attack.

fluffInfo.name: (15+) Prone to Shattering
fluffInfo.value: You understand the creature's Vulnerability to Bludgeoning damage.

fluffInfo.name: Combat Tactics
fluffInfo.value: The Crystalline Dreg is quite literally a glass cannon. It prefers to stay behind other Dregs, blasting its foes with its beam attacks and absorbing any elemental damage to alter its attacks. If an enemy who can deal Bludgeoning damage is present, the Crystalline Dreg will flee from that creature and attempt to kill them from a distance, knowing it is their biggest threat. The Dreg tends to focus on enemies approaching with melee weapons over anyone using elemental damage. If the front line of Dregs that the Crystalline Dreg often uses as shield is gone, or if the Crystalline Dregs are outnumbered and threatened with melee combat, they attempt to flee.

fluffInfo.value: Aberration.

fluffInfo.name: Fluid:
fluffInfo.value: Monster Blood, Contaminated Ichor, Elemental Fluid.

fluffInfo.name: Organs:
fluffInfo.value: Eyes, Heart, Brain, Guts, Flesh.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The dreg makes two Refracted Beam attacks.

actions.name: Refracted Beam
actions.value: *Melee or Ranged Attack Roll:* +5, reach 5 ft. or range 120 ft. *Hit:* 21 (**4d8 + 3**) Radiant damage, and the target has the Blinded condition until the start of the dreg's next turn. If this attack deals a different damage type due to Refract Elements, it has additional effects:

actions.name: Acid or Fire
actions.value: The target is also Burning (2d6) of the corresponding damage type.

actions.name: Cold
actions.value: The target has the Frozen Condition (DC 13).

actions.name: Lightning
actions.value: The target has the Shocked Condition until the end of its next turn.

fluffInfo.name: Study the Foe
fluffInfo.value: Characters proficient in *Survival* or *Nature* gain Advantage on Intelligence (*Arcana*) check to Study a Cyclopean Hulk, learning the following based on their result:

fluffInfo.name: (10+) Phasing Wink
fluffInfo.value: You learn of its Wink Bonus Action.

fluffInfo.name: (15+) Burning Eye
fluffInfo.value: You're aware of the Hulk's Eye Laser attack.

fluffInfo.name: (20+) Strong and Tough
fluffInfo.value: You recognize the Hulk's highest and lowest ability scores and saving throws.

fluffInfo.name: Combat Tactics
fluffInfo.value: It uses its Eye Laser to disintegrate enemies into a fine delerium dust. The Cyclopean Hulk focuses its power on blasting enemies from afar or slamming them into the ground if they get close. It will then Wink out of existence, reappearing every few seconds to deliver a devastating blast from its eye before vanishing again. Cyclopean Hulks usually fight to the end, and rarely flee.

fluffInfo.name: Animus:
fluffInfo.value: Aberration.

fluffInfo.name: Fluid:
fluffInfo.value: Monster Blood, Contaminated Ichor.

fluffInfo.name: Organs:
fluffInfo.value: Eyes, Heart, Brain, Guts, Flesh.

fluffInfo.value: Skull, Spine, Ribs.

fluffInfo.value: Hair.

fluffInfo.name: Hide:
fluffInfo.value: Skin.

fluffInfo.name: Dust:
fluffInfo.value: Aberrant Dust.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The hulk makes two Slam attacks. It can replace one of the attacks with its Eye Laser.

actions.name: Slam
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +8, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 18 (**3d8 + 5**) Bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Eye Laser
actions.value: *Dexterity Saving Throw:* DC 14, each creature in a 60-foot-long, 5-foot-wide Line. *Failure:* 18 (**4d8**) Force damage. *Success* Half damage. *Failure or Success*: If the target is a creature and this damage reduces it to 0 Hit Points, it disintegrates into a pile of fine delerium dust.

bonusActions.name: Wink (Recharge 4-6)
bonusActions.value: The hulk vanishes from the Material Plane and is transported to the Space Between Worlds. At the start of its next turn, it returns to an unoccupied space of its choice within 10 feet of the space it vanished from. If no unoccupied space is available within that range, it appears in the nearest unoccupied space (chosen at random if more than one space is equally near).

entries: **Languages**: understands Druidic and Sylvan but can't speak

traits.name: Dancing Flowers
traits.value: The dancing lady has three spinning flowers resembling life-sized dancing Humanoids. Each flower has AC 16, 5 hit points, vulnerability to fire damage, and immunity to psychic damage. Attack rolls against these whirling blooms have disadvantage. Destroying a flower deals no damage to the dancing lady, who regrows destroyed flowers at the end of their turn.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The dancing lady makes two Slam attacks.

actions.name: Slam
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. *Hit:* 25 (**3d12 + 6**) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Blood-Red Waltz
actions.value: For each flower the dancing lady has, they can choose one creature they can see within 60 feet of them. Each target must make a DC 17 Strength saving throw as a dancing flower sweeps toward them. On a failed save, a creature takes 18 (**4d8**) psychic damage and is moved to an unoccupied space within 60 feet of the dancing lady. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage and isn't moved.

actions.name: Disarming Quickstep
actions.value: For each flower the dancing lady has, they can choose one creature they can see within 60 feet of them. Each target must make a DC 17 Dexterity saving throw as a dancing flower whirls them into a dance. On a failed save, a creature takes 17 (**5d6**) bludgeoning damage and is dazed until the start of the dancing lady's next turn. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage and isn't dazed.

actions.name: Ballet of Terror (1/Day)
actions.value: The dancing lady's flowers pirouette and emit acrid mist. Enemies within 120 feet of the dancing lady who can smell the mist must make a DC 17 Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, a creature becomes frightened of the dancing lady for 1 minute (save ends at end of turn).

fluffInfo.name: Study the Foe
fluffInfo.value: Characters proficient in *Religion* or *Survival* gain Advantage on Intelligence (*Religion*) checks when taking the Study action to examine a Dark Confessor, learning the following based on the result.

fluffInfo.name: (5+) Unnatural Resistance
fluffInfo.value: You recognize the Dark Confessor's damage Resistances.

fluffInfo.name: (10+) Deadly Response
fluffInfo.value: You are aware of the Dark Confessor's Bloody Rebuke Reaction.

fluffInfo.name: (15+) Weaknesses
fluffInfo.value: You are aware the vampire's Regeneration is temporarily halted by Radiant damage, and its Vampire Weaknesses.

fluffInfo.name: Combat Tactics
fluffInfo.value: In the first round of combat, the Dark Confessor casts __Spirit Guardians__. It uses its Claws to attack anyone who comes within its melee reach. The Dark Confessor then proceeds to attack with its Spiritual Maul.
If there are enemies grouped close to one another, the Dark
Confessor uses Unholy Light on them.
The Dark Confessor flees if it is below 50 Hit Points or takes steady Radiant damage.

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.value: The vampire regains 10 Hit Points at the start of its turn if it has at least 1 Hit Point and isn't in sunlight or running water. If the vampire takes Radiant damage or damage from holy water, this trait doesn't function at the start of the vampire's next turn.

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.value: The vampire can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

traits.name: Vampire Weaknesses
traits.value: The vampire has the traits described in the "Vampire Weaknesses" sidebar in the Monsters of Drakkenheim.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The vampire makes three attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Bite, Unholy Light, or Spellcasting.

actions.name: Claws
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +6, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 7 (**2d4 + 2**) Slashing damage, and if the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 15).

actions.name: Spiritual Maul
actions.value: *Melee or Ranged Attack Roll:* +8, reach 5 ft. or range 120 ft. *Hit:* 17 (**3d8 + 4**) Force damage, and the target is pushed 10 feet away from the vampire.

actions.name: Bite
actions.value: *Constitution Saving Throw:* DC 16, one creature within 5 feet that is willing or has the Grappled, Incapacitated, or Restrained condition. *Failure:* 12 (**3d6 + 2**) Necrotic damage, and the vampire regains Hit Points equal to the Necrotic damage dealt.

actions.name: Unholy Light (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: *Dexterity Saving Throw:* DC 16, each creature in a 10-foot radius, 40-foot high Cylinder centered on a point the vampire can see within 120 feet. *Failure:* 14 (**4d6**) Necrotic damage plus 14 (**4d6**) Fire damage, and the target has the Staggered condition until the end of its next turn. *Success* Half damage only.

fluffInfo.name: Study the Foe
fluffInfo.value: Characters proficient in *Survival* gain Advantage on Intelligence (*Nature*) checks to Study a Dark Growth, learning the following based on their result:

fluffInfo.name: (5+) Contaminated and Thriving
fluffInfo.value: You are aware of the Dark Growth's Resistances and Immunities.

fluffInfo.name: (10+) Deadly Spores
fluffInfo.value: You recognize the creature's Infection Spores action.

fluffInfo.name: (15+) Kill it with fire!
fluffInfo.value: You know the creature's Vulnerability to Fire, and its strongest and weakest ability scores and saving throws.

fluffInfo.name: Combat Tactics
fluffInfo.value: A Dark Growth is a simple-minded plant. It uses Mimicry to lure passing creatures towards it, often mimicking the sounds of children or people in need. It entangles and infests any target near it, infecting it with its spores. The creature is a stationary plant and does not flee.

traits.name: Mimicry
traits.value: The dark growth can mimic any sounds it has heard, including voices. A creature that hears the sounds can tell they are imitations with a successful DC 14 Wisdom (*Insight*) check.

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.value: The dark growth regains 10 Hit Points at the start of its turn. If the Dark Growth takes Fire or Radiant damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of the dark growth's next turn. The dark growth dies only if it starts its turn with 0 Hit Points and doesn't regenerate.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The dark growth makes three attacks: two with its Entangling Vines and one with its Infection Spores.

actions.name: Entangling Vines
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +7, reach 30 ft. *Hit:* 8 (**1d8 + 4**) Piercing damage, and the target has the Grappled condition (escape DC 15) and the target has the Restrained condition until the grapple ends.

actions.name: Infection Spores
actions.value: *Ranged Attack Roll:* +7, range 60 ft. *Hit:* 18 (**4d6 + 4**) Necrotic damage, and if the target is a creature, it is subjected to the following effect. *Constitution Saving Throw:* DC 14. *Failure:* The target is infected with a disease called Dark Decay. Instead of acting normally on its turn, the target must move toward the closest creature that isn't infected with Dark Decay and make one melee attack against it. If the attack hits, the target of that attack must also make a saving throw against Dark Decay. At the end of each of its turns, the target repeats the save. Subsequent Failures: The target gains one Contamination level. Third Success: The disease ends.

An infected creature that dies or undergoes a Monstrous Transformation becomes a Dark Growth Shambler. A __Lesser Restoration__ spell or similar magic that removes diseases ends Dark Decay, as does any magic that removes Contamination levels.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The dark growth shambler makes two Claw attacks and one Infectious Bite attack.

actions.name: Claw
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +6, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 10 (**2d6 + 3**) Slashing damage.

actions.name: Infectious Bite
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +6, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 10 (**2d6 + 3**) Necrotic damage, and if the target is a creature, it is subjected to the following effect. *Constitution Saving Throw:* DC 14. *Failure:* The target is infected with a disease called Dark Decay. Instead of acting normally on its turn, the target must move toward the closest creature that isn't infected with Dark Decay and make one melee attack against it. If the attack hits, the target of that attack must also make a saving throw against Dark Decay. At the end of each of its turns, the target repeats the save. Subsequent Failures: The target gains one Contamination level. Third Success: The disease ends.

An infected creature that dies or undergoes a Monstrous Transformation becomes a Dark Growth Shambler. A __Lesser Restoration__ spell or similar magic that removes diseases ends Dark Decay, as does any magic that removes Contamination levels.

traits.name: Morbid Curiosity
traits.value: The death shroud is easily distracted by fresh corpses. Whenever it first detects a corpse that has been dead for less than 1 hour (and that it didn't witness die), it must succeed on a DC 11 Wisdom saving throw or get distracted. While distracted, it spends its movement and actions trying to get close to, and inspect, the corpse for a cause of death. A distracted death shroud in a corpse's space uses its action to make Intelligence (*Medicine*) checks (DC decided by the GM). On a success, it stops being distracted and becomes immune to the allure of that corpse forever.

traits.name: Turn Immunity
traits.value: The death shroud is immune to effects that turn undead.

actions.name: Slap
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 3 (**1d4 + 1**) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Lich Slap
actions.value: *Ranged Spell Attack:* +4 to hit, range 30 ft., one creature. *Hit:* 3 (**1d6**) necrotic damage and the target can't regain hit points until the start of the death shroud's next turn.

entries: **Languages**: understands Common but can't speak it

traits.name: Corpse Sense
traits.value: Within a range of 5 miles, the deathhawk can sense the presence of Undead or corpses that have been dead for less than 90 days; the deathhawk knows the general direction these are in but not their exact locations. In addition, the deathhawk has advantage on Wisdom (*Perception*) checks made to find Undead or corpses that have been dead for less than 90 days.

traits.name: Flyby
traits.value: The deathhawk doesn't provoke opportunity attacks when they fly out of an enemy's reach.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The deathhawk makes one Beak attack and one Wounding Talons attack.

actions.name: Beak
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 11 (**3d4 + 4**) piercing damage.

actions.name: Wounding Talons
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 11 (**2d6 + 4**) slashing damage. If the target is a creature who isn't a Construct or an Undead, they gain a bleeding wound that lasts until they regain at least 1 hit point. A bleeding creature loses 5 (**1d10**) hit points for each bleeding wound they have at the start of their turn. Any creature who can reach the target can use an action to stanch all the target's wounds, ending the effect.

bonusActions.name: Bloodcurdling Shriek (Recharge 5-6)
bonusActions.value: The deathhawk shrieks, and each enemy within 300 feet of the deathhawk who can hear them must make a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw. Creatures who are immune to the frightened condition automatically succeed on this saving throw. On a failed save, a creature is horrified for 1 minute (save ends at end of turn). While horrified, each time the creature makes an attack roll or a saving throw, they must roll a **d4** and subtract the number rolled from the attack roll or saving throw.
If a creature's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for them, they are immune to the Bloodcurdling Shriek of all deathhawks for the next 24 hours.

entries: **Immunities**: acid; blinded, charmed, deafened, exhaustion, frightened, grappled, prone, restrained

traits.name: Reactive Mutations
traits.value: Immediately after the ooze takes damage, it gains resistance to that damage type. The ooze can have up to four resistances from this trait. If the ooze has its maximum number of resistances, the oldest resistance is lost when a new one is gained.

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.value: The ooze can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The ooze makes two Pseudopod attacks. It can replace one attack with Engulf.

actions.name: Engulf
actions.value: The ooze moves up to its speed. While doing so, it can enter Small or smaller creatures' spaces. Whenever the ooze enters a creature's space, the creature must make a DC 16 Dexterity saving throw.
On a successful save, the creature can choose to be pushed 5 feet back or to the side of the ooze. A creature that chooses not to be pushed suffers the consequences of a failed saving throw.

On a failed save, the ooze enters the creature's space, and the creature takes 11 (**2d10**) acid damage and is engulfed. The engulfed creature can't breathe, is restrained, and takes 22 (**4d10**) acid damage at the start of each of the ooze's turns. When the ooze moves, the engulfed creature moves with it.
An engulfed creature can try to escape by taking an action to make a DC 16 Strength check. On a success, the creature escapes and enters a space of its choice within 5 feet of the ooze.

actions.name: Pseudopod
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 9 (**2d8**) acid damage and the target suffers one of the following random effects (roll a d10):
1. The target takes 5 (**1d10**) force damage.
2. The target takes 5 (**1d10**) bludgeoning damage.
3. The target takes 5 (**1d10**) piercing damage.
4. The target takes 5 (**1d10**) slashing damage.
5. The target takes 5 (**1d10**) cold damage.
6. The target takes 5 (**1d10**) fire damage.
7. The target takes 5 (**1d10**) lightning damage.
8. The target takes 5 (**1d10**) thunder damage.
9. The target takes 5 (**1d10**) necrotic damage.
10. The target takes 5 (**1d10**) radiant damage

traits.name: Grounded
traits.value: The brute has advantage on ability checks and saving throws made to avoid being moved against its will.

traits.name: Reckless
traits.value: At the start of its turn, the brute can gain advantage on all melee weapon attack rolls during that turn, but attack rolls against it have advantage until the start of its next turn.

traits.name: Sun Sickness
traits.value: While in sunlight, or if it takes 5 or more radiant damage in a single turn, the brute has disadvantage on ability checks, attack rolls, and saving throws until the end of its next turn. The brute dies if it spends more than 1 hour in direct sunlight.

actions.name: Broken Sword
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. *Hit:* 8 (**2d4 + 3**) slashing damage.

entries: **Quickened Spell**: When the sporeslinger casts a spell that has a casting time of 1 action, it can spend 2 sorcery points to change the casting time to 1 bonus action for this casting.

**Twinned Spell**: When the sporeslinger casts a spell that targets only one creature and doesn't have a range of self, it can spend a number of sorcery points equal to the spell's level to target a second creature in range with the same spell (1 sorcery point if the spell is a cantrip).

fluffInfo.name: Combat Tactics
fluffInfo.value: Deep Dreg Warriors attack from the water, throwing their spears and diving back under the surface as added protection against ranged retaliation. When they engage in melee, the warriors use their Net to restrain their foes, and make melee attacks (with the bonus damage from Catch of the Day) to knock them Unconscious.

Deep Dregs Warriors flee whenever they are outnumbered or if they are reduced below half their maximum Hit Points. They swim to safety rather than die fighting, and prefer to fall back and retaliate after gathering reinforcements.

The Deep Knight will defend the other Deep Dregs to the death. If it is the last one standing it will attempt to flee, but as long as there are allies to protect, it will stay and fight.

fluffInfo.name: Combat Tactics
fluffInfo.value: Deep Sirens are the generals and confidants to the Duchess and often serve as the eyes and ears of their mistress. They use their Illusory Appearance to walk among humanoids and observe them, planning and plotting the attacks of the Deep Dregs. Once it has gathered information, a Deep Siren returns to the Duchess, and is often sent with the Deep Dregs to storm beaches, infiltrate sewers, or take over cities on stormy nights.
The siren doesn't like being in close combat, and always attempts to use __Misty Step__ to move to a more beneficial position, then unleash Storm Lash or spellcasting upon their foes.
They flee if surrounded, if outnumbered, or if they feel the battle is not going in their favor.

actions.value: The deep siren covers herself and anything she is wearing or carrying with a magical illusion that makes her look like another creature of her general size and shape. The illusion ends if the siren takes a Bonus Action to end it or if she dies.

The changes wrought by this effect fail to hold up to physical inspection. For example, the siren could appear to have smooth skin, but someone touching them would feel their fishy flesh. Otherwise, a creature must take an action to visually inspect the illusion and succeed on a DC 15 Intelligence (*Investigation*) check to discern that the siren is disguised.

fluffInfo.name: (15+) Shambling Corruption

fluffInfo.name: Combat Tactics
fluffInfo.value: Delerium Dregs are desperate and confused combatants, incapable of any complex tactics beyond lunging towards their foes to attack by the most direct means. If they see a creature who is not contaminated, they will attack on sight. However, they will band together to form small herds, shuffling through ruins, or wandering the streets together. A wounded Delerium Dreg typically responds with fury and rage, attacking whatever damaged it last without regard to its personal wellbeing. In very rare cases, a wounded Dreg may attempt to flee, especially from a much more formidable combatant.

fluffInfo.value: An __Alienist__ looking to permanently control the mind of their victim may opt to remove the brain altogether, killing the patient and resurrecting the mind as its own sentient entity. Somewhere within this process the brain loses its sense of self and any connection it had to the former body it held, becoming an organism made up entirely of electrical synapses and controlled thoughts. The Disembodied Psyche is then subject to several arduous experiments to heighten its fortitude and mental capabilities, giving the creature forms of telepathy and telekinesis.

The now-undead form of this controlled consciousness can be unleashed upon the foes of the alienist and even take over the bodies of other victims, putting them in a controlled and obedient state for the alienist to perform even more mental experiments on, or use as a puppet against their enemies.

The possession lasts until the body drops to 0 Hit Points or the psyche leaves as a Bonus Action. Whenever the target takes damage, it repeats the save, ending the possession on a success. When the possession ends, the psyche appears in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the target, and the target is immune to this psyche's Mental Possession for 24 hours.

fluffInfo.value: *The mastermind behind some of the worst things to ever find in a basement. Watch out because even your fallen allies can be enemies.*

Perhaps no apothecary is a more prolific creator of monsters than the Reanimator, and amongst them, Dr. Everett Freed is perhaps the most infamous. A gifted professor of anatomy and medicine at Altbruke University, Dr. Everett Freed served as a field medic and surgeon during the Westemär Civil War, where the brutality and chaos of war allowed him to clandestinely begin his experiments with the fallen or grievously wounded soldiers thrust into his care. The sights of the war caused him to see the frailty of the human form—the cries of pain and agony of the wounded collected in the fields disgusted him with their feeble, broken bodies. Deep within himself welled the desire to create a perfect soldier, a warrior who would not bend or break in battle.

During the war, one of Dr. Freed's duties included triaging casualties to determine who could be saved or recover. Unbeknownst to his commanders, Dr. Freed used his position to manipulate the diagnosis, choosing ideal specimens for his experiments, individuals who would then be listed amongst the slain and missing.

fluffInfo.name: Reanimator Minions
fluffInfo.value: It's possible Dr. Freed was the first to create many creatures. He is most well known as the first to create Reautomata. In the process of making his magnum opus, Freed built creatures such as the __Body Snatcher__, __Cerebrograft__, the __Ripper__, and the __Stitcher__. Freed's experiments did not stop there, and in many ways his practice ascended the body alone thanks to his collaborations with the Alienist Dr. Sina Rienks, eventually transforming himself into a __Think Tank__.

fluffInfo.name: Mind Over Body
fluffInfo.value: One of Freed's infamous gambits was to remove his brain from his own body, placing it into a body double. Eventually, Freed became a Think Tank, able to remotely control brainless bodies from his hidden sanctum.

entries: **Personality Trait:** I am always calm and composed, especially when explaining the 'necessary' cruelty of my experiments
**Ideal:** Progress demands sacrifice; the advancement of knowledge justifies all actions, no matter how gruesome.
**Bond:** I still possess the first successful reanimation I ever created: the preserved head of a beloved family member. It's both my proudest achievement and my darkest secret.

**Flaw:** I am obsessed with the perfection and infallibility of my creations, often dismissing any evidence of their defects, uncontrollable behavior, and horrific appearances. I never accept any failure as my fault.

fluffInfo.name: Combat Tactics
fluffInfo.value: Prior to combat, Freed casts __False Life__ and __Death Ward__ on himself, and perhaps any allies joining him in battle. He does not engage in combat without creations by his side. If Freed is caught alone, he doesn't fight; he flees. However, when supported by his loyal creations, he can be overconfident and brash, secure that his bodyguards will keep him safe from harm. Freed always remains within 10 feet of one or more creations so he can use his Bodyguard Reaction reliably.

On his turn, Freed uses Electric Jolt and Necrotic Blast to hammer his foes, while directing a favored creation with Creator's Command. Should one of his minions be brought down, he uses Reanimate and immediately sends it back into the action with Creator's Command.

Freed uses Touch of Death against a particularly loathsome foe, one who harries him with dangerous abilities, or who he especially wishes to slay. All the while, he threatens his enemies by telling them his plans for their body parts once he's killed them.

actions.value: The Reanimator targets the corpse of one of its destroyed creations it can see within 30 feet. The target returns to life with 45 (10d8) Hit Points. The target has Resistance to all damage and Advantage on saving throws until the end of its next turn.

bonusActions.name: Creator's Command
bonusActions.value: The Reanimator chooses a creature it can see that was reanimated or created by it. The target can use its Reaction to make an attack with Advantage or move up to its Speed without provoking Opportunity Attack action.

traits.name: Arcane Acumen
traits.value: The dragonet has advantage on Intelligence (*Arcana*) checks made to reveal information about supernatural effects and objects they can see. Additionally, they always know if their emotions are being sensed, their thoughts are being read, or they are being targeted or perceived by any divination spells.

traits.name: True Words
traits.value: When a creature speaks in Draconic, the dragonet has advantage on Wisdom (*Insight*) checks to determine whether they are lying.

actions.name: Claw
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 5 (**1d4 + 3**) slashing damage.

actions.name: Revealing Breath (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
actions.value: The dragonet exhales sparkling light in a 15-foot cone. Each object in that area is outlined in light for 1 minute, and each creature in that area must succeed on a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw or also be outlined in light for the duration. Outlined creatures and objects shed dim light in a 5-foot radius, and if any outlined creatures or objects bear magic, the dragonet can learn its school of magic, if any, by looking at it. Any attack roll against an outlined creature or object has advantage if the attacker can see the target, and the outlined creature or object can't benefit from being invisible.

actions.name: Truesight (Recharges after a Long Rest)
actions.value: For 1 minute, the dragonet gains truesight out to a range of 60 feet.

traits.name: Greedy
traits.value: Whenever the dragonling first detects treasure worth 100 gp or more that isn't being worn or carried, it must succeed on a DC 11 Wisdom saving throw or get distracted. While distracted, it spends its movement and actions trying to get close to, and frolic in, the treasure. A distracted dragonling repeats the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success and becoming immune to the allure of that treasure for the next 24 hours.

traits.name: Metallic Character
traits.value: When the dragonling's tamer finishes a long rest, the dragonling gains an affinity for the element associated with the first precious metal it touches. This affinity grants the dragonling resistance to that damage type and lasts until its tamer next finishes a long rest. Copper gives acid affinity, gold gives fire, and magnetite & silver give cold.

actions.name: Bite
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 5 (**1d6 + 2**) piercing damage.

fluffInfo.name: Study the Foe
fluffInfo.value: Characters proficient in *Animal Handling* gain Advantage on Intelligence (*Nature*) checks to study a Drakkenheim Sewer Gator, learning the following based on their result:

fluffInfo.name: (5+) Fearless Aquatic Predator!
fluffInfo.value: You learn the Drakkenheim Sewer Gator's condition Immunities and Swim speed.

fluffInfo.name: (10+) Watch out for its bite!
fluffInfo.value: You are aware of the creature's Crushing Bite and Death Roll actions.

fluffInfo.name: (15+) Get it out of the water!
fluffInfo.value: You know of the creature's Contaminated Regeneration trait.

fluffInfo.name: Combat Tactics
fluffInfo.value: The Drakkenheim Sewer Gator is primarily aquatic, haunting the sewer system or the Drann River. These monstrosities lunge from the waters to grab prey, dragging it beneath the surface. Once a target is in its jaws, the gator Death Rolls until its victim stops moving. It is a cunning hunter, knowing how to disappear below murky waters, but it can be provoked to chase its prey. Out of the water it is vulnerable and flees if reduced below half its Hit Points.

fluffInfo.name: Animus:
fluffInfo.value: Monstrosity.

fluffInfo.name: Fluid:
fluffInfo.value: Monster Blood, Contaminated Ichor.

fluffInfo.name: Organs:
fluffInfo.value: Eyes, Heart, Brain, Guts, Flesh.

fluffInfo.name: Bones:
fluffInfo.value: Skull, Ribs, Spine.

fluffInfo.name: Natural Weapons:
fluffInfo.value: Teeth.

fluffInfo.name: Hide:
fluffInfo.value: Skin.

traits.name: Contaminated Regeneration
traits.value: The sewer gator regains 10 Hit Points at the start of its turn as long as it is in contaminated water. The gator dies only if it starts its turn with 0 Hit Points and doesn't regenerate.

traits.name: Amphibious Lunge
traits.value: If the sewer gator swims 20+ feet on its turn, it can long jump or high jump up to 60 feet. If it ends this jump within 5 feet of a creature, it has Advantage on its next Crushing Bite attack against that creature, and that attack deals an additional 40 (**9d8**) Piercing damage.

traits.name: Predatory Stealth
traits.value: The sewer gator has Advantage on Dexterity (*Stealth*) checks to Hide in water.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The sewer gator makes two attacks. It can't make both a Crushing Bite attack and a Tail Strike attack against the same target.

actions.name: Crushing Bite
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +11, reach 15 ft. *Hit:* 33 (**4d12 + 7**) Piercing damage, and if the target is Large or smaller, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 19). While Grappled, the target has the Restrained condition and the sewer gator can't use Crushing Bite against another target.

actions.name: Tail Strike
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +11, reach 15 ft. *Hit:* 25 (**4d6 + 7**) Bludgeoning damage, and the target is pushed 20 feet away from the sewer gator and has the Prone condition.

actions.name: Death Roll
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +11, reach 15 ft., one creature Grappled by the sewer gator. *Hit:* 33 (**4d12 + 7**) Piercing damage. *Strength Saving Throw:* DC 19. *Failure:* The target has the Dazed and Helpless conditions until it escapes the sewer gator's grapple.

entries: **HP**: 7 + seven times caregiver's level (number of d8 Hit Dice equal to their caregiver's level)
**Skills**: perception +0 plus PB, survival +0 plus PB

traits.name: Tunneler
traits.value: The drangolin can burrow through solid rock at half their burrow speed and leaves behind a 3-foot-diameter tunnel when they burrow. Tiny and Small creatures can move through this tunnel normally, and Medium and Large creatures can squeeze through it. This tunnel collapses after 10 minutes.

actions.name: Signature Attack (Claws)
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +3 plus PB to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* **1d6 plus PB** slashing damage.

actions.name: 1st Level: Spit Breath (2 Ferocity)
actions.value: The drangolin breathes fire at their foe. This attack uses the statistics for their signature attack, except the fire is a ranged weapon with a normal range of 30 feet and a long range of 60 feet. On a hit, the attack deals an extra **PB** damage, and all the damage dealt by the attack is fire damage instead of piercing damage.

actions.name: 3rd Level: Roll Out (5 Ferocity)
actions.value: The drangolin moves up to their walking speed in a straight line without provoking opportunity attacks. The drangolin can end this movement in a space that contains another creature. If they do, that creature takes 2 × PB bludgeoning damage for every 10 feet the drangolin traveled, and they must make a DC 10 plus PB Strength saving throw. On a failed save, the creature is knocked prone. On a successful save, the creature is pushed 5 feet out of the drangolin's space into an unoccupied space of the creature's choice.

actions.name: 5th Level: Rend and Roast (8 Ferocity)
actions.value: The drangolin makes two signature attacks against the same target, then breathes fire on them. The target must make a DC 10 plus PB Dexterity saving throw, taking **PBd6** fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

traits.name: Exploit Opening (3/Day)
traits.value: When Draven makes an attack, he has advantage on the attack roll.

traits.name: Profane Sacrifice (1/Turn)
traits.value: When Draven hits a creature with a melee attack, he can sacrifice his vitality to empower the attack. The target's speed drops to 0 until the start of his next turn, and Draven takes 5 (**1d10**) psychic damage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: Draven makes three Gloom Dagger attacks.

actions.name: Gloom Dagger
actions.value: *Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack:* +11 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. *Hit:* 10 (**1d4 + 8**) piercing damage plus 7 (**3d4**) necrotic damage, and Draven can move the target up to 10 feet horizontally. If the damage from this attack reduces a creature to 0 hit points, Draven regains a use of Blood of the Dragon.

actions.name: Blood of the Dragon (1/Day)
actions.value: Draven boils the blood of up to three creatures he can see within 60 feet of him. Each target takes 33 (**6d10**) necrotic damage and must succeed on a DC 19 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned for 1 minute (save ends at end of turn) and knocked prone.

bonusActions.name: Creeping Dread
bonusActions.value: Draven chooses a creature he can see within 30 feet of him in an area of dim light or darkness. The creature must succeed on a DC 19 Wisdom saving throw or move their speed in a direction chosen by Draven. A creature with advantage on saving throws against being frightened has advantage on this saving throw, and a creature who can't be frightened automatically succeeds on it.

entries: **Languages**: all languages known before the curse

traits.name: Aura of Confusion
traits.value: A creature that starts its turn or moves within 25 feet of a Dream Whisperer must succeed on a DC 13 Intelligence saving throw or be affected as if they had failed a save against the __Confusion__ spell.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.value: The Dream Whisperer has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.value: The Dream Whisperer can climb difficult surfaces, including along ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The Dream Whisperer makes three Claw attacks.

actions.name: Claw
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. *Hit:* 13 (**2d8 + 4**) Slashing damage, and the target is subjected to the following effect. *Intelligence Saving Throw:* DC 13. *Failure:* The Dream Whisperer gains Advantage on attack rolls against the target for 1 minute, and the target rolls on the Lost Memories table.

table.title: Lost Memories
rows: The target becomes deeply suspicious of a character or NPC of the GM's choice. They gain the following flaw: "I know they are seeking to betray me. I have to act first—it's me or them!"
The target forgets all memories of a loved one of the GM's choice. The next time the target sees them, it's as if they are meeting them for the first time.
The target becomes stricken with doubt and gains the following flaw: ""The world is out to get me, and I can't win. I may as well give up now."
The target forgets how to speak in one language known, decided by the GM.
The target forgets the location of something important to them, of the GM's choice. It may be the location of a goal, their home settlement, or a hidden treasure.
The target loses an inconsequential memory such as what they ate a few nights ago or the name of an unimportant NPC.

entries: **Speed**: *walk* 0 Ft. All +5 Ft. In Dreamscape, *fly* 20 Ft. (hover)
**Immunities**: bludgeoning, piercing, poison, slashing; charmed, exhaustion, grappled, poisoned, prone, restrained

traits.name: Phantasmal Cone
traits.value: The dreamholder's central eye creates an area of phantasmagoric horrors—illusory manifestations unique to each creature—within a 120-foot cone. At the start of each of its turns, the dreamholder decides which way the cone faces and whether the cone is active. Each creature within the cone at the end of the dreamholder's turn must succeed on a DC 17 Intelligence saving throw or take 16 (**3d10**) psychic damage and become frightened of the dreamholder and the illusions within the area until the end of the dreamholder's next turn.
As an affected creature is surrounded by these illusions, the source of its fear is in every direction, rendering it unable to move in any direction while it can see these sources of its fear.

traits.name: Inconsistent Incoporeality
traits.value: When the dreamholder takes 10 or more psychic or thunder damage in a single instance, it becomes corporeal until the start of its next turn. While corporeal, it loses its Incorporeal Movement trait; its immunity to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage; and its immunity to the grappled and restrained conditions.

traits.name: Incorporeal Movement
traits.value: The dreamholder can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. It takes 5 (**1d10**) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.value: If the dreamholder fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

actions.name: Dreameater
actions.value: *Melee Spell Attack:* +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. *Hit:* 20 (**3d10 + 4**) psychic damage.

actions.name: Eye Rays
actions.value: The dreamholder shoots four of the following magical eye rays at random (reroll duplicates), choosing one to four creatures it can see within 120 feet of it:

entries: **1. Charm Ray**: The target must succeed on a DC 17 Wisdom saving throw or be charmed by the dreamholder for 1 hour, or until the dreamholder harms the target.
**2. Confusion Ray**: The target must succeed on a DC 17 Wisdom saving throw or be afflicted by the confusion spell until the end of its next turn.

**3. Static Ray**: The target must make a DC 17 Intelligence saving throw, taking 10 (**3d6**) psychic damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one. On a failed save, a target has muddled thoughts for 1 minute. During that time, it rolls a d6 and subtracts the number rolled from all its attack rolls and ability checks, as well as its Constitution saving throws to maintain concentration. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

**4. Rot Ray**: The target must make a DC 17 Intelligence saving throw. On a failure, its grey matter deteriorates, it takes 17 (**5d6**) necrotic damage, and it has disadvantage on ability checks and attack rolls it makes until the end of its next turn. On a success it takes half as much damage and suffers no additional effects.

**5. Incorporeal Shunt Ray**: The target must succeed on a DC 17 Charisma saving throw or become momentarily incorporeal, be pushed up to 20 feet directly away from the dreamholder, and then rematerialise. The creature takes 22 (**5d8**) force damage if it rematerialises inside an object. If the creature rematerialises in another creature's space, both creatures take this damage. The target is then pushed to the nearest unoccupied space.

**6. Nightmare Ray**: The target is assailed by illusory manifestations of its fears. It must make a DC 17 Intelligence saving throw, taking 27 (**5d10**) psychic damage on a failure or half as much damage on a success.

fluffInfo.name: Study the Foe
fluffInfo.value: Characters proficient in *Religion* or *Survival* gain Advantage on Intelligence (*Arcana*) checks when taking the Study action to examine a Druid of the Sanguine Rite, learning the following based on the result.

fluffInfo.name: (10+) Unrelenting Unlife
fluffInfo.value: You recognize the creature's Regeneration trait.

fluffInfo.name: (15+) Bloody Renewal
fluffInfo.value: You learn of the creature's Bloodthorn Whip attack and Plasma Absorption trait

fluffInfo.name: (20+) Unnaturally Aware
fluffInfo.value: You know their highest and lowest ability scores

fluffInfo.name: Combat Tactics
fluffInfo.value: The druid of the blood rites uses dark magic to twist the lifeforce of other creatures. The druid uses its bloodthorn whip to inflict a series of open wounds upon its foes, and then feeds on their lifeforce by pulling it through their wounds using plasma absorption.
When not directly engaged in combat, the druids attempt to charm a group of foes and convince them to partake in their blood rituals, using their life force as sacrifice to empower one of their own.
If the druids are directly confronted with greater numbers, or their health is below half, they attempt to flee.

fluffInfo.value: Undead.

fluffInfo.name: Fluid:
fluffInfo.value: Monster Blood.

fluffInfo.value: Teeth, Claws.

fluffInfo.name: Dust:
fluffInfo.value: Undead Dust.

traits.name: Blood Sacrifice
traits.value: A creature with the Restrained condition also has the Helpless condition against the vampire's attacks.

traits.name: Plasma Absorption
traits.value: Each time a creature takes damage from the Bleeding condition while within 30 feet of the vampire, the vampire regains Hit Points equal to the damage dealt.

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.value: The vampire regains 10 Hit Points at the start of its turn if it has at least 1 Hit Point and isn't in sunlight or running water. If the vampire takes Radiant damage or damage from holy water, this trait doesn't function at the start of the vampire's next turn.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The vampire makes three attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Draining Bite or Spellcasting.

actions.name: Claws
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +7, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 9 (**2d4 + 4**) Slashing damage, and if the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 15).

actions.name: Bloodthorn Whip
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +9, reach 30 ft. *Hit:* 17 (**3d8 + 5**) Necrotic damage, and the target has the Bleeding condition (4d4).

actions.name: Draining Bite
actions.value: *Constitution Saving Throw:* DC 17, one creature within 5 feet that is willing or has the Grappled, Incapacitated, or Restrained condition. *Failure:* 14 (**3d6 + 4**) Necrotic damage, and the target has the Weakened condition (save ends).

actions.name: Bloodroots (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: *Dexterity Saving Throw:* DC 17, each creature in a 30-foot Emanation originating from the vampire. *Failure:* 21 (**6d6**) Piercing damage, and the target has the Restrained condition (save ends). *Success* Half damage only.

entries: **Immunities**: cold, force; charmed, dazed, frightened, paralyzed, petrified, stunned

traits.name: Frosted Resistance (3/Day)
traits.value: When Durixaviinox fails a saving throw, he can succeed instead. When he does, his speed is halved and he can't take the Disengage action until the end of his next turn.

traits.name: Hoarfrost
traits.value: Cold damage dealt by Durixaviinox ignores damage resistance.

traits.name: Ice Walk
traits.value: Durixaviinox can move across and climb icy surfaces without needing to make an ability check. Additionally, difficult terrain composed of ice or snow doesn't cost him extra movement.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: Durixaviinox makes one Bite attack and two Claw attacks.

actions.name: Bite
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +14 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. *Hit:* 19 (**2d10 + 8**) piercing damage plus 9 (**2d8**) cold damage, and the target can't take reactions until the end of their next turn.

actions.name: Claw
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +14 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. *Hit:* 15 (**2d6 + 8**) slashing damage, and Durixaviinox can move the target up to 15 feet horizontally.

actions.name: Numbing Breath (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: Durixaviinox exhales a freezing blast in a 90-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 22 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 42 (**12d6**) cold damage and is restrained until the end of their next turn. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage and isn't restrained.

bonusActions.name: Icy Grip
bonusActions.value: Durixaviinox encases a creature he can see within 60 feet of him in ice. The target must make a DC 18 Strength saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 22 (**4d10**) cold damage and is restrained. On a successful save, a target takes half as much damage and isn't restrained. A creature can use an action to break themself or another creature they can reach out of the ice, ending the restrained condition.

traits.name: Earth Glide
traits.value: The elemental can burrow through mundane, unworked earth and stone. While doing so, the elemental doesn't disturb the material they move through. While they use Earth Glide, the elemental can't be used as a mount.

actions.name: Signature Attack (Slam)
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +3 plus PB to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* **1d6 plus PB** bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: 1st Level: Stretch Attack (2 Ferocity)
actions.value: The elemental makes a signature attack with a reach of 10 feet. On a hit, the attack deals an extra **PB** damage, and the elemental can pull the target 5 feet toward them.

actions.name: 3rd Level: Earthshaker (5 Ferocity)
actions.value: The elemental strikes the ground, and each creature within 10 feet of them must succeed on a DC 10 plus PB Dexterity saving throw or be knocked prone. The elemental's caregiver automatically succeeds on this saving throw.

actions.name: 5th Level: Transmute Ground (8 Ferocity)
actions.value: The elemental picks a 10-foot-square area of ground they can see within 30 feet of them. Each creature standing in the area must succeed on a DC 10 plus PB Strength saving throw or partially sink into the ground and become restrained. A creature can use their action to make a DC 10 plus PB Strength (*Athletics*) check, freeing themself or another creature within their reach on a success and ending the restrained condition for the freed creature.

bonusActions.name: Toss Me
bonusActions.value: While the elemental is within 5 feet of their caregiver, they can hurl the caregiver 5 × PB feet in any direction, including up. If the caregiver would normally take damage from a fall after being thrown, they can negate the damage with a successful DC 15 Dexterity saving throw.

traits.name: Minion
traits.value: If the spark takes damage from an attack or as the result of a failed saving throw, their hit points are reduced to 0. If the spark takes damage from another effect, they die if the damage equals or exceeds their hit point maximum; otherwise they take no damage.

traits.name: Trampling Rampage
traits.value: If an enemy who is touching the ground starts their turn within 5 feet of two or more earth sparks, the enemy must make a Strength saving throw with a DC equal to 12 plus the number of earth sparks within 5 feet of the enemy. On a failed save, the enemy falls prone, and they can't stand up until there are fewer than two earth sparks within 5 feet of them.

actions.name: Shatter Smash (Group Attack)
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 5 bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Snort Rocks (Group Attack)
actions.value: *Ranged Weapon Attack:* +7 to hit, range 30/60 ft., one target. *Hit:* 5 bludgeoning damage. If the target is a flying creature, they must succeed on a Strength saving throw or fall prone. The DC for this saving throw equals 12 plus the number of sparks who joined the attack.

traits.name: Minion
traits.value: If the spark takes damage from an attack or as the result of a failed saving throw, their hit points are reduced to 0. If the spark takes damage from another effect, they die if the damage equals or exceeds their hit point maximum; otherwise they take no damage.

On a failed save, the enemy falls prone, and they can't stand up until there are fewer than two earth sparks within 5 feet of them.

entries: **Skills**: deception +7, insight +7, perception +11, sleight of hand +9, stealth +13
**Languages**: Thieves' Cant, plus three other languages

traits.name: Customized Poison
traits.value: The assassin prepares and applies specialized poisons to its weapons. The first time each turn that the assassin deals weapon damage to a creature, choose one of the following:

entries: **Abduction**: *Wisdom Saving Throw:* DC 15. *Failure:* The target has the Unconscious condition for 1 minute. The condition ends if the target takes damage or a creature within 5 feet of it takes an action to wake it. *Success* The target has the Incapacitated condition until the end of its next turn.
**Debilitation**: The target takes 17 (**5d6**) Poison damage, and has the Poisoned condition until the start of the assassin's next turn.
**Suffocation**: The target has the Poisoned condition for 1 minute. While Poisoned in this way, the target can't speak or breathe.

traits.name: Evasion
traits.value: If the assassin is subjected to an effect that allows it to make a Dexterity saving throw to take only half damage, the assassin instead takes no damage if it succeeds on the save and only half damage if it fails. It can't use this trait if it has the Incapacitated condition.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The assassin makes three attacks using its Daggers or one attack using its Heavy Crossbow.

actions.name: Dagger
actions.value: *Melee or Ranged Attack Roll:* +9 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. *Hit:* 15 (**4d4 + 5**) Piercing damage.

actions.name: Heavy Crossbow
actions.value: *Ranged Attack Roll:* +9 to hit, range 100/400 ft., one target. *Hit:* 27 (**4d10 + 5**) Piercing damage.

bonusActions.name: Cunning Action
bonusActions.value: The assassin takes the Dash, Disengage, or Hide action.

entries: **Languages**: Thieves' Cant, plus three other languages

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The enforcer makes two attacks using their Dagger and Fighting Chain in any combination.

actions.name: Dagger
actions.value: *Melee or Ranged Attack Roll:* +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. *Hit:* 5 (**1d4 + 3**) Piercing damage.

actions.name: Fighting Chain
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 6 (**1d6 + 3**) Bludgeoning damage, and the target has the Grappled condition (escape DC 12). The enforcer can only have one creature grappled by its fighting chain.

bonusActions.name: Strangle
bonusActions.value: The enforcer deals 4 (**1d4 + 2**) Bludgeoning damage to a target Grappled by its Fighting Chain, and the target is unable to speak until the start of the enforcer's next turn or until it is no longer Grappled.

fluffInfo.name: Study the Foe

fluffInfo.name: (5+) Aberrant Resistance
fluffInfo.value: You recognize the monster's Immunities and Resistances.

fluffInfo.name: (10+) Hypnotic Color Change
fluffInfo.value: You learn of the monster's Hallucinogenic Bioluminescence trait.

fluffInfo.name: Combat Tactics
fluffInfo.value: The Effulgent Cnidarians are not predatorial—they only want to bask in the glow of delerium crystals, feeding slowly on the arcane energies they emit. They are, however, protective of their food sources. If creatures venture into an area of heavy delerium crystallization, they are sure to find a few Cnidarians bobbing about. The Cnidarian prefers to use its Hallucinogenic Bioluminescence to dissuade threats from engaging, instead hoping to cause its enemies to kill one another. The Cnidarians feed on creatures under its hypnosis, absorbing their essence through its tendrils. If attacked, it uses its Reflexive Flash and attempts to move away from its threats, often floating straight up as quickly as it can and out of the reach of danger.
Cnidarians do not stay around to fight. If all targets have avoided its charm and are actively attacking it, it abandons its food source to seek other safer areas.

traits.name: Altered Reality
traits.value: The cnidarian has the Invisible condition for creatures Charmed by it.

traits.name: Hallucinogenic Bioluminescence
traits.value: A creature that starts its turn within 60 feet of the cnidarian and can see it is subjected to the following effect unless the cnidarian chooses otherwise. *Wisdom Saving Throw:* DC 16. *Failure:* The target has the Charmed condition (save ends). While Charmed, the target regards all other creatures as enemies except the cnidarian, whom it regards as an ally.

Whenever the target makes an attack or casts a detrimental spell, it must choose its target at random from the creatures it can see within range. If a creature provokes an Opportunity Attack action from the target, it must make the attack, if able. If the target ends its turn without taking an Attack or Magic action, it takes 14 (**4d6**) Psychic damage.

Unless *surprised*, a creature can avert its eyes to avoid the saving throw at the start of its turn. If the creature does so, it has Disadvantage on attack rolls against the cnidarian until the start of its next turn. If the creature looks at the cnidarian in the meantime, that creature must immediately make the saving throw.

traits.name: Neon Illumination

actions.name: Tendrils

traits.name: Warding Aura
traits.value: Eldrick projects a 30-foot Emanation of warding magic. The first time on each turn that a creature within the Emanation deals damage or casts a spell on Eldrick, that creature takes 14 (**4d6**) Force damage and is pushed 10 feet away from Eldrick.

actions.name: Eldrick always takes his turn on Initiative count 20
actions.value: On his turn, Eldrick can use his movement and interaction as normal. However, he does not take an action or Bonus Action on his turn unless forced to do so by a spell or other effect. Instead, Eldrick takes one of the following Epic Actions at the end of each player character's turn:

actions.name: Prismatic Blast
actions.value: *Melee or Ranged Attack Roll:* +15, reach 5 ft. or range 120 ft. *Hit:* 27 (**4d10 + 6**) Cold, Fire, or Lightning damage (Eldrick's choice).

actions.name: Teleport
actions.value: Eldrick teleports to an unoccupied space he can see within 60 feet.

actions.name: Chain Lightning (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: Eldrick casts __Chain Lightning__, using the spellcasting ability in Spellcasting.

actions.name: Dispel Magic (1/Round)
