traits.name: Reactive Mutations
traits.value: Immediately after the ooze takes damage, it gains resistance to that damage type. The ooze can have up to six resistances from this trait. If the ooze has its maximum number of resistances, the oldest resistance is lost when a new one is gained.

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.value: The ooze can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.value: If the ooze fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The ooze uses Engulf and makes three Pseudopod attacks.

actions.name: Engulf
actions.value: The ooze moves up to its speed. While doing so, it can enter Small or smaller creatures' spaces. Whenever the ooze enters a creature's space, the creature must make a DC 21 Dexterity saving throw.
On a successful save, the creature can choose to be pushed 5 feet back or to the side of the ooze. A creature that chooses not to be pushed suffers the consequences of a failed saving throw.

On a failed save, the ooze enters the creature's space, and the creature takes 21 (**2d20**) acid damage and is engulfed. The engulfed creature can't breathe, is restrained, and takes 42 (**4d20**) acid damage at the start of each of the ooze's turns. When the ooze moves, the engulfed creature moves with it.
An engulfed creature can try to escape by taking an action to make a DC 21 Strength check. On a success, the creature escapes and enters a space of its choice within 5 feet of the ooze.

actions.name: Pseudopod
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +12 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 14 (**4d6**) acid damage and the target suffers one of the following random effects (roll a d20):
1. The target takes 10 (**1d20**) force damage.
2. The target takes 10 (**1d20**) bludgeoning damage.
3. The target takes 10 (**1d20**) piercing damage.
4. The target takes 10 (**1d20**) slashing damage.
5. The target takes 10 (**1d20**) fire damage.
6. The target takes 10 (**1d20**) cold damage.
7. The target takes 10 (**1d20**) lightning damage.
8. The target takes 10 (**1d20**) thunder damage.
9. The target takes 10 (**1d20**) necrotic damage.
10. The target takes 10 (**1d20**) radiant damage.
11. The target takes 10 (**1d20**) poison damage.
12. The target takes 10 (**1d20**) psychic damage.

13. The target must succeed on a DC 21 Strength saving throw or be restrained. The target or a creature within reach of the target can use its action to make a DC 21 Strength check, freeing the restrained creature on a success.
14. The target must succeed on a DC 21 Wisdom saving throw or be afflicted by the __confusion__ spell for 1 minute*.
15. The target must succeed on a DC 21 Constitution saving throw or be afflicted by the reduce effect of the __enlarge/reduce__ spell for 1 minute*.
16. The target must succeed on a DC 21 Constitution saving throw or be afflicted by the enlarge effect of the __enlarge/reduce__ spell for 1 minute*.
17. The target must succeed on a DC 21 Constitution saving throw or be afflicted by the __zippit!__ spell for 1 minute*.

18. The target must succeed on a DC 21 Constitution saving throw or its hit point maximum is reduced by 10 **1d20** until it finishes a long rest. The ooze regains a number of hit points equal to this value. A creature whose hit point maximum is reduced to 0 dies.
19. The target must succeed on a DC 21 Strength saving throw or be engulfed by the ooze.
20. Roll twice more on this table.
*These spells don't require *concentration*. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

On a failed save, the target is charmed by Lazivos until the end of his next turn or until Lazivos or one of his allies harms the target.

actions.name: Diabolic Deposition (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: Lazivos commands the attention of each enemy within 30 feet of him who can hear him. Each target must make a DC 20 Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, a creature must choose to either take 27 (**6d8**) fire damage plus 27 (**6d8**) psychic damage or be dazed for 1 minute (save ends at end of turn). On a successful save, a creature must either choose to take half as much damage or be dazed until the end of their next turn. Succeed or fail, if a creature is already dazed, they must choose the damage

bonusActions.name: As I Say
bonusActions.value: Lazivos commands a creature charmed by him to use their reaction, if available, to make a weapon attack against a target of his choice.

entries: **Resistances**: cold, fire, lightning, poison, bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks

traits.name: Fiendish Audacity
traits.value: The handler's AC includes its Charisma modifier.

traits.name: Fiendish Fury
traits.value: The handler deals an extra 16 (**3d10**) damage when it hits with a melee weapon attack (included in the attacks).

traits.name: Fiendish Vigour
traits.value: The handler gains 15 temporary hit points at the start of each of its turns. If the handler takes radiant damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of the handler's next turn.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The handler makes four attacks with its Morningstar or Tommybow.

actions.name: Morningstar
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +11 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 27 (**4d10 + 5**) piercing damage.

actions.name: Brittlebone Splinterspray Tommybow
actions.value: *Ranged Weapon Attack:* +11 to hit, range 30/120 ft., two creatures within 5 feet of each other. *Hit:* 15 (**4d4 + 5**) piercing damage. Reload (5).

fluffInfo.name: Study the Foe
fluffInfo.value: Characters proficient in *Medicine* or *Survival* gain Advantage on Wisdom (*Insight*) or Intelligence (*Investigation*) checks to Study an Injector, learning the following based on the result:

fluffInfo.name: (10+) Impervious to Pain
fluffInfo.value: You understand the creature's damage and condition Immunities.

fluffInfo.name: (15+) Be careful, it's volatile!.
fluffInfo.value: You know of its Unstable Tank Reaction.

fluffInfo.name: (20+) Hardy Creature
fluffInfo.value: You are aware of the Injector's AC, Hit Points, and weakest ability score and saving throw.

fluffInfo.name: Combat Tactics
fluffInfo.value: If the Injector has allies nearby, it uses Booster Dose to bolster them before combat. Otherwise, it ruthlessly attacks with its Syringe Arms. It feels no pain and does not waver or retreat.

fluffInfo.name: Animus:
fluffInfo.value: Construct.

fluffInfo.name: Fluid:
fluffInfo.value: Contaminated Ichor, Chemical Solution.

fluffInfo.name: Organs:
fluffInfo.value: Eyes, Heart, Brain, Guts..

fluffInfo.name: Bones:
fluffInfo.value: Skull, Spine.

fluffInfo.name: Natural Weapons:
fluffInfo.value: Needles.

fluffInfo.name: Hair:
fluffInfo.value: Stitches.

fluffInfo.name: Hide:
fluffInfo.value: Skin, Plates.

entries: **Languages**: understands the languages it knew in life but can't speak

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The injector makes four Syringe attacks. It can replace any number of attacks with uses of Booster Dose instead.

actions.name: Syringe
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +10, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 8 (**1d4 + 6**) Piercing damage, and the target is subjected to one of the following effects (roll 1d4; reroll if the injector has already used that effect during this turn):

entries: **Lethal Injection**: The target takes 21 (**6d6**) Poison damage.
**Numbing Solution**: The target takes 9 (**2d8**) Cold damage and is subjected to the following effect: *Constitution Saving Throw:* DC 16. *Failure:* The target has the Frozen condition (DC 16).

**Mind Dampener**: The target takes 7 (**2d6**) Psychic damage and is subjected to the following effect: *Intelligence Saving Throw:* DC 16. *Failure:* The target has the Bewildered condition (save ends).

**Induced Necrosis**: The target takes 9 (**2d8**) Necrotic damage and is subjected to the following effect: *Strength Saving Throw:* DC 16. *Failure:* The target has the Weakened condition (save ends).

actions.name: Booster Dose
actions.value: The injector administers a tincture to a Friendly creature it can see within 5 feet that isn't a Construct, choosing from the effects below. Once a creature benefits from a tincture, it can't gain that benefit again until it finishes a Short or Long Rest.

actions.name: Adrenaline Rush
actions.value: The target can use its Reaction to move up to its Speed without provoking Opportunity Attack action or make one weapon attack with Advantage.

actions.name: Inoculation
actions.value: The injector chooses Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, Necrotic, or Poison damage. The target gains Resistance to the chosen damage type for 1 minute.

actions.name: Restorative Fluid
actions.value: The target regains 35 10d6 Hit Points. If the target is already at its Hit Point Maximum, it gains these as Temporary Hit Points instead.

actions.name: Focus
actions.value: The target has the Valor condition 1d4 for 1 minute.

fluffInfo.name: Study the Foe
fluffInfo.value: Characters proficient in *Medicine* gain Advantage on Wisdom (*Insight*) or Intelligence (*Investigation*) checks to Study an Innocent Harvester, learning the following based on the result:

fluffInfo.name: (10+) Metal and Wood
fluffInfo.value: You understand the Innocent Harvester's creature type as well as its damage and condition Immunities.

fluffInfo.name: (12+) Clamber and Leap
fluffInfo.value: You are aware of the Innocent Harvester's Leap.

fluffInfo.name: (15+) Simple Construct
fluffInfo.value: You know the Innocent Harvester's mental saving throws.

fluffInfo.name: Combat Tactics
fluffInfo.value: Though small and innocent in appearance, Innocent Harvesters are not defenseless. They are fast and agile, equipped with surgical tools in place of one hand and a syringe in the other. Made to subdue trespassers, or remove body parts from corpses, these unflinching minions will not hesitate to leap atop targets. However, they are more comfortable hiding and fleeing than fighting. Their job is to collect body parts. If threatened, they leap onto a target and begin using their surgical tools on them. Harvesters attempt to sedate wounded targets and flee.

fluffInfo.name: Animus:
fluffInfo.value: Construct.

fluffInfo.name: Fluid:
fluffInfo.value: Chemical Solution. Natural Weapons: Claws.

fluffInfo.name: Hair:
fluffInfo.value: Stitches.

fluffInfo.name: Hide:
fluffInfo.value: Plates.

traits.name: Normal Semblance
traits.value: The harvester has Advantage on Charisma (*Deception*) and Dexterity (*Stealth*) checks to pass itself off as an ordinary Small Humanoid such as a Human urchin or a Halfling.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The harvester makes two Surgical Claw attacks.

actions.name: Surgical Claw
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +5, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 10 (**2d6 + 3**) Slashing damage, and the target has the Bleeding condition (2d4).

actions.name: Syringe (1/Day)
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +5, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 10 (**2d6 + 3**) Piercing damage. *Constitution Saving Throw:* DC 11. *Failure:* 28 (**8d6**) Poison damage. *Success* Half damage. *Failure or Success*: If this Poison damage reduces the target to 0 Hit Points, it is stabilized but has the Poisoned condition for 1 hour, even if it regains Hit Points. While Poisoned, the target has the Paralyzed condition.

actions.name: Latch (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: The harvester moves up to its Speed. If it ends this movement within 5 feet of a Medium or larger creature, it can make one Surgical Claw attack against that creature. *Hit:* The harvester attaches to the target. While attached, the harvester has Advantage on attack rolls against the target. The attached harvester moves with the target, using none of the harvester's movement. The harvester can detach itself by using 5 feet of movement on its turn. A creature within 5 feet, including the target, can take an action to detach the harvester with a successful DC 13 Strength (*Athletics*) check.

bonusActions.name: Cunning Action
bonusActions.value: The harvester takes the Dash, Disengage, or Hide action.

fluffInfo.value: Within the Space Between Worlds, creatures exist that feed on arcane power, craving magic of all sorts, but particularly power that extraplanar patrons grant to mortals. One such creature identified by the Amethyst Academy has been classified simply as an Interloper.

fluffInfo.name: Drawn to Magic
fluffInfo.value: Interlopers crave magic, especially delighting in extracting the arcane power wielded by warlocks.
They latch onto the connection between a warlock and their patron, attempting to follow that connection into the Material plane where they lie in wait for their victim.

fluffInfo.name: Clustered Predators
fluffInfo.value: Interlopers seldom appear alone, preferring to attack in groups of three or more. Occasionally, they have been observed to bicker, fighting each other for the largest share of the spoils.

fluffInfo.name: Spell Snatchers
fluffInfo.value: Interlopers are feared by spellcasters because of their ability to Siphon Spells thrown at them. Once spellcasters recognize an area is infested with these creatures, they often commission Paladins of the Silver Order or grizzled monster hunters to hunt them down.

fluffInfo.name: Study the Foe
fluffInfo.value: Characters proficient in *Arcana* gain Advantage on Wisdom (*Insight*) or Intelligence (*Investigation*) checks to study an Interloper, revealing the following based on their result:

fluffInfo.name: (10+) Multidimensional Senses
fluffInfo.value: You recognize the creature's Blindsight trait.

fluffInfo.name: (15+) Magical Entity
fluffInfo.value: You are aware of its Siphon Spell ability.

fluffInfo.name: (20+) Agile and Cunning
fluffInfo.value: You know the Interloper's highest and lowest ability scores and saving throws.

fluffInfo.name: Combat Tactics
fluffInfo.value: An Interloper has only one objective, to feast on the spellcaster's magic that attracted it, and then to return to whence it came. It pursues the nearest spellcaster, prioritizing warlocks, assailing them until they are dead, or the caster's magic is spent It Teleports to evade physical attacks. If an Interloper drops below 10 Hit Points, it will __Plane Shift__, retreating into the Space Between Worlds to recover, seeking to return to feast again, likely in greater numbers.

fluffInfo.value: Aberration.

fluffInfo.name: Fluid:
fluffInfo.value: Monster Blood, Contaminated Ichor.

fluffInfo.name: Organs:
fluffInfo.value: Guts, Flesh.

fluffInfo.name: Natural Weapons:
fluffInfo.value: Claws.

fluffInfo.value: Skin.

fluffInfo.value: Aberrant Dust.

traits.name: Fully Contaminated
traits.value: The interloper is immune to Contamination and has Advantage on saving throws against contaminated spells. The interloper may cast contaminated spells even though it does not gain Contamination levels.

traits.name: Delerium Healing
traits.value: As an action, the interloper can touch a delerium shard to regain 10 (3d6) Hit Points. Once the interloper has used a delerium shard in this way, the shard can't be used in this manner again for 24 hours.

traits.name: Alien Intellect
traits.value: The interloper is immune to any effect that would sense its emotions or read its thoughts, as well as any divination spell that it refuses. Wisdom (*Insight*) checks made to ascertain the interloper's intentions or sincerity have Disadvantage.

traits.name: Special Immunities
traits.value: Interloper is immune to the Jinxed condition.

traits.name: Fully Contaminated
traits.value: The interloper is immune to Contamination and has Advantage on saving throws against contaminated spells. The interloper may cast contaminated spells even though it does not gain Contamination levels.

traits.name: Pack Tactics
traits.value: The interloper has Advantage on attack rolls against a creature if at least one of the interloper's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally doesn't have the Incapacitated condition.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The interloper makes one Spindly Claw attack and one Suckered Bite attack. If the interloper has used Siphon Spell since the end of its last turn, it can instead make three Spindly Claw or Suckered Bite attacks.

actions.name: Spindly Claw
actions.value: *Constitution Saving Throw:* DC 11, one creature within 5 ft. *Failure:* 14 (**4d6**) Necrotic damage and the target gains one Contamination level. Succes: half damage only.

actions.name: Suckered Bite
actions.value: *Charisma Saving Throw:* DC 15, one creature within 5ft. *Failure:* 14 (**4d6**) Psychic damage and the target has the Bewildered condition (save ends) and the interloper regains 10 (3d6) Hit Points. *Success* half damage only.

actions.name: Delerium Healing
actions.value: The interloper touches a delerium shard and regains 10 (3d6) Hit Points. Once the interloper has used a delerium shard in this way, that shard can't be used in this manner again for 24 hours.

actions.name: Plane Shift (1/Day)
actions.value: The interloper casts __Plane Shift__ targeting only itself, requiring no components and using Charisma as its spellcasting ability.

bonusActions.name: Teleport
bonusActions.value: The interloper teleports to an unoccupied space it can see within 30 feet.

entries: **Languages**: Common, Deep Speech, Undercommon, telepathy 120 ft.

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.value: Ithu'rath can breathe air and water.

traits.name: Immutable Form
traits.value: Ithu'rath is immune to any power, spell, or effect that would alter their form.

traits.name: Slimy Resistance (3/Day)
traits.value: When Ithu'rath fails a saving throw, they can succeed on the save by channeling the power of their protective slime. Until the end of Ithu'rath's next turn, creatures have advantage on the saving throw for Ithu'rath's Devolving Tentacle attack.

traits.name: Supernatural Resistance
traits.value: Ithu'rath has advantage on saving throws against powers, spells, and other supernatural effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: Ithu'rath makes six Devolving Tentacle attacks and uses Piscine Transformation.

actions.name: Devolving Tentacle
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +11 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. *Hit:* 16 (**3d6 + 6**) piercing damage. The first time a creature is hit with this attack on a turn, they must succeed on a DC 19 Constitution saving throw or be injected with a degenerative psionic slime (save ends at end of turn). While slimed, each time the creature makes an attack roll or an ability check, they must roll a d4 and subtract the number rolled from the d20 roll. At the end of a slimed creature's turn, the size of the subtracted die increases by one: the d4 becomes a d6, the d6 becomes a d8, and so on, to a maximum of d12. The cure ailment power or __lesser restoration__ spell also ends this effect.

actions.name: Piscine Transformation (3rd-Order Power)
actions.value: Ithu'rath targets a creature with a head, legs, or torso they can see within 60 feet of them, blasting them with a pulse of transformational energy. The target must succeed on a DC 19 Wisdom saving throw or undergo one of the following transformations of the Ithu'rath's choice:

entries: **Head.** The target's head transforms into the head of a fish, proportionately sized for their body. They can't speak.
**Legs.** The target's legs become fins. Their walking speed is reduced to 10 feet (unless their walking speed is slower), and they gain a swimming speed of 30 feet.

**Torso.** The target's torso becomes the body of a fish with gills. They can only breathe water and can hold their breath for 1 hour. If the target isn't underwater when this transformation takes effect, they begin suffocating.

actions.value: The transformation lasts until a cure ailment power of 4th order or higher or the __greater restoration__ spell affects the target. A target who suffers all three transformations at once is permanently transformed into a hybrid fishlike creature and can only be returned to their original form by a __wish__ spell or similar supernatural effects.

bonusActions.name: Jaunt (3rd-Order Power)
bonusActions.value: Ithu'rath teleports 30 feet to an unoccupied space they can see.

traits.name: Apotheosis (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
traits.value: If the koboldzilla would be reduced to 0 hit points, its current hit point total instead resets to 145 hit points, it recharges its Dragon Breath, its Dexterity increases to 27 (+8), and its Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma increase to 16 (+3). Additionally, all kobold pilots are incinerated in the process, it can't use its Koboldapult legendary action until it finishes a short or long rest, and the koboldzilla can use the options in the "Mythic Actions" section for 1 hour. Award a party an additional 8,400 XP (16,800 XP total) for defeating the koboldzilla after its Apotheosis activates.

traits.name: Constructed Weakness
traits.value: The koboldzilla has the following flaws:

entries: **Arcanothermic Engine**: If the koboldzilla takes 10 or more cold damage in a single turn, it can't recharge its Dragon Breath action until the end of its next turn.
**Rustable**: If the koboldzilla takes 10 or more acid damage in a single turn, it becomes restrained until the end of its next turn.

traits.name: Immutable Form
traits.value: The koboldzilla is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.value: If the koboldzilla fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Loose Plating
traits.value: When the koboldzilla is reduced to 70 hit points or fewer for the first time since it last finished a long rest, it loses some of its armour plating. Its AC is reduced to 18, its walking speed is doubled, and its Dexterity increases to 20 (+5). These effects last until it finishes a long rest.

traits.name: Siege Monster
traits.value: The koboldzilla deals double damage to objects and structures.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The koboldzilla makes two attacks: one with its Gazebo Smash and one with its Tail.

actions.name: Gazebo Smash
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., each target within a 5-foot-radius circle. *Hit:* 12 (**3d4 + 5**) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Tail
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +9 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. *Hit:* 15 (**3d6 + 5**) slashing damage.

actions.name: Dragon Breath (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: The koboldzilla exhales fire in a 40-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 16 Dexterity saving throw, taking 24 (**7d6**) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

traits.name: Exploit Opening (3/Day)
traits.value: When Jedar makes an attack, he has advantage on the attack roll.

actions.name: Warhammer
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 6 (**1d8 + 2**) bludgeoning damage plus 2 (**1d4**) necrotic damage.

actions.name: Nameless Reach (2/Day; 1st-Level Spell)
actions.value: *Ranged Spell Attack:* +4 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. *Hit:* 14 (**4d6**) necrotic damage, and the next attack roll made against this target before the end of Jedar's next turn has advantage.

actions.name: Animate Bones (1/Day)
actions.value: Jedar animates three __decrepit skeleton__s, who appear in unoccupied spaces Jedar can see within 30 feet of him. The skeletons act immediately after Jedar on the same initiative count and follow his verbal orders.
If Jedar dies, the skeletons are destroyed.

bonusActions.name: Bone Shield
bonusActions.value: Jedar destroys a decrepit skeleton under his control and chooses a creature he can see within 60 feet of him. The target gains 7 (2d6) temporary hit points.

fluffInfo.name: Study the Foe
fluffInfo.value: Characters proficient in *Survival* or *Nature* gain Advantage on Intelligence (*Arcana*) check to Study a Juggernaut Hulk, learning the following based on their result:

fluffInfo.name: (10+) Pure Destruction
fluffInfo.value: You know of its Out of My Way trait.

fluffInfo.name: (15+) Rusted Blades
fluffInfo.value: You learn of the Juggernaut's Whirlwind action and Rip and Tear Bonus Action.

fluffInfo.name: (20+) Renewing Flesh
fluffInfo.value: You recognize its Regeneration trait.

fluffInfo.name: Combat Tactics
fluffInfo.value: The Juggernaut Hulk barrels forward in combat, slamming foes out of its way and swinging its blades wildly. Its main tactic is to knock enemies down and then drive its blades into them, bisecting them on the spot.
The Juggernaut Hulk does not flee and seems to shrug off most injuries. It will fight until its last breath with determination and ferocity.

fluffInfo.value: Aberration.

fluffInfo.name: Fluid:
fluffInfo.value: Monster Blood, Contaminated Ichor.

fluffInfo.name: Organs:
fluffInfo.value: Eyes, Heart, Brain, Guts, Flesh.

fluffInfo.name: Bones:
fluffInfo.value: Skull, Spine, Ribs.

fluffInfo.name: Hair:
fluffInfo.value: Hair.

fluffInfo.name: Hide:
fluffInfo.value: Skin.

fluffInfo.name: Dust:
fluffInfo.value: Aberrant Dust.

traits.name: Regenerate
traits.value: The hulk regains 10 Hit Points at the start of its turn. If the hulk takes Acid or Cold damage, this trait doesn't function on the hulk's next turn. The hulk dies only if it starts its turn with 0 Hit Points and doesn't regenerate.

traits.name: Out of My Way
traits.value: The hulk moves more than 10 feet in a straight line. *Dexterity Saving Throw:* DC 17, each creature within 5 feet of its path. *Failure:* The target is pushed 5 feet away from the hulk and has the Prone condition.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The hulk makes two Rusty Blade attacks. It can replace one Rusty Blade attack with Whirlwind if available.

actions.name: Rusty Blade
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +9, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 13 (**2d6 + 6**) Slashing damage and the creature gains the Bleeding 2d6 condition.

actions.name: Whirlwind (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: The hulk twirls its blades around it in a violent, heavy swing. *Strength Saving Throw:* DC 17, each creature within 10 feet of the hulk. *Failure:* 27 (**6d6 + 6**) Slashing damage, and the target has the Prone condition. *Success* Half damage only.

bonusActions.name: Rip and Tear
bonusActions.value: The hulk makes one Rusty Blade attack against a Prone creature.

entries: **Languages**: Common, Dwarvish, thieves' cant, telepathy 120 ft.

traits.name: Mind Link
traits.value: Jutkarr can communicate telepathically with any Amethyst Knife boss regardless of distance, provided they are on the same plane of existence.

traits.name: Poison Resistant
traits.value: Jutkarr has advantage on saving throws he makes to avoid or end the poisoned condition on himself.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: Jutkarr makes two Deserved Transfer attacks.

actions.name: *Deserved Transfer (2nd-Order Power)
actions.value: *Melee or Ranged Power Attack:* +9 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30 ft., one creature. *Hit:* 13 (**2d6 + 6**) psychic damage, and one creature Jutkarr can see within 30 feet of him gains temporary hit points equal to half the damage dealt.

actions.name: Psionic Resilience (2/Day; 4th-Order Power)
actions.value: Jutkarr touches a willing creature and gives them immunity to one of the following conditions for 1 hour: blinded, charmed, dazed, deafened, frightened, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, or stunned. Additionally, if the target suffers from the chosen condition, that condition is suppressed for 1 hour.

traits.name: Multiple Tongues
traits.value: The worm has three tongues, each of which can be targeted with attacks (AC 20, immunity to psychic damage) while that tongue is grappling a creature. When a tongue takes 35 damage or more in a single turn, that tongue is destroyed, releasing any target it was grappling. The worm can't use a destroyed tongue with their Multiattack or Tongue Grab action until they finish a long rest. Damaging or destroying a tongue deals no damage to the worm.

traits.name: Slowed, Not Stopped (3/Day)
traits.value: When the worm fails a saving throw, they can choose to succeed instead. When they do, their speed and the reach of their Tongue Grab attack are each reduced by a cumulative 10 feet until they finish a long rest. The worm's speed and reach can't be reduced below 5 feet in this way.

traits.name: Tunneler
traits.value: The worm can burrow through solid rock at half their burrowing speed and leaves a 10-foot-diameter tunnel in their wake.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The worm can make a number of Tongue Grab attacks equal to the number of tongues they currently have (see Multiple Tongues). The worm can replace any number of those attacks with a use of Swallow.

actions.name: Tongue Grab
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +14 to hit, reach 30 ft., one target. *Hit:* 14 (**4d6**) acid damage, and the creature is grappled (escape DC 19). Until this grapple ends, the worm can't use this tongue against another target.

actions.name: Maw
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +14 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 22 (**3d8 + 9**) piercing damage. If the target is Huge or smaller, they must succeed on a DC 19 Dexterity saving throw or be swallowed (as if by the worm's Swallow action).

actions.name: Swallow
actions.value: The worm pulls a Huge or smaller grappled creature into their maw and swallows them. A swallowed creature is no longer grappled, but they are blinded and restrained, have total cover against attacks and other effects outside the worm, and take 28 (**8d6**) acid damage at the start of each of the worm's turns.

If the worm takes 30 damage or more on a single turn from a creature inside them, the worm must succeed on a DC 21 Constitution check at the end of that turn or regurgitate all swallowed creatures, each of whom fall prone in an unoccupied space within 10 feet of the worm. If the worm dies, a swallowed creature can escape from the corpse by using 20 feet of movement, exiting prone.

bonusActions.name: Tongue Sweep
bonusActions.value: The worm violently swings a creature they have grappled. The grappled creature takes 10 (**3d6**) bludgeoning damage, and each enemy within 10 feet of the grappled creature must succeed on a DC 16 Dexterity saving throw or take 10 (**3d6**) bludgeoning damage.

traits.name: Multiple Tongues
traits.value: The worm has three tongues, each of which can be targeted with attacks (AC 20, immunity to psychic damage) while that tongue is grappling a creature. When a tongue takes 35 damage or more in a single turn, that tongue is destroyed, releasing any target it was grappling. The worm can't use a destroyed tongue with their Multiattack or Tongue Grab action until they finish a long rest. Damaging or destroying a tongue deals no damage to the worm.

traits.name: Slowed, Not Stopped (3/Day)
traits.value: When the worm fails a saving throw, they can choose to succeed instead. When they do, their speed and the reach of their Tongue Grab attack are each reduced by a cumulative 10 feet until they finish a long rest. The worm's speed and reach can't be reduced below 5 feet in this way.

traits.name: Tunneler
traits.value: The worm can burrow through solid rock at half their burrowing speed and leaves a 10-foot-diameter tunnel in their wake.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The worm can make a number of Tongue Grab attacks equal to the number of tongues they currently have (see Multiple Tongues). The worm can replace any number of those attacks with a use of Swallow.

actions.name: Tongue Grab
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +14 to hit, reach 30 ft., one target. *Hit:* 14 (**4d6**) acid damage, and the creature is grappled (escape DC 19). Until this grapple ends, the worm can't use this tongue against another target.

actions.name: Maw
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +14 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 22 (**3d8 + 9**) piercing damage. If the target is Huge or smaller, they must succeed on a DC 19 Dexterity saving throw or be swallowed (as if by the worm's Swallow action).

If the worm takes 30 damage or more on a single turn from a creature inside them, the worm must succeed on a DC 21 Constitution check at the end of that turn or regurgitate all swallowed creatures, each of whom fall prone in an unoccupied space within 10 feet of the worm. If the worm dies, a swallowed creature can escape from the corpse by using 20 feet of movement, exiting prone.

entries: **HP**: 7 + seven times caregiver's level (number of d8 Hit Dice equal to their caregiver's level)
**Skills**: athletics +3 plus PB, perception +0 plus PB

actions.name: Signature Attack (Tongue Lash)
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +3 plus PB to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* **1d6 plus PB** acid damage.

actions.name: 1st Level: Distracting Attack (2 Ferocity)
actions.value: The worm makes a signature attack. On a hit, the attack deals its normal effects, and the next attack roll made against the target before the start of the worm's next turn has advantage.

actions.name: 3rd Level: Tongue Grab (5 Ferocity)
actions.value: The worm makes a signature attack. On a hit, the target is also grappled (escape DC 10 plus PB). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained and the worm can't make a signature attack against another target.

actions.name: 5th Level: Swallow (8 Ferocity)
actions.value: The worm attempts to swallow a Medium or smaller creature within 5 feet of them. The target must make a DC 10 plus PB Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, the target takes **PBd6** bludgeoning damage and is swallowed. On a successful save, the target takes half as much damage and isn't swallowed. The worm can have only one target swallowed at a time.

A swallowed target is blinded and restrained, they have total cover against attacks and other effects outside the worm, and they take **PBd6** acid damage at the start of each of the worm's turns. Whenever the worm takes damage, they must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or regurgitate the swallowed creature, who falls prone in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the worm. The DC for this saving throw equals 10 or half the triggering damage, whichever is higher. If the worm is incapacitated or dies, a swallowed creature is no longer restrained by the worm and can escape from the corpse using 5 feet of movement, exiting prone.

bonusActions.name: Item Storage
bonusActions.value: The worm can swallow an object without harming it by storing the object in a second stomach. They can use this bonus action again to regurgitate a specific stored object without disturbing any other objects in their second stomach. A regurgitated object lands in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the worm.
The worm's second stomach can hold up to PB × 10 pounds of objects, not exceeding a volume of 10 cubic feet.

fluffInfo.name: Study the Foe
fluffInfo.value: Characters proficient in *Medicine*, *Arcana*, or *Survival* gain Advantage on Wisdom (*Insight*) or Intelligence (*Investigation*) checks to Study the Kingkiller Hydra, learning the following based on the result:

fluffInfo.name: (15+) Lab Construct
fluffInfo.value: You recognize the creature's type, its Resistances, and Immunities.

fluffInfo.name: (20+) Barrage of Bites
fluffInfo.value: You learn of the creature's Hydra Fury Epic Action.

fluffInfo.name: (24+) Head Regrowth
fluffInfo.value: You are aware of the creature's Multiple Heads trait.

fluffInfo.name: Combat Tactics
fluffInfo.value: The Kingkiller Hydra is relentless. It attacks with all its heads against any target in range. If there is distance between it and its foes, it Tramples them before unleashing Bite attacks with its heads, or it Spits Acid at them from afar while closing the distance.
If the hydra takes 75 or more Fire damage in a single round, it attempts to flee.

fluffInfo.name: Animus:
fluffInfo.value: Construct.

fluffInfo.name: Fluid:
fluffInfo.value: Monster Blood, Contaminated vIchor, Acidic Bile.

fluffInfo.name: Organs:
fluffInfo.value: Eyes, Heart, Brain, Guts, Glands.

fluffInfo.name: Bones:
fluffInfo.value: Skull, Spine.

fluffInfo.name: Natural Weapons:
fluffInfo.value: Claws, Teeth.

fluffInfo.name: Hair:
fluffInfo.value: Stitches.

fluffInfo.name: Hide:
fluffInfo.value: Scales.

traits.name: Corrosive Aura
traits.value: The area within 30 feet of the hydra is filled with corrosive fumes and is Lightly Obscured. A creature that starts its turn in the fumes takes 20 (**8d4**) Acid damage.

traits.name: Head Count
traits.value: The hydra can't make more Bite or Spit Acid attacks each round than it has heads, and each head can only be used to make one Bite or Spit Acid attack each round.

traits.name: Multiple Heads
traits.value: The hydra has five heads. Whenever the hydra takes 25 damage or more in a single turn, one of its heads dies. The hydra dies if all of its heads are dead.

traits.name: Reactive Heads
traits.value: For each head the hydra has beyond one, it gets an extra Reaction that can be used only for Opportunity Attack action.

traits.name: Special Immunities
traits.value: The hydra is immune to the Burning (Acid only) condition.

traits.name: Wakeful
traits.value: While the hydra sleeps, at least one of its heads is awake.

actions.name: The hydra always takes its turn on Initiative count 20
actions.value: On its turn, the hydra can use its movement and interaction as normal. However, it does not take an action or Bonus Action on its turn unless forced to do so by a spell or other effect. Instead, the hydra takes one of the following Epic Actions at the end of each player character's turn:

actions.name: Bite
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +14, reach 20 ft. *Hit:* 26 (**4d8 + 8**) Piercing damage.

actions.name: Spit Acid
actions.value: *Ranged Attack Roll:* +14, range 150/600 ft. *Hit:* 20 (**8d4**) Acid damage, and the target has the Burning condition (8d4 Acid). While Burning, the target has the Blinded condition.

actions.name: Grow Heads
actions.value: The hydra can only perform this Epic Action if one or more of its heads died this round, unless the head was killed by Fire damage. The hydra grows two heads, and regains 20 Hit Points.

actions.name: Hydra Fury (1/Round)
actions.value: The hydra makes one Bite attack or one Spit Acid attack for each head that hasn't yet made an attack this round.

actions.name: Trample (1/Round)
actions.value: The hydra moves up to its Speed without provoking Opportunity Attack action. During this movement, it can move through the spaces of Huge or smaller creatures. Each creature the hydra moves over is subjected to the following effect. *Dexterity Saving Throw:* DC 22. *Failure:* 35 (**10d6**) Bludgeoning damage, and the target has the Prone condition.

actions.name: Tail (1/Round)
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +14, reach 15 ft. *Hit:* 34 (**4d12 + 8**) Bludgeoning damage, and the target is pushed up to 20 feet away from the hydra.

actions.name: Epic Resistance
actions.value: The hydra chooses one condition, spell, or other effect currently affecting them and rolls 1d20. On an 11+, the effect ends on it. The hydra can use this action even if it would otherwise be unable to take actions, its actions are being controlled by another creature, or if a spell or effect alters its game statistics.

traits.name: Corrupting Phasing
traits.value: Kiona can move through other creatures and objects. Kiona takes 5 (**1d10**) force damage if she ends her turn inside an object. A creature takes 9 (**2d8**) necrotic damage the first time Kiona passes through them on a turn.

traits.name: Incorporeal Empowerment
traits.value: Each incorporeal Undead within 120 feet of Kiona ignores difficult terrain.

traits.name: Spiritual Sacrifice (3/Day)
traits.value: When Kiona fails a saving throw, she can lose 15 hit points and choose to succeed instead.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: Kiona makes two Energy Siphon attacks.

actions.name: Energy Siphon
actions.value: *Melee or Ranged Spell Attack:* +9 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 120 ft., one creature. *Hit:* 15 (**3d6 + 5**) necrotic damage, and the target can't regain hit points until the start of Kiona's next turn. Kiona gains temporary hit points equal to half the damage dealt by this attack.

actions.name: Rise from Death (1/Day)
actions.value: Kiona conjures three shadows, two specters, or one wraith under her control. Each summoned creature appears in an unoccupied space within 30 feet of Kiona and acts immediately after her turn on the same initiative count.

bonusActions.name: Path of Pain
bonusActions.value: Kiona chooses one other incorporeal Undead within 120 feet of her who can see her. That Undead can move up to their speed.

traits.name: Charm Resistant
traits.value: Kishina has advantage on saving throws she makes to avoid or end the charmed condition on herself.

traits.name: Light Landing
traits.value: Kishina takes no damage from falling.

traits.name: Standing Leap
traits.value: Kishina's long jump is up to 45 feet and her high jump is up to 15 feet, with or without a running start.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: Kishina makes four Unarmed Strike attacks or three Throwing Knife attacks.

actions.name: Unarmed Strike
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 11 (**1d8 + 7**) bludgeoning damage, or 20 (**3d8 + 7**) bludgeoning damage on a critical hit.

actions.name: Throwing Knife
actions.value: *Ranged Weapon Attack:* +10 to hit, range 20/60 ft., one target. *Hit:* 9 (**1d4 + 7**) piercing damage.

actions.name: Painful Sprint (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: Kishina moves up to her speed without provoking opportunity attacks, hitting a pressure point on each enemy she can see who she passes within 5 feet of during this move. Each target must succeed on a DC 18 Constitution saving throwing or be poisoned until the start of their next turn. A creature who fails this save by 5 or more also falls prone.

bonusActions.name: Throw
bonusActions.value: Kishina attempts to throw a Large or smaller enemy she can see within 5 feet of her. The target must succeed on a DC 18 Dexterity saving throw or be moved up to 15 feet away from her and be knocked prone.

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.value: Klar can breathe air and water.

traits.name: Mimicry
traits.value: Klar can mimic animal sounds. A creature who hears the sounds can tell they are imitations with a successful DC 13 Wisdom (*Insight*) check.

traits.name: Standing Leap
traits.value: Klar's long jump is up to 40 feet and their high jump is up to 15 feet, with or without a running start.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: Klar makes one Bite attack and one Mantis Claws attack.

actions.name: Bite
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 8 (**1d8 + 4**) piercing damage.

actions.name: Mantis Claws
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +6 to hit, reach 5 f., one target. *Hit:* 7 (**1d6 + 4**) slashing damage. If the target is Medium or smaller, they are grappled (escape DC 14). While grappled in this way, the target is restrained. Moving while grappling a Medium or smaller target doesn't halve Klar's speed. Klar can have only one target grappled in this way at a time.

bonusActions.name: Bellowing Roar (1/Day)
bonusActions.value: Klar lets loose a terrifying roar.

Each creature within 30 feet of Klar who can hear them must succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened of Klar for 1 minute. If a creature frightened in this way takes damage, they can repeat this saving throw, ending the effect on themself on a success.

bonusActions.name: Kangaroo Leap
bonusActions.value: Klar jumps up to half their speed without provoking opportunity attacks.

traits.name: Aura of Righteousness
traits.value: Theodore projects a 30-foot Emanation of radiant power. Allies in the Emanation have Advantage on saving throws. A Hostile creature that starts its turn in the Emanation takes 14 (**4d6**) Radiant damage.

actions.name: Theodore always takes his turn on Initiative count 20
actions.value: On his turn, Theodore can use his movement and interaction as normal. However, he does not take an action or Bonus Action on his turn unless forced to do so by a spell or other effect. Instead, Theodore takes one of the following Epic Actions at the end of each player character's turn:

entries: **Holy Avenger Longsword**: *Melee Attack Roll:* +13, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 18 (**2d12 + 5**) Slashing damage, and the target suffers one of the following effects of Theodore's choice.
**Divine Smite**: *Wisdom Saving Throw:* DC 17. *Failure:* 18 (**4d8**) Radiant damage. *Success* Half damage.

actions.name: Searing Smite
actions.value: *Dexterity Saving Throw:* DC 17. *Failure:* 14 (**4d6**) Fire damage, and the target has the Burning condition (4d6 Fire). *Success* Half damage only.

actions.name: Thunderous Smite
actions.value: *Strength Saving Throw:* DC 17. *Failure:* 9 (**2d8**) Thunder damage, and the target is pushed up to 10 feet away from Theodore and has the Prone condition. *Success* Half damage only.

actions.name: Shield
actions.value: *Melee or Ranged Attack Roll:* +13, reach 5 ft or range 30/90 ft. *Hit:* 19 (**4d6 + 5**) Bludgeoning damage, and the target has the Dazed condition until the end of its next turn. *Hit or Miss:* After being thrown, the shield returns to Theodore's hand.

actions.name: Charge (1/Round)
actions.value: Theodore moves up to his Speed toward a Hostile creature he can see. He gains Advantage on the next weapon attack he makes this round.

actions.name: Call the Sacred Flame (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: *Dexterity Saving Throw:* DC 17, each creature in a 10-foot-radius, 40-foot-high Cylinder centered on a point within 60 feet of Theodore. *Failure:* 21 (**6d6**) Radiant damage plus 21 (**6d6**) Fire damage, and the target has the Blinded condition (save ends).

actions.name: Epic Resistance
actions.value: Theodore chooses one condition, spell, or other effect currently affecting him and rolls 1d20. On an 11+, the effect ends on him. Theodore can use this action even if he would otherwise be unable to take actions, his actions are being controlled by another creature, or if a spell or effect alters his game statistics.

traits.name: Shield? Shield!
traits.value: The adeptus gains a +1 bonus to AC while within 5 feet of at least one ally who also has this trait, is wielding a shield, and isn't incapacitated or prone. To benefit from this trait, the adeptus must be wielding a shield.

actions.name: Firecracker
actions.value: *Ranged Spell Attack:* +4 to hit, range 60 ft., one target. *Hit:* 5 (**2d4**) fire damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 12 Constitution saving throw or be deafened until the end of their next turn.

actions.name: Shocking Grasp (Cantrip)
actions.value: *Melee Spell Attack:* +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 4 (**1d8**) lightning damage, and the target can't take reactions until the start of their next turn. The adeptus has advantage on this attack roll if the target is wearing metal armor.

actions.name: Lesser Magic Missile (1/Day; 1st-Level Spell)
actions.value: The adeptus creates three glowing darts of magical force. Each dart hits a creature of their choice who they can see within 120 feet of them. A dart deals 2 (**1d2 + 1**) force damage to its target. The darts all strike simultaneously, and the adeptus can direct them to hit one creature or several. This action is considered to be the __magic missile__ spell for the purpose of other spells and effects.

traits.name: Shield? Shield!
traits.value: The artifex gains a +1 bonus to AC while within 5 feet of at least one ally who also has this trait, is wielding a shield, and isn't incapacitated or prone. To benefit from this trait, the artifex must be wielding a shield.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The artifex makes one Chain Hook attack and uses Activate Trap, if available.

actions.name: Chain Hook
actions.value: *Ranged Weapon Attack:* +4 to hit, range 15/30 ft., one target. *Hit:* 4 (**1d4 + 2**) piercing damage, and if the target is a Large or smaller creature, they must succeed on a DC 12 Strength saving throw or be pulled up to 15 feet toward the artifex.

actions.name: Activate Trap (3/Day)
actions.value: The artifex activates one of the following hidden traps; the artifex can't use the same trap two rounds in a row:

actions.name: Spiky Pit Trap
actions.value: The artifex chooses a point on the ground that they can see within 60 feet of them, opening a concealed 15-foot-square trapdoor on the ground centered on that point to reveal a 10-foot-deep pit trap lined with spikes. Creatures on the ground in the trapdoor's area must make a DC 12 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a creature falls into the pit and takes 3 (**1d6**) piercing damage from the spikes and 3 (**1d6**) bludgeoning damage from the fall. On a successful save, a creature moves to the nearest unoccupied space outside that area.

actions.name: Swarm of Bees Trap
actions.value: The artifex chooses a point on the ground that they can see within 60 feet of them, causing a buried canister to erupt and release a 15-foot-radius, 10-foot-high cylinder of swarming bees. When a creature enters the swarm's area for the first time on a turn or starts their turn there, they must make a DC 12 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 5 (**2d4**) poison damage and is poisoned until the end of their next turn. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage and isn't poisoned. At the start of each of the artifex's turns, the swarm moves 10 feet away from the artifex in a straight line. The swarm disperses after 1 minute or when the artifex dies.

actions.name: Wall of Fire Trap
actions.value: The artifex chooses a point on the ground that they can see within 60 feet of them, igniting a concealed trench of oil and creating a 20-foot long, 15-foot high, and 1-foot-thick wall of fire. When the wall appears, each creature within its area must make a DC 12 Dexterity saving throw, taking 7 (**2d6**) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. A creature who enters the wall for the first time on a turn or ends their turn there takes 7 (**2d6**) fire damage. The wall is opaque and lasts for 1 minute.

traits.name: Shield? Shield!
traits.value: The centurion gains a +1 bonus to AC while within 5 feet of at least one ally who also has this trait, is wielding a shield, and isn't incapacitated or prone. To benefit from this trait, the centurion must be wielding a shield.

actions.name: Pilum
actions.value: *Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack:* +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30/120 ft., one target. *Hit:* 5 (**1d6 + 2**) piercing damage.

actions.name: Firetail Pilum (2/Day)
actions.value: The centurion ignites a pilum then uses it to make a ranged Pilum attack against a target within 60 feet of them. Hit or miss, the target and each creature in a 5-foot-wide line between the target and the centurion must succeed on a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw or take 5 (**2d4**) fire damage. The line smolders for 1 minute, creating a 5-foot-wide, 20-foot-tall wall of opaque smoke. A creature within reach of the pilum can use an action to extinguish it, causing the smoke to dissipate.

actions.name: Boom Pilum!!! (1/Day)
actions.value: The centurion straps a vial of unstable ores to a pilum then uses it to make a ranged Pilum attack against a target within 60 feet of them. Hit or miss, the ores explode after the attack. The target and each creature within 10 feet of them must make a DC 13 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 7 (**2d6**) thunder damage, is knocked prone, and is deafened for 1 minute (save ends at end of turn). On a successful save, a creature takes only half as much damage and isn't knocked prone or deafened.

traits.name: Constructed Weakness

entries: **Rustable**: If the kobold mech takes 10 or more acid damage in a single turn, it becomes restrained until the end of its next turn.

traits.name: Pack Tactics
traits.value: The kobold mech has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the kobold's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't incapacitated.

traits.name: Piloted

traits.name: Self-Destruct
traits.value: When the kobold mech is reduced to 0 hit points, its cache of dynamite immediately explodes. Each creature within 20 feet of the kobold must make a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw, taking 21 (**6d6**) thunder damage on a failure, or half as much damage on a success.

actions.name: Multiattacks
actions.value: The kobold mech makes two attacks with its Cavitation Drill. It can replace one of these attacks with a Javelin Missile.

actions.name: Cavitation Drill
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 9 (**1d10 + 4**) piercing damage plus 7 (**2d6**) thunder damage.

actions.name: Javelin Missile (6/Day)
actions.value: The kobold mech fires a dynamite-strapped javelin at a point it can see within 120 feet of it. Each creature within 5 feet of that point must make a DC 12 Dexterity saving throw, taking 10 (**3d6**) thunder damage on a failure, or half as much damage on a success.

traits.name: Shield? Shield!
traits.value: The signifer gains a +1 bonus to AC while within 5 feet of at least one ally who also has this trait, is wielding a shield, and isn't incapacitated or prone. To benefit from this trait, the signifer must be wielding a shield.

traits.name: Standard Bearer
traits.value: Each kobold unit can have one or more signifers, whose weapon is their unit's battle standard. If a signifer drops their signum, they use the kobold tiro stat block instead. If an allied kobold tiro uses an action to pick up a signum not carried by another creature, that tiro uses the kobold signifer stat block instead. When a signifer or tiro's stat block changes in this way, any conditions or effects currently affecting them remain active, and their hit points and hit point maximum remain the same.
A signum that isn't being held by a creature can be damaged; it has AC 15, 5 hit points, and immunity to poison and psychic damage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The signifer makes two Signum attacks.

actions.name: Signum
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 5 (**1d6 + 2**) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Shield Wall Formation
actions.value: The signifer chooses up to four kobolds within 60 feet of them who can hear them. Each kobold can use their reaction to move up to their speed, and each kobold who does so must end this movement within 5 feet of an ally.

bonusActions.name: Glory to the Legion (1/Day)
bonusActions.value: The signifer and each ally within 30 feet of them who can hear them regains 5 (**2d4**) hit points.

traits.name: Minion
traits.value: If the tiro takes damage from an attack or as the result of a failed saving throw, their hit points are reduced to 0. If the tiro takes damage from another effect, they die if the damage equals or exceeds their hit point maximum; otherwise they take no damage.

traits.name: Shield? Shield!
traits.value: The tiro gains a +1 bonus to AC while within 5 feet of at least one ally who also has this trait, is wielding a shield, and isn't incapacitated or prone. To benefit from this trait, the tiro must be wielding a shield.

traits.name: Testudo
traits.value: When the tiro finishes a long rest, they choose a non-minion creature to be their commander. While a tiro who isn't incapacitated or prone is within 5 feet of their commander, the commander gains a cumulative +1 bonus to AC (maximum bonus of +5).

actions.name: Pugio (Group Attack)
actions.value: *Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack:* +3 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. *Hit:* 1 piercing damage.

traits.name: Shield? Shield!
traits.value: The veles gains a +1 bonus to AC while within 5 feet of at least one ally who also has this trait, is wielding a shield, and isn't incapacitated or prone. To benefit from this trait, the veles must be wielding a shield.

actions.name: Pilum
actions.value: *Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack:* +3 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30/120 ft., one target. *Hit:* 4 (**1d6 + 1**) piercing damage. If the attack hits a creature wielding a shield, the veles can embed the pilum in the shield, giving the target disadvantage on attack rolls until the target either stops wielding the shield or uses an action to remove the pilum from it. The veles carries six pila.

bonusActions.name: Pivot
bonusActions.value: The veles moves up to half their speed without provoking opportunity attacks.

traits.name: Not What I Seem
traits.value: The venator begins combat disguised as an inexperienced warrior. They have advantage on their first weapon attack roll against a creature who hasn't seen them make an attack.

traits.name: Shield? Shield!
traits.value: The venator gains a +1 bonus to AC while within 5 feet of at least one ally who also has this trait, is wielding a shield, and isn't incapacitated or prone. To benefit from this trait, the venator must be wielding a shield.

actions.name: Dolabra
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 6 (**1d8 + 2**) slashing damage.

actions.name: Net
actions.value: *Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack:* +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 5/15 ft., one Large or smaller creature. *Hit:* The target is restrained until they are freed. A creature can use their action to make a DC 10 Strength check, freeing themself or another creature within their reach on a success. Dealing 5 slashing damage to the net (AC 10) also frees the creature without harming them and destroys the net. The venator carries one net.

bonusActions.name: Lost in the Crowd
bonusActions.value: The venator takes the Hide action. They have advantage on their Dexterity (*Stealth*) check if they are within 5 feet of two or more allied kobolds.

bonusActions.name: Then We Light the Net on Fire!
bonusActions.value: The venator chooses a creature within 5 feet of them who is restrained by a net and lights that net on fire. While restrained by the net, the target takes 3 (**1d6**) fire damage at the start of each of their turns. Each time the net deals damage, roll any die. On an odd result, the net burns away and is destroyed, freeing the restrained creature. A creature who attempts to free the restrained creature from the net (as described in the venator's Net attack) automatically puts out the fire as part of that action, regardless of whether that check succeeds.

entries: **Speed**: *walk* 20 Ft. But See Loose Plating, *burrow* 20 Ft.
**Immunities**: fire, poison; blinded, charmed, deafened, exhaustion, frightened, paralysed, petrified, poisoned, stunned

traits.name: Apotheosis (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
traits.value: If the koboldzilla would be reduced to 0 hit points, its current hit point total instead resets to 310 hit points, it recharges its Dragon Breath, its Dexterity increases to 27 (+8), and its Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma increase to 18 (+4). Additionally, all kobold pilots are incinerated in the process, it can't use its Koboldapult legendary action until it finishes a short or long rest, and the koboldzilla can use the options in the "Mythic Actions" section for 1 hour. Award a party an additional 33,000 XP (66,000 XP total) for defeating the koboldzilla after its Apotheosis activates.

traits.name: Constructed Weakness
traits.value: The koboldzilla has the following flaws:

entries: **Arcanothermic Engine**: If the koboldzilla takes 20 or more cold damage in a single turn, it can't recharge its Dragon Breath action until the end of its next turn.
**Rustable**: If the koboldzilla takes 20 or more acid damage in a single turn, it becomes restrained until the end of its next turn.

traits.name: Immutable Form
traits.value: The koboldzilla is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.value: If the koboldzilla fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Loose Plating
traits.value: When the koboldzilla is reduce to 165 hit points or fewer for the first time since it last finished a long rest, it loses some of its armour plating. Its AC is reduced to 19, its walking speed is doubled, and its Dexterity increases to 20 (+5). These effects last until it finishes a long rest.

traits.name: Siege Monster
traits.value: The koboldzilla deals double damage to objects and structures.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The koboldzilla makes two attacks: one with its Gazebo Smash and one with its Tail.

actions.name: Gazebo Smash
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +13 to hit, reach 10 ft., each target within a 5-foot-radius circle. *Hit:* 20 (**4d6 + 6**) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Tail
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +13 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. *Hit:* 24 (**4d8 + 6**) slashing damage.

actions.name: Dragon Breath (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: The koboldzilla exhales fire in a 60-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 20 Dexterity saving throw, taking 42 (**12d6**) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

entries: **Resistances**: necrotic, poison; bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from mundane attacks
**Languages**: understands the languages they knew in life but can't speak

traits.name: Breathless Aura
traits.value: Enemies within 30 feet of the koptourok can't speak, and if they are a creature who needs to breathe, they also have disadvantage on Constitution saving throws.

traits.name: Wings of Breath
traits.value: The koptourok gains a flying speed equal to their walking speed if they have at least one enemy within 30 feet of them. If the koptourok starts their turn in the air and doesn't have a flying speed, they fall.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The koptourok makes two Choking Grasp attacks.

actions.name: Choking Grasp
actions.value: *Melee Spell Attack:* +6 to hit, reach 30 ft., one creature. *Hit:* 14 (**4d6**) bludgeoning damage, and the target is pulled to an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the koptourok and grappled (escape DC 14). While grappled in this way, the target is restrained and the koptourok's speed isn't halved by the grapple.

actions.name: Last Gasp
actions.value: The koptourok attempts to steal the breath from each creature they are grappling. Each target must make a DC 14 Constitution saving throw, taking 14 (**4d6**) bludgeoning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. The koptourok gains temporary hit points equal to 5 times the number of creatures who failed their save.

**Languages**: understands all languages but can't speak, telepathy 150 ft.

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.value: The Kraken can breathe air and water.

traits.name: Discorporation
traits.value: When the Kraken drops to 0 hit points or dies, all conditions and other effects end for them. They teleport back to the place where they slumber, return to life with all their hit points, and fall unconscious.

traits.name: Siege Monster
traits.value: The Kraken deals double damage to objects and structures.

traits.name: Slowed Resistance (3/Day)
traits.value: If the Kraken fails a saving throw, they can choose to succeed instead, and their speed is reduced by a cumulative 10 feet for 24 hours.

traits.name: Supernatural Resistance
traits.value: The Kraken has advantage on saving throws against powers, spells, and other supernatural effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The Kraken makes four Tentacle attacks or uses Mental Lance three times.

actions.name: Tentacle
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +16 to hit, reach 30 ft., one target. *Hit:* 19 (**2d10 + 8**) bludgeoning damage plus 11 (**2d10**) psychic damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 18). The Kraken has ten tentacles, each of which can grapple one target.

actions.name: Mental Lance (3rd-Order Power)
actions.value: *Ranged Power Attack:* +18 to hit, range 120 ft., one creature. *Hit:* 22 (**4d10**) psychic damage, and the target is frightened of the Kraken until the start of the Kraken's next turn.

actions.name: Psionic Storm
actions.value: The Kraken creates a psionic storm, entrapping a vehicle they can see within 120 feet of them. While entrapped in the storm, the vehicle is restrained. The storm ends if the Kraken's *concentration* is broken (as if *concentrating* on a spell) or if they are more than 120 feet from the vehicle. If the Kraken's turn ends three times before the storm ends, the vehicle is reduced to 0 hit points and this effect ends.

actions.name: Skull-Splitting Howl (1/Day)
actions.value: The Kraken telepathically howls in the mind of each enemy within 120 feet of them. Each target must make a DC 26 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a target takes 55 (**10d10**) psychic damage and can't concentrate on powers or spells until the start of the Kraken's next turn. On a successful save, the target takes half as much damage and suffers no other effect.

bonusActions.name: Telekinetic Fling
bonusActions.value: The Kraken throws a creature they are grappling into an unoccupied space the Kraken can see within 60 feet of them. The target lands prone and takes 22 (**4d10**) bludgeoning damage.

fluffInfo.name: Study the Foe
fluffInfo.value: Characters proficient in *Survival* gain Advantage on Intelligence (*Nature*) checks when they Study a Hypnotic Eldritch Blossom, learning the following based on their result:

fluffInfo.name: (5+) Infected Vermin.
fluffInfo.value: You are aware of the creature's Infestation Reaction.

fluffInfo.name: (10+) Speed and Dread.
fluffInfo.value: You learn of the creature's Loathsome Presence action and Scuttle Bonus Action.

fluffInfo.name: (15+) Broken Personality.
fluffInfo.value: You understand the creature's strongest and weakest ability scores and saving throws.

fluffInfo.name: Combat Tactics
fluffInfo.value: A Kronen is usually agitated and alarmed when encountered, and its first instinct in combat is to find a new hiding place or flee deeper into its lair. It uses its Loathsome Presence while clawing at any in the way of its escape using Scuttle, reflexively spreading roaches to attackers via its Infestation Reaction.

If it escapes, a Kronen is eventually drawn to return to its old hiding place. Should characters remain there, the Kronen will furiously attack to reclaim its shelter but won't pursue charac ters who leave it alone in its hideout.

fluffInfo.name: Animus:
fluffInfo.value: Aberration.

fluffInfo.name: Fluid:
fluffInfo.value: Monster Blood, Contaminated Ichor

fluffInfo.name: Organs:
fluffInfo.value: Eyes, Guts, Flesh.

fluffInfo.name: Natural Weapons:
fluffInfo.value: Claws.

fluffInfo.name: Hide:
fluffInfo.value: Carapace.

fluffInfo.name: Dust:
fluffInfo.value: Aberrant Dust.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The kronen makes two Claw attacks and uses Loathsome Presence.

actions.name: Claw
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +7, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 13 (**2d8 + 4**) Slashing damage.

actions.name: Loathsome Presence
actions.value: *Wisdom Saving Throw:* DC 15, each creature that can see the kronen. *Failure:* 18 (**4d8**) Psychic damage, and the target has the Frightened condition for 1 minute (save ends). If the creature's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, it is immune to the kronen's Loathsome Presence for 24 hours.

bonusActions.name: Scuttle
bonusActions.value: The kronen takes the Dash action.

traits.name: Avoidance
traits.value: If the lacuna is subjected to an effect that allows them to make a saving throw to take only half damage, they instead take no damage if they succeed on the saving throw, and only half damage if they fail.

traits.name: False Appearance
traits.value: While the lacuna remains motionless, they are indistinguishable from a normal statue.

traits.name: Fiend Between
traits.value: The lacuna doesn't have a walking speed and can't benefit from any bonus to their speed.

traits.name: Supernatural Resistance
traits.value: The lacuna has advantage on saving throws against powers, spells, and other supernatural effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The lacuna makes three Grief-Eater attacks and uses Infuse Sadness, if available.

actions.name: Grief-Eater
actions.value: *Melee or Ranged Spell Attack:* +12 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20 ft., one creature. *Hit:* 29 (**4d10 + 7**) psychic damage, and the target's speed is reduced by 10 feet until the end of their next turn.

actions.name: Infuse Sadness (1/Day)
actions.value: Each enemy the lacuna can see within 30 feet of them must succeed on a DC 20 Wisdom saving throw or be overwhelmed with grief for 1 minute (save ends at end of turn). While a creature is overwhelmed, attacks against them are made with advantage.

bonusActions.name: Slip Between
bonusActions.value: The lacuna teleports up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space they can see.

bonusActions.value: The lacuna teleports up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space they can see.

traits.name: Exploit Opening (3/Day)
traits.value: When Avalla makes an attack, she has advantage on the attack roll.

traits.name: Supernatural Resistance
traits.value: Avalla has advantage on saving throws against powers, spells, and other supernatural effects.

actions.name: Lightning Lash (Cantrip)
actions.value: *Melee or Ranged Spell Attack:* +7 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 60 ft., one creature. *Hit:* 15 (**3d6 + 5**) lightning damage, and Avalla can move the target up to 15 feet horizontally.

actions.name: Iron Terror (1/Day; 4th-Level Spell)
actions.value: Avalla projects a terrifying illusion of the High Command to each enemy in a 30-foot cone. Each target must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or take 21 (**6d6**) psychic damage and be frightened of each member of the High Command for 1 minute (save ends at end of turn).

actions.name: Iron Shackles (1/Day; 3rd-Level Spell; Concentration)
actions.value: Avalla conjures animated iron chains at a point she can see on the ground within 60 feet of her. The chains fill a 15-foot- square on the ground centered on that point and last for 1 minute. When a creature enters that area for the first time on a turn or starts their turn there, they must succeed on a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw or be restrained (save ends at start of turn). A creature restrained in this way takes 7 (**2d6**) bludgeoning damage at the end of each of their turns.

actions.name: Iron Ring (2/Day)
actions.value: If not in the Cyst, Avalla teleports to the Cyst. If in the Cyst, she teleports to a place she has visited.

entries: **Skills**: athletics +8, deception +8, perception +7, persuasion +8, stealth +11, survival +7

traits.name: Stone Sacrifice (3/Day)
traits.value: When Emer fails a saving throw, she can choose to succeed instead by ending the effects of her Stone Gaze on a creature of her choice within 300 feet of her.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: Emer uses Pinning Shot or makes three attacks using Snake Bite, Longbow, or both. She also uses Stone Gaze or Envenomed Stone, if available.

actions.name: Snake Bite
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +11 to hit, reach 10 ft., one creature. *Hit:* 17 (**5d6**) poison damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 17 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned until the end of Emer's next turn. While poisoned in this way, the target can't take reactions.

actions.name: Longbow
actions.value: *Ranged Weapon Attack:* +11 to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. *Hit:* 11 (**1d8 + 7**) piercing damage plus 14 (**4d6**) poison damage.

actions.name: Pinning Shot
actions.value: Emer makes three Longbow attacks against a creature touching the ground within 150 feet of her. If at least two of those attacks hit, the target is restrained by arrows pinning their limbs to the ground. A creature restrained in this way or another creature who can reach them can use an action to pull out the arrows and end the condition.

actions.name: Stone Gaze
actions.value: Emer fires beams of energy from her eyes at up to three creatures she can see within 60 feet of her. Each target must succeed on a DC 17 Constitution saving throw or begin turning to stone (save ends at end of turn). While turning to stone, a creature's speed is reduced by 10 feet and they have disadvantage on Dexterity checks and saving throws. If a creature who is turning to stone is targeted by this action again and fails their save, their speed is reduced by another 10 feet and they are dazed until the effect ends.

If a creature who is turning to stone and dazed in this way is targeted by this action again and fails their save, they are petrified and can no longer make saving throws to end the effects of Stone Gaze. The petrification lasts until the creature is restored by Emer's Stone Sacrifice trait, a cure ailment power of 4th order or higher, a __greater restoration__ spell, or a similar supernatural effect.

actions.name: Envenomed Stone (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: Emer utters an ancient hex. Each creature within 60 feet of her who is being turned to stone by her Stone Gaze must make a DC 17 Constitution saving throw, taking 44 (**8d10**) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

bonusActions.name: Mesmerizing Eyes
bonusActions.value: The glowing eyes of Emer's snakes gaze at one creature Emer can see within 60 feet of her. If the target can see Emer, they must succeed on a DC 17 Wisdom saving throw or be charmed until the start of the target's next turn. A target charmed in this way must immediately use their reaction, if available, to move up to their speed in a direction of Emer's choice.

traits.name: Cave Apex
traits.value: The lamasombra's unnatural scales, padded feet, and bones allow them to avoid detection. They can't be detected with tremorsense. When the lamasombra is in darkness or dim light, they are invisible to creatures with darkvision, but they are visible in dim light to creatures without darkvision.

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.value: The lamasombra can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The lamasombra makes one Bite attack and one Tongue attack.

actions.name: Bite
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +11 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 33 (**6d8 + 6**) piercing damage. If the target is a creature, they must succeed on a DC 17 Constitution saving throw or contract boiling wastes disease. Until the disease is cured, the target can't regain hit points, and the lamasombra can sense the direction to the creature's location as long as they're on the same plane of existence.

actions.name: Tongue
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +11 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. *Hit:* 27 (**6d6 + 6**) bludgeoning damage, or 37 (**9d6 + 6**) bludgeoning damage if the target is a creature who can't see the lamasombra. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, they are pulled up to 15 feet in a straight line toward the lamasombra.

bonusActions.name: Nightmarish Cunning
bonusActions.value: The lamasombra takes the Dash, Disengage, or Hide action.

fluffInfo.name: Study the Foe
fluffInfo.value: Characters proficient in *Survival* or *Nature* gain Advantage on Intelligence (*Arcana*) check to Study a Lambent Dreg, learning the following based on their result:

fluffInfo.name: (5+) Drawn to Contamination
fluffInfo.value: You are aware of the Dreg's Arcane Hunger trait.

fluffInfo.name: (10+) Urge to Contaminate
fluffInfo.value: You know of the Lambent Dreg's Octarine Beam and Wave of Contamination attacks.

fluffInfo.name: (15+) Smart and Cunning
fluffInfo.value: You learn of the Lambent Dreg's highest and lowest ability scores and saving throws.

fluffInfo.name: Combat Tactics
fluffInfo.value: Lambent Dregs tends to gather around delerium clusters throughout the city, often appearing in groups in highly contaminated areas. Creatures who have Contamination levels are prime targets for Lambent Dregs. The Dregs chase them down, avoiding non-contaminated targets when possible.

If threatened, Lambent Dregs run into the middle of a group of enemies and expel their Wave of Contamination, attempting to render their foes into a state of contamination, allowing the Dreg to easily engage with them.
Lambent Dregs flee if outnumbered and in a losing situation.

fluffInfo.name: Animus:

traits.name: Arcane Hunger
traits.value: The dreg has Advantage on attack rolls against creatures that have one or more levels of Contamination.

actions.name: Multiattack

actions.name: Octarine Beam
actions.value: *Melee or Ranged Attack Roll:* +7, reach 5 ft. or range 60 ft. *Hit:* 13 (**3d6 + 3**) Radiant damage, it is subjected to the following effect. *Constitution Saving Throw:* DC 14. *Failure:* The target gains one level of Contamination.

actions.name: Wave of Contamination (Recharge 5-6)

fluffInfo.name: Study the Foe
fluffInfo.value: Characters proficient in *Arcana* gain Advantage on Intelligence (*Religion*) checks to Study a Last Memory, learning the following based on their result:

fluffInfo.name: (5+) Deathless Memory.
fluffInfo.value: You know the creature's monster type, Resistances, and Immunities.

fluffInfo.name: (10+) Painful Recall.
fluffInfo.value: You are aware of the creature's Anguish action.

fluffInfo.name: (15+) Weak Undead.
fluffInfo.value: You learn the creature's ability scores and saving throws.

fluffInfo.name: Combat Tactics
fluffInfo.value: Last Memories can move along the ground or up walls, often hiding as shadows on the ground. They have even followed prey, appearing as a strange movement in one's peripheral vision, or a shifting shadow from an unknown source.

When they reveal themselves, Last Memories cry out in anguish, causing those nearby to suffer visions of their last moments, inducing emotional trauma to any who succumb to it. They grasp those nearby, terrorizing them with waves of sorrow. Last Memories seem to embody the raw emotions of their death, using those emotions as weapons against the living. They do not flee, for they do not cherish their existence. Their only purpose is to spread the fear and the pain of their own death before fading away, only to reappear days later to relive their agony.
