traits.name: Eternal Torment
traits.value: If a last memory dies, it reappears 1d4 days later, unleashing a howling scream that can be heard up to 300 feet away.

traits.name: Silhouette
traits.value: The last memory can only move along contiguous flat surfaces, such as walls or floors. It cannot fly or swim and must always be in contact with a surface. Additionally, the last memory ignores all natural Difficult Terrain and can climb without making an ability check.

traits.name: Unusual Nature
traits.value: The last memory doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

actions.name: Sorrowful Touch
actions.value: *Melee or Ranged Attack Roll:* +4, reach 5 ft. or range 30 ft. *Hit:* 12 (**3d6 + 2**) Psychic damage, and the target has the Slowed condition until the end of its next turn.

actions.name: Anguish (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: *Wisdom Saving Throw:* DC 10, each creature in a 30-foot Emanation originating from the last memory that can hear it. *Failure:* 10 (**3d6**) Psychic damage and the target becomes Jinxed 1d6 (save ends).

entries: **HP**: Nine times their level (number of d12 Hit Dice equal to their level)
**Skills**: athletics +3 plus PB, insight +1 plus PB

actions.name: Signature Attack (Molten Slam)
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +3 plus PB to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* **1d6 + PB** bludgeoning damage plus 4 (**1d8**) fire damage. A flammable object hit by this attack ignites if it isn't being worn or carried. Beginning at 7th level, the bastion can make this attack twice, instead of once, when they take the Attack action on their turn.

actions.name: 3rd Level: Burning Embrace (3/Day)
actions.value: As an action, the bastion makes a signature attack against a creature within range. If the attack hits, the target is also grappled (escape DC 10 plus PB). While grappled in this way, a target is restrained and takes **PBd6** fire damage at the start of each of their turns.

actions.name: 5th Level: Melting Grasp (3/Day)
actions.value: When the bastion hits a creature with a signature attack, the creature takes an extra **PBd4** fire damage. If the target is wielding a mundane metal weapon, the bastion partially melts the target's weapon, giving it a permanent -2 penalty to attack and damage rolls. If the target is wielding a supernatural metal weapon, the penalty lasts for 1 hour instead.

actions.name: 7th Level: Eruption (1/Day)
actions.value: As an action, the bastion erupts, shooting a 30-foot cone of earth and lava from their head. Each creature in that area must make a DC 10 plus PB Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a target takes **PBd6** bludgeoning damage plus **PBd6** fire damage and is knocked prone. On a successful save, a target takes half as much damage and is not knocked prone. The lava spreads around corners and ignites flammable objects in that area that aren't being worn or carried.

entries: **Personality Trait**: I speak softly imagining myself to be in a tragic fairytale while casting others in fictional roles.
**Ideal**: The world is a mirror held to my glorious reflection.
**Bond**: I obsessively crave beauty, decadence, and relish all art. I especially love my garden and my lilies. They are all I have left.
**Flaw**: I fly into an enraged fury at the sight of my own likeness or the names of my lost family members.

fluffInfo.name: Study the Foe
fluffInfo.value: Characters proficient in *History* or *Insight* gain Advantage on Intelligence (*Arcana*) check to Study Queen Lenore, learning the following based on their result:

fluffInfo.name: (10+) Mutated Queen of Drakkenheim
fluffInfo.value: You recognize she is an Aberration.

fluffInfo.name: (15+) Deadly Gaze
fluffInfo.value: You learn of her Radiant Gaze ability.

fluffInfo.name: (20+) Formidable Foe
fluffInfo.value: You understand her highest and lowest saving throws.

fluffInfo.name: Combat Tactics
fluffInfo.value: Lenore does not often outright engage in combat, throwing Dregs and her handmaidens at enemies who threaten her. She prefers to stay behind her minions where she is safe, relying on her Radiant Gaze to slowly disable and contaminate her foes..
If forced into melee, she uses her Tentacle Hair to attack and will take the first opportunity to escape if she can.

actions.name: Tentacle Hair

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.value: The aboleth can breathe air and water.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.value: If the aboleth fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Infectious Mucus
traits.value: The aboleth is surrounded by infectious mucus. A creature that touches the aboleth or that hits it with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it must make a DC 14 Constitution saving throw. On a failure, the creature is diseased. For the first hour of the disease, the creature takes 2 (**1d4**) necrotic damage if it ends its turn out of water (it must be at least neck-deep to avoid this damage). After the first hour and until the disease is cured, a creature is unable to gain the benefits of a short or long rest if it does not spend the rest at least neck-deep in water.
A creature that fails the saving throw by 5 or more becomes a host of a broodling egg that hatches in 3d6 days.

traits.name: Probing Telepathy
traits.value: If a creature communicates telepathically with the aboleth, the aboleth learns the creature's greatest desires if the aboleth can see the creature.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The aboleth makes two Tentacle attacks and uses Birth, if available.

actions.name: Tentacle
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. *Hit:* 11 (**2d6 + 4**) bludgeoning damage and the target must make a saving throw against the aboleth's Infectious Mucus trait.

actions.name: Birth (Recharge 4-6)
actions.value: The aboleth produces a broodling in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of it.

actions.name: Entrance (3/Day)
actions.value: The aboleth targets one creature it can see within 30 feet of it. The target must succeed on a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw or be magically charmed by the aboleth until the aboleth dies or until it is on a different plane of existence from the target. The charmed target is under the aboleth's control and can't take reactions, and the aboleth and the target can communicate telepathically with each other over any distance.

Whenever the charmed target takes damage, the target can repeat the saving throw. On a success, the effect ends. No more than once every 24 hours, the target can also repeat the saving throw when it is at least 1 mile away from the aboleth.

entries: **Immunities**: poison; charmed, exhaustion, frightened, poisoned, prone

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.value: The chrysalis can breathe air and water.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (1/Day)
traits.value: If the chrysalis fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Regenerative State
traits.value: The chrysalis' hit points reset to its maximum at the start of its turn.

traits.name: Sticky Mucus
traits.value: When a creature hits the chrysalis with a melee attack, it must succeed on a DC 15 Strength saving throw or become disarmed as its weapon stays stuck to the creature. A creature can use an action to make a DC 15 Strength (*Athletics*) check, freeing a stuck weapon within its reach on a success. If the attack requires that the attacker touch the aboleth (GM's discretion), then the attacker becomes grappled (escape DC 15) on a failed save. While it is grappled, it can't use that limb. If the attack is a bite, then the creature can't speak while it is grappled in this way.

traits.name: Transitional State
traits.value: The chrysalis turns into a lesser aboleth broodmother at the start of its fourth turn after becoming a chrysalis, ending any grapples it is a part of.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The chrysalis makes three Sticky Ectoplasm attacks. Each attack must be against a different target.

actions.name: Sticky Ectoplasm
actions.value: *Ranged Weapon Attack:* +7 to hit, range 30/90 ft., one target. *Hit:* 11 (**2d6 + 4**) acid damage and the target's speed is reduced by 15 feet until the target uses an action to remove the ectoplasm. A creature whose speed is reduced to 0 feet by this effect is restrained (escape DC 15).

traits.name: Communication Spores
traits.value: The Veiled Lady's telepathy extends throughout its lair. It communicates using images and emotion.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (2/Day)
traits.value: If the Veiled Lady fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Mycelial Form
traits.value: The Veiled Lady can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check, and can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

traits.name: Sun Sickness
traits.value: While in sunlight, or if it takes 5 or more radiant damage in a single turn, the Veiled Lady has disadvantage on ability checks, attack rolls, and saving throws until the end of its next turn. The Veiled Lady dies if it spends more than 1 hour in direct sunlight.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The Veiled Lady uses either its Infectious Spores or Shackles of Pain, if available, then makes a Halluciwhip attack.

actions.name: Halluciwhip
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +5 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. *Hit:* 9 (**3d4 + 3**) slashing damage plus 3 (**1d6**) poison damage and the target must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned until the end of its next turn.

actions.name: Infectious Spores (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: The Veiled Lady exhales a cloud of spores at a creature it can see within 30 feet of it. The creature must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or become afflicted by the fungal infection* spell for 1 minute. An affected creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.

actions.name: Shackles of Pain (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: The Veiled Lady exhales a cloud of spores at a creature it can see within 30 feet of it. The creature must succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw or become afflicted by the shackles of pain* spell. The Veiled Lady can have only one creature afflicted by Shackles of Pain at a time.

bonusActions.name: Detritivore
bonusActions.value: As a bonus action, the Veiled Lady can target one Small or larger corpse not under the effects of the gentle repose spell within 15 feet of it, draining it of its essence and regaining 10 (**3d6**) hit points. Once a corpse has been targeted by this feature, it becomes desiccated and can't be targeted again.

traits.name: Charm Resistant
traits.value: Lestheris has advantage on saving throws to avoid or end the charmed condition on herself.

traits.name: Dark Calling
traits.value: Each other creature within 30 feet of Lestheris has disadvantage on death saving throws.

traits.name: Tome of the Ethereal
traits.value: Lestheris can see 120 feet into the Ethereal Plane.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: Lestheris makes two Grave Grasp or two Necrotic Lance attacks.

actions.name: Grave Grasp (Cantrip)
actions.value: *Melee Spell Attack:* +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 7 (**2d6**) necrotic damage, and the target can't regain hit points until the start of Lestheris's next turn.

actions.name: Necrotic Lance (1st-Level Spell)
actions.value: *Ranged Spell Attack:* +6 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. *Hit:* 9 (**2d8**) necrotic damage.
Lestheris can destroy a shade under her control within 30 feet of her and deal an extra 4 (**1d8**) necrotic damage to the target.

actions.name: Animate Spirits (2/Day)
actions.value: Lestheris animates two shades.

The shades appear in unoccupied spaces Lestheris can see within 30 feet of her. The shades act immediately after Lestheris on the same initiative count and follow her verbal orders. If Lestheris dies, the shades are destroyed.

traits.name: Supernatural Resistance
traits.value: The leyleech has advantage on saving throws against powers, spells, and other supernatural effects.

actions.name: Bite
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 4 (**1d4 + 2**) piercing damage. If the target is a creature who can cast spells, the leyleech chooses one of the target's spellcasting abilities. That ability score is reduced by 1 (min- imum score of 1) until the target finishes a short or long rest, and the leyleech's form becomes charged for 1 minute or until they use Magic Purge.

actions.name: Magic Purge (Charged Form Only)
actions.value: The leyleech spews corrupted magical energy at a creature they can see within 30 feet of them. The leyleech is no longer charged, and the target must make a DC 11 Constitution saving throw, taking 7 (**2d6**) force damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

actions.value: The leyleech makes a signature attack. On a hit, the attack deals an extra **PB** damage, and if the target hits the leyleech with an attack before the start of the leyleech's next turn, the target takes PB lightning damage.

actions.name: 3rd Level: Anomalous Terrain (5 Ferocity)
actions.value: The area within 10 feet of the leyleech becomes difficult terrain for their enemies until the start of their next turn. When an enemy enters that area for the first time on a turn or starts their turn there, they must succeed on a DC 10 plus PB Dexterity saving throw or take **PBd4** force damage.

actions.name: 5th Level: Magic Purge (8 Ferocity)
actions.value: The leyleech spews corrupted magical energy at a creature they can see within 30 feet of them. The target must make a DC 10 plus PB Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the target takes **PBd8** force damage and is dazed until the start of the leyleech's next turn. On a successful save, the target takes half as much damage and isn't dazed.

traits.name: Rejuvenation
traits.value: If the lich is destroyed but their soulstone is intact, their soul retreats into the stone. While the lich's soul is in the stone, a creature who can see the stone at the start of their turn must succeed on a DC 20 Charisma saving throw or be charmed by the stone until the end of their next turn. While charmed in this way, the creature must do everything in their power to move toward and touch the stone, avoiding obvious hazards.

If a creature touches the stone while the lich's soul is inside, the creature must make a DC 20 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the creature drops to 0 hit points and the lich reforms with all their hit points in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the soulstone. On a successful save, the creature loses half their hit points and the lich reforms with half their hit points in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the soulstone.
The soulstone has AC 19, 50 hit points, and immunity to all damage except force and thunder.

traits.name: Supernatural Resistance
traits.value: The lich has advantage on saving throws against powers, spells, and other supernatural effects.

traits.name: Turn Immunity
traits.value: The lich is immune to effects that turn Undead.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The lich uses Glare of Undeath and makes four attacks using Biting Acid, Disruptive Thunder, Pain of Ages, or a combination of them.

actions.name: Biting Acid (3rd-Level Spell)
actions.value: *Ranged Spell Attack:* +12 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. *Hit:* 22 (**5d8**) acid damage, and the target can't regain hit points until the start of the lich's next turn.

actions.name: Disruptive Thunder (3rd-Level Spell)
actions.value: *Melee or Ranged Spell Attack:* +12 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 60 ft., one target. *Hit:* 22 (**4d10**) thunder damage. If the target is Huge or smaller, the lich can move them up to 45 feet horizontally.

actions.name: Pain of Ages (3rd-Level Spell)
actions.value: *Melee or Ranged Spell Attack:* +12 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 90 ft., one creature. *Hit:* 21 (**6d6**) psychic damage, and the first time the target hits a creature with an attack before the start of the lich's next turn, that attack deals half damage.

actions.name: Glare of Undeath
actions.value: The lich's eyes flare with supernatural power at one creature they can see within 60 feet of them. The target must succeed on a DC 20 Wisdom saving throw or be compelled to hug themself tightly as protection against an unbearably cruel world. A creature hugging themself in this way is restrained for 1 minute (save ends at end of turn). A creature the target can hear and understand can use an action to make a DC 20 Charisma (*Persuasion*) check, ending the effect on a success.

actions.name: Horrid Woe (2/Day)
actions.value: The lich sends negative energy coursing through a creature they can see within 90 feet of them. The target is seared with pain and must make a DC 20 Constitution saving throw, taking 61 (**7d8 + 30**) necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. A target reduced to 0 hit points by this damage becomes stable but can't regain hit points, and their spirit turns into a wraith who appears in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of their body. This wraith acts on the lich's turn immediately after them, and they obey the lich's verbal commands to the best of their ability. If the wraith or lich are destroyed, the wraith disappears, the target's spirit returns to their body, and the target can regain hit points.

actions.name: Life Absorption (1/Day; 9th-Level Spell; Concentration)
actions.value: The lich unleashes a wave of life-sapping energy. Each enemy within 120 feet of them must make a DC 20 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the target takes 16 (**3d10**) necrotic damage at the start of each of their turns for 1 minute, and the lich gains temporary hit points equal to the total damage dealt.

bonusActions.name: Necrotic Form (3rd-Level Spell)
bonusActions.value: The lich enters a shadow form and moves up to their speed. While in this form, the lich is immune to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage and the grappled and restrained conditions, and they can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing. The lich reverts to their true form at the end of their turn.

actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +7, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 7 (**1d6 + 4**) Piercing damage.

actions.name: Longbow
actions.value: *Ranged Attack Roll:* +7, range 150/600 ft. *Hit:* 8 (**1d8 + 4**) Piercing damage, and the target has the Slowed condition until the end of Petra's next turn.

bonusActions.name: Cunning Action

fluffInfo.name: Combat Tactics
fluffInfo.value: The Liminal Herald is a contaminated entity from the deepest corners of the Space Between Worlds. It undoes creatures atom by atom with its Eldritch Beams. It targets the intellect of other creatures with its Mind Scramble, especially spellcasters *Concentrating* on spells. The Liminal Herald harnesses the very fabric of magic itself and uses that force against mortals who would attempt to dabble in it.

When targeted by an attack, the Liminal Herald bends space and time around it using its Reflect Pain feature, causing the creature who attacked it to take on a mental payload of pain felt by the creature.
If it is reduced below half its Hit Points, the Liminal Herald attempts to flee.

fluffInfo.name: Study the Foe
fluffInfo.value: Characters proficient in *Nature* or *Survival* gain Advantage on Intelligence (*Arcana*) checks when they Study a Living City, learning the following based on their result:

fluffInfo.name: (15+) Animated Building.
fluffInfo.value: You are aware of the Living City's Structural Form and No Exit traits, as well as its Immunities.

fluffInfo.name: (20+) Escape Routes.
fluffInfo.value: You recognize that destroying the creature's walls and doors creates exits, but these are short-lived because of its Shifting Form Epic Action.

fluffInfo.name: (25+) Slow, Smart, and Tough.
fluffInfo.value: You learn of the Living City's strongest and weakest ability scores and saving throws.

fluffInfo.name: Combat Tactics
fluffInfo.value: A Living City takes the form of an oddly intact residence, workshop, or warehouse using its Structural Form trait, and waits for hapless creatures to wander inside. A Living City may deceive characters into entering it using its telepathy and Haunting Whispers. It suppresses its Digestive Aura and so it can take full advantage of its False Appearance trait.

Typically, a Living City shapes its body to create outer rooms that have walls bordering the edge of the Living City's space, and inner rooms deep within which do not have walls, ceilings, or floors immediately adjacent to spaces outside the Living City. The Living City will create doors, windows, or even stairs within it so that its prey can easily move from outside, to the outer rooms, and then further inside to the inner rooms. Often, the Living City might place any treasure or valuables it has collected in these inner rooms as bait.

Once a few characters have entered one of its innermost rooms, the Living City attacks and activates its Digestive Aura. When it rolls Initiative, it uses its No Exit trait to close all the doors and windows in its body, trapping characters inside. Then, it attacks them with its Grasping Tendrils, Bite, and Haunting Whispers, while using its Shifting Form Epic Action to slowly change its interior, separating the characters and cutting off their escape routes.

Should the player characters break a hole in one of its walls, the Living City uses its Shifting Form trait to plug the hole. Note that some area-of-effect attacks and spells (such as __Burning Hands__) can damage or destroy multiple sections of the Living City. However, a Living City can only take damage from one section being destroyed per turn. If characters manage to slip outside the Living City through a breached hole or exit, the Living City may use its Grasping Tendrils to pull them back in. It then tries to quickly seal them inside again with Shifting Form.

traits.name: Digestive Aura
traits.value: A creature that starts its turn in the living city's space takes 10 (**4d4**) Acid damage. At the start of its turn, the living city decides whether its Digestive Aura is active until the start of its next turn (no action required).

traits.name: False Appearance
traits.value: While the living city remains motionless in its Structural Form, it is indistinguishable from an ordinary structure or vehicle, such as a house or a sailing ship.

traits.name: Structural Form
traits.value: The living city can spend 10 minutes in *Concentration* to shape-shift into a Gargantuan structure or back into its true, amorphous form. Its game statistics are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed.

While in the form of a structure, the living city takes up its entire space and creates floors, walls, doorways, and windows within its space which resemble and behave like normal structures, while leaving behind open space within it to create rooms. Creatures can pass through the open spaces and stop there as if moving through a normal structure.

The walls and floors of the living city can be damaged and thus breached. Each 5-foot-by-5-foot section has AC 15 and 30 Hit Points. Reducing a section to 0 Hit Points destroys it and deals 30 damage to the living city. A living city can only take this damage once per turn.

In addition, the living city extrudes pieces of itself inside its space which resemble furnishings and everyday objects. The extrusions appear, feel, sound, and behave exactly like the mimicked objects. A thin, slimy tendril connects any furnishings or objects to the body of the living city. The tendril has AC 15 and 1 Hit Point. If the tether is severed or destroyed, the simulacra melts into goo, but does no harm to the living city.

traits.name: No Exit
traits.value: When it rolls for Initiative, the living city reflexively closes the windows, doors, and other egress points on the outside of its body, preventing creatures inside it from leaving its space.

A creature in the living city's space that attempts to leave its space using teleportation or planar travel is subjected to the following effect. *Charisma Saving Throw:* DC 20. *Failure:* 27 (**5d10**) Psychic damage. *Failure or Success*: The teleportation or planar travel fails.

actions.name: The living city always takes its turn on Initiative count 20
actions.value: On its turn, the living city can use its movement and interaction as normal. However, it does not take an action or Bonus Action on its turn unless forced to do so by a spell or other effect. Instead, the living city takes one of the following Epic Actions at the end of each player character's turn:

actions.name: Bite
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +10, reach 0 ft. *Hit:* 23 (**4d8 + 5**) Piercing damage.

actions.name: Grasping Tendril
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +10, reach 10 ft. *Hit:* 14 (**2d8 + 5**) Bludgeoning damage, and the target is pushed or pulled 10 feet (the living city's choice).

actions.name: Haunting Whispers
actions.value: *Intelligence Saving Throw:* DC 15, one creature in the living city's space. *Failure:* 10 (**3d6**) Psychic damage, and the target has the Frightened condition (save ends).

actions.name: Shifting Form
actions.value: The living city alters the composition of a 10-foot-by-10-foot area inside it, creating walls, doors, windows, stairs, or furnishings. It can choose to make the area Difficult Terrain. Creatures inside the living city who are not directly observing the shift must succeed on a DC 20 Wisdom (*Perception*) check to notice the change.

If the living city creates a wall that cuts through another creature's space when it appears, the creature is pushed to one side of the wall (the living city's choice). If a creature would be surrounded on all sides by the wall (or the wall and another solid surface), that creature can make a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw. On a success, it can use its Reaction to move up to its speed so that it is no longer enclosed by the wall.

actions.name: Epic Resistance
actions.value: The living city chooses one condition, spell, or other effect currently affecting them and rolls 1d20. On an 11+, the effect ends on it. The living city can use this Epic Action even if it would otherwise be unable to take actions, its actions are being controlled by another creature, or if a spell or effect alters its game statistics.

traits.name: Deadly Sharpshooter
traits.value: Attacking at long range with a ranged weapon doesn't impose disadvantage on Llyvessa's attack rolls.

traits.name: Elf Glamour (1/Day)
traits.value: When a creature targets Llyvessa with an attack, power, or spell, the creature must succeed on a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw or be charmed by her until the end of her next turn (no action required).

traits.name: Mind Link
traits.value: Llyvessa can communicate telepathically with any Amethyst Knife boss regardless of distance, provided they are on the same plane of existence.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: Llyvessa makes two Scimitar or Longbow attacks. Alternatively, she makes one Longbow attack and uses Psychic Shot, if available.

actions.name: Scimitar
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 9 (**1d6 + 6**) slashing damage.

actions.name: Longbow
actions.value: *Ranged Weapon Attack:* +9 to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. *Hit:* 15 (**2d8 + 6**) piercing damage.

actions.name: Psychic Shot (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: Llyvessa makes a Longbow attack that ignores cover, and which can pass through mundane solid objects up to 5 feet thick that aren't being worn or carried.

bonusActions.name: Jaunt (1/Day; 3rd-Order Power)
bonusActions.value: Llyvessa or one willing creature within 5 feet of her teleports to an unoccupied space Llyvessa can see within 30 feet of her.

fluffInfo.name: Study the Foe
fluffInfo.value: Characters proficient in *Survival* gain Advantage on Intelligence (*Nature*) checks to Study a Loathsome Gag Fly, learning the following based on their result:

fluffInfo.name: (5+) Flying Monstrosity.
fluffInfo.value: You know the Gag Fly's creature type and speeds.

fluffInfo.name: (10+) Explosive Bile.
fluffInfo.value: You learn of the Gag Fly's Bloat Burst Reaction.

fluffInfo.name: (15+) Bestial Minded.
fluffInfo.value: You recognize the Gag Fly's highest and lowest ability scores and saving throws.

fluffInfo.name: Combat Tactics
fluffInfo.value: The Loathsome Gag Fly is a simple-minded creature who wants to feed on flesh and lay larva on the corpses of the dead. It sprays acid on any creature that it sees nearby in an attempt to weaken it. It then lands on them and begins feeding.

Gag Flies usually attack in groups and care very little for the wellbeing of each other. As a matter of fact, when a Gag Fly is killed and explodes in a shower of acid, this usually causes other nearby flies to go into a feeding frenzy on targets sprayed in the gore, as they are drawn to any flesh dissolving in the acids of their mucus.

fluffInfo.name: Animus:
fluffInfo.value: Monstrosity.

fluffInfo.name: Fluid:
fluffInfo.value: Monster Blood, Contaminated Ichor, Acidic Bile, Mucus.

fluffInfo.name: Organs:
fluffInfo.value: Eyes, Guts, Glands.

fluffInfo.name: Natural Weapons:
fluffInfo.value: Mandibles, Needles.

fluffInfo.name: Hide:
fluffInfo.value: Carapace.

traits.name: Digestive Enzymes
traits.value: The gag fly has Advantage on attack rolls against a Burning target.

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.value: The gag fly can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

actions.name: Proboscis
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +5, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 10 (**2d6 + 3**) Piercing damage.

actions.name: Acid Spray (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: *Dexterity Saving Throw:* DC 13, each creature in a 15-foot Cone. *Failure:* 5 (**2d4**) Acid damage, and the target has the Burning condition (2d4 Acid). *Success* Half damage only.

fluffInfo.name: Study the Foe
fluffInfo.value: Characters proficient in *Animal Handling* gain Advantage on Intelligence (*Nature*) checks to Study a Lob Frog, learning the following based on their result:

fluffInfo.name: (5+) Poisonous Skin.
fluffInfo.value: You recognize the Lob Frog's Immunities and Poison Skin trait.

fluffInfo.name: (10+) Hurled Eggs.
fluffInfo.value: You are aware of the Lob Frog's Throw Frogspawn action.

fluffInfo.name: (15+) Assured Amphibian.
fluffInfo.value: You know the Lob Frog's Strength and Charisma ability scores and saving throws.

fluffInfo.name: Combat Tactics
fluffInfo.value: Lob Frogs are keen to keep their distance from predators and threats, but are constantly on the lookout for hosts for their offspring. They attempt to lob their contaminated eggs at potential threats, hoping to produce more Lob Frogs. If confronted directly, their Poison Skin acts as a defense while they use their Standing Leap to escape unfavorable situations.

If a Lob Frog has at least two or more targets with attached eggs, or if they are reduced below half Hit Points, they leap away to find somewhere safe and wet to hide. They would rather not risk their life, and simply hope to infect as many targets as possible to continue their species.

fluffInfo.name: Animus:
fluffInfo.value: Monstrosity.

fluffInfo.name: Fluid:
fluffInfo.value: Monster Blood, Contaminated Ichor, Venom.

fluffInfo.name: Organs:
fluffInfo.value: Eyes, Heart, Brain, Guts, Glands, Flesh.

fluffInfo.name: Bones:
fluffInfo.value: Skull, Spine, Ribs.

fluffInfo.name: Natural Weapons:
fluffInfo.value: Teeth.

fluffInfo.name: Hide:
fluffInfo.value: Skin, Webbed Membrane.

traits.name: Standing Leap
traits.value: The lob frog's long jump is up to 30 feet and its high jump is up to 20 feet, with or without a running start.

traits.name: Poison Skin
traits.value: When a creature within 5 feet of the lob frog hits it with a melee attack, that creature takes 3 (**1d6**) Poison damage.

actions.name: Bite
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +4, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 4 (**1d4 + 2**) Piercing damage, and the target has the Distracted condition.

actions.name: Throw Frogspawn
actions.value: *Ranged Attack Roll:* +4, range 30/60 ft. *Hit:* 6 (**1d8 + 2**) Bludgeoning damage plus 10 (**3d6**) Acid damage. If the target is a creature, the egg sticks to the target's body, melding with its flesh. A creature within 5 feet of the egg can take an action to remove the egg, dealing 10 (**3d6**) Acid damage to the target in the process. If the egg is still attached to the target at the end of its next turn, the target is infected with a disease and has the Sickened condition until the disease ends. The disease can't be cured except by magic.

Every hour, the target is subjected to the following effect. *Constitution Saving Throw:* DC 12. *Failure:* The target gains one Contamination level. Contamination levels gained in this way can't be removed until the disease is cured. If the target suffers a Monstrous Transformation, it dies and its flesh falls away, birthing a Lob Frog.

traits.name: Lightning Absorption
traits.value: Whenever Logger is subjected to lightning damage, they take no damage and instead regain a number of hit points equal to the lightning damage dealt.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: Logger makes two Slam attacks. If they are in a fury (see Nature's Fury), they instead make three Slam attacks.

actions.name: Slam
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. *Hit:* 13 (**2d6 + 6**) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Entangling Vines
actions.value: Vines lash out from Logger's body.

Each enemy within 30 feet of them must succeed on a DC 17 Strength saving throw or take 9 (**1d6 + 6**) bludgeoning damage and be grappled (escape DC 17) and pulled up to 30 feet directly toward Logger.

bonusActions.name: Nature's Fury (1/Day)
bonusActions.value: Logger enters a fury for 1 minute.

While in a fury, Logger has advantage on Strength checks and saving throws, and they can make an extra Slam attack when they use Multiattack. If Logger ends their turn without damaging another creature on that turn, the fury ends early.

traits.name: Intimidating Aura
traits.value: Elias projects a 30-foot Emanation of imposing command. An ally that start its turn in the Emanation has Advantage on the first attack roll it makes before the start of its next turn. A Hostile creature that starts its turn in the Emenation takes 10 (**3d6**) Thunder damage and is subjected to the following effect. *Wisdom Saving Throw:* DC 16. *Failure:* The target has the Frightened condition until the start of its next turn. *Success* The target is immune to Elias's Intimidating Aura for 24 hours.

actions.name: Elias always takes his turn on Initiative count 20
actions.value: On his turn, Elias can use his movement and interaction as normal. However, he does not take an action or Bonus Action on his turn unless forced to do so by a spell or other effect. Instead, Elias takes one of the following Epic Actions at the end of each player character's turn:

entries: **Lord Commander's Blade**: *Melee Attack Roll:* +12, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 25 (**4d8 + 7**) Slashing damage, and Elias can apply one of the following martial masteries to the target:
**Wound**: The target has the Bleeding condition (4d4).
**Topple**: The target has the Prone condition.
**Sap**: The target has Disadvantage on the next attack roll it makes before the start of start of Elias's next turn.
**Longbow**: *Ranged Attack Roll:* +12, range 150/600 ft. *Hit:* 25 (**4d8 + 7**) Piercing damage, and Elias can apply one of the following martial masteries to the target:
**Push**: If the target is Large or smaller, it is pushed up to 10 feet away from Elias.
**Slow**: The target has the Slowed condition (DC 15 Constitution save ends).

actions.name: Command
actions.value: Elias chooses one ally he can see. If the ally can see and hear him, it can use its Reaction to make one weapon attack with Advantage. On a hit, the attack deals an extra 10 (**3d6**) damage.

actions.name: Flare (1/Round)
actions.value: Elias chooses a point he can see within 60 feet and fires at flare at it, signaling the Hooded Lantern's bombardment. Elias recharges his Artillery Strike. He can only use this Epic Action if it's the first Epic Action he has taken this round.

actions.name: Artillery Strike (Recharge Special)
actions.value: Elias can only use this Epic Action if it's the last Epic Action he takes this round. *Dexterity Saving Throw:* DC 17, each creature in a 20-foot radius Sphere centered on the point Elias chose with his Flare Epic Action. *Failure:* 18 (**4d8**) Piercing damage plus 14 (**4d6**) Fire damage, and the target has the Prone condition. *Success* Half damage only.

actions.name: Epic Resistance
actions.value: Elias chooses one condition, spell, or other effect currently affecting him and rolls 1d20. On an 11+, the effect ends on him. Elias can use this action even if he would otherwise be unable to take actions, his actions are being controlled by another creature, or if a spell or effect alters his game statistics.

traits.name: Exploit Opening (3/Day)
traits.value: When Erasmus makes an attack, he has advantage on the attack roll.

traits.name: Master Tactician
traits.value: At the start of a combat encounter, Erasmus chooses when he acts in the initiative order after all other creatures have rolled initiative.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: Erasmus makes two Greatsword attacks. He can replace one attack with a use of I'm Right Here.

actions.name: Greatsword
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 12 (**2d6 + 5**) slashing damage. If the target is a creature, they have disadvantage on attack rolls against creatures other than Erasmus until the end of their next turn.

actions.name: I'm Right Here
actions.value: Erasmus taunts a creature he can see within 5 feet of him who can hear him. The creature must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or use their reaction, if available, to attack Erasmus. If the creature attacks, an ally within 30 feet of Erasmus who isn't incapacitated can make a weapon attack against the creature (no action required).

actions.name: Iron Ring (2/Day)
actions.value: If not in the Cyst, Erasmus teleports to the Cyst. If in the Cyst, he teleports to a place he has visited.

bonusActions.name: Mark
bonusActions.value: Erasmus chooses a creature he can see within 60 feet of him and marks them until the start of his next turn. The first time one of Erasmus's allies deals damage to a marked creature on each turn, the creature takes an extra 3 (**1d6**) damage.

bonusActions.name: Reposition
bonusActions.value: Erasmus and each ally within 60 feet of him who can hear him moves up to 5 feet without provoking opportunity attacks.

fluffInfo.name: Study the Foe
fluffInfo.value: Characters proficient in *Nature* or *Survival* gain Advantage on Intelligence (*Arcana*) checks when they take the Study action to examine the Lord of the Feast learning the following based on the result:

fluffInfo.name: (5+) Difficult to Kill
fluffInfo.value: You know of the creature's Regeneration ability.

fluffInfo.name: (10+) Dangerous Archer
fluffInfo.value: You recognize that he carries special arrows revealing his Poison Arrow, Ensnaring Arrow, and Harpoon Arrow attacks.

fluffInfo.name: (15+) Cunning Combatant
fluffInfo.value: You learn their strongest and weakest saving throws.

fluffInfo.name: Combat Tactics
fluffInfo.value: The Lord of the Feast stalks the Temple Ward of Drakkenheim with his war dogs, searching for glorious kills. He seeks out the most fearsome monsters, and loves picking fights with faction agents and adventurers. When a band of plucky heroes enters his territory, the Lord of the Feast tracks and hunts them until they leave the Inner City or he has their skulls.
The Lord of the Feast uses a variety of arrows in combat:
Poison Arrow to debilitate foes, Ensnaring Arrow to stop them fleeing, and Harpoon Arrow to pull them toward him to engage in melee combat.
If the Lord of the Feast is reduced below 100 Hit Points, he attempts to escape, but regroups as soon as possible with more hunters in tow to continue the hunt.

fluffInfo.name: Animus:
fluffInfo.value: Monstrosity.

fluffInfo.name: Fluid:
fluffInfo.value: Monster Blood.

fluffInfo.name: Organs:
fluffInfo.value: Eyes, Heart, Brain, Guts, Flesh.

fluffInfo.name: Bones:
fluffInfo.value: Skull, Spine, Ribs.

fluffInfo.name: Natural Weapons:
fluffInfo.value: Teeth, Claws.

fluffInfo.name: Hair:
fluffInfo.value: Fur.

fluffInfo.name: Hide:
fluffInfo.value: Skin.

traits.name: Aura of Hunger
traits.value: A creature that starts its turn within 30 feet of the Lord of the Feast takes 10 (**3d6**) Necrotic damage.

traits.name: Close-Quarters Hunter
traits.value: Being within 5 feet of a Hostile creature doesn't impose Disadvantage on the Lord of the Feast's ranged attack rolls.

traits.name: Hunter's Sense
traits.value: The Lord of the Feast has Advantage on attack rolls against a *Bloodied* creature.

traits.name: Predatory Senses
traits.value: The Lord of the Feast has Advantage on Wisdom (*Perception*) checks. He can pinpoint the position of any creature within 120 feet of him with the Invisible condition.

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.value: The Lord of the Feast regains 20 Hit Points at the start of his turn if he has at least 1 Hit Point remaining.

actions.name: The Lord of the Feast always takes his turn on Initiative count 20
actions.value: On its turn, the Lord of the Feast can use his movement and interaction as normal. However, he does not take an action or Bonus Action on his turn unless forced to do so by a spell or other effect. Instead, the Lord of the Feast takes one of the following Epic Actions at the end of each player character's turn:

entries: **Bite**: *Melee Attack Roll:* +9, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 15 (**2d10 + 4**) Piercing damage plus 18 (**4d8**) Necrotic damage. *Constitution Saving Throw:* DC 17. *Failure:* The target gains one Contamination level.
**Claws**: *Melee Attack Roll:* +9, reach 10 ft. *Hit:* 11 (**2d6 + 4**) Slashing damage, and the target has the Bleeding condition (4d4).

**Poison Arrow**: *Ranged Attack Roll:* +9, range 150/600 ft. *Hit:* 13 (**2d8 + 4**) Piercing damage plus 18 (**4d8**) Poison damage. *Constitution Saving Throw:* DC 17. *Failure:* The target has the Poisoned condition (save ends).
**Ensnaring Arrow**: *Ranged Attack Roll:* +9, range 150/600 ft. *Hit:* 13 (**2d8 + 4**) Piercing damage, and the target has the Restrained condition (DC 17 Dexterity saving throw ends).
**Harpoon Arrow**: *Ranged Attack Roll:* +9, range 150/600 ft. *Hit:* 13 (**2d8 + 4**) Piercing damage, and if the target is Huge or smaller, it is pulled up to 20 feet toward the Lord of the Feast.

actions.name: Reposition
actions.value: The Lord of the Feast moves up to his Speed without provoking Opportunity Attack action.

actions.name: Call of the Hunt (1/Round)
actions.value: The Lord of the Feast releases a blood-curdling howl that can be heard all across Drakkenheim. All garmyr in the city heed this call and rush towards the Lord of the Feast's current position. Each garmyr within 60 feet who can see and hear the Lord of the Feast can use its Reaction to move up to half its Speed and make one melee or ranged attack with Advantage.

actions.name: Epic Resistance
actions.value: The Lord of the Feast chooses one condition, spell, or other effect currently affecting him and rolls 1d20. On an 11+, the effect ends on him. The Lord of the Feast can use this action even if he would otherwise be unable to take actions, his actions are being controlled by another creature, or if a spell or effect alters his game statistics.

entries: **Skills**: arcana +16, deception +10, insight +10, perception +10, persuasion +10, stealth +8

traits.name: Draw In
traits.value: If Lord Syuul fails a saving throw while grappling at least one enemy, he can choose to release all grappled creatures and succeed on the saving throw instead.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: Lord Syuul makes two Tentacle or two Psionic Repeater attacks then manifests a power or uses Memory Transfer.

actions.name: Tentacle
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +11 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. *Hit:* 28 (**4d10 + 6**) psychic damage, and if the target is Large or smaller, they are grappled (escape DC 19).

actions.name: Psionic Repeater
actions.value: *Ranged Weapon Attack:* +11 to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. *Hit:* 22 (**3d10 + 6**) force damage.

actions.name: Brain Overload (1/Day; 6th-Order Power)
actions.value: Lord Syuul creates a sudden surge of energy in the mind of a creature he can see within 120 feet of him. The target must make a DC 19 Constitution saving throw, taking 77 (**14d10**) psychic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. If the target has a brain and is reduced to 0 hit points, their brain explodes, and if they can't survive without their brain, they die.

actions.name: Flay (6th-Order Power)
actions.value: Lord Syuul shoots a 15-foot cone of psionic energy from his eyes. Each creature in that area must make a DC 19 Intelligence saving throw, taking 35 (**10d6**) psychic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

actions.name: Memory Transfer
actions.value: Lord Syuul psionically plunders the mind of each creature he is grappling. Each target must succeed on a DC 19 Intelligence saving throw or take 44 (**8d10**) psychic damage. If a target fails their saving throw and doesn't escape the grapple by the end of their next turn, they must choose one of these effects:

entries: The target's proficiency bonus drops to 0, they can't form new thoughts or speak, and they have disadvantage on all ability checks, attack rolls, and saving throws. Only the cure ailment power, a __lesser restoration__ spell, or a similar supernatural effect can end this effect. Additionally, until Lord Syuul finishes a long rest, he gains a cumulative +5 bonus to damage rolls.

The target is charmed by Lord Syuul for 1 hour. While the target is charmed, Lord Syuul can issue the target telepathic commands (no action required), which the target does their best to obey. Each time the target takes damage, they can make a DC 19 Wisdom saving throw, ending the effect on a success.

actions.name: Guise (3rd-Order Power)
actions.value: Lord Syuul projects a psionic image over his body, transforming his appearance for 1 hour into that of a Medium creature he has seen. When he manifests this power, he can also change the appearance of any equipment he carries.

The changes wrought by this power fail to hold up to physical inspection. A creature can use an action to inspect Lord Syuul's appearance and make a DC 19 Intelligence (*Investigation*) check, noticing the image is a projection on a success.

bonusActions.name: Grappling Jaunt
bonusActions.value: Lord Syuul and each creature grappled by him teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space he can see.

traits.name: Holy Aura
traits.value: Lucretia projects a 60-foot Emanation of holy power. At the start of each of her turns, she can choose the aura's effect, which applies to creatures of her choice in the Emanation:

traits.name: Divine Grace
traits.value: Creatures in the Emanation that target Lucretia with an attack or a harmful spell must first make a DC 20 Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, the creature must choose a new target or lose the attack or spell. This effect doesn't protect Lucretia from area effects, such as the explosion of a __Fireball__. If Lucretia makes an attack, casts a spell that affects an enemy, or deals damage to another creature, this trait ends until the start of her next turn.

traits.name: Pacifying Presence
traits.value: A creature that starts its turn in the Emanation has the Weakened condition until the start of its next turn.

traits.name: Wrathful Flame
traits.value: A creature that starts its turn in the Emanation takes 10 (**3d6**) Radiant damage plus 10 (**3d6**) Fire damage.

traits.name: Prescient
traits.value: Lucretia can't be *surprised* while she is conscious.

traits.name: Sanctified by Falling Fire
traits.value: When Lucretia dies, her soul is pulled into the delerium crystal embedded in her chest.

traits.name: Special Immunities
traits.value: Lucretia Mathias is immune to the Contamination condition.

traits.name: Unarmored Defense
traits.value: While Lucretia is wearing no armor and wielding no shield, her AC includes her Wisdom modifier (included above).

traits.name: Undeniable Faith
traits.value: Lucretia automatically succeeds on Constitution saving throws to maintain *Concentration* on her spells.

actions.name: Lucretia always takes her turn on Initiative count 20
actions.value: On her turn, Lucretia can use her movement and interaction as normal. However, she does not take an action or Bonus Action on her turn unless forced to do so by a spell or other effect. Instead, Lucretia takes one of the following Epic Actions at the end of each player character's turn:

entries: **Pacifying Touch**: *Wisdom Saving Throw:* DC 20, one creature within 5 feet of Lucretia. *Failure:* 35 (**10d6**) Psychic damage, and the target has the Incapacitated condition (save ends). *Success* Half damage only. *Failure or Success*: If this damage reduces the target to 0 Hit Points, the target is stabilized but has the Unconscious condition for 1 hour, even after regaining Hit Points.

**Sacred Flame**: *Dexterity Saving Throw:* DC 20, one creature within 60 feet of Lucretia. *Failure:* 45 (**10d8**) Radiant damage, and the target has the Blinded condition until the end of its next turn. *Success* Half damage only.

actions.name: Divine Intervention (1/Day)
actions.value: Lucretia chooses any spell which doesn't require a Reaction to cast. As part of this Epic Action, she casts that spell without Material components. If she uses this Epic Action to cast the __Wish__ spell, she can't use this Epic Action for the next 1d4 days.

actions.name: Epic Resistance
actions.value: Lucretia chooses one condition, spell, or other effect currently affecting her and rolls 1d20. On an 11+, the effect ends on her. Lucretia can use this action even if she would otherwise be unable to take actions, her actions are being controlled by another creature, or if a spell or effect alters her game statistics.

fluffInfo.name: Study the Foe
fluffInfo.value: Characters proficient in *History* or *Nature* gain Advantage on Intelligence (*Arcana*) checks when they take the Study action to examine a Lurker on the Threshold, learning the following based on the result.

fluffInfo.name: (10+) Baleful Resistance
fluffInfo.value: You know the creature's Immunities.

fluffInfo.name: (15+) Arcane Beams
fluffInfo.value: You learn the creature's Cosmic Rays attack action.

fluffInfo.name: (20+) Enduring
fluffInfo.value: You know the creature's highest and lowest ability scores.

fluffInfo.name: Combat Tactics
fluffInfo.value: The Lurker on the Threshold is a creature of pure arcane energy and twisted realities. It fires Cosmic Rays at mortal creatures,warping their minds, showing truths that drive them mad, or undoes their very existence on a cellular level. It grabs creatures with its Tendrils and blasts its beams while holding them in place, undoing the creatures from the inside out, before tossing them aside and moving on to the next. The Lurker on the Threshold only flees if it is reduced to under half its Hit Points, not because of any sense of fear, but because it finds specific enemies a nuisance.

fluffInfo.name: Animus:
fluffInfo.value: Aberration.

fluffInfo.name: Fluid:
fluffInfo.value: Contaminated Ichor, Goopy Ooze, Mucus.

fluffInfo.name: Organs:
fluffInfo.value: Eyes, Guts, Glands, Flesh. Natural

fluffInfo.name: Weapons:
fluffInfo.value: Tentacles.

fluffInfo.value: Skin.

fluffInfo.value: Aberrant Dust.

entries: **Languages**: telepathy 120 ft. understands all languages but can't speak

traits.name: Fully Contaminated
traits.value: The lurker is immune to Contamination and has Advantage on saving throws against contaminated spells. The lurker may cast contaminated spells even though it does not gain Contamination levels.

traits.name: Delerium Healing
traits.value: As an action, the lurker can touch a delerium shard to regain 10 (3d6) Hit Points. Once the lurker has used a delerium shard in this way, the shard can't be used in this manner again for 24 hours.

traits.name: Alien Intellect
traits.value: The lurker is immune to any effect that would sense its emotions or read its thoughts, as well as any divination spell that it refuses. Wisdom (*Insight*) checks made to ascertain the lurker's intentions or sincerity have Disadvantage.

traits.name: Eldritch Blood
traits.value: A creature that deals Piercing or Slashing damage to the lurker while within 5 feet of it takes 5 (**1d10**) Necrotic damage.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.value: The lurker has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The lurker makes three Tendril attacks. It can replace each Tendril attack with a use of Cosmic Rays.

actions.name: Tendril
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +8, reach 30 ft. *Hit:* 13 (**2d8 + 4**) Bludgeoning damage plus 9 (**2d8**) Necrotic damage, and if the target is a Huge or smaller creature, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 16). While Grappled, the target has the Restrained condition. The lurker has ten tendrils, each of which can grapple one creature.

actions.name: Cosmic Rays
actions.value: The lurker randomly shoots one of the following magical rays at a target it can see within 120 feet (roll 1d4; reroll if the lurker has already used that ray this turn):

entries: **Disintegrating Ray**: *Dexterity Saving Throw:* DC 16. *Failure:* 27 (**6d8**) Force damage. If this damage reduces the target to 0 Hit Points, it disintegrates into dust.

**Memory Lapse Ray**: *Intelligence Saving Throw:* DC 16. *Failure:* The target's memories become distant for 1 minute. While its memories are distant, the target can't take the Magic action, use class features, or understand language, and has Disadvantage on ability checks. At the end of each of its turns, the target repeats the save, ending the effect on itself on a success.
**Contaminating Ray**: *Constitution Saving Throw:* DC 16. *Failure:* 16 (**3d10**) Necrotic damage, and the target gains one Contamination level. *Success* Half damage only.
**Existential Dread Ray**: On the target's next turn, each time it takes an action other than the Dodge action, moves more than 5 feet, or takes a Bonus Action, it takes 14 (**4d6**) Psychic damage.

fluffInfo.name: Study the Foe
fluffInfo.value: Characters proficient in *Insight* gain Advantage on Intelligence (*Arcana*) check to study a Lurking Dreg, learning the following based on their result:

fluffInfo.name: (10+) Something's Off
fluffInfo.value: You suspect this person may have been exposed to eldritch contamination.

fluffInfo.name: (15+) Hiding Something
fluffInfo.value: You are aware of the Lurking Dreg's Cunning Action trait.

fluffInfo.name: (20+) Not A Humanoid
fluffInfo.value: You realize this is a Dreg appearing to be a normal humanoid and recognize the Lurking Dreg's highest and lowest ability scores and saving throws.

fluffInfo.name: Combat Tactics
fluffInfo.value: Some Lurking Dregs hide in the shadows, waiting for an opportune moment to strike. Others pose as human and attempt to converse with prey, hoping to draw them deeper into the ruins. Lurking Dregs have been known to use stories of lost allies, trapped children, and more to lure adventurers into an ambush.

When they attack, Lurking Dregs use their Furious Ambush right away to get as many attacks in as possible. They Disengage if they can and attempt to keep their enemies at bay, possibly having other Dregs tie them up while the Lurking Dreg darts in and out.
If Lurking Dregs find themselves outnumbered at any point, they run into the shadows and Hide, attempting to escape.

traits.name: Normal Semblance
traits.value: The dreg has Advantage on Charisma (*Deception*) checks to disguise itself as, or impersonate, a humanoid creature.

actions.name: Dagger
actions.value: *Melee or Ranged Attack Roll:* +5, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft. *Hit:* 5 (**1d4 + 3**) Piercing damage plus 10 (**3d6**) Poison damage.

actions.name: Furious Ambush (Recharges on a Short Rest)
actions.value: The dreg makes two Dagger attacks.

bonusActions.name: Cunning Action
bonusActions.value: The dreg takes the Dash, Disengage, or Hide action.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The maestro makes two attacks with its Rapier.

actions.name: Rapier
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +5 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. *Hit:* 6 (**1d8 + 2**) piercing damage.

actions.name: Vicious Mockery
actions.value: Cantrip: DC 14 Wisdom saving throw, range 60 ft., one target that can hear the maestro. Failure: 5 (**2d4**) psychic damage and the target has disadvantage on the next attack roll it makes before the end of its next turn.

bonusActions.name: Inspire (3/Short or Long Rest)
bonusActions.value: The maestro targets one creature within 60 feet of it. If the target can hear the maestro, the target gains a Bardic Inspiration die; a d10. Once within the next 10 minutes, the creature can roll the die and add the number to one ability check, attack roll, or saving throw it makes. Once the Bardic Inspiration die is rolled, it is lost. A creature can have only one Bardic Inspiration die at a time.

fluffInfo.name: Study the Foe
fluffInfo.value: Characters proficient in *Nature* or *Survival* gain Advantage on Intelligence (*Arcana*) checks to study a Magma Troll, learning the following information based on the result:

fluffInfo.name: (5+) From Harsh Environments
fluffInfo.value: You know the troll's Immunities.

fluffInfo.name: (10+) Hard to Kill
fluffInfo.value: You learn of the troll's Regeneration trait.

fluffInfo.name: (15+) Special Weakness
fluffInfo.value: You have insight into the troll's Vulnerabilities.

fluffInfo.name: Combat Tactics
fluffInfo.value: Magma Trolls hunt for food during the hottest days of summer or in places of extreme temperatures. Often accompanied by sweltering heat, they begin combat by unleashing their Sulfurous Belch before rushing in to maul foes with their claws and bites.
If a Magma Troll takes Cold damage, it immediately flees and attempts to find a safe place to recuperate.
