traits.name: Regeneration
traits.value: The troll regains 10 Hit Points at the start of each of its turns. If the troll takes Cold damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of the troll's next turn. The troll dies only if it starts its turn with 0 Hit Points and doesn't regenerate.

traits.name: Special Immunities
traits.value: The troll is immune to the Burning condition.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The troll makes two Fiery Claw attacks and one Volcanic Bite attack. It can replace its Volcanic Bite attack with Sulphurous Belch, if available.

actions.name: Volcanic Bite
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +7, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 7 (**1d6 + 4**) Piercing damage plus 10 (**3d6**) Fire damage.

actions.name: Fiery Claw
actions.value: *Melee or Ranged Attack Roll:* +7, reach 5 ft. or range 120 feet. *Hit:* 18 (**4d6 + 4**) Fire damage, and the target has the Burning condition (4d6 Fire).

actions.name: Sulfurous Belch (Recharges 5-6)
actions.value: *Constitution Saving Throw:* DC 16, each creature in a 20-foot-radius Sphere centered on the troll. *Failure:* 14 (**4d6**) Fire damage and has the Blinded condition until it or another creature within 5 of it uses an action to clean the ash from their eyes. *Success* Half damage only.

entries: **Immunities**: cold, poison, psychic; blinded, charmed, deafened, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned

traits.name: Arcanomagnetic Repulsion
traits.value: Attacks against the armour made with ferrous weapons or ammunition are made at disadvantage.

traits.name: False Appearance
traits.value: While the armour remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from a pile of armour plates.

traits.name: Superconductor
traits.value: If the armour takes 10 or more fire damage in a single instance, it falls prone and, until the end of its next turn, it is incapacitated and its flying speed is reduced to 0 feet.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The armour makes two melee attacks or casts Magnetobolt twice.

actions.name: Greatsword
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 10 (**2d6 + 3**) slashing damage plus 4 (**1d8**) force damage.

actions.name: Magnetobolt
actions.value: *Ranged Spell Attack:* +7 to hit, reach 90 ft., one target. *Hit:* 10 (**3d6**) force damage and the target must succeed on a DC 15 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone. A creature wearing ferrous armour makes this saving throw with disadvantage.

traits.name: Arcanomagnetic Repulsion
traits.value: Attacks against the weapon made with ferrous weapons or ammunition are made at disadvantage.
The area within 10 feet of the dragon is difficult terrain for creatures wearing ferrous armour.

traits.name: Superconductor
traits.value: If the dragon takes 1 or more fire damage in a single instance, its flying speed is reduced by 20 feet until the end of its next turn. If its flying speed is reduced to 0 feet, it immediately falls 100 feet, and falls a further 100 feet at the start of its next turn.

actions.name: Bite
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 7 (**1d10 + 2**) piercing damage.

actions.name: Sword Shot
actions.value: *Ranged Weapon Attack:* +4 to hit, range 30/90 ft., one target. *Hit:* 4 (**1d4+2**) piercing damage.

actions.name: Breath Weapons (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: The dragon uses one of the following breath weapons.

actions.name: Storm of Swords
actions.value: The dragon fires a torrent of sharp metal objects in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 11 Dexterity saving throw, taking 14 **4d6** piercing damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

actions.name: Repulsion Breath
actions.value: The dragon exhales repulsion energy in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 11 Strength saving throw. On a failed save, the creature is pushed up to 30 feet away from the dragon. A creature wearing ferrous armour has disadvantage on this saving throw.

entries: **Languages**: understands any one language but speaks only through the use of their Mimicry trait

traits.name: Agile Predator
traits.value: When the manticore hits a creature with an attack on the manticore's turn, the manticore doesn't provoke opportunity attacks from that creature for the rest of that turn.

traits.name: Mimicry
traits.value: The manticore can mimic any words or phrases they have heard in a language they understand. A creature who hears the speech can tell it is an imitation with a successful DC 10 Wisdom (*Insight*) check.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The manticore makes one Bite and one Claw attack, or two Tail Spike attacks.

actions.name: Bite
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 8 (**1d8 + 4**) piercing damage. If the target is a creature who is frightened of the manticore, they take an extra 4 (**1d8**) piercing damage.

actions.name: Claw
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 9 (**1d10 + 4**) slashing damage, and the manticore can move the target up to 5 feet horizontally.

actions.name: Tail Spike
actions.value: *Ranged Weapon Attack:* +5 to hit, range 60/120 ft., one target. *Hit:* 5 (**1d4 + 3**) piercing damage plus 3 (**1d6**) poison damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned until the end of their next turn.

bonusActions.name: Trumpeting Howl (1/Day)
bonusActions.value: Each enemy within 120 feet who can hear the manticore must succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened of the manticore for 1 minute (save ends at end of turn). If the initial saving throw fails by 5 or more, a creature is also dazed while frightened in this way.

entries: **HP**: 7 + seven times caregiver's level (number of d8 Hit Dice equal to their caregiver's level)
**Skills**: perception +1 plus PB, stealth +1 plus PB

traits.name: Learning to Fly
traits.value: The manticore has a flying speed of 10 × PB feet.

traits.name: Mimicry
traits.value: The manticore can mimic any words or phrases they have heard in a language the manticore's caregiver understands. A creature who hears the speech can tell it is an imitation with a successful DC 10 plus PB Wisdom (*Insight*) check.

actions.name: Signature Attack (Bite)
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +3 plus PB to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* **1d6 plus PB** piercing damage.

actions.name: 1st Level: Tail Spike (2 Ferocity)
actions.value: The manticore hurls a spine from its tail. This attack uses the statistics for their signature attack, except the spine is a ranged weapon with a normal range of 30 feet and a long range of 60 feet, and on a hit, the attack deals an extra **PB** of poison damage.

actions.name: 3rd Level: Trumpeting Howl (5 Ferocity)
actions.value: Each enemy within 30 feet of the manticore who can hear them must succeed on a DC 10 plus PB Wisdom saving throw or be frightened of them until the end of the manticore's next turn.

actions.name: 5th Level: Poisoned Sting (8 Ferocity)
actions.value: The manticore stings a target within 10 feet of them with their tail. The target must make a DC 10 plus PB Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the target takes **PBd10** poison damage and becomes dazed until the end of their next turn. On a successful save, the target takes half as much damage and isn't dazed.

entries: **Resistances**: bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from mundane attacks that aren't adamantine

traits.name: Agility Rune
traits.value: Being within 5 feet of an enemy doesn't impose disadvantage on the giant's ranged attack rolls.

traits.name: False Appearance
traits.value: While motionless, the giant is indistinguishable from a statue.

traits.name: Stone Flesh
traits.value: When a creature attacks the giant with a melee weapon that isn't adamantine and rolls a 1 on the d20 for that attack, that weapon is destroyed if it is mundane. If that weapon is supernatural, it loses all supernatural properties for 1 hour.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The giant makes two Greatsling attacks.

actions.name: Greatsling
actions.value: *Ranged Weapon Attack:* +8 to hit, range 60/240 feet, one target. *Hit:* 15 (**3d6 + 5**) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Slam
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. *Hit:* 27 (**4d10 + 5**) bludgeoning damage, and if the target is a creature, they must succeed on a DC 16 Strength saving throw or be pushed 10 feet away from the giant.

actions.name: Boulder Roll (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: The giant bowls a boulder in a 10-foot-wide, 30-foot-long line along the ground. Each creature in this line must make a DC 16 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 27 (**5d10**) bludgeoning damage and falls prone. On a successful save, the creature takes half as much damage and doesn't fall prone. Each object in this line that isn't supernatural or worn or carried by a creature takes 27 (**5d10**) bludgeoning damage. At the end of its roll, the boulder crumbles, creating a 10-foot square of difficult terrain.

bonusActions.name: Siege Stance
bonusActions.value: The giant digs their heels into the ground, reducing their speed to 0. While in this stance, the normal and long ranges of the giant's Greatsling attack are doubled, and when this attack hits, each other creature within 5 feet of the target must succeed on a DC 17 Dexterity saving throw or take 10 (**3d6**) bludgeoning damage. The giant's stance lasts until they become grappled, incapacitated, prone, or restrained, or until the giant ends it as a bonus action.

traits.name: Multiple Heads
traits.value: The marsh hydra has advantage on saving throws against being blinded, charmed, dazed, deafened, frightened, stunned, and knocked unconscious.

traits.name: Roll Over
traits.value: If the marsh hydra moves at least 20 feet straight toward a creature and then hits them with an Entangling Serpents attack on the same turn, that target must succeed on a DC 16 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The marsh hydra makes two Entangling Serpents attacks. They can replace one attack with a Many Bites attack.

actions.name: Entangling Serpents
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 14 (**2d8 + 5**) bludgeoning damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 16).

actions.name: Many Bites
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. *Hit:* 9 (**1d8 + 5**) piercing damage, and the target must make a DC 16 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the target takes 18 (**4d8**) poison damage and is poisoned until the end of the marsh hydra's next turn. On a successful save, the target takes half as much damage and isn't poisoned.

bonusActions.name: Serpent Surprise
bonusActions.value: The marsh hydra activates one of the following effects; if the effect targets another creature, the marsh hydra targets one creature they can see within 30 feet of them:

entries: **1. Poison Spit**: The targeted creature must succeed on a DC 16 Dexterity saving throw or take 9 (**2d8**) poison damage and be blinded until the end of the marsh hydra's next turn.

**2. Entrancing Gaze**: The targeted creature must succeed on a DC 16 Wisdom saving throw or be charmed by the marsh hydra for 1 minute or until the marsh hydra harms the target (save ends at end of turn).
**3. Terrifying Rattle**: The targeted creature must succeed on a DC 16 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened by the marsh hydra for 1 minute (save ends at end of turn).
**4. Reinforcements**: The marsh hydra shuffles which heads are on the outside of their body and regains 10 (3d6) hit points.

traits.name: Scent Reliance
traits.value: The marvorok can't use their blindsight if they can't breathe or smell.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The marvorok makes three Claw attacks and one Eviscerate attack.

actions.name: Claw
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +12 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 19 (**3d8 + 6**) slashing damage, and if the target is Large or smaller, they are grappled (escape DC 17). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained. The marvorok can grapple up to two creatures at a time.

actions.name: Eviscerate
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +12 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature grappled by the marvorok. *Hit:* 17 (**2d10 + 6**) piercing damage plus 17 (**2d10 + 6**) slashing damage.

bonusActions.name: Taste the Air
bonusActions.value: The marvorok makes a Wisdom (Perception) check.

bonusActions.name: Underground Stalker
bonusActions.value: The marvorok teleports, along with any creatures they are grappling, up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space they can see. If the marvorok teleports into an area of dim light or darkness, they can take the Hide action as part of this bonus action, and any creatures they are grappling can't speak or make noise until the end of the marvorok's next turn.

traits.name: Academy Rings (1/Day)
traits.value: The mage can cast a spell from Spellcasting without expending a use of it.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The mage makes three Prismatic Blast attacks.

actions.name: Prismatic Blast
actions.value: *Melee or Ranged Attack Roll:* +6, reach 5 ft. or range 120 ft. *Hit:* 14 (**4d6**) Cold, Fire, or Lightning damage (mage's choice).

fluffInfo.name: Study the Foe
fluffInfo.value: Characters proficient in *Nature* or *Survival* gain Advantage on Intelligence (*Arcana*) checks to Study a Maw Vermin, learning the following based on the result:

fluffInfo.name: (10+) Filled with Delerium
fluffInfo.value: You recognize that this creature gained the Magic Resistance trait, and has Resistance to Acid, Poison, and Necrotic damage.

fluffInfo.name: (15+) Chew and Spit!
fluffInfo.value: You learn the details of the Maw Vermin's Bite, and Glob Launcher.

fluffInfo.name: (20+) Dim but Enduring
fluffInfo.value: You know the Maw Vermin's strongest and weakest ability scores and saving throws.

fluffInfo.name: Combat Tactics
fluffInfo.value: Maw Vermin is a primal creature that cannot comprehend anything beyond its next meal. Ratlings give them a wide berth, as it is just as likely to consume them as anything else. When a Maw Vermin senses anything it can eat, it lumbers towards the meal, using its Grasping Maw to pull targets closer so it can Bite them. Maw Vermin want to consume anything in sight, using its own food to secure even more. It uses Glob Launcher to spit half-digested morsels, happily eating whatever mess is left over.

fluffInfo.name: Animus:
fluffInfo.value: Monstrosity.

fluffInfo.name: Fluid:
fluffInfo.value: Monster Blood, Contaminated Ichor, Acidic Bile.

fluffInfo.name: Organs:
fluffInfo.value: Eyes, Heart, Brain, Guts, Flesh, Glands.

fluffInfo.name: Bones:
fluffInfo.value: Skull, Spine, Ribs.

fluffInfo.name: Natural Weapons:
fluffInfo.value: Claws, Teeth, Tentacles.

fluffInfo.name: Hair:
fluffInfo.value: Fur.

fluffInfo.name: Hide:
fluffInfo.value: Skin.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.value: The maw vermin has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The maw vermin makes one Bite attack and three Claw attacks, and it can use Grasping Maw or Glob Launcher.

actions.name: Bite
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +10, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 22 (**3d10 + 6**) Piercing damage, and if the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it is swallowed. A swallowed creature has the Blinded and Restrained conditions, and has Total Cover from effects originating outside the maw vermin. At the start of each of the maw vermin's turns, a swallowed creature takes 10 (**3d6**) Acid damage and must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or gain one Contamination level.

The maw vermin can swallow up to three creatures at a time. If the maw vermin takes 20+ damage in a single turn from a creature inside it, the maw vermin must succeed on a DC 20 Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate all swallowed creatures, each of which land in spaces within 10 feet of the maw vermin with the Prone condition. If the maw vermin dies, a swallowed creature no longer has the Restrained condition and can escape from the corpse using 10 feet of movement, exiting with the Prone condition.

actions.name: Claw
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +10, reach 10 ft. *Hit:* 19 (**3d8 + 6**) Slashing damage, and if the target is Huge or smaller, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 16). Until the grapple ends, the maw vermin can't use this Claw on another target. The maw vermin has three Claws.

actions.name: Grasping Maw
actions.value: *Strength Saving Throw:* DC 18, one Medium or smaller creature the maw vermin can see within 15 feet. *Failure:* The target is pulled into an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the maw vermin.

actions.name: Glob Launcher
actions.value: The maw vermin coats a swallowed creature in acidic goo and launches it at a point within 120 feet of it. *Dexterity Saving Throw:* DC 15, each creature within 10 feet of the launched creature as it lands (the launched creature automatically fails). *Failure:* 21 (**6d6**) Acid damage, and the target has the Burning condition (4d6 Acid). While Burning, the target has the Restrained condition.

entries: **Skills**: deception +4, investigation +3, sleight of hand +4, stealth +4

traits.name: Helpful-ish
traits.value: The mechakobold desires to help other creatures on their ability checks and will always try to take the Help action in non-combat situations. However, if the check on which the mechakobold helps is a failure, the consequences are always catastrophic (GM's discretion).

traits.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
traits.value: While in sunlight, the mechakobold has disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as on Wisdom (*Perception*) checks that rely on sight.

actions.name: Slingshot
actions.value: *Ranged Weapon Attack:* +4 to hit, range 20/60 ft., one target. *Hit:* 4 (**1d4 + 2**) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Tie Laces
actions.value: The mechakobold attempts to tie together the lower limbs of a creature within 5 feet of it using a pair of spare laces. It makes a Dexterity (*Sleight of Hand*) check contested by the target's Dexterity (*Acrobatics*) or Strength (*Athletics*) check. On a success, the target's walking and climbing speeds are halved until it unties its laces as an action, or cuts them with an attack with a slashing weapon.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The medusa uses Stone Gaze and makes two attacks using Snake Bite, Heavy Crossbow, or both.

actions.name: Snake Bite
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. *Hit:* 10 (**3d6**) poison damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned until the end of the medusa's next turn.

actions.name: Heavy Crossbow
actions.value: *Ranged Weapon Attack:* +8 to hit, range 100/400 ft., one target. *Hit:* 10 (**1d10 + 5**) piercing damage plus 7 (**2d6**) poison damage.

actions.name: Stone Gaze
actions.value: The medusa fires energy beams from their eyes at up to three creatures they can see within 60 feet of them. Each target must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or begin turning to stone (save ends at end of turn). While turning to stone, a creature's speed is reduced by 10 feet and they have disadvantage on Dexterity checks and saving throws.
If a creature who is turning to stone is targeted by this action again and fails their save, their speed is reduced by another 10 feet and they are dazed until the effect ends.

If a creature who is turning to stone and dazed in this way is targeted by this action again and fails their save, they are petrified and can no longer make saving throws to end the effects of Stone Gaze. The petrification lasts until the creature is restored by a cure ailment power of 4th order or higher, a __greater restoration__ spell, or a similar supernatural effect.

bonusActions.name: Nimble Escape
bonusActions.value: The medusa takes the Disengage or Hide action.

entries: **HP**: Seven times their level (number of d8 Hit Dice equal to their level)
**Skills**: perception +1 plus PB, survival +1 plus PB

actions.name: Signature Attack (Snake Bite)
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +3 plus PB to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* **1d10 plus PB** piercing damage. Beginning at 7th level, the headstrong can make this attack twice, instead of once, when they take the Attack action on their turn.

actions.name: 3rd Level: Snake Spit (3/Day)
actions.value: As a bonus action, the headstrong spits venom at the eyes of a creature within 5 feet of them. The target must succeed on a DC 10 plus PB Dexterity saving throw or be blinded until the end of their next turn.

actions.name: 5th Level: Venomous Bite (3/Day)
actions.value: When the headstrong hits a creature with a signature attack, the headstrong injects the target with venom. The target must make a DC 10 plus PB Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the target takes **PBd6** poison damage and is poisoned until the start of the headstrong's next turn. On a successful save, the target takes half as much damage and isn't poisoned.

actions.name: 7th Level: Stone Gaze (3/Day)
actions.value: As an action, the headstrong fires energy beams from their eyes at a creature they can see within 30 feet of them. The target must succeed on a DC 10 plus PB Constitution saving throw or begin to turn to stone and be restrained.

A target restrained in this way must repeat the saving throw at the end of their next turn. On a successful save, the effect ends. On a failed save, the creature is petrified for 1 hour or until they are restored by a cure ailment power of 4th order or higher, a __greater restoration__ spell, or a similar supernatural effect.

entries: **Immunities**: acid; bludgeoning damage from falling; prone

traits.name: False Appearance (Object Form Only)
traits.value: While the mimic remains motionless, they are indistinguishable from an ordinary object.

traits.name: Mimicry
traits.value: The mimic can imitate any sounds they have heard, including voices. A creature who hears the sounds can tell they are imitations with a successful DC 12 Wisdom (*Insight*) check.

actions.name: Pseudopod
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +5 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. *Hit:* 7 (**1d8 + 3**) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, they are grappled (escape DC 13).

actions.name: Gnashing Maw
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 7 (**1d8 + 3**) piercing damage plus 3 (**1d6**) acid damage. If the target is grappled by the mimic, they take an extra 3 (**1d6**) acid damage.

actions.name: Shapechanger
actions.value: The mimic polymorphs into a Small, Medium, or Large object or back into their true amorphous form. Other than size, the mimic's statistics are the same in each form. Anything they are wearing or carrying isn't transformed. They revert to their true form if they die.

actions.name: Envelop
actions.value: While grappling a creature, the mimic uses their Shapechanger action to polymorph into an object that is the same size or bigger than the grappled creature (if the mimic isn't already in such a form). The creature is then enveloped by the mimic. An enveloped creature is no longer grappled, but they can't breathe, are blinded and restrained, have total cover against attacks and other effects outside the mimic, and take 10 (**3d6**) acid damage at the start of each of the mimic's turns. When the mimic moves, the enveloped creature moves with them. The mimic can envelop one creature at a time.

An enveloped creature can use their action to try to escape by making a DC 13 Strength check. On a successful check, the creature is no longer enveloped and is shunted to an unoccupied space of their choice within 5 feet of the mimic. The creature automatically escapes if the mimic uses Shapechanger or Panic Shift, becomes incapacitated, or dies.

actions.name: 1st Level: Distracting Attack (2 Ferocity)
actions.value: The mimic makes a signature attack. On a hit, the attack deals its normal effects, and the next attack made against the target before the start of the mimic's next turn has advantage.

actions.name: 3rd Level: Adhesive Pseudopods (5 Ferocity)
actions.value: The mimic attempts to adhere to each creature of their choice within 5 feet of them. Each target must succeed on a DC 10 plus PB Dexterity saving throw or be grappled (escape DC 10 plus PB).

actions.name: 5th Level: I'm You (8 Ferocity)
actions.value: The mimic uses their Shapechanger trait to polymorph into one Large or smaller creature they can see within 5 feet of them. Other than size, the mimic's statistics do not change, and the mimic reverts to their previous form at the start of their next turn.

After transforming, the mimic can make a signature attack against the target whose form they have taken. Hit or miss, the target must then make a DC 10 plus PB Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, attacks against the target have advantage and the target has disadvantage on attack rolls and saving throws until the start of the mimic's next turn.

bonusActions.name: Wearable Companion
bonusActions.value: While the mimic is within 5 feet of their caregiver, the mimic can pull themself into the caregiver's space, cover the caregiver's body, and take on the appearance of clothing. While the caregiver is wearing the mimic, the mimic's space is not difficult terrain for the caregiver, the caregiver has advantage on Dexterity (*Stealth*) checks, and the caregiver can change the appearance of their mimic clothing at will (no action required) as long as the caregiver and mimic aren't incapacitated.

Any attack that hits the caregiver also hits the mimic they are wearing, and vice versa, with both taking the full damage and effect of the attack. While worn in this way, the mimic can't move, and they can't take actions other than using a bonus action to revert to their previous form. A mimic automatically reverts to their previous form if they enter a rampage. Upon reverting to their previous form, the mimic is no longer worn by their caregiver, and the mimic enters the nearest unoccupied space of their choice.

traits.name: In Your Space
traits.value: The mimiature can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and the mimiature can move through any opening at least 1 inch wide without squeezing.

traits.name: Minion
traits.value: If the mimiature takes damage from an attack or as the result of a failed saving throw, their hit points are reduced to 0. If the mimiature takes damage from another effect, they die if the damage equals or exceeds their hit point maximum; otherwise they take no damage.

actions.name: Sticky Swarm (Group Attack)
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 1 bludgeoning damage. Until the end of the target's next turn, they have disadvantage on ability checks and saving throws made to escape a grapple, and they have advantage on ability checks made to initiate or maintain a grapple. Additionally, if three or more mimiatures joined the attack, the target's appendages become so sticky that until the end of the target's next turn, they can't cast spells with somatic components, they can't drop objects, and they can't interact with objects other the ones they are already holding.

actions.name: Group Shapechanger
actions.value: The mimiature polymorphs into a Tiny object or back into their true amorphous form. If four mimiatures within 5 feet of each other use this action together, they can join together to become one Small object. Anything a mimiature is wearing or carrying isn't transformed. A mimiature in object form reverts to their true form if any mimiature in the group moves, takes an action, or dies.

fluffInfo.name: Study the Foe
fluffInfo.value: Characters proficient in *History* or any kind of artisan's tools gain Advantage on Intelligence (*Arcana*) checks when they take the Study action to examine Minazorond. They learn the following information based on their check result.

fluffInfo.name: (10+) Resistant Form
fluffInfo.value: You know the creature's Resistances and Immunities.

fluffInfo.name: (15+) Shrug Off Effects
fluffInfo.value: You recognize the creature's Draconic Rebuke ability.

fluffInfo.name: (20+) Tough to Kill
fluffInfo.value: You learn of its Construct Resilience trait.

fluffInfo.name: Combat Tactics
fluffInfo.value: Minazorond is an animated engine of destruction charged with the protection of Castle Drakken. The corrupted protector attacks any who approach the palace itself, opening with a terrifying roar and a barrage of shocking bursts before closing the distance to unleash its breath weapon. Under most circumstances, the dragon is too large to physically enter the palace proper, and is thus restricted to attacking targets in the castle baileys and courtyards.

fluffInfo.name: Animus:
fluffInfo.value: Dragon.

fluffInfo.name: Natural Weapons:
fluffInfo.value: Teeth, Claws

fluffInfo.name: Hide:
fluffInfo.value: Plates, Scales.

fluffInfo.name: Dust:
fluffInfo.value: Draconic Dust

traits.name: Protective Aura
traits.value: A creature that starts its turn within 30 feet of Minazorond takes 14 (**4d6**) Lightning damage.

traits.name: Construct Resilience
traits.value: If damage reduces Minazorond to 0 Hit Points, it must make a Constitution saving throw with a DC of 5 plus the damage taken, unless the damage is Radiant or from a Critical Hit. On a success, Minazorond drops to 1 Hit Point instead.

actions.name: Minazorond always takes its turn on Initiative count 20
actions.value: On its turn, Minazorond can use its movement and interaction as normal. However, it does not take an action or Bonus Action on its turn unless forced to do so by a spell or other effect. Instead, Minazorond takes one of the following Epic Actions at the end of each player character's turn:

entries: **Bite**: *Melee Attack Roll:* +14, reach 10 ft. *Hit:* 33 (**4d12 + 7**) Piercing damage, and if the target is Medium or smaller, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 17). While Grappled, the target has the Restrained condition.
**Claw**: *Melee Attack Roll:* +14, reach 10 ft. *Hit:* 17 (**3d6 + 7**) Slashing damage.

actions.name: Tail
actions.value: *Strength Saving Throw:* DC 22, one creature Minazorond can see within 20 feet. *Failure:* 14 (**4d6**) Force damage, and if the target is Medium or smaller, it has the Prone condition.

actions.name: Shocking Burst
actions.value: *Wisdom Saving Throw:* DC 20, one target Minazorond can see within 120 feet. *Failure:* 22 (**4d10**) Lightning damage, and the target has the Shocked condition. *Success* Half damage only.

actions.name: Terrifying Roar (Recharges after a Short Rest)
actions.value: *Wisdom Saving Throw:* DC 20, each creature in a 120-foot Emanation originating from Minazorond that can hear it. *Failure:* 18 (**4d8**) Thunder damage, and the target has the Frightened condition (save ends).

actions.name: Breathe Deep (1/Round)
actions.value: Minazorond's Breath Weapon recharges. Minazorond can only use this Epic Action if it's the first Epic Action it has taken this round.

actions.name: Breath Weapon (Special Recharge)
actions.value: Minazorond uses one of the following breath weapons. It can only use this Epic Action if it's the last Epic Action it takes this round.

actions.name: Lightning Breath
actions.value: *Dexterity Saving Throw:* DC 22, each creature in a 120-foot Cone. *Failure:* 81 (**16d8**) Lightning damage, and the target has the Shocked condition. *Success* Half damage.

actions.name: Thunder Breath
actions.value: *Constitution Saving Throw:* DC 22, each creature in a 120-foot Cone. *Failure:* 66 (**12d10**) Thunder damage, and the target is pushed 20 feet away from Minazorond and has the Dazed condition (save ends). Failure by 5 or More: Double damage, and the target also has the Deafened condition (save ends). *Success* Half damage only.

actions.name: Epic Resistance
actions.value: Minazorond chooses one condition, spell, or other effect currently affecting them and rolls 1d20. On an 11+, the effect ends on it. Minazorond can use this action even if it would otherwise be unable to take actions, its actions are being controlled by another creature, or if a spell or effect alters its game statistics.

traits.name: Aquatic Camouflage
traits.value: The leech has Advantage on Dexterity (*Stealth*) checks made to hide in aquatic terrain.

traits.name: Memory Bank
traits.value: The leech has three memory banks in its body. When encountered, roll 1d3 to determine how many memory banks are filled with grey matter. The rest are empty.

actions.name: Attach
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +3, reach 0 ft. *Hit:* The leech attaches to the target. While attached, the leech doesn't attack, and moves with the target, using none of the leech's movement. The leech can detach itself using 5 feet of movement, and detaches immediately if its blood bags are filled or if the target dies.

A creature within 5 feet can take an action to detach the leech with a successful DC 13 Wisdom (*Medicine*) check. *Failure:* The leech is still detached, but the target has the Bleeding condition (2d4). Failure by 5 or More: The leech isn't detached and the target takes 8 (**2d4 + 3**) Piercing damage.

bonusActions.name: Brain Drain
bonusActions.value: The leech can use this Bonus Action only when it is attached to a creature. That creature is subjected to the following effect. *Intelligence Saving Throw:* DC 11. *Failure:* The target's Intelligence score is reduced by 1d4, and one of the leech's memory banks is filled. If this effect reduces the target's Intelligence score to 0, it has the Unconscious condition until it regains at least 1 point of Intelligence. Otherwise, the reduction lasts until the creature finishes a Short or Long Rest.

bonusActions.name: Thought Transfusion
bonusActions.value: The leech can use this Bonus Action only when it is attached to a creature and has at least one filled memory bank. The attached creature gains Advantage on Intelligence-based D20 Tests for 1 minute, and the leech empties one of its filled memory banks.

traits.name: Displacement
traits.value: Attack rolls against the Mind Siphon have Disadvantage, since it projects an illusion that makes it appear near its actual location. This trait is suppressed while the Mind Siphon has the Incapacitated condition.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.value: The Mind Siphon has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.value: The Mind Siphon can climb difficult surfaces, including along ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The Mind Siphon makes two Tentacle Tongue attacks at different targets.

actions.name: Tentacle Tongue
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +8 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. *Hit:* 26 (**5d8 + 4**) Psychic damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 16) from the Mind Siphon's Tentacle Tongue, and the target has the Stunned condition until the Grapple ends. The Mind Siphon can Grapple up to two creatures at the same time.

actions.name: Consume Head (Recharge 6)
actions.value: *Constitution Saving Throw:* DC 16, one creature Grappled by Tentacle Tongue. *Failure:* 44 (**8d10**) Piercing damage. *Success* Half damage. *Failure or Success*: If this damage reduces the target to 0 Hit Points, the Mind Siphon kills it and devours its head.

actions.name: Synaptic Eruption (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: *Intelligence Saving Throw:* DC 16, each creature within 30 feet of the Mind Siphon. *Failure:* 36 (**8d8**) Psychic damage, and the target has the Stunned condition until the end of the Mind Siphon's next turn. *Success* Half damage only.

traits.value: The mindkiller can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

traits.name: Psionic Immunity
traits.value: The mindkiller is unaffected by psionic powers manifested by voiceless talkers unless the mindkiller wishes to be.

actions.name: Claws
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 7 (**2d4 + 2**) slashing damage plus 7 (**2d6**) psychic damage, and if the target is a Medium or smaller creature, they are grappled (escape DC 12).

actions.name: Concealing Strike
actions.value: *Ranged Power Attack:* +5 to hit, range 30 ft., one creature. *Hit:* 13 (**3d6 + 3**) psychic damage, and the mindkiller is invisible to the target until the end of the mindkiller's next turn.

actions.name: Mindwipe
actions.value: A Humanoid grappled by the mindkiller must succeed on a DC 12 Strength saving throw or the mindkiller enters the Humanoid's body. While inside a Humanoid, the mindkiller has total cover against attacks and other effects originating outside the Humanoid, and the only action the mindkiller can take is to leave the body, exiting in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the body.

When a Humanoid ends their turn with the mindkiller inside of them, they must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or take 10 necrotic damage. If the Humanoid is reduced to 0 hit points, they die and the mindkiller takes over the body, which regains hit points equal to the Humanoid's hit point maximum. The mindkiller retains their Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma scores, their understanding of Deep Speech and Undercommon, and their telepathy. They otherwise adopt the target's statistics and can take the actions the creature could take. They know everything the creature knew, including spells, class features, traits, and languages. If the body is reduced to 0 hit points after the mindkiller takes control, the mindkiller must leave it.

A creature wielding a sharp tool or weapon within reach of a Humanoid host or body with a mindkiller inside can use an action to attempt to remove the mindkiller, making an attack roll against the Humanoid's AC if the host is unwilling. On a hit, the creature deals 11 (**2d10**) slashing damage to the host and must make a DC 15 Wisdom (*Medicine*) check. On a successful check, the creature cuts the mindkiller out of the host. On a faiIed check, if this slashing damage reduced the host to 0 hit points, the mindkiller kills the host; otherwise, there is no effect.

traits.name: Flammable
traits.value: If the elemental takes fire damage, it ignites. It takes 3 (**1d6**) fire damage at the start of each of its turns and its weapon attacks deal an additional 3 (**1d6**) fire damage. If the elemental is subject to heavy rain or takes 5 or more cold damage in a single instance, the flames are extinguished and the effects end.

traits.name: Oil Form
traits.value: When the elemental moves through water, it uses its swimming speed to skim along the water's surface; it can't submerge below the surface of water without a powerful detergent.

traits.name: Water Form
traits.value: The elemental can enter a hostile creature's space and stop there. It can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The elemental makes two Slam attacks.

actions.name: Slam
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +5 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. *Hit:* 6 (**1d6 + 3**) bludgeoning damage and the target's speed is reduced by 10 feet until it or another creature within reach of the target uses its action to clean the target. This speed reduction can stack; if the target's walking speed is reduced to 0 feet by this effect, it is restrained.

actions.name: Arcane Activation
actions.value: The elemental attempts to possess one Medium or smaller corporeal creature in close proximity to an arcane power source, such as a magitech firearm. The creature must succeed on a DC 13 Strength saving throw or be under the elemental's control until the elemental releases it as a bonus action, or the arcane power source is destroyed or is more than 5 feet from the possessed creature. While the elemental controls a creature in this way, the possessed creature gains the features in the Arcane Possession sidebar.

traits.name: Adhesive

actions.name: Pseudopod

traits.value: If the minotaur moves at least 20 feet straight toward a Large or smaller creature and then hits the creature with a Goring Horns attack on the same turn, that target must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or be dazed until the start of the minotaur's next turn.

traits.name: Minotaur Senses
traits.value: The minotaur always knows which way is north and can't become lost.

fluffInfo.value: *She doesn't look so tough, now surrender before you...uh oh*

A Mutagenist has researched a serum that they inject to transform into a monstrous form. They use themselves as the conduit for this power and hurl themselves towards their enemies as a hulking abomination. They spend their lives researching and discovering new ways to improve and modify the serum in hopes of becoming the perfect Apex form.

fluffInfo.name: Mutagenist Minions
fluffInfo.value: The Mutagenist is constantly experimenting on other creatures before turning their concoctions onto themselves. First their tests involve small rodents, birds, or other unassuming livestock. Skinwings are one such example of a Mutagenist's early experimentation. When they move on to humanoid subjects, they create abominations like the __Cerebrograft__, while their failed experiments end up as Uncontained Growths.

Every Mutagenist strives to accomplish the ultimate goal of the Apex Formula, the elixir that will transmogrify them into the perfect specimen of humanity, at least in their altered and maddened view.

entries: **Personality Trait:** I bury myself in books and research, and seldom talk to others.
**Bond:** My work is important, with my research I could cure so many of humanity's inherent weaknesses, and make us stronger as a species.
**Ideal:** Perfection is achievable if one just puts the time and effort into obtaining it.
**Flaw:** I know my view of the perfect human is flawless, I will not hear otherwise..

fluffInfo.name: Study the Foe
fluffInfo.value: Characters proficient in *Medicine* gain Advantage on Wisdom (*Insight*) or Intelligence (*Investigation*) checks to Study a Mutagenist, learning the following based on the result:

fluffInfo.name: (10+) Physiological Experts
fluffInfo.value: You recognize the Mutagenist's saving throws, as well as the Grotesque Gargantuan's Resistances and Immunities.

fluffInfo.name: (15+) Forced Mutation
fluffInfo.value: You learn of its Mutant Strain and Transmogrifying Elixir action.

fluffInfo.name: (20+) Hulking Form
fluffInfo.value: You know of the Transmogrified Form's Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma ability scores and saving throws.

fluffInfo.name: Combat Tactics
fluffInfo.value: The Mutagenist relies on their spellcasting and Forced Mutation, attempting to cause debilitating effects on its foes while altering their forms.

If the Mutagenist is in a losing situation, it drinks its Transmogrifying Elixir to become its Transmogrified Form. In this form, it hurls rocks at its targets, knocking them Prone. The hulking Mutagenist then bounds up to them and slams them with its Meaty Fists.

traits.name: Noxious Blood
traits.value: When a creature hits the mutagenist with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it, the creature takes 10 (**3d6**) Poison damage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The mutagenist makes two Scalpel attacks and uses Forced Mutation.

actions.name: Scalpel
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +7, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 6 (**1d6 + 3**) Slashing damage, and the target has the Bleeding condition (4d6).

actions.name: Forced Mutation
actions.value: *Constitution Saving Throw:* DC 15, one creature the mutagenist can see within 60 feet. *Failure:* 18 (**4d8**) Necrotic damage, and the target gains a randomly determined mutation. The mutation lasts for 1 minute, and afterwards, any lost body parts are restored. *Success* Half damage only.

actions.name: Transmogrifying Elixir (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
actions.value: The mutagenist injects itself with a transmogrifying elixir. The mutagenist transforms, using the Grotesque Gargantuan stat block for their altered form. The mutagenist reverts to its normal form after 1 hour or if its transmogrified form is reduced to 0 Hit Points.

bonusActions.name: Anatomical Precision
bonusActions.value: The mutagenist gains Advantage on Scalpel attacks until the start of its next turn, as long as it has not moved this turn. The mutagenist's Speed becomes 0 until the start of its next turn.

traits.name: Necrotic Absorption
traits.value: Whenever Mycete is subjected to necrotic damage, she takes no damage and instead regains a number of hit points equal to the necrotic damage dealt.

actions.name: Parasitic Spores
actions.value: *Melee or Ranged Spell Attack:* +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30 ft., one target. *Hit:* 7 (**2d6**) necrotic damage, and if the target is a creature, Mycete regains 3 (1d6) hit points.

actions.name: Fungal Growth
actions.value: Mycete causes fungi to proliferate from a point she can see within 60 feet of her. Solid surfaces in a 10-foot square centered on that point become difficult terrain, and a creature who enters that area for the first time on a turn or starts their turn there must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned for 1 minute (save ends at end of turn).

actions.name: Animate Husks (1/Day)
actions.value: Mycete animates three rotting zombies, who appear in unoccupied spaces Mycete can see within 30 feet of her. The zombies act immediately after Mycete on the same initiative count and follow her verbal orders. If Mycete dies, the zombies are destroyed.

bonusActions.name: Spore Eruption
bonusActions.value: Mycete destroys a rotting zombie under her control, and the zombie violently erupts with toxic spores.
Each enemy within 5 feet of the zombie must make a DC 13 Constitution saving throw, taking 9 (**2d8**) necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

They attack their foes using their spectral weapons, using the Mindmuddler option against spellcasters. If the target is still alive by the 2nd round, the Night Blade takes the Disengage action to escape.
The Night Blade flees if it is at a Disadvantage, is surrounded, or is in direct sunlight.

traits.value: The vampire regains 10 Hit Points at the start of its turn if it has at least 1 Hit Point and isn't in sunlight or running water. If the vampire takes Radiant damage or damage from holy water, this trait doesn't function at the start of the vampire's next turn.

traits.name: Spider Climb

traits.name: Vampire Weaknesses

actions.name: Claws
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +8, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 10 (**2d4 + 5**) Slashing damage, and if the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 16).

actions.name: Spectral Weapons
actions.value: *Melee or Ranged Attack Roll:* +8, reach 5 ft. or range 100/400 ft. *Hit:* 16 (**2d10 + 5**) Force damage, and the target suffers one of the following effects of the vampire's choice (the vampire can't select the same option more than once per turn):

entries: **Poison**: The target takes an extra 9 (**2d8**) Poison damage and has the Poisoned condition (save ends, *Constitution Saving Throw:* DC 16).
**Open Wounds**: The target has the Bleeding condition (3d6).
**Mindmuddler**: The target has the Bewildered condition (save ends, *Intelligence Saving Throw:* DC 16).

actions.name: Bite
actions.value: *Constitution Saving Throw:* DC 16, one creature within 5 feet that is willing or has the Grappled, Incapacitated, or Restrained condition. *Failure:* 15 (**3d6 + 5**) Necrotic damage, and the vampire regains Hit Points equal to the Necrotic damage dealt.

bonusActions.name: Meld Into Shadow
bonusActions.value: In Dim Light or Darkness, the vampire casts __Invisibility__ on itself, requiring no components and using Charisma as its spellcasting ability.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The hag makes two Dream Claw attacks.

actions.name: Dream Claw
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 9 (**1d10 + 4**) slashing damage plus 3 (**1d6**) psychic damage. If a target is hit by this attack more than once on a turn, they must make a DC 15 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the target falls unconscious for 1 minute (save ends at end of turn), until the target takes damage, or until another creature who can reach the target uses their action to wake them. Creatures who can't be supernaturally put to sleep automatically succeed on this saving throw.

actions.name: Vicious Visions (1/Day; 6th-Level Spell)
actions.value: The hag releases magic dream dust in a 60-foot cone. Each creature must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or be charmed for 1 minute or until they deal damage to another creature. While charmed, the creature sees all allies as enemies and all enemies as allies.

actions.name: Tiny Time
actions.value: The hag magically shrinks down to a height of 1 inch, becoming Tiny along with any items they wear or carry. While Tiny, the hag has advantage on Dexterity (*Stealth*) checks made to hide, and they can use a bonus action to enter the head of an unconscious Humanoid they can reach or to grow back to the hag's normal size. The hag's game statistics otherwise remain the same.

While the hag is inside a Humanoid's head, that Humanoid is considered haunted by the hag, and the hag has total cover against attacks and other effects outside the head. The hag can speak telepathically to the haunted Humanoid, but the Humanoid is unaware of the source of this telepathic speech. The haunted Humanoid can't gain any benefit from rest unless the hag allows it, and when the Humanoid attempts to sleep, the hag can fill the Humanoid's mind with nightmarish visions.

The hag is expelled from the head and grows back to their normal size if the haunted Humanoid is affected by a __dispel evil and good__ spell or similar supernatural effects, or if the hag chooses to exit the head as a bonus action.

bonusActions.name: Sleepwalk
bonusActions.value: The hag moves one unconscious creature they can see within 60 feet of them up to 30 feet horizontally.

traits.name: Central Nervous System
traits.value: The mimic's brain is the central nervous system of the tavern mimic. The first time the brain takes damage on a turn, it takes an additional 10 (**3d6**) psychic damage. As a reaction to taking this damage, the brain can relocate itself to any location within the tavern.

traits.name: Grappler
traits.value: The brain has advantage on attack rolls against any creature grappled by it.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.value: If the brain fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Sensitive Gut
traits.value: The brain's blindsight extends throughout its interior structure.

traits.name: Shapechanger
traits.value: The brain can use its action to polymorph into a different building or back into its true, tavern form. Its statistics are the same in each form. Any equipment or creatures it is wearing or carrying aren't transformed. It reverts to its true form if it dies.

traits.name: Warded
traits.value: The brain can't be harmed or affected by attacks or effects that originate from outside of it.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The brain makes two attacks, one with its Pseudopod and one with its Squirt.

actions.name: Pseudopod
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +11 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. *Hit:* 16 (**4d4 + 6**) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Squirt
actions.value: *Ranged Weapon Attack:* +12 to hit, range 20/60 ft., one target. *Hit:* 17 (**4d4 + 7**) acid damage.

fluffInfo.name: Study the Foe
fluffInfo.value: Characters proficient in *Nature* or *Survival* gain Advantage on Intelligence (*Arcana*) check to Study an Oak Troll, learning the following information based on the result:

fluffInfo.name: (5+) From Harsh Environments
fluffInfo.value: You know the troll's Bite and Gnarled Claw actions.

fluffInfo.name: (10+) Hard to Kill
fluffInfo.value: You learn of the troll's Regeneration trait.

fluffInfo.name: (15+) Special Weakness
fluffInfo.value: You have insight into the troll's Vulnerabilities.

fluffInfo.name: Combat Tactics
fluffInfo.value: With their thick shroud of leaves, Oak Trolls are well protected from their enemies. They always look for an opportunity to send their leaves bursting off to Blind their enemies.

fluffInfo.name: Animus:
fluffInfo.value: Giant.

fluffInfo.value: Monster Blood, Sap.

fluffInfo.value: Leaves.

fluffInfo.name: Hide:
fluffInfo.value: Bark.

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.value: The troll regains 10 Hit Points at the start of each of its turns. If the troll takes Fire damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of the troll's next turn. The troll dies only if it starts its turn with 0 Hit Points and doesn't regenerate.

traits.name: Forest Sense
traits.value: The troll can pinpoint the location of creatures and moving objects within 120 feet of it as long as both it and the anything it is detecting is in a natural forested area.

traits.name: Shroud of Leaves
traits.value: The troll is covered head to toe in a shroud of thick leaves. While it has this shroud it is immune to all damage except Fire damage. If the troll takes any Fire damage, the leaves all burn away revealing the gnarled oak wood body of the troll and it loses this trait.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The troll makes two Gnarled Claw attacks and one Bite attack

actions.name: Gnarled Claw
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +8, reach 10 ft. *Hit:* 12 (**2d6 + 5**) Slashing damage.

actions.name: Bite
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +8, reach 10 ft. *Hit:* 23 (**4d8 + 5**) Piercing damage and if the target is a creature, the target has the Bleeding condition (2d8) as thick splinters pierce and remain in the creature's flesh.

bonusActions.name: Abundant Growth
bonusActions.value: The troll regains its Shroud of Leaves trait.

bonusActions.name: Leaf Burst
bonusActions.value: As long as the troll has its Shroud of Leaves, it can shed its Shroud of Leaves in a burst, losing the trait in the process. *Dexterity Saving Throw:* DC 16, each creature within 15 feet of the troll. *Failure:* 7 (**2d6**) Slashing damage and has the Blinded condition until the end of their next turn.

traits.name: Reactive Mutations
traits.value: Immediately after the ooze takes damage, it gains resistance to that damage type. The ooze can have up to three resistances from this trait. If the ooze has its maximum number of resistances, the oldest resistance is lost when a new one is gained.

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.value: The ooze can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The ooze makes two Pseudopod attacks. It can replace one attack with Engulf.

actions.name: Engulf
actions.value: The ooze moves up to its speed. While doing so, it can enter Small or smaller creatures' spaces. Whenever the ooze enters a creature's space, the creature must make a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw.
On a successful save, the creature can choose to be pushed 5 feet back or to the side of the ooze. A creature that chooses not to be pushed suffers the consequences of a failed saving throw.

On a failed save, the ooze enters the creature's space, and the creature takes 9 (**2d8**) acid damage and is engulfed. The engulfed creature can't breathe, is restrained, and takes 18 (**4d8**) acid damage at the start of each of the ooze's turns. When the ooze moves, the engulfed creature moves with it.
An engulfed creature can try to escape by taking an action to make a DC 14 Strength check. On a success, the creature escapes and enters a space of its choice within 5 feet of the ooze.

actions.name: Pseudopod

1. The target takes 4 (**1d8**) force damage.
2. The target takes 4 (**1d8**) bludgeoning damage.
3. The target takes 4 (**1d8**) piercing damage.

5. The target takes 4 (**1d8**) cold damage.
6. The target takes 4 (**1d8**) fire damage.

fluffInfo.name: (5+) Resilient Sapling.
fluffInfo.value: You learn of the Octarine Tree's type, its Resistances, and Immunities.

fluffInfo.name: (10+) Flying Fruit.
fluffInfo.value: You are aware of the creature's Delerium Fruit action.

fluffInfo.name: (15+) Combustible Timber.
fluffInfo.value: You recognize the creature's vulnerability to fire.

fluffInfo.name: Combat Tactics
fluffInfo.value: The Octarine Tree grows in clusters within Queen's Park Garden, or in the forests north of Drakkenheim, but lone trees have been spotted in advantageous positions throughout the city. Whether in market squares or growing on cliff sides overlooking parts of the city, the trees seem to keep watch over large stretches of road. The Octarine Tree is surprisingly fast when it decides to move but usually opts to root itself in a good position and throw Delerium Fruit at its enemies.

When engaged in melee, an Octarine Tree tangles up creatures in its Crushing Roots and Thwacks them. It will take an opportunity to lumber to a better position and plant itself in the ground to continue hurling fruit if it can.

traits.name: Enraged
traits.value: While *Bloodied*, the octarine tree gains Advantage on all attack rolls.

traits.name: Plant Camouflage
traits.value: The octarine tree has Advantage on Dexterity (*Stealth*) checks made to Hide in forests.

traits.name: Siege Monster
traits.value: The octarine tree deals double damage to objects and structures.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The octarine tree makes three attacks.

actions.name: Thwack
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +10, reach 10 ft. *Hit:* 19 (**2d12 + 6**) Bludgeoning damage, and if the target is Large or smaller, it is pushed 10 feet and has the Prone condition.

actions.name: Crushing Roots
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +10, reach 20 ft. *Hit:* 25 (**3d12 + 6**) Bludgeoning damage, and if the target is Large or smaller, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 16). While Grappled, the target has the Restrained condition. The octarine tree can grapple up to four creatures at a time.

actions.name: Delerium Fruit
actions.value: *Ranged Attack Roll:* +10, range 60/120 ft. *Hit:* 15 (**2d8 + 6**) Necrotic damage. *Constitution Saving Throw:* DC 18. *Failure:* The target gains one Contamination level. Failure by 5 or More: The target triggers an [Arcane Anomalies](https://5e.tools/tables.html#arcane%20anomalies_monstersofdrakkenheim) centered on itself.

bonusActions.name: Take Root
bonusActions.value: If the octarine tree has not moved this round, it can plant itself into the ground. It regains 18 (4d8) Hit Points and has the Immobilized condition until the start of its next turn. While Immobilized, the octarine tree has Immunity to the Grappled, Prone, and Restrained conditions, and its AC increases to 20. These benefits end early if the tree takes Fire damage.

traits.name: Defiant Anger
traits.value: When the ogre has half their hit points or fewer, they are resistant to mundane bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The ogre makes one Spiked Club attack and one Fist attack.

actions.name: Spiked Club
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 8 (**2d4 + 3**) piercing damage.

actions.name: Fist
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 5 (**1d4 + 3**) bludgeoning damage. If the target is Medium or smaller, they are grappled (escape DC 13). Until this grapple ends, the ogre can't use this fist to attack other targets. The ogre has two fists, one of which holds their club.

actions.name: People-Bowling
actions.value: The ogre throws one Medium or smaller creature they are grappling up to 30 feet horizontally. Each creature in the thrown creature's path must succeed on a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw or take 3 (**1d6**) bludgeoning damage and be knocked prone. After this throw, the thrown creature takes 7 (**2d6**) bludgeoning damage and falls prone.

bonusActions.name: Bellow (1/Day)
bonusActions.value: The ogre yells in the face of one creature within 10 feet of them. The target must succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened of the ogre until the end of the ogre's next turn. A creature who succeeds on their saving throw is immune to all ogres' Bellow for 24 hours.

actions.name: 3rd Level: Angry Denial (3/Day)
actions.value: When the basher takes damage from a creature the basher can see within 5 feet of them, the basher can use their reaction to instead take no damage and make a signature attack against the creature.

actions.name: 5th Level: Throw Away (3/Day)

If the creature lands within 5 feet of an enemy, the creature can use a reaction to make a melee attack against that enemy.

actions.name: 7th Level: Wide Sweep (3/Day)
actions.value: As an action, the basher sweeps their spiked club in an enormous circle, making a signature attack against each enemy within 10 feet of them. This attack has a +PB bonus to its attack and damage rolls, and if it hits a Large or smaller creature, the basher can push the target up to 10 feet away from them.

traits.name: Minion
traits.value: If the goon takes damage from an attack or as the result of a failed saving throw, their hit points are reduced to 0. If the goon takes damage from another effect, they die if the damage equals or exceeds their hit point maximum; otherwise they take no damage.

actions.name: Fist (Group Attack)
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 2 bludgeoning damage, and if this attack was made by more than one goon, the target must succeed on a Strength saving throw or be knocked prone and moved up to 10 feet horizontally. The DC for this saving throw equals 10 plus the number of goons who joined the attack.

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.value: The olothec can breathe air and water.

traits.name: Immutable Form
traits.value: The olothec is immune to any power, spell, or effect that would alter their form.

traits.name: Supernatural Resistance
traits.value: The olothec has advantage on saving throws against supernatural effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The olothec makes six Devolving Tentacle attacks and uses Piscine Transformation.

actions.name: Devolving Tentacle
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +9 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. *Hit:* 12 (**2d6 + 5**) piercing damage. The first time a creature is hit with this attack on a turn, they must succeed on a DC 17 Constitution saving throw or be injected with a degenerative psionic slime (save ends at end of turn). While slimed, each time the creature makes an attack roll or an ability check, they must roll a d4 and subtract the number rolled from the d20 roll. At the end of a slimed creature's turn, the size of the subtracted die increases by one: the d4 becomes a d6, the d6 becomes a d8, and so on, to a maximum of d12. The cure ailment power or __lesser restoration__ spell also ends this effect.

actions.name: Piscine Transformation (3rd-Order Power)
actions.value: The olothec targets a Humanoid they can see within 60 feet of them with a pulse of transformational energy. The target must succeed on a DC 17 Wisdom saving throw or undergo one of the following transformations of the olothec's choice:

entries: **Head.** The target's head transforms into the head of a fish, proportionately sized for their body. They can't speak.
**Legs.** The target's legs become fins. Their walking speed is reduced to 10 feet (unless their walking speed is slower), and they gain a swimming speed of 30 feet.

**Torso.** The target's torso becomes the body of a fish with gills. They can only breathe water and can hold their breath for 1 hour. If the target isn't underwater when this transformation takes effect, they begin suffocating.

actions.value: This transformation lasts until the target is affected by a cure ailment power of 4th order or higher or a __greater restoration__ spell. A target who suffers all three transformations at once is permanently transformed into a hybrid fishlike creature and can only be returned to their original form by a __wish__ spell or similar magic.

bonusActions.name: Jaunt (3rd-Order Power)
bonusActions.value: The olothec teleports 30 feet to an unoccupied space they can see.

traits.value: When the oracle starts their turn outdoors while not incapacitated, they can stoke a thunderstorm (no action required). For 1 minute or until the oracle uses Turbulent Escalation again, the weather in a 1-mile radius centered on the oracle changes as follows:

entries: If the sky is cloudless, it becomes cloudy.
If the sky is cloudy, it begins to rain or snow (oracle's choice).
If it's raining or snowing, the weather becomes stormy.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The oracle uses Tempest Bolt twice. They can replace one use with a Cyclone Staff attack.

The target must make a DC 18 Dexterity saving throw, taking 31 (**7d8**) lightning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. If the target is outdoors and the weather is stormy, they have disadvantage on the saving throw.

entries: **Lightning Within.** The Elemental becomes charged with lightning. The next time the Elemental hits a target with an attack within the next minute, the attack deals an extra 33 (**6d10**) lightning damage.

fluffInfo.name: Combat Tactics
fluffInfo.value: These revered figures are seldom encountered alone. Instead, they are often in the company of several Swarms of Ratlings and perhaps even borne aloft on a litter by a squadron of Giant Ratlings. They may even have several Warlocks of the Rat God serving them as underlings. These minions are disposable to the oracle, who commands their underlings to throw themselves against their foes with wild abandon.

In battle, a ratling oracle fights from the back, calling out proclamations of doom on their foes using Death Toll and Squeak of Doom. They mock their foes' attempts at any success, attempting to use Tail Barbs to turn an opponent's luck against them.

traits.name: Adjustable Appendages
traits.value: The otyugh has seven adjustable appendages, which they can convert into other appendages using their Transform bonus action. In their natural state, the otyugh has one eyestalk, three legs, and three tentacles. These appendages grant the following benefits:

entries: **Eyestalks.** The otyugh's first eyestalk gives them darkvision out to a range of 60 feet and immunity to the dazed condition, and each additional eyestalk increases their darkvision's range by 60 feet. If the otyugh has no eyestalks, they are blinded and lose immunity to the flanked condition.
**Legs.** Each leg gives the otyugh a cumulative walking speed of 15 feet.
**Tentacles.** The otyugh's number of tentacles determine how many attacks they can make with Multiattack and how many creatures they can grapple with Tentacle Slam.

traits.name: Limited Telepathy

traits.name: Trash Traversal
traits.value: The otyugh ignores difficult terrain. They also have advantage on Dexterity (*Stealth*) checks made to hide in piles of refuse.

traits.name: Vile Stench
traits.value: A creature who starts their turn within 10 feet of the otyugh must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned until the start of the creature's next turn.

actions.name: Multiattack

actions.name: Tentacle Slam

If the target is Medium or smaller, they are grappled (escape DC 13) and restrained until the grapple ends. The otyugh can grapple one target for each tentacle they currently have.

bonusActions.name: Transform

actions.name: Eye Psionics
actions.value: The overmind creates three of the following psionic eye effects. Unless otherwise stated, each eye targets a creature who the overmind can see within 120 feet of them. They can't use the same effect twice in a turn.

entries: **1. Charm Beam**: The targeted creature must succeed on a DC 16 Wisdom saving throw or be charmed by the overmind for 1 hour, or until the overmind harms the creature or one of their allies.

**2. Compulsion Beam**: The targeted creature must succeed on a DC 16 Intelligence saving throw or use their reaction, if available, to move up to their speed toward the closest ally they can see and make a weapon attack against them. Creatures who can't be charmed are unaffected.

**3. Toxic Vapors**: The overmind chooses a point they can see within 120 feet of them. Each creature within 10 feet of the point must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned for 1 minute (save ends at end of turn).

**4. Telekinetic Beam**: The targeted creature must succeed on a DC 16 Strength saving throw or be moved up to 30 feet in any direction and take 7 (**2d6**) force damage at the end of the move. Alternatively, the overmind can target an object they can see within 120 feet of them that weighs 300 pounds or less and isn't being worn or carried, moving it up to 30 feet in any direction. The overmind can also exert fine control on objects with this effect, such as manipulating a simple tool or opening a door or a container.

**5. Lightning Bolt**: The overmind shoots a 5-foot-wide, 60-foot-long line of lightning. Each creature in the line must succeed on a DC 16 Dexterity saving throw, taking 21 (**6d6**) lightning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

**6. Fire Beam**: The targeted creature must make a DC 16 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, the target takes 36 (**8d8**) fire damage and catches fire, taking 9 (**2d8**) fire damage at the start of each of their turns for 1 minute (save ends at end of turn). Any creature can use their action to douse the fire, ending the effect early.
