actions.value: The owlbear leaps up to half their speed without provoking opportunity attacks. When they land, each creature within 5 feet of them must succeed on a DC 10 plus PB Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

actions.name: 5th Level: Bear Hug (8 Ferocity)
actions.value: The owlbear attempts to grab and crush a creature they can see within 5 feet of them. The target must make a DC 10 plus PB Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, the target takes **PBd10** bludgeoning damage and is grappled (escape DC 10 plus PB). On a successful save, the target takes half as much damage and is not grappled. Until this grapple ends, the target is also restrained. The grapple ends if the owlbear uses Bear Hug on another target or makes a signature attack against another target.

bonusActions.name: Give a Hoot (Recharges after a Long Rest)
bonusActions.value: The owlbear lets loose a unique battle hoot. If the owlbear's caregiver can hear the owlbear, the caregiver gains 5 × PB temporary hit points.

fluffInfo.name: Study the Foe
fluffInfo.value: Characters proficient in *Arcana* or *Religion* gain Advantage on Intelligence (*Arcana*) checks to Study the Pale Man, learning the following based on their result:

fluffInfo.name: (10+) Unnatural Resilience.
fluffInfo.value: You learn the Pale Man's monster type, Resistances, and Immunities.

fluffInfo.name: (15+) Fear Incarnate.
fluffInfo.value: You are aware of the Pale Man's Terror Gaze action.

fluffInfo.name: (20+) Predator's Precision.
fluffInfo.value: You know the Pale Man's strongest and weakest ability scores and saving throws.

fluffInfo.name: Combat Tactics
fluffInfo.value: The Pale Man is a consummate ambush predator. He prefers to stalk prey from concealment, sowing paranoia before striking. He uses his Terror Gaze to incapacitate or scatter groups, then isolates and eliminates targets one by one.

If pressed into open combat, he uses his unnatural agility to slip away, often retreating into darkness or vanishing from sight entirely, only to resume his hunt moments later. He never fights to the death unless cornered, and even then, he uses every trick at his disposal to escape.

fluffInfo.name: Animus:
fluffInfo.value: Monstrosity or Undead (uncertain).

fluffInfo.name: Fluid:
fluffInfo.value: Contaminated Ichor.

fluffInfo.name: Organs:
fluffInfo.value: Eyes, Heart.

fluffInfo.name: Natural Weapons:
fluffInfo.value: Claws.

fluffInfo.name: Hide:
fluffInfo.value: Skin.

entries: **Immunities**: necrotic, poison; charmed, frightened, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, restrained

traits.name: Aura of Fleshy Insects
traits.value: *Constitution Saving Throw:* DC 18, each creature of the Pale Man's choosing who starts its turn within 60 feet of the Pale Man. *Failure:* 22 (**5d8**) Necrotic damage and the target gains one level of Contamination.

traits.name: Crawling Flesh
traits.value: When the Pale Man is reduced to 0 Hit Points, he breaks apart into a __Swarm of Contaminated Insects__ in the same space. Unless the swarm is destroyed, the Pale Man's swarm returns to its cocoon and reforms into the Pale Man 1d6 days later.

traits.name: Insect Body
traits.value: The Pale Man can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and the Pale Man can move through any opening large enough for a Tiny insect.

actions.name: The Pale Man always takes his turn on Initiative count 20
actions.value: On his turn, the Pale Man can use his movement and interaction as normal. However, he does not take an action or Bonus Action on his turn unless forced to do so by a spell or other effect. Instead, the Pale Man takes one of the following Epic Actions at the end of each player character's turn.

actions.name: Contaminating Touch
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +10, reach 10 ft. *Hit:* 10 (**3d6**) Necrotic damage, it is subjected to the following effect. *Constitution Saving Throw:* DC 18. *Failure:* The target gains one level of Contamination.

actions.name: Forced Mutation
actions.value: The Pale Man targets a creature within 60 feet who has one or more mutations and magically alters the mutation. The Pale Man chooses one of the target's existing mutations to remove and replaces it with a different one of his choice.

actions.name: Infest the Flesh (1/Round)
actions.value: *Dexterity Saving Throw:* DC 16, each creature in a 30-foot Emanation from the Pale Man. *Failure:* 22 (**5d8**) Necrotic damage, and the target gains the Burning (3d8 Necrotic) condition. A target also has the Dazed condition while it is burning in this way. Failure by 5 or more: The target also has the Restrained condition (save ends) due to masses of swarming fleshy bugs. *Success* Half damage.

actions.name: Contaminate (1/Round)
actions.value: *Constitution Saving Throw:* DC 16, each creature Restrained by the Pale Man's Infest the Flesh action. *Failure:* The target gains one level of Contamination.

actions.name: Abrupt Contaminant (1/Round)
actions.value: The Pale Man targets a creature within 60 feet who has one or more levels of Contamination. That creature takes 7 (**2d6**) Necrotic damage for each level of Contamination it has.

actions.name: Epic Resistance
actions.value: The Pale Man chooses one condition, spell, or other effect currently affecting him and rolls 1d20. On an 11 or higher, the effect ends on him. The Pale Man can use this Epic Action even if it would otherwise be unable to take actions, its actions are being controlled by another creature, or if a spell or effect alters its game statistics.

traits.name: Amorphous
traits.value: The ooze can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

traits.name: False Appearance
traits.value: While the ooze remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from an oily pool or wet rock.

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.value: The ooze can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

actions.name: Pseudopod
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* your spell attack modifier to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* **1d6 + PB** bludgeoning damage

fluffInfo.value: *Pro tip, go for the eyes before it goes for your blood.*

The study of diseases opens doorways to many dangerous scientific discoveries. As experts in both ridding the body of illness and the mutations of infectious disease, a Pathogenist brings their study to the battlefield by using monsters and enemies as test subjects for their infections. Long years spent carefully monitoring the causes and effects of such plagues has led to a mastery of disease mutation. A Pathogenist's creations can spread in a terrifying manner, riddling their foes with debilitating symptoms, crippling their bodies and rattling their minds.

fluffInfo.name: Pathogenist Minions
fluffInfo.value: An __Injector__ makes a great lab assistant for the Pathogenist, helping it administer disease and pathogens to its victims. __Wretched Patients__ are often disease-ridden, bandaged individuals who are convinced that, if they aid the doctor, they will be cured. __Plague Carriers__ are a common unfortunate product of a Pathogenist's experiments, used to deliver disease to its enemies in grotesque fashion.

entries: **Personality Trait:** I love my pathogens and viruses, and speak to my babies as if they were my children.
**Bond:** Understanding the fine balance between what it takes to harm or heal is vital to the ongoing progression of modern medicine.
**Ideal:** Disease is often feared and misunderstood, but with understanding, comes control. You do not need to fear that which you control
**Flaw:** I am bound to my work and cannot fathom the idea that I am misguided in my research..

fluffInfo.name: Study the Foe
fluffInfo.value: Characters proficient in *Medicine* or *Survival* gain Advantage on Wisdom (*Insight*) or Intelligence (*Investigation*) checks to study a Pathogenist, learning the following based on the result:

fluffInfo.name: (10+) Poison Master
fluffInfo.value: You learn of the Pathogenist's Resistances and Immunities as well as its Heightened
Tolerance trait.

fluffInfo.name: (15+) Disease Experimenter
fluffInfo.value: You are aware of its Pestilent Infection and Outbreak actions.

fluffInfo.name: (20+) Lacks Character
fluffInfo.value: You know the Pathogenist's Strength and Charisma ability modifiers and saving throws.

fluffInfo.name: Combat Tactics
fluffInfo.value: The Pathogenist uses poison and disease to disable their foes. When combat begins, they attempt to inflict Plague of Wind upon a target, and proceed to use Outbreak to spread that disease. The Pathogenist uses Poison Needle to subdue problematic targets. The Pathogenist will attempt to flee if they have fewer than 40 Hit Points and are outnumbered.

traits.name: Laboratory Adaptation
traits.value: The pathogenist is immune to disease.

traits.name: Mutated Strains
traits.value: The pathogenist's attacks and effects ignore the target's __Resistance__ or Immunity to Poison damage and Immunity to the Poisoned condition and disease.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The pathogenist makes two Poison Needle attacks.

actions.name: Poison Needle
actions.value: *Melee or Ranged Attack Roll:* +8, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft. *Hit:* 5 (**1d4 + 3**) Piercing damage plus 35 (**10d6**) Poison damage. If this damage reduces the target to 0 Hit Points, it is stabilized and has the Poisoned condition for 1 hour, even if it regains Hit Points. While Poisoned, the target has the Paralyzed condition.

actions.name: Pestilent Infection (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: The pathogenist infects one creature it can see within 30 feet with a magical disease. At the start of each of its turns, the target is subjected to the following effect. *Constitution Saving Throw:* DC 16. *Failure:* 18 (**4d8**) Necrotic damage, and the target gaines one Exhaustion level. Third Success: The disease ends.

actions.name: Plague Wind (1/Day)
actions.value: *Constitution Saving Throw:* DC 16, each creature in a 60-foot Cone. *Failure:* 22 (**5d8**) Poison damage plus 23 (**5d8**) Necrotic damage. *Success* Half damage. *Failure or Success*: If the target has 25 Hit Points or fewer after taking this damage, it dies and its flesh turns to ash, leaving a weathered skeleton.

bonusActions.name: Heightened Tolerance
bonusActions.value: The pathogenist ends the Charmed or Frightened condition on itself.

traits.name: Cone of Encouragement
traits.value: The peeper's central eye emits a beatific gaze, creating an area of encouragement in a 30-foot cone. At the end of each of its turns, the peeper decides which way the cone faces. See Reactions for more details.

traits.name: Scaredy
traits.value: The peeper has disadvantage on ability checks and saving throws against the frightened condition, and automatically fails these saving throws if it can see the source of its fear and the source is two or more size categories larger than it.

actions.name: Bite
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 4 (**1d4 + 2**) piercing damage.

fluffInfo.name: Study the Foe
fluffInfo.value: Characters proficient in *Insight* and *Investigation* gain Advantage on Intelligence (*Arcana*) checks when they examine a Phage, revealing the following based on their result:

fluffInfo.name: (5+) Interdimensional Intruder
fluffInfo.value: You are aware of its Warped Space trait.

fluffInfo.name: (10+) Magic Eater
fluffInfo.value: You understand its Consume Spell Reaction and Bite attack.

fluffInfo.name: (15+) Stored Energy
fluffInfo.value: You learn of the Phage's Spell Vessel trait.

fluffInfo.name: Combat Tactics
fluffInfo.value: Phages are compelled by their hunger for magic. They use their Consume Spell Reaction at the first opportunity, regardless of the spell being cast.

Unfed phages stalk their prey, harassing them with Bites but attacking nonlethally as a dead spellcaster cannot provide them with magical energy. Sated phages often become docile, only using Bite or Spit in defense, disengaging to escape if given the opportunity. When their lives are threatened, Phages digest stored spells to reposition in hopes of getting an even tastier morsel.

traits.name: Spell Vessel
traits.value: After using its Consume Spell Reaction, the phage stores the spell until the spell is digested or the phage dies. When the phage dies, the spell takes effect. If the original caster of the spell sees the phage die, it can choose the area or target(s) of the spell as if they had cast it from the phage's space. Otherwise, the spell affects a random area or target(s) from those within range.

traits.name: Warped Space
traits.value: The phage magically warps space in a 10-foot Emanation. Attacks targeting the phage from outside the Emanation have Disadvantage, and the phage has Advantage on saving throws against spells and effects that originate from outside the Emanation.

actions.name: Bite
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +5, reach 10 ft. *Hit:* 10 (**2d6 + 3**) Piercing damage. If the phage isn't storing a spell, it makes this attack with Advantage and deals an extra 14 (**4d6**) Piercing damage on a hit.

actions.name: Spit
actions.value: *Ranged Attack Roll:* +4, range 60/120 ft. *Hit:* 14 (**3d6 + 3**) Acid damage.

actions.name: Digest Spell
actions.value: The phage digests the spell it has stored, teleporting to an unoccupied space it can see within 30 feet and making a Spit attack with Advantage.

traits.name: Displacement
traits.value: The phantasm projects a magical illusion that makes it appear to be standing near its actual location, causing attack rolls against it to have disadvantage. Creatures with truesight ignore this trait. If it is hit by an attack, this trait is disrupted until the end of its next turn. This trait is also disrupted while the phantasm is incapacitated or has a speed of 0 feet.

traits.name: Incorporeal Movement
traits.value: The phantasm can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. It takes 5 (**1d10**) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

actions.name: Horrifying Visage (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: Each creature within 60 feet of the phantasm that can see it must succeed on a DC 16 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened for 1 minute. If the save fails by 5 or more, the target also ages 1d4 × 10 years. A frightened target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. If a target's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the target is immune to this phantasm's Horrifying Visage for the next 24 hours. The aging effect can be reversed with a greater restoration spell, but only within 24 hours of it occurring.

traits.name: Minion

traits.name: Soul Feast

On a failed save, the pitling consumes the creature's soul, and the pitling becomes a Category 2 demon of the GM's choice with 1 soul. A creature whose soul is consumed in this way immediately dies, and they can't be restored to life by any means short of a __wish__ spell. If the creature was reduced to 0 hit points by a group attack, the GM picks one pitling who joined the attack to consume the soul.

traits.name: Plague Symptoms
traits.value: The plague carrier is host to a disease created by a pathogenist, chosen from the options below. A creature infected by this disease is subjected to the chosen effect at the start of each of its turns. *Constitution Saving Throw:* DC 13. *Failure:* 18 (**4d8**) Necrotic damage, and the target suffers the disease's effect. Third Success: The disease ends.

traits.name: Coughing Fits
traits.value: The target is unable to speak until the start of its next turn.

traits.name: Fatigue
traits.value: The target's Speed is reduced by 5 feet until the start of its next turn.

traits.name: Shivers
traits.value: The target shakes uncontrollably. Each time it fails its saving throw, it drops whatever it is holding.

actions.name: Festering Bite
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +2, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 4 (**1d8**) Piercing damage. *Constitution Saving Throw:* DC 13. *Failure:* The target is infected with the plague carrier's Plague Symptoms.

actions.name: Bile Spreader
actions.value: *Constitution Saving Throw:* DC 13, each creature in a 15-foot Cone. *Failure:* 9 (**2d8**) Necrotic damage, and the target is infected with the plague carrier's Plague Symptoms. *Success* Half damage only.

traits.name: Cloud of Blight
traits.value: A miasma surrounds the Plague Carrion in a 20-foot Emanation. Each time another creature starts its turn or enters the area, it gains a -1 penalty to damage rolls. Multiple instances of this penalty stack, but a creature can't gain it more than once each round. The penalty is removed when the creature finishes a Quick, Short, or Long Rest.

traits.name: Death Burst
traits.value: When the Plague Carrion dies, it explodes in a cloud of sickening gas. *Constitution Saving Throw:* DC 17, each creature in a 10-foot Emanation centered on the Plague Carrion. *Failure:* 27 (**6d8**) Poison damage, and the creature's Hit Point maximum is reduced by an amount equal to half the Poison damage taken (rounding down). *Success* Half damage only.
The Hit Point maximum reduction lasts until the creature finishes a Short or Long Rest.

actions.name: Multiattack

actions.name: Plague Touch

actions.name: Plague Beam
actions.value: *Ranged Attack Roll:* +8 to hit, range 60 ft., one target. *Hit:* 16 (**3d8 + 3**) Poison damage, and the target has the Poisoned condition until the end of the Plague Carrion's next turn.

traits.name: Sylvan Regeneration
traits.value: The spirit regains 1 Hit Point at the start of its turn if it has at least 1 Hit Point and is in direct sunlight.

actions.name: Petal Burst (Blooming Only)

traits.name: Arcane Power Source
traits.value: An arcane power source—a crystal on the mining suit's rear—can be targeted separately from the mining suit (AC 19, 64 hit points, vulnerability to thunder damage, and immunity to all damage except bludgeoning, force, piercing, and slashing). If the mining suit fails a saving throw against an area of effect, the crystal also fails the saving throw. If the power source is destroyed, the tar elemental possessing the mining suit moves into the nearest unoccupied space without provoking opportunity attacks and the mining suit becomes an inanimate object.

traits.name: Flammable
traits.value: If the mining suit takes fire damage, it ignites. It takes 10 (**3d6**) fire damage at the start of each of its turns and its melee attacks deal an additional 10 (**3d6**) fire damage. If the mining suit is subject to heavy rain or takes 10 or more cold damage in a single instance, the flames are extinguished and the effects end.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The mining suit makes three attacks: one with its Claw, one with its Demolition Drill, and one with its Pseudopod.

actions.name: Claw
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. *Hit:* 18 (**3d8 + 5**) slashing damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it is grappled (escape DC 16). Until this grapple ends, the mining suit has advantage on attack rolls using its Claw against the target and the mining suit can't use its Claw on another target.

actions.name: Demolition Drill
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +8 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. *Hit:* 15 (**3d6 + 5**) piercing damage.

actions.name: Pseudopod
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. *Hit:* 14 (**2d8 + 5**) bludgeoning damage plus 10 (**3d6**) necrotic damage.

actions.name: Multiattack

actions.name: Acid Flask (Decosopher)
actions.value: *Melee or Ranged Attack Roll:* +9 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 60 ft., *Hit:* 12 (**2d6 + 5**) Acid damage and 7 (**2d6**) Acid damage at the end of the target's next turn.

actions.name: Incendiary Bomb (Blastwright)

actions.name: Neurotoxic Cloud (Biothurge)
actions.value: Targets in a 20-ft. Cone take 10 (**3d6**) Necrotic damage and have the Poisoned condition for 1 minute. If the target succeeds on a DC 17 Constitution saving throw, it takes half damage and is not Poisoned.

bonusActions.name: Impromptu Golem (Biothurge, 1/Day)
bonusActions.value: The biothurge turns a twisted mass spare bodies parts into a **__Zombie__**. The zombie lasts until the end of the biothurge's next turn or until it is destroyed. The biothurge can use a Bonus Action to extend the duration for 1 round.

bonusActions.name: Latent Decoction (Decosopher, 1/Day)
bonusActions.value: The decosopher activates a potion stored in its blood stream. The decosopher is affected by its choice of: *Haste, Healing (Superior), Speed, or Water Breathing*.

bonusActions.name: Magitek Interference (Blastwright, 1/Day)
bonusActions.value: The blastwright enjoins a magical item or golem to cease functioning until the beginning of the blastwright's next turn. If the item is held or is a creature, a successful DC 17 Intelligence saving throw resists the interference.

traits.name: Vigilant

traits.name: Elf Glamour (1/Day)
traits.value: When a creature targets Ellan with an attack, power, or spell, the creature must succeed on a DC 18 Wisdom saving throw or be charmed by him until the end of his next turn (no action required).

traits.name: Resolute Aura
traits.value: While he is conscious, Ellan and any allies within 20 feet of him who can see him can't be charmed or frightened.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: Ellan makes two Bladed Scepter attacks.

actions.name: Bladed Scepter
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 11 (**1d8 + 7**) bludgeoning damage plus 10 (**3d6**) poison damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 18 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned for 1 minute (save ends at end of turn).

actions.name: Command (2nd-Level Spell)
actions.value: Ellan speaks a one-word command to up to two creatures he can see within 60 feet of him.

Each target must succeed on a DC 18 Wisdom saving throw or follow the command on their next turn. The spell has no effect if the target is Undead, doesn't understand Common or Elvish, or would be directly harmed by following the command. If the target can't follow Ellan's command, the spell ends. Some typical commands and their effects follow:

entries: **Approach**: The target moves toward Ellan by the shortest and most direct route, ending their turn if they move within 5 feet of Ellan.
**Drop**: The target drops whatever they are holding and then ends their turn.
**Flee**: The target spends their turn moving away from Ellan by the fastest available means.
**Grovel**: The target falls prone and then ends their turn.
**Halt**: The target doesn't move and takes no actions.

actions.name: Unholy Flame (3rd-Level Spell)
actions.value: Ellan conjures unholy fire around one creature he can see within 60 feet of him. The target must make a DC 18 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, the target takes 27 (**6d8**) fire damage and is enveloped (save ends at end of turn). While enveloped, a creature takes 7 (**2d6**) fire damage at the start of each of their turns. On a successful save, the target takes half as much damage and isn't enveloped.

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.value: The principle regains 20 hit points at the start of their turn if they aren't incapacitated. If they take fire damage, they only regain 10 hit points at the start of their next turn.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The principle makes two Hampering Roots attacks or two Vernal Lash attacks.

actions.name: Hampering Roots
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. *Hit:* 23 (**4d8 + 5**) bludgeoning damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 15). While grappled in this way, the target is restrained.

actions.name: Vernal Lash
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +10 to hit, reach 60 ft., one target. *Hit:* 27 (**4d10 + 5**) slashing damage, and the principle moves the target up to 15 feet horizontally.

actions.name: Burst from the Earth (1/Day)
actions.value: The principle causes three Large trees with whipping branches to sprout from the ground in unoccupied spaces the principle can see within 60 feet of them. Each tree has AC 15, 40 hit points, and immunity to psychic damage.

An enemy who starts their turn within 15 feet of one of these trees must make a DC 18 Dexterity saving throw, taking 14 (**4d6**) slashing damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

bonusActions.name: Convocation of Verdure (2/Day)
bonusActions.value: The principle imbues the power of verdancy in themself or another Elemental they can see within 30 feet of them, granting one of the following effects of that Elemental's choice:

entries: **Roots of the Mind.** For 1 minute, the Elemental can link with each Large or larger plant object they can see within 90 feet of them (no action required). For the duration, the Elemental can perceive, make attacks, and use actions as if they were in the space of a linked plant.

**Thunder Burst.** Thorny vines burst from the Elemental. Each enemy the Elemental can see within 30 feet of them must make a DC 16 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a target takes 27 (**6d8**) piercing damage and is restrained until the end of their next turn. On a successful save, they take half as much damage and aren't restrained.

fluffInfo.name: Study the Foe
fluffInfo.value: Characters proficient in *Survival* or *Nature* gain Advantage on Intelligence (*Arcana*) check to Study a Protean Abomination, learning the following based on their result:

fluffInfo.name: (10+) Corpse Eater
fluffInfo.value: You know of its Absorption trait.

fluffInfo.name: (15+) Enveloping Mass
fluffInfo.value: You uncover the Protean Abomination's Engulf feature.

fluffInfo.name: (20+) Weak Minded
fluffInfo.value: You recognize the abomination's highest and lowest ability scores and saving throws.

fluffInfo.name: Combat Tactics
fluffInfo.value: The Protean Abomination is a hungry creature that hides in dark ruins, old basements, or in piles of rubble, squeezing out to devour anything that comes by. No longer capable of strategic or nuanced thought, the Protean Abomination simply wishes to feed, grow, and survive. It is very territorial and once it has chosen a place to nest, it will stay there for months or years, only moving if it has gone weeks without absorbing a creature.
When prey does wander by, Protean Abominations will attempt to move up to the creature and Engulf it. It wants only to absorb the creature into its mass and grow stronger.
If brought below half Hit Points, the abomination might try to squeeze into a location where it cannot be followed to escape, waiting patiently for less problematic prey.

traits.name: Absorption
traits.value: When the abomination kills a creature that is neither a construct nor undead, it absorbs the corpse into its body and regains 20 Hit Points.

traits.name: Amorphous
traits.value: The abomination can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without expending extra movement to do so.

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.value: The abomination can climb difficult surfaces, including along ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The abomination makes two Slam attacks. If both attacks hit a Large or smaller creature, the target has the Grappled condition (escape DC 16) and the abomination uses Engulf on the Grappled creature.

actions.name: Slam
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +8, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 18 (**3d8 + 5**) Bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Engulf
actions.value: The abomination engulfs a Large or smaller creature Grappled by it. Until the grapple ends the target has the Blinded and Restrained conditions, is suffocating, and has Total Cover against attacks and other effects outside the abomination. If the abomination moves, the engulfed target moves with it. The abomination can have only one creature engulfed at a time. *Constitution Saving Throw:* DC 15. *Failure:* 18 (**3d8 + 5**) Bludgeoning damage. The engulfed creature repeats the save at the start of each of the abomination's turns Success: The target escapes and enters the nearest unoccupied space.

fluffInfo.name: Study the Foe
fluffInfo.value: Characters proficient in *Insight* or *Investigation* gain Advantage on Intelligence (*Arcana*) checks to study a Psychophant, revealing the following based on their result:

fluffInfo.name: (5+) Feeding on Despair
fluffInfo.value: You are aware of its Life Siphon ability.

fluffInfo.name: (10+) Resistant Form
fluffInfo.value: You know its Resistances and Immunities.

fluffInfo.name: (15+) Escape with Prey
fluffInfo.value: You learn of the creature's Teleport Bonus Action.

fluffInfo.name: Combat Tactics
fluffInfo.value: A Psychophant feeds on the weak and will avoid a fight with competent adventurers unless the right opportunity presents itself, or its true nature is discovered. In combat it will attempt to subdue aggressors with its Final Scream, then target the bloodiest opponent with its Psychic Grasp. Victim in hand, it will attempt to flee using Teleportation, repeatedly feeding on the target with its Life Siphon until the creature falls unconscious.

actions.name: Final Scream (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: *Wisdom Saving Throw:* DC 14, each creature in a 30-foot Cone. *Failure:* 40 (**9d8**) Psychic damage, and the target has the Frightened condition (save ends). *Success* Half damage, and the target is immune to this psychophant's Final Scream for 24 hours.

actions.name: Shape-Shift
actions.value: The psychophant shape-shifts into a Small or Medium Humanoid it has seen or reverts to its true form. Its game statistics are the same in each form.

bonusActions.name: Life Siphon
bonusActions.value: The psychophant deals 7 (**2d6**) Necrotic damage to a creature it damaged this turn with Psychic Grasp, then regains Hit Points equal to the Necrotic damage dealt.

bonusActions.name: Teleport
bonusActions.value: The psychophant teleports to an unoccupied space it can see within 30 feet. It can bring one creature Immobilized by its Psychic Grasp, which teleports to an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the psychophant's destination space.

fluffInfo.value: The first pudding gremlin was the result of a misguided mage attempting to bring drama to their dinner table. The gremlin leapt from the plate and was soon causing havoc in the kitchen, where it created a small army of currant-filled compatriots. This ability to transform regular puddings into duplicates has resulted in pudding gremlins being a widespread pest during the festive season.

The pudding gremlin's sharp green horns and claws pose an immediate threat to those trying to quash these creatures. However, it is the tiny brandy scented inferno that resides within each pudding gremlin that provides the drama the mage had wished for. Even when defeated, these not-so-sweet treats create an unwelcome surprise, exploding and spraying clumps of sticky, scalding-hot cake over their foes.

traits.name: Death Burst
traits.value: The pudding gremlin explodes when it dies. *Dexterity Saving Throw:* DC 11, each creature in a 5-foot Emanation originating from the pudding gremlin. *Failure:* 7 (**2d6**) Fire damage. *Success* Half damage.

traits.name: False Appearance
traits.value: If the pudding gremlin doesn't move on its turn, it has Advantage when taking the Hide action.

actions.name: Claw
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +5, reach 5 ft, *Hit:* 5 (**1d4 + 3**) Slashing damage.

actions.name: Fire Breath (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: *Dexterity Saving Throw:* DC 11, each creature in a 15 ft Cone. *Failure:* 7 (**2d6**) Fire damage. *Success* Half damage.

actions.name: Create Gremlin (1/Day)
actions.value: If the pudding gremlin is within 10 ft of an ordinary pudding, it can turn the ordinary pudding into another pudding gremlin. This new pudding gremlin appears in an unoccupied space within 10 ft of the original pudding gremlin and acts as its ally.

traits.name: Limited Magic Immunity
traits.value: The rakshasa can't be affected or detected by spells of 4th level or lower unless it wishes to be. It has advantage on saving throws against all other spells and magical effects.

traits.name: Ninth Life (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
traits.value: If the rakshasa would be reduced to 0 hit points, its current hit point total instead resets to 153hit points and it gains 50 temporary hit points as deformed, tumorous growths sprout from its skin. Additionally, the rakshasa can use the options in the "Mythic Actions" section for 1 hour. Award a party an additional 11,500 XP (17,400 XP total) for defeating the rakshasa after its Ninth Life activates.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)

actions.name: Multiattack

For the next minute, the target can't be affected by spells or magical effects of 4th level or lower except for those cast by the rakshasa. In addition, the magic of any non-artifact item the target holds, carries, or touches is suppressed while the target is in contact with the item. The curse can be lifted by a __remove curse__ spell or similar magic.

fluffInfo.name: Combat Tactics
fluffInfo.value: A maunder has no sense for combat tactics and exists only to eat whatever it can get within the grasp of its many hands. Once it has hold of a creature, it immediately begins to feed using its Bite. A Pyknic Maunder will attack an unconscious or downed character, uncaring about other attackers.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The maunder makes one Grasp or Bite attack against each creature within its reach. Alternatively, it makes two Eye Beam attacks.

actions.name: Grasp
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +6, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 11 (**2d6 + 4**) Bludgeoning damage, and if the target is Medium or smaller, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 13). The maunder has countless hands and can grapple any number of creatures.

actions.name: Bite
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +6, reach 5 ft., one creature Grappled by the maunder. *Hit:* 15 (**2d10 + 4**) Piercing damage. A Dazed target that is Grappled by the maunder is Helpless against this attack.

actions.name: Eye Beam

bonusActions.name: Babble

traits.name: Evasion
traits.value: If Qar is subjected to an effect that allows him to make a Dexterity saving throw to take only half damage, he instead takes no damage if he succeeds on the saving throw, and only half damage if he fails.

traits.name: Exploit Opening (3/Day)
traits.value: When Qar makes an attack, he has advantage on the attack roll.

traits.name: Supernatural Resistance
traits.value: Qar has advantage on saving throws against powers, spells, and other supernatural effects.

actions.name: Multiattack

actions.name: Unarmed Strike

actions.name: Iron Ring (2/Day)
actions.value: If not in the Cyst, Qar teleports to the Cyst. If in the Cyst, he teleports to a place he has visited.

actions.name: Claw

Additionally, that area is filled with magical darkness for 1 minute. A creature with darkvision can't see through this darkness, and no light except a __daylight__ spell or a light-creating spell of 5th level or higher can illuminate it.

traits.name: Canny Defense
traits.value: While the Queen of Thieves is wearing light or no armor and wielding no shield, her AC includes her Intelligence modifier (included above).

traits.name: Masked Identity
traits.value: The Queen of Thieves is immune to any effect that would sense her emotions or read her thoughts, as well as any divination spell that she refuses. Wisdom (*Insight*) checks made to ascertain her intentions or sincerity have Disadvantage.

traits.name: Memory Thief
traits.value: Creatures are not aware when the Queen of Thieves reads their thoughts or imposes the Charmed condition on them. Additionally, when a spell cast by the her that causes creatures to become Charmed ends, she can make affected creatures lose their memories. Each creature must succeed on a DC 18 Intelligence saving throw or forget up to 8 hours of the time spent Charmed by her. These memories can be restored with a __Heal__ spell or similar magic.

traits.name: Vexing Aura
traits.value: The Queen of Thieves projects a 30-foot Emanation of bewitching magic. At the start of each of her turns, she can choose the aura's effect, which applies to creatures of her choice in the Emanation:

entries: **Enchanting Presence**: A creature that starts its turn in the Emanation has the Charmed condition until it ends its turn outside the Emanation. If she deals damage to the creature, the condition ends, and that creature is immune to her Enchanting Presence for 24 hours.
**Mocking Laughter**: A creature that starts its turn in the Emanation takes 14 (**4d6**) Psychic damage.

actions.name: The Queen of Thieves always takes her turn on Initiative count 20
actions.value: On her turn, she can use her movement and interaction as normal. However, she does not take an action or Bonus Action on her turn unless forced to do so by a spell or other effect. Instead, she takes one of the following Epic Actions at the end of each player character's turn:

actions.name: +3 Rapier
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +13, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 12 (**1d8 + 8**) Piercing damage plus 35 (**10d6**) Poison damage.

actions.name: Cutting Words
actions.value: *Intelligence Saving Throw:* DC 18, one creature within 120 feet of the Queen of Thieves. *Failure:* 35 (**10d6**) Psychic damage, and the target has Disadvantage on the next D20 Test it makes before the end of its next turn. *Success* Half damage only.

actions.name: Dash
actions.value: The Queen of Thieves moves up to her Speed without provoking Opportunity Attack action.

actions.name: Misdirection (1/Round)
actions.value: The Queen of Thieves becomes Invisible and teleports to an unoccupied space she can see within 60 feet. At the same time, an illusory double of her appears where she was standing. The illusory double, as well as the Invisible condition, end if the Queen of Thieves attacks or casts a spell, or after 1 minute.

actions.name: Resistance Resistance
actions.value: The Queen of Thieves chooses one condition, spell, or other effect currently affecting her and rolls 1d20. On an 11+, the effect ends on her. She can use this action even if she would otherwise be unable to take actions, her actions are being controlled by another creature, or if a spell or effect alters her game statistics.

traits.name: Exploit Opening (3/Day)
traits.value: When Radlee makes an attack, she has advantage on the attack roll.

traits.name: Sure-Footed
traits.value: Radlee has advantage on saving throws against being moved against her will or knocked prone.

traits.name: Tactical Vigilance
traits.value: Radlee has advantage on initiative checks.
While she isn't incapacitated, Radlee and each ally within 30 feet of her who can see or hear her can't be surprised.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: Radlee makes three Halberd or three Longbow attacks. Alternatively, she makes one Halberd attack and uses Backswipe.

actions.name: Halberd
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. *Hit:* 12 (**1d10 + 7**) slashing damage.

actions.name: Longbow
actions.value: *Ranged Weapon Attack:* +6 to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. *Hit:* 7 (**1d8 + 3**) piercing damage.

actions.name: Backswipe
actions.value: Radlee swings her halberd's shaft at a creature within 5 feet of her. The target must succeed on a DC 18 Strength saving throw or take 16 (**3d10**) bludgeoning damage and be knocked prone.

traits.name: Cat's Grace
traits.value: When the rakitten falls and isn't incapacitated, it can subtract up to 30 feet from the fall when calculating falling damage. In addition, it has advantage on ability checks and saving throws made to avoid the prone condition.

traits.name: Swipey
traits.value: While not in combat, the rakitten takes any opportunity it can to knock things off shelves and ledges.

actions.name: Claw
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 4 (**1d4 + 2**) slashing damage.

actions.name: Ethereal Paw
actions.value: A spectral, magical, floating paw appears at a point the rakitten chooses within 30 feet of it. The paw lasts for 1 minute or until the rakitten dismisses it as a bonus action. The paw vanishes if it is ever more than 30 feet away from the rakitten or if the rakitten uses this action again.

The rakitten can use its action to control the paw. It can use the paw to manipulate an object, open an unlocked door or container, stow or retrieve an item from an open container, or pour the contents out of a vial. It can move the paw up to 30 feet each time it uses it. The paw can't attack, activate magic items, or carry more than 10 pounds.

traits.name: Land's Stride
traits.value: Moving through nonmagical difficult terrain costs the ranger no extra movement. It can also pass through nonmagical plants without being slowed by them and without taking damage from them if they have thorns, spines, or a similar hazard.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The ranger makes three attacks with its Shortsword or two attacks with its Longbow.

actions.name: Shortsword
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 7 (**1d6 + 4**) piercing damage.

actions.name: Longbow
actions.value: *Ranged Weapon Attack:* +9 to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. *Hit:* 8 (**1d8 + 4**) piercing damage.

actions.name: Volley
actions.value: The ranger makes a separate Longbow attack against each creature of its choice within 10 feet of a point it can see within the weapon's range.

actions.name: Whirlwind
actions.value: The ranger makes a separate Shortsword attack against each creature of its choice within its reach.

bonusActions.name: Hunter's Mark (1/Short or Long Rest)
bonusActions.value: The ranger chooses one creature it can see within 90 feet and mystically marks it as its quarry for 1 hour. For the duration, the ranger deals an extra 3 (**1d6**) damage to the target whenever it hits it with a weapon attack, and the ranger has advantage on any Wisdom (*Perception*) or Wisdom (*Survival*) check it makes to find the creature. If the target drops to 0 hit points before this effect ends, the ranger can use a bonus action on a subsequent turn to mark a new creature.

fluffInfo.name: Study the Foe
fluffInfo.value: Characters proficient in *History* or *Insight* gain Advantage on Intelligence (*Arcana*) checks to Study the Rat Prince, learning the following based on the result:

fluffInfo.name: (5+) Fearsome Leader
fluffInfo.value: You know he has the traits of a typical ratling, though he is much more formidable.

fluffInfo.name: (10+) Delerium Teeth
fluffInfo.value: You recognize the Rat Prince's Contaminated Bite attack.

fluffInfo.name: (15+) Adverse to Logic
fluffInfo.value: You are aware of the Rat Prince's strongest and weakest ability scores and saving throws, as well as the flaws noted in the Rat Prince's roleplaying traits.

fluffInfo.name: Combat Tactics
fluffInfo.value: Leading other ratlings into battle, the Rat Prince is a ferocious combatant. He uses his Sacrificial Pawn Reaction to avoid attacks while firing his crossbow or attacking ferociously with his Contaminated Bite. He uses Ratling Cunning to ensure that he remains adjacent to another ratling he can use as a body shield.

Caught alone, the Rat Prince doesn't fight: he flees. If he can't, he cries and begs for his life. He will sell out other ratlings if it means his own survival. When this rat is cornered, he offers anything he can think of to convince characters to let him go free, and will claim he can lead characters to fantastic treasures, secret passages through the city, vast amounts of "the shiny," and boasts that his favorable reputation amongst the ratlings can guarantee safety. Whether or not these are true is up to you. Unless the characters can make the Rat Prince loyal in some other way (through food, fear, or magic), he tries to escape at the earliest opportunity.

traits.name: Keen Smell
traits.value: The Rat Crown-Prince has Advantage on Wisdom (*Perception*) checks that rely on smell.

traits.name: Verminous Aura
traits.value: The Rat Crown-Prince emits a 30-foot Emanation of verminous contamination. A creature that starts its turn in the Emanation takes 10 (**3d6**) Necrotic damage.

actions.name: The Rat Crown-Prince always takes his turn on Initiative count 20
actions.value: On his turn, The Rat Crown Prince can use his movement and interaction as normal. However, he does not take an action or Bonus Action on his turn unless forced to do so by a spell or other effect. Instead, the Rat Crown-Prince takes one of the following Epic Actions at the end of each player character's turn:

actions.name: Contaminated Bite (1/Round)
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +10, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 8 (**1d4 + 6**) Piercing damage plus 10 (**3d6**) Necrotic damage. *Constitution Saving Throw:* DC 15. *Failure:* The target gains one Contamination level.

actions.name: Delerium-Infused Blades
actions.value: *Melee or Ranged Attack Roll:* +10, reach 5 ft. or range 30/60 ft. *Hit:* 13 (**2d6 + 6**) Necrotic damage, and the target suffers one of the following effects of the Rat Crown-Prince's choice (he can't select the same option more than once per round):

entries: **Poison**: *Constitution Saving Throw:* DC 16. *Failure:* 18 (**4d8**) Poison damage, and the target has the Poisoned condition for 1 minute (save ends). *Success* Half damage only.
**Acid Burn**: *Dexterity Saving Throw:* DC 16. *Failure:* 10 (**3d6**) Acid damage, and the target has the Burning condition (3d6 Acid). *Success* Half damage only.
**Mindkiller**: If the target is maintaining *Concentration* on a spell, it takes an extra 25 (**5d10**) Psychic damage unless it chooses to end its *Concentration*.

actions.name: Call Ratlings (1/Round)
actions.value: 2d4 __Ratling Warriors__ appear, burrowing up from below unoccupied spaces within 60 feet of the Rat Crown-Prince. The warriors have 1 Hit Point each and remain until killed.

actions.name: Meld into Shadow (1/Round)
actions.value: The Rat Crown-Prince has the Invisible condition until he makes an attack.

actions.name: Swift Stride
actions.value: The Rat Crown-Prince moves up to his Speed.

actions.name: Epic Resistance
actions.value: The Rat Crown-Prince chooses one condition, spell, or other effect currently affecting him and rolls 1d20. On an 11+, the effect ends on him. The Rat Crown-Prince can use this action even if he would otherwise be unable to take actions, his actions are being controlled by another creature, or if a spell or effect alters his game statistics.

fluffInfo.name: Roleplaying Traits
fluffInfo.value: The Rat God has destructive and apocalyptic motivations.

entries: **Personality Trait:** You seem hungry. Are you hungry?
**Ideal:** Eat or be eaten. That is the way of things. Eat! Eat! Eat! It is all food when you need to survive!
**Bond:** What you have is not enough. If you kill and eat them all. What was theirs is now yours!
**Flaw:** Why does your friend get to have nicer things than you? Don't you deserve them instead? Betray them! Eat them! Make it yours!

fluffInfo.name: Study the Foe
fluffInfo.value: Characters proficient in *Arcana* or *History* gain Advantage on Intelligence (*Religion*) checks when they take the Study action to examine the Rat God, learning the following based on the result:

fluffInfo.name: (20+) Fiendish Power
fluffInfo.value: You are aware of its Truesight and telepathy, its Resistances and Immunities, and its Epic Resistance. You also know this Rat God is beyond life and death and can reform years later if killed

fluffInfo.name: (25+) Cloud of Rats
fluffInfo.value: You are aware of the creature's Verminous Aura trait.

fluffInfo.name: (30+) Powerful Presence
fluffInfo.value: You know Rat God's highest and lowest ability scores and saving throws.

fluffInfo.name: Combat Tactics
fluffInfo.value: The Rat God is a being of pure malice and appetite. It cares not for the whims of mortals, only for pure destruction and the chattering and gnawing of infinite rats as they devour the cosmos. It finds joy only in annihilation, and the screams of mortals as they are reduced to bone by the Rat God's writhing swarm.

The Rat God can use its Rodent Rift to move to where it can catch as many targets as possible in its Verminous Aura, then set them ablaze with its Flail of Skulls. It will target the weakest characters with its Warp Bolt, and the least intelligent with its Infernal Chittering. It performs a Great Feeding to replenish itself and uses Rodent Rifts to escape a dangerous situation.

traits.name: Mass of Tails
traits.value: Ranged attacks against the Rat God from further than 60 feet away have Disadvantage.

traits.name: Verminous Aura
traits.value: The Rat God is surrounded by a 60-foot radius of vermin, pouring out of it and spilling over into the area as they claw and gnash. The area is Difficult Terrain and a creature that starts its turn in the area takes 21 (**6d6**) Necrotic damage.

actions.name: The Rat God always takes its turn on Initiative count 20
actions.value: On its turn, the Rat God can use its movement and interaction as normal. However, it does not take an action or Bonus Action on its turn unless forced to do so by a spell or other effect. Instead, the Rat God takes one of the following Epic Actions at the end of each player character's turn:

entries: **Flail of Skulls**: *Melee Attack Roll:* +16, reach 15 ft. *Hit:* 28 (**3d12 + 9**) Bludgeoning damage, and the target has the Burning condition (3d6 Acid).

**Great Feeding**: *Constitution Saving Throw:* DC 26, each creature within 60 feet of the Rat God. *Failure:* 10 (**3d6**) Piercing damage, and the target has the Sickened condition (save ends). *Success* Half damage only. *Failure or Success*: The Rat God regains Hit Points equal to the total damage dealt to all targets.

actions.name: Rodent Rifts (1/Round)
actions.value: The Rat God teleports to an unoccupied space within 120 feet. Each creature within 15 feet of the Rat God when it arrives is subjected to the following effect. *Strength Saving Throw:* DC 26. *Failure:* 28 (**8d6**) Necrotic damage, and the target is pushed 10 feet away from the Rat God.

actions.name: Warp Bolt
actions.value: *Constitution Saving Throw:* DC 22, one creature the Rat God can see within 120 feet. *Failure:* 23 (**4d12**) Necrotic damage, and the target suffers a Contamination level.

actions.name: Infernal Chittering
actions.value: *Intelligence Saving Throw:* DC 26, one creature the Rat God can see within 60 feet that can hear the Rat God. *Failure:* 18 (**4d8**) Psychic damage, and the target has the Weakened condition (save ends).

actions.name: Epic Resistance
actions.value: The Rat God chooses one condition, spell, or other effect currently affecting them and rolls 1d20. On an 11+, the effect ends on it. The Rat God can use this action even if it would otherwise be unable to take actions, its actions are being controlled by another creature, or if a spell or effect alters its game statistics.

fluffInfo.value: Ratling Guttersnipes stick to the shadows, staying hidden as long as possible. They are likely to position themselves on rooftops or behind rubble, and often secure their locations with pit traps, flasks of oil, torches, or other devious traps when they are able. Once they notice their target is in position, Ratling Guttersnipes unload a volley of poison-tipped bolts, or unleash deadly traps. After their targets are weakened, the ratlings rushes in to surprise and stab creatures with their delerium blades, and then quickly dart back out.
As with all ratlings, if the fight turns against them, they will flee or beg for their lives.

The pathogenist prefers to keep their distance and will attempt to scurry away if cornered or forced to fight in melee. It will also run if it is alone, or if its allies are fewer than its enemies.

The condition immediately ends and is replace by a new condition if the ratling uses Metastasize on the target again. *Failure or Success*: 9 (**2d8**) Necrotic damage.

fluffInfo.value: You know its strongest and weakest ability scores and saving throws.

fluffInfo.name: Combat Tactics
fluffInfo.value: Ratlings fight together in large groups to surround and overwhelm their foes with Pack Tactics. They use whatever rusty weapons they can find, or use their teeth and claws when nothing else is available. Occasionally, ratlings carry makeshift slings and hurl anything they pick up off the ground at their enemies: rocks, bones, or even chips of delerium.

However, ratlings flee and hide using Ratling Cunning when they don't have a numerical advantage over their foes. Indeed, they won't start fights if they don't outnumber their foes at least two to one, but while they outnumber their foes three to one or more, the typical ratling warrior can become insanely brave. When ratlings overpower their foes, they may even grapple them down and take them as prisoners to eat later.

traits.name: Writhing Aura
traits.value: The ground within 30 feet of the ravenous flora is filled with plant roots and becomes Difficult Terrain. A creature that starts its turn in the aura takes 7 (**2d6**) Poison damage.

traits.name: Poison Ivy
traits.value: If the ravenous flora would take Poison damage, it instead takes no damage and regains Hit Points equal to the Poison damage it would have received.

actions.name: The ravenous flora always takes its turn on Initiative count 20
actions.value: On its turn, the ravenous flora can use its movement and interaction as normal. However, it does not take an action or Bonus Action on its turn unless forced to do so by a spell or other effect. Instead, the ravenous flora takes one of the following Epic Actions at the end of each player character's turn:

entries: **Bite**: *Melee Attack Roll:* +7, reach 10 ft. *Hit:* 9 (**1d10 + 4**) Piercing damage, and the target has the Grappled condition (escape DC 15). Until this grapple ends, the target has the Restrained condition and the ravenous flora can't Bite another target.

**Spit Acid**: *Ranged Attack Roll:* +7, range 150/600 ft. *Hit:* 14 (**3d6 + 4**) Acid damage, and the target has the Burning condition (2d4 Acid). While Burning, the target has the Blinded condition.

**Swallow**: The ravenous flora makes one Bite attack against a Medium or smaller target it has Grappled. If the attack hits, the target is swallowed and the grapple ends. The swallowed target has the Blinded and Restrained conditions, has Total Cover from attacks and effects outside the flora, and takes 10 (**3d6**) Acid damage at the start of each of its turns. The flora can have up to four targets swallowed at a time.
If the flora takes 15 damage or more on a single turn from a creature inside it, it must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate all swallowed creatures, which land with the Prone condition in unoccupied spaces within 10 feet of it. If the flora dies, a swallowed creature no longer has the Restrained condition and can escape from the corpse using 5 feet of movement, exiting with the Prone condition.

actions.name: Hypnotic Pollen (1/Round)
actions.value: *Wisdom Saving Throw:* DC 16, each creature in a 60-foot Emanation originating from the ravenous flora. *Failure:* 9 (**2d8**) Psychic damage, and the target has the Weakened condition (save ends). While Weakened, the target must spend all of its movement on each of its turns to move directly toward the ravenous flora. During this movement, the target ignores Difficult Terrain caused by the flora's Writhing Aura.

actions.name: Epic Resistance
actions.value: The ravenous flora chooses one condition, spell, or other effect currently affecting them and rolls 1d20. On an 11+, the effect ends on it. The ravenous flora can use this action even if it would otherwise be unable to take actions, its actions are being controlled by another creature, or if a spell or effect alters its game statistics.

fluffInfo.name: Combat Tactics
fluffInfo.value: The Reality Cyst is less of a hunter than it is a disease. It feeds off the confusion of creatures trapped in its illusions. It mimics the bending realities of the Space Between Worlds and mirrors that into the minds of those who are close to it. After their target enters a trance, it drinks their mental energy and grows.

The Reality Cyst does only one thing: it feeds. It cannot move or defend itself well against attacks. It relies on creatures succumbing to its Unhinged Reality trait and devouring their minds. Once discovered, there is little the cyst can do to survive.

While Immobilized, the target believes itself to be in an altered and confused environment of shifting forms, and can't see or hear anything else. The target does not perceive itself to be stationary, and instead believes it is walking through a bizarre landscape. It can take an action on its turn to repeat the save, ending the effect on itself on a success. If the creature succeeds on its save or the effect ends for it, it is immune to the reality cyst's Unhinged Reality for 24 hours.

fluffInfo.name: Constructs of Metal and Flesh.
fluffInfo.value: Despite their outward appearances, Reautomata are constructs, not undead: their organic components operate more like machines than mere flesh. Such is the composition of a Reautomata that they fight on despite grievous injury, unflinching even as they are dismembered. Stopping a Reautomata necessitates mangling its body past the point of physical operation. Reautomata are ultimately brutal and decisive combatants that fight without regard for their personal well-being.

fluffInfo.name: Created in Torment.
fluffInfo.value: Reautomata must be skillfully made by a master Reanimator using the finest components. It is essential the work begin on both a living and fully conscious individual. Typically, most apothecaries perform the work without anesthetic, instead opting to sever the vocal cords of their victims so as to not have their screams disturb the grim work involved. Limbs are removed and replaced, and metal is grafted into flesh and welded into the bone of the fully aware subject. Nervous tissue is pulled from the brain and distributed from the body, giving the construct nearly perfect proprioceptive awareness while excising unnecessary or superfluous brain tissues associated with cognitive functions. The process renders the Reautomata fully obedient, but not mindless.

fluffInfo.name: (16+) Dispassionate Metal and Flesh.
fluffInfo.value: You are aware of the Reautomata's Relentless Endurance trait, as well as its damage and condition Immunities.

fluffInfo.name: (19+) Limb Weapons.
fluffInfo.value: You know of the Reautomata's Arm Blades and Entrapping Rend attacks.

fluffInfo.name: Combat Tactics
fluffInfo.value: Reautomata fight with outward ferocity and aggressive attacks which belie the cold, unfeeling calculation at the core of each solider. In battle, Reautomata launch themselves towards their foes in great leaps, impaling their targets upon their rending arm blades. The rending blades flense into flesh and latch on like hooks, allowing the Reautomata to restrain their targets. They then use their great strength to rend apart their restrained victims.

Reautomata unquestionably obey the orders of their creator and will fight until destroyed without regard for their own bodies. However, even with only general instructions, Reautomata fight intelligently and know how to utilize the environment to their advantage, making use of their climb speeds and jumping ability to prioritize dangerous targets.

actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +12, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 21 (**4d6 + 7**) Piercing damage.

actions.name: Wrecking Ball
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +12, reach 20 ft. *Hit:* 21 (**4d6 + 7**) Bludgeoning damage. *Strength Saving Throw:* DC 20. *Failure:* The target has the Dazed condition (save ends) and the Prone condition.

actions.name: Destructive Rampage (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: The reautomata moves up to its Speed in a straight line, moving through the space of any Medium or smaller creature on its path. The first time its enters each creature's space during this move, it can make a Drill or Wrecking Ball attack against that creature.

bonusActions.name: Overdrive Engine (1/Day; *Bloodied* Only)
bonusActions.value: The reautomata's Destructive Rampage recharges, and it gains Immunity to all damage and conditions until the end of its next turn. For the duration, the reautomata automatically succeeds on all saving throws and Strength, Dexterity, and Constitution-based ability checks and has Advantage on attack rolls. It can't be forced to move or affected by spells of level 8 or lower unless it chooses to be. Features and effects that ignore Resistances and Immunities, such as a Vorpal Weapon, don't function against the reautomata unless those effects are caused by a level 9 spell or an artifact.

At the end of its next turn, the reautomata dies and explodes. *Dexterity Saving Throw:* DC 20, each creature in a 20-foot Emanation originating from the reautomata when it dies. *Failure:* 20 (**8d4**) Acid damage plus 36 (**8d8**) Necrotic damage. *Success* Half damage.

traits.name: Ascendant Transformation
traits.value: When Vladimir von Drakken drops to 0 Hit Points, his body explodes in a shower of gore and he reappears in an unoccupied space within 10 feet as Ascendant Vladimir von Drakken. His Initiative doesn't change.

traits.name: Aura of Dread
traits.value: A creature that starts its turn within 30 feet of Vladimir von Drakken takes 21 (**6d6**) Necrotic damage.

traits.name: Bloodthirsty
traits.value: Vladimir von Drakken has Advantage on attack rolls against a target with the *Bloodied* or Bleeding condition.

traits.name: Daywalker
traits.value: Vladimir von Drakken doesn't possess any Vampire Weaknesses from the Monsters of Drakkenheim.

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.value: Vladimir von Drakken regains 30 Hit Points at the start of his turn if he has at least 1 Hit Point remaining.

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.value: Vladimir von Drakken can climb difficult surfaces, including along ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

actions.name: Vladimir von Drakken always takes his turn on Initiative count 20
actions.value: On his turn, Vladimir von Drakken can use his movement and interaction as normal. However, he does not take an action or Bonus Action on his turn unless forced to do so by a spell or other effect. Instead, Vladimir von Drakken takes one of the following Epic Actions at the end of each player character's turn:

entries: **Bloodmourne**: *Melee Attack Roll:* +12, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 27 (**6d6 + 6**) Force damage, and the target has the Bleeding condition (4d4). In addition, Vladimir von Drakken can apply one of the following martial maneuvers to the target:
**Advance**: Vladimir von Drakken pushes the target 15 feet, then moves up to 15 feet to an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the target without provoking Opportunity Attack action.
**Hamstring**: The target has the Immobilized condition until the end of its next turn.
**Overpower**: The target has the Staggered condition until the end of its next turn.
**Claws**: *Melee Attack Roll:* +12, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 20 (**4d6 + 6**) Necrotic damage, and if the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 20).

actions.name: Bite (1/Round)
actions.value: *Constitution Saving Throw:* DC 20, one creature within 5 feet that is willing or has the Grappled, Incapacitated, or Restrained condition. *Failure:* 49 (**14d6**) Necrotic damage, and the target has the Weakened condition (DC 20 Constitution save ends). Vladimir von Drakken regains Hit Points equal to the Necrotic damage dealt. A Humanoid killed by this damage rises on its next turn as a Vampire Spawn under Vladimir von Drakken's control.

actions.name: Dominate (1/Round)
actions.value: *Wisdom Saving Throw:* DC 20, one creature Vladimir von Drakken can see within 120 feet. *Failure:* The target has the Charmed condition until the end of its next turn. While Charmed, the target obeys Vladimir von Drakken's commands and can't take Reactions. Failure by 5 or More: The Charmed condition lasts 24 hours or until Vladimir von Drakken is reduced to 0 Hit Points. Each time the target takes damage, it repeats the save, ending the effect on itself on a success. *Success* The target has Disadvantage on its next attack roll against Vladimir von Drakken.

actions.name: Wing Blast (1/Round)
actions.value: *Strength Saving Throw:* DC 20, each creature in a 15-foot Emanation originating from Vladimir von Drakken. *Failure:* 14 (**4d6**) Bludgeoning damage, and the target is pushed 10 feet away from Vladimir von Drakken and has the Prone condition. *Failure or Success*: Before or after using this Epic Action, Vladimir von Drakken can move up to half his Fly Speed without provoking Opportunity Attack action.

actions.name: Shadow Step (2/Round)
actions.value: Vladimir von Drakken teleports to an unoccupied space he can see within 60 feet that is in Dim Light or Darkness. He has Advantage on the next melee attack he makes before the end of this round.

actions.name: Shape-Shift (1/Round)
actions.value: Vladimir von Drakken shape-shifts into a Tiny bat (Speed 5 ft., Fly Speed 30 ft.) or a Medium cloud of mist (Speed 5 ft., Fly Speed 20 ft. [hover]), or he returns to his vampire form. Anything he is wearing transforms with him.

While in bat or mist form, Vladimir von Drakken can't speak. His game statistics, other than his size and Speed, are unchanged, but he can't use Epic Actions other than Shape-Shift and Epic Resistance. While in mist form, Vladimir von Drakken can't speak or manipulate objects, and loses his Aura of Dread. He is weightless and can enter an enemy's space and stop there. If air can pass through a space, the mist can do so, but it can't pass through liquid. He has Resistance to all damage.

actions.name: Epic Resistance
actions.value: Vladimir von Drakken chooses one condition, spell, or other effect currently affecting him and rolls 1d20. On an 11+, the effect ends on him. He can use this action even if he would otherwise be unable to take actions, his actions are being controlled by another creature, or if a spell or effect alters his game statistics.

fluffInfo.value: A Ripper is a creation of a truly mad apothecary, though one ostensibly created as a "surgical assistant" for dissection and autopsy. In truth, a Ripper's only purpose is as a butcher, carrying out the grim task of dismembering corpses and collecting severed parts to supply fresh materials to create more abominations. Transforming morgues into abattoirs and surgery rooms into charnel houses, having a Ripper amongst their servants enables an Apothecary to work with startling efficiency.
Due to their horrific appearance and grim purpose, Rippers are seldom encountered outside an Apothecary's laboratory. Given their size and brutal skill, Rippers make ideal guardians.

fluffInfo.name: Parts Collectors
fluffInfo.value: Apothecaries stitch all manner of extra arms, hands, and limbs to their Rippers, which the creature uses to gather severed body parts and hold down subjects.

fluffInfo.name: Fear Engine
fluffInfo.value: The Ripper's tortured mind sympathetically responds when it senses a victim's fear and terror, but its twisted brain responds with adrenaline and bloodlust.

fluffInfo.name: Study the Foe
fluffInfo.value: Characters proficient in *Arcana* or *Medicine* gain Advantage on Wisdom (*Insight*) or Intelligence (*Investigation*) checks to Study a Ripper, learning the following based on the result:

fluffInfo.value: You know of its Insensitive to Pain trait, as well as its damage and condition Immunities.

fluffInfo.name: (15+) Razor-Sharp Weapons
fluffInfo.value: You recognize the Ripper's Whirling Bonesaw attack, and it's Feed on Fear and Dismemberment traits.

fluffInfo.name: (20+) Formidable but Dim-Witted
fluffInfo.value: You learn the Ripper's Constitution, Dexterity, and Intelligence saving throws.

fluffInfo.name: Combat Tactics
fluffInfo.value: The Ripper is an unsubtle and unsophisticated combatant, but it can follow its creators' orders intelligently. Unless directed otherwise, a Ripper usually begins battle by using its Gory Display to terrify its victims. It then ponderously moves towards its chosen target before lowering its Saw Blade down, preferring Frightened targets to benefit from its Feed on Fear trait. During its turn, a Ripper continues attacking with its Saw Blade until it misses. If it reduces a target to 0 Hit Points, it does not stop making attacks until its target dies.

traits.value: When the rotbeast dies, they release a burst of infectious air. Each non-Fungus creature within 5 feet of them must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or gain a level of exhaustion and become infected with forest rot disease. An infected creature regains half the normal number of hit points when they spend Hit Dice or finish a long rest, and they can't reduce their exhaustion level by finishing a long rest.

fluffInfo.name: Twisted Mages
fluffInfo.value: When a mageborn is bitten by a vampire, the magical energies flowing in their now-tainted blood create a Sanguine Witch. A creature of both vampiric bloodlust and arcane might. These witches serve as right hands to vampire nobility and as generals and lieutenants in vampire armies.They are cunning and manipulative creatures who lure victims with deception and wit.

fluffInfo.name: Arcane Blood
fluffInfo.value: Sanguine Witches are mageborn but their magic energies are stunted and twisted; they can use magic to absorb life essence from their victims and live unnatural lives.
The more a Sanguine Witch feeds, the more the vampiric essence mutates with their arcane blood. Sanguine Witches often take on grotesque mutations from this otherworldly mixing.
Notably, many Sanguine Witches have acquired blood red glowing eyes and animalistic snouts and fangs.

fluffInfo.name: Mages of the Court
fluffInfo.value: Sanguine Witches stand as the chosen court mages to vampire masters. They perform all the duties a court mage would usually do, but their loyalty to the Court of the Night is unbreaking. Their mastery over undeath, and their ability to warp victims into vampiric thralls makes them a terrifying creature to behold

fluffInfo.name: Study the Foe
fluffInfo.value: Characters proficient in *Religion* or *Survival* gain Advantage on Intelligence (*Religion*) checks when taking the Study action to examine a Sanguine Witch, learning the following based on the result:

fluffInfo.name: (5+) Unnatural Resistances
fluffInfo.value: You recognize the creature's damage Resistances and Immunities.

fluffInfo.name: (10+) Siphon Vitality
fluffInfo.value: You learn of the creature's Feast action.

fluffInfo.name: (15+) Arcane Caster
fluffInfo.value: You know the creature possesses formidable spellcasting abilities.

fluffInfo.name: Combat Tactics
fluffInfo.value: The Sanguine Witch uses __Darkness__ to hide themselves and attempt to enthrall subjects with __Hold Person__ before using Feast to feed on them. The witch's goal is to create thralls of their opponents.
If the Sanguine Witch is in direct sunlight, or at less than half their Hit Points, they attempt to flee.

fluffInfo.name: Combat Tactics
fluffInfo.value: Reautomata fight with outward ferocity and aggressive attacks which belie the cold, unfeeling calculation at the core of each solider. In battle, Reautomata launch themselves towards their foes in great leaps, impaling their targets upon their rending arm blades. The rending blades flense into flesh and latch on like hooks, allowing the Reautomata to restrain their targets. They then use their great strength to rend apart their restrained victims.

Reautomata unquestionably obey the orders of their creator and will fight until destroyed without regard for their own bodies. However, even with only general instructions, Reautomata fight intelligently and know how to utilize the environment to their advantage, making use of their climb speeds and jumping ability to prioritize dangerous targets.

actions.value: The hag makes one Lightning Strike attack and uses Dry Drowning.

actions.name: Lightning Strike
actions.value: *Melee or Ranged Spell Attack:* +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 120 ft., one target. *Hit:* 10 (**3d6**) lightning damage.

actions.name: Dry Drowning
actions.value: The hag chooses a creature they can see within 120 feet of them, making the target feel as though their lungs are filling with water. The target must succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw or be dazed until the start of the hag's next turn. A creature who can breathe water or who doesn't need air automatically succeeds on this saving throw.

bonusActions.name: Sea Storm (1/Day; 3rd-Level Spell; Concentration)
bonusActions.value: The hag creates a roiling storm with a 60-foot radius centered on themself that moves with them and lasts for 1 minute. The hag has advantage on Lightning Strike attacks against targets in that area, and those attacks deal an extra 3 (**1d6**) lightning damage.

**Skills**: deception +3 plus PB, intimidation +3 plus PB

actions.name: Signature Attack (Zap)
actions.value: *Melee or Ranged Spell Attack:* +3 plus PB to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 60 ft., one target. *Hit:* 4 (**1d8**) lightning damage. This spell's damage increases by 1d8 when the apprentice reaches 5th level (2d8), 11th level (3d8), and 17th level (4d8).

actions.name: 3rd Level: Wash Away (3/Day)
actions.value: As a bonus action, the apprentice rides a crashing wave. They make a signature attack against an enemy within 5 feet of them and move up to their walking speed without provoking opportunity attacks. If the attack hits, it deals an extra **PB** bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: 5th Level: Ride the Lightning (3/Day)
actions.value: As an action, the apprentice supercharges their foe's nervous system. The apprentice makes a signature attack, and if it deals damage to a creature, the target must make a DC 10 plus PB Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the target is incapacitated and their speed is halved until the end of their next turn.

actions.name: 7th Level: Drown (1/Day)
actions.value: As an action, the apprentice chooses three creatures the apprentice can see within 60 feet of them. Each target feels as though their lungs are filling with water and must make a DC 10 plus PB Constitution saving throw. A creature who can breathe water or who doesn't need air automatically succeeds on this saving throw. On a failed save, a target takes **PBd8** force damage, and for 1 minute, they can't speak, their speed is halved, and they are dazed (save ends at end of turn). On a successful save, the target takes half as much damage and suffers no other effect. Another creature within 5 feet of a target can use their action to make a DC 10 plus PB Strength (*Athletics*) or Intelligence (*Medicine*) check, ending the effect on a success.
