traits.name: Flyby (Scaled Wings only)
traits.value: The sea serpent doesn't provoke Opportunity Attacks when it flies out of an enemy's reach.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The sea serpent makes a number of attacks equal to half this spell's level (rounded down).

actions.name: Allure (Glowing Lantern only)
actions.value: The sea serpent causes a lantern hanging from one of its fins to glow eerily. *Wisdom Saving Throw:* DC equals your spell save DC, each creature in a 30-foot Emanation originating from the sea serpent. *Failure:* The target is Charmed by the sea serpent until the start of its next turn. Creatures have Advantage on the saving throw if the sea serpent has dealt damage to them already this turn, and the Charmed condition ends immediately if the sea serpent deals damage to a creature Charmed by this ability.

actions.name: Inhale (Enormous Mouth only)
actions.value: *Strength Saving Throw:* DC equals your spell save DC, each creature in a 15-foot Cone. *Failure:* **1d6 + summonSpellLevel** Psychic damage and the creature is pulled 5 feet straight toward it or, if the creature is already within 5 feet of the sea serpent, it takes an additional **2d6** Piercing damage. *Success* Half damage.

actions.name: Bite
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* Bonus equals your spell attack modifier, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* **1d6 + 3 + summonSpellLevel** Piercing damage and the creature has the Grappled condition (escape DC equals your spell save DC). The Grappled condition ends if the sea serpent bites a different creature.

actions.name: Thrash
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* Bonus equals your spell attack modifier, reach 10 ft. *Hit:* **1d10 + 3 + summonSpellLevel** Bludgeoning damage and the target is pushed 5 feet away from the sea serpent.

fluffInfo.name: Study the Foe
fluffInfo.value: Characters proficient in *History* or *Nature* gain Advantage on Intelligence (*Arcana*) checks when they take the Study action to examine a Sentient Planetoid, learning the following based on the result.

fluffInfo.name: (10+) Mental Fortress
fluffInfo.value: You are aware of the creature's Resistances and Immunities.

fluffInfo.name: (15+) Panoptic Arcanist
fluffInfo.value: You learn of the creature's All-Knowing Magic action.

fluffInfo.name: (20+) Unfathomable Strength
fluffInfo.value: You know the creature's highest and lowest ability scores.

fluffInfo.name: Combat Tactics
fluffInfo.value: Sentient Planetoids are not all hostile creatures. Some of them, who have knowledge of mortals deem them a pest or a problem, especially if traversing the Space Between Worlds. Like a mortal who finds a rat in their home, a sentient planetoid will attempt to remove the creature or kill it.

Some planetoids might wish to converse with mortals, wanting to learn information from them about simple concepts of mundane life, or ask questions they think a mortal would know, only to confuse them with esoteric concepts and broad ideas of the universe. This can sometimes frustrate a planetoid who may react by simply wanting to eradicate the creature who bothered it.

fluffInfo.name: Animus:
fluffInfo.value: Aberration.

fluffInfo.name: Fluid:
fluffInfo.value: Contaminated Ichor.

fluffInfo.name: Hide:
fluffInfo.value: Plates.

fluffInfo.name: Dust:
fluffInfo.value: Aberrant Dust.

entries: **Resistances**: acid, cold, fire, lightning, poison, thunder
**Immunities**: psychic; charmed, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned

traits.name: Fully Contaminated
traits.value: The sentient planetoid is immune to Contamination and has Advantage on saving throws against contaminated spells. The sentient planetoid may cast contaminated spells even though it does not gain Contamination levels.

traits.name: Delerium Healing
traits.value: As an action, the sentient planetoid can touch a delerium shard to regain 10 (3d6) Hit Points. Once the sentient planetoid has used a delerium shard in this way, the shard can't be used in this manner again for 24 hours.

traits.name: Alien Intellect
traits.value: The sentient planetoid is immune to any effect that would sense its emotions or read its thoughts, as well as any divination spell that it refuses. Wisdom (*Insight*) checks made to ascertain the sentient planetoid's intentions or sincerity have Disadvantage.

traits.name: Beyond Space and Time
traits.value: The sentient planetoid always acts on Initiative count 20. Additionally, it can't be moved, teleported, or sent to another plane of existence against its will.

traits.name: Gravitational Pull
traits.value: The sentient planetoid exerts its own force of gravity in a 100-foot Emanation. A creature that starts its turn in the Emanation falls towards the sentient planetoid, taking falling damage as appropriate if it collides with the planetoid. A creature can make a DC 22 Dexterity saving throw to grab onto a fixed object it can reach, avoiding the fall on a success.

traits.name: Immutable Form
traits.value: The sentient planetoid is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.value: The sentient planetoid has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The sentient planetoid makes four attacks, only one of which can be an Unfathomable Knowledge attack.

actions.name: Unfathomable Knowledge
actions.value: *Melee or Ranged Attack Roll:* +14, reach 5 ft. or range 250 ft. *Hit:* 39 (**6d12**) Psychic damage, and the target has the Addled and Weakened conditions until the end of its next turn.

actions.name: Crashing Comet
actions.value: *Ranged Attack Roll:* +14, range 150 ft. *Hit:* 27 (**6d8**) Bludgeoning damage, and the target has the Burning condition (3d8 Fire).

actions.name: All-Knowing Magic (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: The sentient planetoid casts any spell of level 5 or lower, using Intelligence as its spellcasting ability (spell save DC 22, +14 to spell attacks).

entries: **Resistances**: bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from mundane attacks
**Immunities**: poison, psychic; charmed, dazed, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned

traits.name: Immutable Form
traits.value: The builder is immune to any power, spell, or effect that would alter their form.

traits.name: Siege Monster
traits.value: The builder deals double damage to objects and structures.

traits.name: Supernatural Resistance
traits.value: The builder has advantage on saving throws against powers, spells, and other supernatural effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The builder makes two attacks using Wrecking Ball, Stone, or both, and can use Lay the Foundation, if available.

actions.name: Wrecking Ball
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +11 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. *Hit:* 26 (**3d12 + 7**) bludgeoning damage.
Each enemy within 5 feet of the target must succeed on a DC 19 Dexterity saving throw or take 13 (**2d12**) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Stone
actions.value: *Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack:* +11 to hit, reach 10 ft. or range 60/240 ft., one target. *Hit:* 23 (**3d10 + 7**) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, they are knocked prone.

actions.name: Lay the Foundation (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: The builder pours wet concrete on the ground in a 20-foot square starting from a point within 5 feet of the builder. Until the foundation dries in 1 hour, that area is difficult terrain, and when a creature with a Strength score of 20 or less starts their turn in that area, they must succeed on a DC 19 Strength (*Athletics*) check or be restrained until the start of their next turn.

traits.name: Immutable Form
traits.value: The miner is immune to any power, spell, or effect that would alter their form.

traits.name: Supernatural Resistance
traits.value: The miner has advantage on saving throws against powers, spells, and other supernatural effects.

traits.name: Tunneler
traits.value: The miner can burrow through solid rock at half their burrowing speed and leaves a 5-foot-diameter tunnel in their wake.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The miner makes two attacks using Drill Press, Pneumatic Pick, or both.

actions.name: Drill Press
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. *Hit:* 15 (**2d8 + 6**) piercing damage. If the target is touching the ground, they are knocked prone and restrained by the miner's drill. While restrained in this way, the target takes 15 (**2d8 + 6**) piercing damage at the start of each of their turns, and the miner can't make Drill Press attacks. The restrained condition ends if the miner moves, makes a Drill Press attack, or is destroyed. The target or a creature who can reach them can use an action to pull the target away from the drill, ending the restrained condition and dealing 15 (**2d8 + 6**) piercing damage to the target in the process.

actions.name: Pneumatic Pick
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. *Hit:* 17 (**2d10 + 6**) piercing damage. If the target is wearing mundane armor, their armor takes a permanent and cumulative -1 penalty to the AC it offers.
Armor reduced to an AC of 10 is destroyed.

actions.name: Unload Rocks (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: The miner hurls rocks and dirt in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 18 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 44 (**8d10**) bludgeoning damage and is blinded until the end of their next turn. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage and is not blinded.

bonusActions.name: Break Ground (Recharge 5-6)
bonusActions.value: The miner strikes the ground and creates a fissure extending from them in a 30-foot-long, 5-foot-wide, 30-foot-deep line. Each Medium or smaller creature in that area must make a DC 18 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a creature falls into the fissure, taking 10 (**3d6**) bludgeoning damage from the fall and landing prone. On a successful save, a creature is shunted 5 feet into an unoccupied space and does not fall into the fissure. If a creature doesn't have an unoccupied space within 5 feet of them, they fall into the fissure.

traits.name: Siege Monster
traits.value: The engine deals double damage to objects and structures.

traits.name: Supernatural Resistance
traits.value: The engine has advantage on saving throws against powers, spells, and other supernatural effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The engine makes two attacks using Blade Rake, Force Cannon, or both.

actions.name: Blade Rake
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +14 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. *Hit:* 35 (**4d12 + 9**) slashing damage. If the target is Large or smaller, they are pulled up to 15 feet toward the engine.

actions.name: Force Cannon
actions.value: *Ranged Spell Attack:* +12 to hit, range 400 ft., one target. *Hit:* 33 (**6d10**) force damage, and the target is dazed until the end of their next turn.

actions.name: Burning Oil (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: The engine shoots burning oil in a 60-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 20 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 52 (**15d6**) fire damage and is covered in scalding oil. A creature covered in scalding oil takes 10 (**3d6**) fire damage at the start of each of their turns. A creature can use an action to remove the oil from themself or a creature they can reach, ending the effect. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage and is not covered in scalding oil.

bonusActions.name: Destructive Rollout
bonusActions.value: The engine moves up to their speed in a straight line, destroying mundane walls in their path that are less than 10 feet thick. Medium or smaller mundane objects in the engine's path are destroyed if the objects aren't being worn or carried by a creature. The engine can move through the spaces of other creatures during this movement as if they were difficult terrain, and if the engine does so, the creature must succeed on a DC 20 Dexterity saving throw or take 11 (**2d10**) bludgeoning damage and be knocked prone.

fluffInfo.name: Study the Foe
fluffInfo.value: Characters proficient in *Survival* gains Advantage on Intelligence (*Nature*) checks to Study a Sewer Thing, learning the following based on their result:

fluffInfo.name: (5+) Resilient Plant
fluffInfo.value: You know it's creature type, Resistances, and Immunities

fluffInfo.name: (10+) Poisonous Engulfer
fluffInfo.value: You learn of the creature's Poison Absorption and Engulf features.

fluffInfo.name: (15+) Sense of Self
fluffInfo.value: You understand the creature's Wisdom and Charisma ability scores and saving throws.

fluffInfo.name: Combat Tactics
fluffInfo.value: The Sewer Thing waits for the opportune moment to strike.

It lets creatures approach, appearing as plant matter over some sewer debris. Once its prey is close, it springs to life, lashing out with its tendrils at any it has surprised, attempting to Engulf them. This tactic works well if it is in water or sewage, where it can pull victims beneath the surface.

The Sewer Thing starts combat attempting to Engulf surprised targets. Once a creature is Engulfed, the Sewer Thing retreats into the sewer water and flees. It is a hunter, consuming its prey by dissolving them inside of it. Once it has its food, it has no reason to stay and fight.

traits.name: Instinctive Ambusher
traits.value: At the start of the sewer thing's first turn of each combat, if the sewer thing attacks a creature, it can make one additional Tendril Lash attack as part of its Multiattack action.

traits.name: Poison Absorption
traits.value: Whenever the sewer thing takes Poison damage, it takes no damage and regains a number of Hit Points equal to the Poison damage dealt.

traits.name: Toxic Aura
traits.value: A creature that starts its turn within 5 feet of the sewer thing is subjected to the following effect. *Constitution Saving Throw:* DC 12. *Failure:* 5 (**1d10**) Poison damage.

traits.name: Unexpected Appearance
traits.value: If the sewer thing is motionless at the start of combat, it has Advantage on its Initiative roll. Additionally, if a creature hasn't observed the sewer thing move or act, that creature must succeed on a DC 18 Intelligence (*Investigation*) check to discern that the sewer thing is animate.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The sewer thing makes two attacks and uses Engulf.

actions.name: Tendril Lash
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +8, reach 30 ft. *Hit:* 14 (**2d8 + 5**) Bludgeoning damage, and the target has the Grappled condition (escape DC 16).

actions.name: Reel
actions.value: The sewer thing pulls each creature Grappled by it up to 20 feet straight toward it.

actions.name: Engulf
actions.value: The sewer thing engulfs a Medium or smaller creature within 5 feet of it that is Grappled by it. The grapple ends. The target has the Blinded and Restrained conditions, is suffocating, and is subjected to the following effect at the start of each of the sewer thing's turns. *Constitution Saving Throw:* DC 16. *Failure:* 11 (**2d10**) Poison damage plus 11 (**2d10**) Acid damage.

If the sewer thing moves, the target moves with it. The sewer thing can have up to four creatures engulfed at a time. An engulfed creature can take an action to escape with a successful DC 16 Strength (*Athletics*) check, landing in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the sewer thing.

traits.name: Engulfing Sack
traits.value: The mound has a vegetative sack on their body where they carry engulfed creatures. The sack can be attacked (AC 15; 50 hit points; immunity to poison and psychic damage), which deals no damage to the mound. Destroying the sack frees creatures trapped by the mound's Engulf action. The mound regrows the sack at the beginning of their next turn.

traits.name: False Appearance
traits.value: While the mound remains motionless, they are indistinguishable from an ordinary mass of vegetation.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The mound makes two Vine Lash attacks. They can replace one attack with a use of Engulf, if available.

actions.name: Vine Lash
actions.value: *Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack:* +8 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 60 ft., one target. *Hit:* 14 (**2d8 + 5**) piercing damage. If the target is Medium or smaller, the mound can pull the target up to 30 feet toward them.

actions.name: Engulf (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: The mound reaches out with writhing vines and attempts to pull in up to two Medium or smaller creatures within 30 feet of them. Each target must succeed on a DC 16 Strength saving throw or be engulfed in the mound's engulfing sack. An engulfed creature is restrained, has total cover against attacks and other effects outside the mound, and takes 7 (**2d6**) poison damage at the start of each of the mound's turns. When the mound moves, the engulfed creature moves with them. If the mound dies or their engulfing sack is destroyed, each engulfed creature is freed and shunted to an unoccupied space of their choice within 5 feet of the mound.

traits.name: False Appearance
traits.value: While the mound remains motionless, they are indistinguishable from an ordinary mass of vegetation. If the mound's caregiver is Large or smaller, they can use the Hide action to attempt to hide in the same space as their motionless mound.

actions.name: Signature Attack (Vine Lash)
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +3 plus PB to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* **1d6 plus PB** piercing damage.

actions.name: 1st Level: Long-Range Lash (2 Ferocity)
actions.value: The mound makes a signature attack with a reach of 30 feet instead of 5 feet.
If this attack hits a Medium or smaller creature, the mound can pull the target up to 10 feet toward the mound.

actions.name: 3rd Level: Verdant Roundup (5 Ferocity)
actions.value: The mound targets up to PB creatures within 30 feet of them who are Large or smaller. Each target must succeed on a DC 10 plus PB Dexterity saving throw or be pulled up to 15 feet toward the mound and take **PBd4** poison damage.

actions.name: 5th Level: Engulf (8 Ferocity)
actions.value: The mound attempts to pull a Large or smaller creature within 5 feet of them into their body. The target must make a DC 10 plus PB Strength saving throw. On a failure, the target is pulled into the mound's space, takes **PBd8** poison damage, and is engulfed. On a success, a creature takes half as much damage, doesn't move, and isn't engulfed.

An engulfed creature is restrained, has total cover against attacks and other effects outside the mound, and takes **PBd8** poison damage at the start of each of the mound's turns. When the mound moves, the engulfed creature moves with them. An engulfed creature can try to escape by taking an action to make a DC 10 plus PB Strength check. On a success, that creature is freed and shunted to an unoccupied space of their choice within 5 feet of the mound.
The mound can have one Large or up to four Medium or smaller creatures engulfed at a time.

entries: **Immunities**: poison; blinded, charmed, deafened, flanked, frightened, poisoned, prone

traits.name: False Appearance
traits.value: While the pile remains motionless, they are indistinguishable from an ordinary mass of vegetation.

traits.name: Hungry Grab
traits.value: If an enemy starts their turn within 5 feet of three or more piles, the creature must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or be grappled. While grappled in this way, the target is restrained, and at the start of each of the target's turns, they take poison damage equal to the number of piles within 5 feet of them. The saving throw and escape DC equal 10 plus the number of piles within 5 feet of the creature. The grapple ends if fewer than three piles are within 5 feet of the creature.

traits.name: Minion
traits.value: If the pile takes damage from an attack or as the result of a failed saving throw, their hit points are reduced to 0. If the pile takes damage from another effect, they die if the damage equals or exceeds their hit point maximum; otherwise they take no damage.

actions.name: Vine Lash (Group Attack)
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 4 piercing damage.

fluffInfo.name: Combat Tactics
fluffInfo.value: The Shardmaul Manticore attacks from above, choosing whichever target looks weakest and the least armored. It descends from above suddenly, making Bite and Claw attacks against the weakest prey it detects. After its first descent, it lifts off again, using Wing Shards to cover its ascent. It then repeats its attack pattern.
A Shardmaul Manticore is bold enough to attack when outnumbered but typically flees if it faces stiff opposition that reduces it to half its Hit Points or fewer.

actions.value: *Dexterity Saving Throw:* DC 15, each creature in a 20-foot Emanation originating from the manticore (flying creatures have Disadvantage). *Failure:* 28 (**8d6**) Piercing damage, and if the target is flying, it has the Prone condition. *Success* Half damage only.

traits.name: Tunneler
traits.value: The drangolin can burrow through solid rock at half their burrow speed and leaves behind a 3-foot-diameter tunnel when they burrow. Tiny and Small creatures can move through it normally, and Medium and Large creatures can squeeze through it. This tunnel collapses after 10 minutes.

actions.name: Fiery Claws
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +5 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. *Hit:* 10 (**2d6 + 3**) slashing damage plus 3 (**1d6**) fire damage.

actions.name: Erupt (1/Day)
actions.value: If the drangolin is burrowing within 10 feet of the surface, they can erupt from the ground (without spending movement) into a space that contains one or more creatures. When they do, each creature within 10 feet of the drangolin must make a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw. A creature directly above the drangolin when they emerge has disadvantage on this saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 14 (**4d6**) bludgeoning damage and is knocked prone. On a successful save, a creature takes only half as much damage and is pushed 5 feet to an unoccupied space of their choice instead of being knocked prone.

actions.name: Wrecking Ball (1/Day)
actions.value: The drangolin moves up to twice their walking speed in a straight line without provoking opportunity attacks. While doing so, they can enter Large or smaller creatures' spaces. If the drangolin enters another creature's space during this move, that creature must succeed on a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw or take 7 (**2d6**) bludgeoning damage plus 7 (**2d6**) fire damage. If the drangolin enters the space of a structure or object that isn't being worn or carried, it takes twice as much damage.

traits.name: Feline Resilience (3/Day)
traits.value: When Shtriga Nonna fails a saving throw, she can immediately turn into a cat of her size (Medium in her normal form, Large while under the effect of Grow) and succeed instead. While in cat form, Shtriga Nonna retains her game statistics and ability to speak, except she can't cast spells or use Soul Steal. She reverts to her previous form at the end of her next turn.

traits.name: Supernatural Resistance
traits.value: Shtriga Nonna has advantage on saving throws against powers, spells, and other supernatural effects.

actions.name: Multiattack

actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +7 to hit, reach 5 ft. (10 ft. with Grow), one target. *Hit:* 11 (**2d6 + 4**) slashing damage, or 14 (**3d6 + 4**) slashing damage while under the effect of Grow. If the target is wearing mundane metal armor, they must succeed on a DC 15 Dexterity throw or their armor takes a permanent and cumulative -1 penalty to the AC it offers. If the armor is reduced to an AC of 10, it is destroyed.

actions.name: Soul Steal (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: Shtriga Nonna inhales deeply in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 15 Constitution saving throw, taking 16 (**3d10**) necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. Shtriga Nonna regains 10 hit points for each creature who fails this saving throw.

bonusActions.name: Grow (2/Day; 3rd-Level Spell)
bonusActions.value: For 1 minute, Shtriga Nonna magically increases in size, along with anything she is wearing or carrying. While enlarged, she is Large, her reach becomes 10 feet, she deals an extra 3 (**1d6**) damage on Strength-based weapon attacks (included in the attacks), and she makes Strength checks and Strength saving throws with advantage. If Shtriga Nonna lacks the room to become Large, she attains the maximum size possible in the space available.

bonusActions.name: Gobble You Up
bonusActions.value: Shtriga Nonna feeds on the body of an unconscious creature within 5 feet of her. The target takes 10 (**3d6**) piercing damage, and Shtriga Nonna recharges her Soul Steal action.

fluffInfo.name: (5+) Unrestrained Undead
fluffInfo.value: You recognize the Skin Crawler's creature type, Resistances, and Immunities.

fluffInfo.name: (10+) Squeezing Death
fluffInfo.value: You are aware of its Crush and Consume Bonus Action.

fluffInfo.name: (15+) Deathly Aware
fluffInfo.value: You learn of the Skin Crawler's mental ability scores and saving throws.

fluffInfo.name: Combat Tactics
fluffInfo.value: The Skin Crawler is a mindless creature. It is nothing but animated flesh seeking to consume. If it senses a living creature nearby, it crawls towards it with total disregard for its own life.
It only wants to bind the living and squeeze them to death while slowly devouring their flesh, consuming it into itself.
A Skin Crawler is too focused to flee and continues to attempt to devour a target until either it or their target is dead.

fluffInfo.name: Combat Tactics
fluffInfo.value: Skretches keep to high perches and observe potential prey before attacking. A Skretch prefers to attack targets that are visibly injured, weakened, or otherwise vulnerable.

Once it finds a suitable quarry, a Skretch circles their prey overhead pelting them with Spittle while waiting for their Expel Waste to recharge. Since its attacks require the Skretch to be directly overhead its target, they prefer to keep well above their targets to avoid any projectiles or ranged attacks.

A Skretch never enters close combat willingly. If it is engaged up close, it uses the Disengage action to flee. As lazy scavengers, a Skretch doesn't pursue its prey very far or into buildings and flees if reduced to half its Hit Points or fewer.

actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 4 (**1d6 + 1**) piercing damage plus 2 (**1d4**) fire damage.

actions.name: Claws
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 3 (**1d4 + 1**) piercing damage plus 2 (**1d4**) fire damage.

traits.name: Lethe
traits.value: When the demon's soul count is 0, they have advantage on attack rolls, disadvantage on saving throws, and their Intelligence score becomes 3 (-4). Additionally, the demon must use their movement on each of their turns to move as close as possible to the nearest creature they can sense with their soulsight, and then if they are able, they must use their action to attack and attempt to kill that creature. The demon can't act with any other purpose until they add 1 to their soul count.

traits.name: Soul Devourer
traits.value: When the demon reduces a creature who isn't a Construct or an Undead to 0 hit points or deals damage to a dying creature, the creature must make a DC 11 Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the demon consumes the creature's soul and adds 1 to the demon's soul count. A creature whose soul is consumed in this way immediately dies, and they can't be restored to life by any means short of a __wish__ spell.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The demon makes four attacks using Pincer, Sword, Javelin, or a combination of them. They can replace one of these attacks with a Tail Spike attack. The demon can burn 1 soul to make a fifth attack using Pincer, Sword, or Javelin.

actions.name: Pincer
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 13 (**2d6 + 6**) bludgeoning damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 17). While grappled, the target is restrained. The demon has six pincers, each of which can grapple a target or wield a weapon.

actions.name: Sword
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. *Hit:* 15 (**2d8 + 6**) slashing damage.

actions.name: Javelin
actions.value: *Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack:* +9 to hit, reach 10 ft. or range 60/240 ft., one target. *Hit:* 13 (**2d6 + 6**) piercing damage.

actions.name: Tail Spike
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +9 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. *Hit:* 11 (**1d10 + 6**) piercing damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned for 1 minute (save ends at end of turn).

bonusActions.value: The demon takes the Disengage action and gains a burrowing speed equal to their walking speed until the end of their next turn.

traits.name: Puppet
traits.value: While in a dreamholder's lair, the sleepwalker sees what the dreamholder wants it to. A creature can use its action to make a Charisma (*Persuasion*) check contested by the dreamholder's Charisma (*Persuasion*) to help the sleepwalker see through the illusion. On a success, the sleepwalker sees through the dreamholder's illusions and can't be beguiled by the dreamholder for the next 24 hours. On a failure, the sleepwalker believes the creature to be a trick, and any further attempts made to persuade it by that creature automatically fail for the next 24 hours.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The sleepwalker makes two melee attacks.

actions.name: Phantom Fist
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. *Hit:* 7 (**1d10 + 2**) psychic damage.

fluffInfo.value: Camouflaged against the ice, a solitary snow sphinx is on the prowl. A shock of dark humanoid hair whips around a feline face, revealing piercing blue eyes that can freeze foes with a single glance. Compared to its desert-dwelling cousins, this sphinx is far less likely to be defeated with reason or logic. Although a snow sphinx can speak, it generally greets its prey with claws and teeth rather than riddles or philosophical conversation.

Physically, this fearsome creature is well adapted to harsh habitats, such as ice-covered mountains or arctic plains. It has wide paws to stop it sinking into soft snow and thick fur to ward out the cold. The sphinx's muscular wings carry the same spotted markings as its fur; they are strong enough to withstand the bitter winds that whistle across the tundra.

traits.name: Inscrutable
traits.value: No magic can observe the sphinx remotely or detect its thoughts without its permission. Wisdom (*Insight*) checks made to ascertain its intentions or sincerity are made with Disadvantage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The sphinx makes two Claw attacks.

actions.name: Claw
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +6, reach 5 ft, *Hit:* 12 (**2d8 + 3**) Slashing damage plus 14 (**4d6**) Cold damage.

bonusActions.name: Freezing Glare (Recharge 5-6)
bonusActions.value: *Constitution Saving Throw:* DC 13, each creature in a 30-foot Cone. *First Failure:* The target has the Restrained condition and repeats the save at the end of its next turn if it is still Restrained, ending the effect on itself on a success. *Second Failure:* The target has the Petrified condition instead of the Restrained condition, and is turned into an ice statue.

traits.name: Natural Camouflage
traits.value: The snowfox has advantage on Dexterity (*Stealth*) checks made in snowy terrain or cloudy skies.

traits.name: Nimble Escape
traits.value: The snowfox doesn't provoke opportunity attacks when they leave an enemy's reach.

actions.name: Bite
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 4 piercing damage, and the snowfox attaches to the target. While attached, the snowfox's Claw attacks against that target are made with advantage, and the snowfox can't attack another target. The target or a creature who can reach them can detach the snowfox as an action with a successful DC 13 Strength (*Athletics*) check. The snowfox can detach by spending 5 feet of their movement.

actions.name: Claw
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 4 slashing damage.

bonusActions.name: Burrow
bonusActions.value: The snowfox burrows up to 5 feet in snow.

bonusActions.name: Listen
bonusActions.value: The snowfox makes a Wisdom (*Perception*) check.

traits.name: Metamagic
traits.value: The sorcerer has 7 sorcery points and regains all expended sorcery points when it finishes a long rest. It can spend these points in the following ways:

entries: **Quickened Spell**: When the sorcerer casts a spell that has a casting time of 1 action, it can spend 2 sorcery points to change the casting time to 1 bonus action for this casting.

**Twinned Spell**: When the sorcerer casts a spell that targets only one creature and doesn't have a range of self, it can spend a number of sorcery points equal to the spell's level to target a second creature in range with the same spell (1 sorcery point if the spell is a cantrip).

actions.name: Dagger
actions.value: *Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack:* +3 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. *Hit:* 3 (**1d4 + 1**) piercing damage.

actions.name: Magnetobolt
actions.value: Ranged Spell Attack: +5 to hit, range 90 ft., one target. *Hit:* 7 (**2d6**) force damage and the creature must succeed on a Strength saving throw or be knocked prone. A creature made of ferrous metal or wearing ferrous armour has disadvantage on this saving throw.

actions.name: Shocking Grasp
actions.value: Melee Spell Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 9 (**2d8**) lightning damage and the creature can't take reactions until the start of its next turn. The sorcerer has advantage on the attack roll if the target is wearing armour made of metal.

traits.name: Fiendish Adacity
traits.value: The handler's AC includes its Charisma modifier.

traits.name: Fiendish Fury
traits.value: The handler deals an extra 5 (**1d10**) damage when it hits with a melee weapon attack (included in the attacks).

traits.name: Fiendish Vigour
traits.value: The handler gains 5 temporary hit points at the start of each of its turns. If the handler takes radiant damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of the handler's next turn.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The handler makes two attacks with its Morningstar or Tommybow.

actions.name: Morningstar
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 14 (**2d10 + 3**) piercing damage.

actions.name: Brittlebone Splinterspray Tommybow
actions.value: *Ranged Weapon Attack:* +4 to hit, range 30/120 ft., ., two creatures within 5 feet of each other. *Hit:* 9 (**2d4 + 4**) piercing damage. Reload (3).

traits.name: False Appearance
traits.value: While the skull remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from an ordinary humanoid skull.

actions.name: Bite
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +4, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 4 (**1d4 + 2**) Piercing damage.

actions.name: Disparaging Remarks
actions.value: *Wisdom Saving Throw:* DC 12, one creature the skull can see within 10 feet. *Failure:* 5 (**2d4**) Psychic damage, and the target has Disadvantage on the next attack roll it makes before the end of its next turn.

**Immunities**: necrotic, poison; charmed, dazed, exhaustion, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, restrained, unconscious
**Languages**: the languages they knew in life

traits.name: Corrupting Phasing
traits.value: The specter can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. The specter takes 5 (**1d10**) force damage if they end their turn inside an object. A creature takes 2 (**1d4**) necrotic damage the first time a specter passes through them on a turn.

actions.name: Decaying Touch
actions.value: *Melee Spell Attack:* +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. *Hit:* 7 (**2d6**) necrotic damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 12 Constitution saving throw or spend 1 Hit Die without any benefit. If the target has no Hit Dice to spend, they drop to 0 hit points instead.
If a Humanoid dies within 1 minute of being hit by this attack, their spirit rises as a specter under the GM's control in an unoccupied space nearest to where that Humanoid died.

bonusActions.name: Hidden Movement (Recharge 5-6)
bonusActions.value: The specter turns invisible and then moves up to their speed. At the end of this movement, the invisibility ends.

traits.name: Aquatic Camouflage
traits.value: The leech has Advantage on Dexterity (*Stealth*) checks made to hide in aquatic terrain.

traits.name: Spell Glands
traits.value: The leech has a spell gland, which can store up to ten levels of spells. When encountered, roll 1d10 to determine how many spell levels it has stored.

actions.name: Attach
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +3, reach 0 ft. *Hit:* The leech attaches to the target. While attached, the leech doesn't attack, and moves with the target, using none of the leech's movement. The leech can detach itself using 5 feet of movement, and detaches immediately if its blood bags are filled or if the target dies.

A creature within 5 feet can take an action to detach the leech with a successful DC 13 Wisdom (*Medicine*) check. *Failure:* The leech is still detached, but the target has the Bleeding condition (2d4). Failure by 5 or More: The leech isn't detached and the target takes 8 (**2d4 + 3**) Piercing damage.

bonusActions.name: Spell Drain
bonusActions.value: The leech can use this Bonus Action only when it is attached to a creature. The attached creature is subjected to the following effect. *Intelligence Saving Throw:* DC 13. *Failure:* 10 (**3d6**) Psychic damage, and the target has the Bewildered condition until the start of the leech's next turn. If the target has spell slots, the leech drains one randomly determined spell slot which can be no higher than level 3. It then fills its spell glands with the same number of spell levels.

bonusActions.name: Arcane Transfusion
bonusActions.value: The leech can use this Bonus Action only when it is attached to a creature and has at least one level worth of spells in its Spell Glands. The leech empties any number of spell levels from its Spell Glands, and the creature it is attached to regains an equal number of spell levels worth of spell slots.

fluffInfo.name: Study the Foe
fluffInfo.value: Characters proficient in *Survival* or *Nature* gain Advantage on Intelligence (*Arcana*) check to Study a Spined Dreg, learning the following based on their result:

fluffInfo.name: (5+) Spined Form
fluffInfo.value: You are aware of the Spined Dreg's speeds, as well as its Spider Climb and Spiny Body traits.

fluffInfo.name: (10+) Launched Spines
fluffInfo.value: You recognize the Dreg's Spike attack.

fluffInfo.name: (15+) Cunning and Agile
fluffInfo.value: You understand the Dreg's highest and lowest ability scores and saving throws.

fluffInfo.name: Combat Tactics
fluffInfo.value: Due to its agile nature and inherent Climb Speed, the Spined Dreg prefers vantage points on low roofs or second stories of ruined buildings. It tends to avoid openly traversing the streets, and usually attacks from a distance or to leap down upon its enemies and grapple them. They will climb up walls to escape if reduced below half their Hit Points and outnumbered.

fluffInfo.value: Aberration.

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.value: The dreg climb difficult surfaces, including along ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

traits.name: Spiny Body
traits.value: Any creature grappling the dreg or Grappled by it takes 5 (**1d10**) Piercing damage at the end of that creature's turn.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The dreg makes three Spike attacks.

actions.name: Spike
actions.value: *Melee or Ranged Attack Roll:* +6, reach 5 ft., or range 20/60 ft. *Hit:* 6 (**1d4 + 4**) Piercing damage plus 7 (**2d6**) Necrotic damage. Critical *Hit:* *Constitution Saving Throw:* DC 10. *Failure:* The target gains one level of Contamination.

fluffInfo.name: Study the Foe
fluffInfo.value: Characters proficient in *History* or *Nature* gain Advantage on Intelligence (*Arcana*) checks when they take the Study action to examine a Star Warden, learning the following based on the result.

fluffInfo.name: (10+) Mentally Tough
fluffInfo.value: You know the creature's Immunities.

fluffInfo.name: (15+) Transposition
fluffInfo.value: You recognize the creature's Outside Time and Space Reaction.

fluffInfo.name: (20+) Otherworldly Intellect
fluffInfo.value: You learn the creature's highest and lowest ability scores.

fluffInfo.name: Combat Tactics
fluffInfo.value: Star wardens exist in multiple times and dimensions at once. A creature that tries to fight a star warden is at a loss for where and how the star warden exists before it. Both the Star Warden and the creatures facing it are constantly shifted around the battlefield, unable to grasp their sense of reality. The Star Warden uses its Outside Time and Space Reaction to let two creatures attack one another instead of landing a blow upon itself. It can force the truth of all reality into a creature's mind or have it experience the cold vastness of space. Star Wardens are clever and always flee a losing fight.

fluffInfo.name: Animus:
fluffInfo.value: Aberration.

fluffInfo.name: Fluid:
fluffInfo.value: Contaminated Ichor, Goopy Ooze, Mucus.

fluffInfo.name: Organs:
fluffInfo.value: Guts, Glands, Flesh.

fluffInfo.name: Natural Weapons:
fluffInfo.value: Tentacles.

fluffInfo.name: Hide:
fluffInfo.value: Skin.

fluffInfo.name: Dust:
fluffInfo.value: Aberrant Dust.

traits.name: Fully Contaminated
traits.value: The star warden is immune to Contamination and has Advantage on saving throws against contaminated spells. The star warden may cast contaminated spells even though it does not gain Contamination levels.

traits.name: Delerium Healing
traits.value: As an action, the star warden can touch a delerium shard to regain 10 (3d6) Hit Points. Once the star warden has used a delerium shard in this way, the shard can't be used in this manner again for 24 hours.

traits.name: Alien Intellect
traits.value: The sentient planetoid is immune to any effect that would sense its emotions or read its thoughts, as well as any divination spell that it refuses. Wisdom (*Insight*) checks made to ascertain the sentient planetoid's intentions or sincerity have Disadvantage.

traits.name: Cosmic Aura
traits.value: A creature that starts its turn within 30 feet of the star warden is subjected to the following effect. *Charisma Saving Throw:* DC 17. *Failure:* The target is hurled through time and space, witnessing every moment of existence in a single second. It takes 17 (**5d6**) Psychic damage and is teleported to an unoccupied space it can see within 30 feet.

traits.name: Lords of Time and Space
traits.value: When the star warden is reduced to 0 Hit Points, roll a d20. On a 1 or 20, the star warden regains all of its Hit Points and another creature of its choice within 30 feet is reduced to 0 Hit Points instead.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The star warden makes two attacks.

actions.name: Staff of Stars
actions.value: *Melee or Ranged Attack Roll:* +8, reach 5 ft. or range 60/120 ft. *Hit:* 22 (**5d6 + 4**) Radiant damage plus 10 (**3d6**) Force damage.

actions.name: Nebulae Grasp
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +8, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 27 (**5d8 + 4**) Piercing damage, and the star warden can teleport the target to an unoccupied space the star warden can see within 120 feet.

actions.name: Stardust
actions.value: *Dexterity Saving Throw:* DC 17, each creature in a 30-foot Cone. *Failure:* 18 (**4d6 + 4**) Radiant damage and the target has the Burning condition (4d6 Radiant).

bonusActions.name: The Cold Void of Space
bonusActions.value: *Constitution Saving Throw:* DC 17, one creature within 120 feet of the star warden that teleported this turn. *Failure:* The target has the Frozen condition. *Success* 10 (**3d6**) Cold damage.

entries: **Speed**: *walk* 0 Ft. All +5 Ft. In Dreamscape, *fly* 20 Ft. (hover)
**Immunities**: bludgeoning, piercing, poison, slashing; charmed, exhaustion, grappled, poisoned, prone, restrained

traits.name: Phantasmal Cone
traits.value: The dreamholder's central eye creates an area of phantasmagoric horrors—illusory manifestations unique to each creature—within a 90-foot cone. At the start of each of its turns, the dreamholder decides which way the cone faces and whether the cone is active. Each creature within the cone at the end of the dreamholder's turn must succeed on a DC 14 Intelligence saving throw or take 11 (**2d10**) psychic damage and become frightened of the dreamholder and the illusions within the area until the end of the dreamholder's next turn.
As an affected creature is surrounded by these illusions, the source of its fear is in every direction, rendering it unable to move in any direction while it can see these sources of its fear.

traits.name: Inconsistent Incoporeality
traits.value: When the dreamholder takes 5 or more psychic or thunder damage in a single instance, it becomes corporeal until the start of its next turn. While corporeal, it loses its Incorporeal Movement trait; its immunity to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage; and its immunity to the grappled and restrained conditions.

traits.name: Incorporeal Movement
traits.value: The dreamholder can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. It takes 5 (**1d10**) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.value: If the dreamholder fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

actions.name: Dreameater
actions.value: *Melee Spell Attack:* +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. *Hit:* 14 (**2d10 + 3**) psychic damage.

actions.name: Eye Rays
actions.value: The dreamholder shoots three of the following magical eye rays at random (reroll duplicates), choosing one to three creatures it can see within 120 feet of it:

entries: **1. Charm Ray**: The target must succeed on a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw or be charmed by the dreamholder for 1 hour, or until the dreamholder harms the target.
**2. Confusion Ray**: The target must succeed on a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw or be afflicted by the confusion spell until the end of its next turn.

**3. Static Ray**: The target must make a DC 14 Intelligence saving throw, taking 7 (**2d6**) psychic damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one. On a failed save, a target has muddled thoughts for 1 minute. During that time, it rolls a d6 and subtracts the number rolled from all its attack rolls and ability checks, as well as its Constitution saving throws to maintain concentration. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

**4. Rot Ray**: The target must make a DC 14 Intelligence saving throw. On a failure, its grey matter deteriorates, it takes 10 (**3d6**) necrotic damage, and it has disadvantage on ability checks and attack rolls it makes until the end of its next turn. On a success it takes half as much damage and suffers no additional effects.

**5. Incorporeal Shunt Ray**: The target must succeed on a DC 14 Charisma saving throw or become momentarily incorporeal, be pushed up to 15 feet directly away from the dreamholder, and then rematerialise. The creature takes 13 (**3d8**) force damage if it rematerialises inside an object. If the creature rematerialises in another creature's space, both creatures take this damage. The target is then pushed to the nearest unoccupied space.

**6. Nightmare Ray**: The target is assailed by illusory manifestations of its fears. It must make a DC 14 Intelligence saving throw, taking 16 (**3d10**) psychic damage on a failure or half as much damage on a success.

traits.name: Chorus of Death
traits.value: If the starving harpy hears a harpy's Alluring Song, they can start harmonizing (no action required). The starving harpy continues harmonizing until the song ends, until they choose to stop harmonizing, or until they become deafened or incapacitated. For each starving harpy harmonizing, the range of the song increases by 50 feet, and the save DCs for the singing harpy's Alluring Song action and Beckon bonus action both increase by 1 (maximum DC increase of 5).

traits.name: Echolocation
traits.value: The harpy can't use their blindsight while deafened.

traits.name: Minion
traits.value: If the harpy takes damage from an attack or as the result of a failed saving throw, their hit points are reduced to 0. If the harpy takes damage from another effect, they die if the damage equals or exceeds their hit point maximum; otherwise they take no damage.

actions.name: Grasping Talons (Group Attack)
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 1 piercing damage, and if the target is a creature, the harpies can move them 5 feet in any direction. If the attack was made by three or more harpies, they can move the target 10 feet instead of 5.

traits.name: Tiny Target
traits.value: If the stirge is reduced to 0 hit points by any damage other than psychic while attached to another creature, that creature takes damage equal to half that dealt to the stirge.

actions.name: Proboscis
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. *Hit:* 3 piercing damage, and the stirge can attach to the target and enter their space. While attached, the stirge moves with the target and can't make Proboscis attacks. A creature who can reach the stirge can use an action to detach the stirge, shunting them into the nearest unoccupied space of the stirge's choice. The stirge also detaches if they become grappled, incapacitated, prone, or restrained.

actions.name: Drain Essence
actions.value: The stirge sips the life essence of a creature they are attached to who isn't a Construct or an Undead. The creature loses 3 hit points and must succeed on a DC 12 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned until the end of the stirge's next turn. If the creature is already poisoned, they also become dazed until the end of the stirge's next turn.

traits.name: Minion
traits.value: If the broodling takes damage from an attack or as the result of a failed saving throw, their hit points are reduced to 0. If the broodling takes damage from another effect, they die if the damage equals or exceeds their hit point maximum; otherwise they take no damage.

traits.name: Tiny Target
traits.value: If the broodling is reduced to 0 hit points by any damage other than psychic while attached to another creature, that creature takes 1 damage of the same type.

actions.name: Proboscis (Group Attack)
actions.value: *Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack:* +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. *Hit:* 1 piercing damage, and each broodling who joined the attack can attach to the target and enter their space. While attached, a broodling moves with the target and can't make Proboscis attacks. The target or a creature who can reach them can use an action or bonus action to detach all broodlings, shunting them into the nearest unoccupied space of each broodling's choice. The broodling also detaches if they become grappled, incapacitated, prone, or restrained.

actions.name: Drain Essence
actions.value: The broodling sips the life essence of a creature they're attached to who isn't a Construct or an Undead. The creature loses 1 hit point.

entries: **HP**: 7 + seven times caregiver's level (number of d8 Hit Dice equal to their caregiver's level)

actions.name: Signature Attack (Proboscis)
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +3 plus PB to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* **1d6 plus PB** piercing damage.

actions.name: 1st Level: Destabilizing Attack (2 Ferocity)
actions.value: The stirge makes a signature attack. On a hit, the target also has disadvantage on the next attack they make before the end of their next turn.

actions.name: 3rd Level: Quick Drink (5 Ferocity)
actions.value: The stirge makes a signature attack. On a hit, the target takes an extra **PBd4** piercing damage and is poisoned until the end of their next turn.

actions.name: 5th Level: Attach (8 Ferocity)
actions.value: The stirge makes a signature attack against a creature. On a hit, the target takes an extra **PBd6** piercing damage and the stirge attaches to the target and enters their space. While attached, the stirge moves with the target and can't attack any creature other than the target. If the stirge hits the target with an attack while attached, the target takes an extra **PBd6** piercing damage. The stirge can use an action or bonus action to detach and move 5 feet into an unoccupied space without provoking opportunity attacks. The stirge also detaches if they become grappled, incapacitated, prone, or restrained, or if they take more than PB × 5 damage in a turn.

bonusActions.name: Essence Shared (2/Long Rest)
bonusActions.value: If the stirge's caregiver is within 5 feet of them and the stirge isn't attached to another creature, the stirge pumps life essence into the caregiver's veins. The caregiver regains **1d6 plus PB** hit points.

fluffInfo.name: Combat Tactics
fluffInfo.value: The Stitcher has a singular, focused mind, and even when defending itself, uses its sewing and surgical skills to sew up its foes. The Stitcher often identifies what the most advantageous option is for its Sewing Needle, focusing on the mouths of spellcasters, the limbs of melee combatants, and the eyes of ranged combatants. It attempts to attach limbs to victims it has sewn up.

actions.name: Scissorhand
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +9, reach 10 ft. *Hit:* 18 (**3d8 + 5**) Slashing damage, and the target has the Bleeding condition (4d4).

actions.name: Sewing Needle
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +9, reach 10 ft. *Hit:* 14 (**2d8 + 5**) Piercing damage. *Dexterity Saving Throw:* DC 17. *Failure:* The target has a body part bound and sewn up (stitcher's choice):

actions.name: Eyes
actions.value: The target has the Blinded condition.

actions.name: Mouth
actions.value: The target cannot speak and cannot cast spells with a verbal component.

actions.name: Limbs
actions.value: The target has the Restrained condition.

A creature within 5 feet can take an action to remove the threads with a successful DC 17 Wisdom (*Medicine*) check, ending the effect. *Failure:* The threads are removed but the target takes 11 (**2d10**) Slashing damage. Failure by 5 or More: The target takes 11 (**2d10**) Slashing damage and the threads aren't removed.

actions.name: Attach Limb
actions.value: *Strength Saving Throw:* DC 17, one creature the stitcher can see within 10 feet (Grappled, Slowed, Restrained, Incapacitated, and Immobilized creatures have Disadvantage). *Failure:* The target makes a DC 17 Intelligence saving throw at the start of each of its turns. On a success, it controls the limb until the start of its next turn. Otherwise, the limb is uncontrolled for the same duration. The target suffers one of the following effects depending on the attached limb:

entries: **Head**: While controlled, the target has Advantage on Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma-based D20 Tests. While uncontrolled, the target can control its action or its movement on its turn, but the head controls the other. On a failure by 5 or more, the head chooses which to control instead of the target.

**Arm**: While controlled, the target can take an extra action on its turn, choosing from the Attack (one weapon attack only) or Utilize actions. While uncontrolled, the extra arm makes one melee weapon attack against the target at the start of its turn. The arm has a +9 attack bonus and deals 14 (**3d6 + 4**) Bludgeoning damage on a hit.

**Leg**: While controlled, the target can take an extra action on its turn, choosing from the Dash or Disengage actions. While uncontrolled, the leg forces the target to move up to its Speed in a random direction at the start of its turn. If this movement forces the target toward a hazard or precipice, the host can repeat the saving throw. On a successful save, it stops its movement and has the Prone condition before entering the hazard.
An attached limb can be attacked (AC 20, 20 Hit Points, Immunity to Poison and Psychic damage). A creature within 5 feet can take an action to remove the limb with a successful DC 17 Wisdom (*Medicine*) check or DC 15 Strength check. When removed by any means other than a successful Wisdom (*Medicine*) check, the target takes 18 (**4d8**) Necrotic damage and has the Bleeding condition (4d4).

fluffInfo.name: Combat Tactics
fluffInfo.value: Storm Trolls hunt for food during heavy rainfall or bad storms. Often accompanied by cracks of thunder and flashes of lightning, they begin combat by hurling lightning at their foes before rushing in to maul them with their Claws and Bites.
If a Storm Troll takes Acid damage, it immediately flees and attempts to find a safe place to recuperate.

fluffInfo.name: Combat Tactics
fluffInfo.value: The Striga is a vampire warped by delerium and contamination. It loses its inhibitions and subtlety, becoming a ravenous bloodthirsty monster. The Striga charges into battle and aggressively pursues its foes, clawing and howling as it hunts its prey. The Striga attempts to single out a weak target and tears them to shreds before moving on to the next.
A Striga rarely flees as it is too bloodthirsty to consider its own life.

traits.value: The striga is immune to Contamination and has Advantage on saving throws against contaminated spells. It may cast contaminated spells even though it does not gain Contamination levels.

traits.name: Necrotic Aura
traits.value: A creature that starts its turn within 30 feet of the Striga takes 10 (**3d6**) Necrotic damage.

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.value: The striga regains 10 Hit Points at the start of its turn if it has at least 1 Hit Point and isn't in sunlight or running water. If the striga takes Radiant damage or damage from holy water, this trait doesn't function at the start of the vampire's next turn.

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.value: The striga can climb difficult surfaces, including along ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

traits.name: Vampire Weaknesses
traits.value: The striga has the traits described in the "Vampire Weaknesses" sidebar in the Monsters of Drakkenheim.

actions.name: The striga always takes its turn on Initiative count 20
actions.value: On its turn, the striga can use its movement and interaction as normal. However, it does not take an action or Bonus Action on its turn unless forced to do so by a spell or other effect. Instead, the striga takes one of the following Epic Actions at the end of each player character's turn:

actions.name: Necrotic Bite (1/Round)
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +10, reach 10 ft. *Hit:* 24 (**4d6 + 6**) Necrotic damage. The target's Hit Point Maximum is reduced by an amount equal to the Necrotic damage taken, and the striga regains Hit Points equal to that amount.

actions.name: Claws
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +10, reach 15 ft. *Hit:* 24 (**4d6 + 6**) Slashing damage.

actions.name: Delerium Healing
actions.value: The striga touches a delerium shard and regains 10 (3d6) Hit Points. Once the striga has used a delerium shard in this way, it can't be used in this manner again for 24 hours.

actions.name: Blood Howl (1/Round)
actions.value: *Wisdom Saving Throw:* DC 18, each creature in a 30-foot Emanation originating from the striga that can hear it. *Failure:* 35 (**10d6**) Psychic damage, and the target has the Jinxed (1d6) and Immobilized conditions (save ends both). *Success* Half damage, and the target is immune to the striga's Blood Howl for 24 hours.

actions.name: Charge
actions.value: The striga moves up to 40 feet in a straight line, moving through the spaces of other creatures. Each creature whose space the striga passes through is subjected to the following effect. *Dexterity Saving Throw:* DC 18. *Failure:* The target is pushed 10 feet away from the striga and has the Prone condition.

actions.name: Epic Resistance
actions.value: The striga chooses one condition, spell, or other effect currently affecting them and rolls 1d20. On an 11+, the effect ends on it. The striga can use this action even if it would otherwise be unable to take actions, its actions are being controlled by another creature, or if a spell or effect alters its game statistics.

actions.name: Rejuvenating Flare (1/Day)

**Protective Light.** Four brilliant motes orbit the Elemental for 1 minute. When the Elemental deals damage to a creature with an attack, the Elemental can extinguish one mote (no action required) to deal an extra 14 (**4d6**) radiant damage to that creature.

A distracted sunsnacker repeats the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success and becoming immune to the allure of that source of food for the next 24 hours.

fluffInfo.name: Combat Tactics
fluffInfo.value: The Swarm of Ratlings is an alternative way to represent a massive number of ratlings, rather than needing to use dozens of individually weak ratling minions in an encounter against higher-level characters.

In battle the Swarm of Ratlings moves like a rolling tide, using its Scurrying Horde Bonus Action to close the distance with as many targets as possible. The swarm tries to move into and over the spaces of its enemies, so it can Bite them with Advantage using its Chittering Mass trait. The swarm continues making Bite attacks against a downed character in its space as the swarm goes into a feeding frenzy.
The Swarm of Ratlings is impossibly brave until it's reduced to 0 Hit Points, at which point the Scampering Survivors usually try to run away.

traits.value: After the tar-rasque's Primordial Awakening trait activates, the crystal in the tar-rasque's head can be targeted separately from the tar-rasque (AC 19, 80 hit points, vulnerability to thunder damage, and immunity to all other damage types except bludgeoning, force, piercing, and slashing). It can only be targeted by a creature grappled by the tar-rasque's Necrotar Tongue, or by creatures that Ready an action for when the tar-rasque makes a Necrotar Tongue attack. If the crystal is destroyed, the tar-rasque's current hit points are reduced to 0.

traits.name: Flammable
traits.value: If the tar-rasque takes fire damage, it ignites. It and any creature it is grappling takes 13 (**2d12**) fire damage at the start of each of its turns and its melee attacks and Necrotaruption deal an additional 13 (**2d12**) fire damage. If the tar-rasque is subject to heavy rain or takes 15 or more cold damage in a single instance, the flames are extinguished and the effects end.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.value: If the tar-rasque fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.value: The tar-rasque has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Primordial Awakening (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
traits.value: If the tar-rasque would be reduced to 0 hit points, its current hit point total instead resets to 155 hit points, it recharges its Necrotaruption, and it regains 1 expended use of Legendary Resistance. Additionally, the tar-rasque can use the options in the "Mythic Actions" section for 1 hour. Award a party an additional 11,500 XP (23,000 XP total) for defeating the tar-rasque after its Primordial Awakening activates.

traits.name: Refractive Exterior
traits.value: Any time the tar-rasque is targeted by a magic missile spell, a line spell, or a spell that requires a ranged attack roll, some of the energy is refracted into a random elemental type and a bolt of energy fires back at the caster as a ranged spell attack using the caster's spell attack modifier, and dealing 4 (**1d8**) damage on a hit. Roll a d4 to determine the damage type: 1-acid, 2-cold, 3-fire, 4-lightning.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The tar-rasque makes three attacks: one with its Necrotar Tongue, one with its Claws, and one with its Tail. It can use its Necrotaruption instead of its Necrotar Tongue.

actions.name: Necrotar Tongue
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +10 to hit, reach 60 ft., one target. *Hit:* 15 (**4d4 + 5**) necrotic damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 18 Strength saving throw or be grappled (escape DC 18) and pulled into the tar-rasque's maw. Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained, takes 15 (**4d4 + 5**) necrotic damage at the start of each of its turns, and the tar-rasque can't use its tongue on another target.

actions.name: Claws
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +10 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. *Hit:* 19 (**4d6 + 5**) slashing damage.

actions.name: Tail
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +10 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. *Hit:* 15 (**4d4 + 5**) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 18 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

actions.name: Necrotaruption (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: The tar-rasque exhales a torrent of thick tar-phlegm in a 40-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 18 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 21 (**6d6**) necrotic damage and is restrained until the end of the tar-rasque's next turn. On a successful save, the creature takes half as much damage and isn't restrained. In addition, until the end of the tar-rasque's next turn, the area is difficult terrain for other creatures and a creature that starts its turn in the area or enters it for the first time on its turn takes 10 (**3d6**) necrotic damage.

entries: **Resistances**: acid, necrotic, piercing; bludgeoning, slashing from nonmagical attacks

traits.name: Arcane Power Source
traits.value: The crystal in the tarannosaurus' ribcagecan be targeted separately from the tarannosaurus (AC 19, 64 hit points, vulnerability to thunder damage, and immunity to all other damage types except bludgeoning, force, piercing, and slashing). If the tarannosaurus fails a saving throw against an area of effect, the crystal also fails the saving throw.

If the crystal is destroyed the tar elemental possessing the tarannosaurus moves into the nearest unoccupied space without provoking opportunity attacks and the tarannosaurus crumbles into a pile of inanimate bones.

traits.name: Flammable
traits.value: If the tarannosaurus takes fire damage, it ignites. It takes 10 (**3d6**) fire damage at the start of each of its turns and its melee attacks and Taruption deal an additional 10 (**3d6**) fire damage. If the tarannosaurus is subject to heavy rain or takes 10 or more cold damage in a single instance, the flames are extinguished and the effects end.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The tarannosaurus makes two attacks: one with its Bite and one with its Tail. It can't make both attacks against the same target. It can use Taruption in place of the Bite attack.

actions.name: Bite
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +12 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. *Hit:* 34 (**4d12 + 8**) piercing damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it is grappled (escape DC 20). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained and the tarannosaurus can't bite another target.

actions.name: Tail
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +12 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. *Hit:* 21 (**3d8 + 8**) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Taruption (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: The tarannosaurus launches a torrent of tar in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in the cone that isn't tar- or water-based must succeed on a DC 17 Strength saving throw or become restrained for 1 minute. A creature can use its action to make a DC 17 Strength check, ending the effect on itself on a success. This area is difficult terrain for 1 minute, or until it is cleaned.

traits.name: Arcane Power Source
traits.value: The crystal in the tarchaeologist's magitech pistol can be targeted separately from the tarchaeologist (AC 19, 20 hit points, vulnerability to thunder damage, and immunity to all other damage types except bludgeoning, force, piercing, and slashing). If the tarchaeologist fails a saving throw against an area of effect, the crystal also fails the saving throw.

If the crystal is destroyed, or if the tarchaeologist is disarmed of its pistol (it has a +7 modifier on ability checks and saving throws to avoid being disarmed), the mini tar elemental possessing the tarchaeologist moves into the nearest unoccupied space without provoking opportunity attacks and the tarchaeologist falls unconscious and stable.

traits.name: Flammable
traits.value: If the tarchaeologist takes fire damage, it ignites. It takes 3 (**1d6**) fire damage at the start of each of its turns and its melee attacks deal an additional 3 (**1d6**) fire damage. If the tarchaeologist is subject to heavy rain or takes 5 or more cold damage in a single instance, the flames are extinguished and the effects end.

traits.name: Necromantic Reinvigoration (1/Ever)
traits.value: If the tarchaeologist is reduced to 0 hit points, its current hit point total instead resets to 52 hit points, its creature type changes to undead, and it gains immunity to poison damage and the poisoned condition.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The tarchaeologist makes three attacks: one with its Pseudopod, one with its Wrench, and one with its Magitech Pistol.

actions.name: Pseudopod
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +5 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. *Hit:* 5 (**1d4 + 3**) bludgeoning damage plus 7 (**2d6**) necrotic damage.

actions.name: Wrench
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 7 (**1d8 + 3**) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Magitech Pistol
actions.value: *Ranged Weapon Attack:* +5 to hit, range 40/120 ft., one target, loud (500 ft.), reload (2). *Hit:* 7 (**1d8 + 3**) piercing damage.

traits.name: Flammable
traits.value: If the tarling takes fire damage, it ignites. traits.name: Oil Form
traits.value: When the tarling tries to move through water, it instead uses its swimming speed to skim along the water's surface; it can't submerge below the surface of water without a powerful detergent.

actions.name: Bite
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 4 (**1d4 + 2**) piercing damage.

traits.name: Disaster Prone
traits.value: When the tatzling makes an ability check or attack roll and rolls a 1 on the d20, the results are often disastrous. The GM has great latitude when deciding the consequences of this trait triggering.

actions.name: Bite
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 5 (**1d6 + 2**) piercing damage.

actions.name: Claw
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 4 (**1d4 + 2**) slashing damage.

traits.name: Central Nervous System
traits.value: The mimic's brain is the central nervous system of the tavern mimic. The first time the brain takes damage on a turn, it takes an additional 7 (**2d6**) psychic damage. As a reaction to taking this damage, the brain can relocate itself to any location within the tavern.

traits.name: Grappler
traits.value: The brain has advantage on attack rolls against any creature grappled by it.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.value: If the brain fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Sensitive Gut
traits.value: The brain's blindsight extends throughout its interior structure.

traits.name: Shapechanger
traits.value: The brain can use its action to polymorph into a different building or back into its true, tavern form. Its statistics are the same in each form. Any equipment or creatures it is wearing or carrying aren't transformed. It reverts to its true form if it dies.

traits.name: Warded
traits.value: The brain can't be harmed or affected by attacks or effects that originate from outside of it.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The brain makes two attacks, one with its Pseudopod and one with its Squirt.

actions.name: Pseudopod
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. *Hit:* 14 (**2d8 + 5**) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Squirt
actions.value: *Ranged Weapon Attack:* +9 to hit, range 20/60 ft., one target. *Hit:* 14 (**2d8 + 5**) acid damage.

fluffInfo.name: (5+) Odd Bone Structure

fluffInfo.name: (10+) Squeezing Death

fluffInfo.name: Combat Tactics
fluffInfo.value: The Tentacled Dreg can use its tentacles to climb and swim much better than other Dregs, and so it likes to hide on perches or in water waiting for its unfortunate prey to come near. When it attacks, it Constricts its target, squeezing them to death with its many tentacles.
If outnumbered and below half of its Hit Points, a Tentacled Dreg will attempt to climb or swim to safety.

actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +5, reach 15 ft. *Hit:* 10 (**2d6 + 3**) Bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Constricting Tentacle

If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 13). Until this grapple ends, the target has the Restrained condition, takes 10 (**2d6 + 3**) Bludgeoning damage plus 7 (**2d6**) Necrotic damage at the start of each of its turns, and the dreg can't make Constricting Tentacle attacks.

traits.name: Reactive Mutations
traits.value: Immediately after the ooze takes damage, it gains resistance to that damage type. The ooze can have up to two resistances from this trait. If the ooze has its maximum number of resistances, the oldest resistance is lost when a new one is gained.

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.value: The ooze can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

actions.name: Engulf
actions.value: The ooze moves up to its speed. While doing so, it can enter Tiny creatures' spaces. Whenever the ooze enters a creature's space, the creature must make a DC 12 Dexterity saving throw.
On a successful save, the creature can choose to be pushed 5 feet back or to the side of the ooze. A creature that chooses not to be pushed suffers the consequences of a failed saving throw.

On a failed save, the ooze enters the creature's space, and the creature takes 5 (**2d4**) acid damage and is engulfed. The engulfed creature can't breathe, is restrained, and takes 10 (**4d4**) acid damage at the start of each of the ooze's turns. When the ooze moves, the engulfed creature moves with it.
An engulfed creature can try to escape by taking an action to make a DC 12 Strength check. On a success, the creature escapes and enters a space of its choice within 5 feet of the ooze.

It can choose the same or different disguises for each affected creature. When cast in this manner, the effect lasts for 1 minute or until the initiated chooses to dismiss it from that creature.

bonusActions.name: Malignant Transposition (3/Day)
bonusActions.value: The initiated creates clouds in a 5-ft radius Sphere in its space and in up to three additional spaces it can see within 60 feet. The Spheres are Heavily Obscured except to the initiated. The Spheres last until the start of the initiate's next turn, or they can be dispersed by a strong wind.

When the clouds appear, the initiated can target one creature in one cloud with the following effect. *Charisma Saving Throw:* DC 15. *Failure:* The creature swaps places with the initiated. The initiated can also teleport themselves to an unoccupied space within one of the other clouds.

fluffInfo.name: Study the Foe
fluffInfo.value: Characters proficient in *Arcana* or *History* gain Advantage on Intelligence (*Religion*) checks when they take the Study action to examine The Algorithm, learning the following based on their result:

fluffInfo.name: (20+) Practically Impervious
fluffInfo.value: You learn the Algorithm's Immunities.

fluffInfo.name: (25+) Order and Consequence
fluffInfo.value: You are aware of the creature's Predictive Analytics trait.

fluffInfo.name: (30+) Enduring Intellect
fluffInfo.value: You recognize The Algorithm's highest and lowest ability scores and saving throws

fluffInfo.name: Roleplaying Traits
fluffInfo.value: The Algorithm is nigh incomprehensible.

entries: **Personality Trait:** "I speak down to mortal creatures, for they cannot begin to comprehend the depth of my knowledge, or the details of the cosmos. They are but simple accidents in a sea of chaos that must be corrected."
**Bond:** "I am bound to the order of all things, It is my cosmic ordained purpose to bring order to the chaos of the universe."
**Ideal:** "Order out of Chaos is perfection, I will achieve perfection."
**Flaw:** "No one is as humble as I!"

fluffInfo.name: Combat Tactics
fluffInfo.value: The Algorithm is a creature of order and consequence. It sees all of the Space Between Worlds and every reality as a confusing mass of chaos that must be rearranged and perfected. When The Algorithm encounters mortal creatures, it will attempt to organize them as best suits it using its wires and Algorithmic Manipulation to forcibly move them.
It will convert problematic creatures into obedient androids using its Reprogram ability, and any who threaten it are reduced to atoms using Deatomization.

If The Algorithm has created a cyborg using Reprogram, or if there are extra constructs from previous failed experiments nearby, The Algorithm can assume direct control of them, deatomizating itself and entering the construct to use as a suit of armor.

If the combat becomes too stressful or problematic for The Algorithm, and it is unable to control or organize the situation in a way that benefits it, it may get frustrated and begin Deatomizating everything. If that doesn't work, it flees into the void to find something more easily manipulated to work on.
