traits.name: Electronic Data Network
traits.value: A creature that starts its turn within 60 feet of the Algorithm takes 21 (**6d6**) Lightning damage.

traits.name: Immutable Form
traits.value: The Algorithm is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form.

traits.name: Predictive Analytics
traits.value: At the end of each of the Algorithm's turns, it rolls 1d20 for each player character fighting it. The Algorithm can replace any D20 Test made by it or a creature it can see with one of these predictive rolls. It must choose to do so before the roll, and it can replace a roll in this way only once per turn.
Each predictive roll can be used only once. Any unused predictive rolls are lost at the start of the Algorithm's next turn.

actions.name: The Algorithm always takes its turn on Initiative count 20
actions.value: On its turn, the Algorithm can use its movement and interaction as normal. However, it does not take an action or Bonus Action on its turn unless forced to do so by a spell or other effect. Instead, the Algorithm takes one of the following Epic Actions at the end of each player character's turn:

entries: **Wire**: *Dexterity Saving Throw:* DC 26, one creature the Algorithm can see within 60 feet. *Failure:* 21 (**2d10 + 10**) Force damage, and if the target is a Huge or smaller creature, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 20). The Algorithm can grapple up to six creatures at a time.

**Algorithmic Manipulation**: *Strength Saving Throw:* DC 26, one Huge or smaller creature or object the Algorithm can see within 120 feet. *Failure:* The Algorithm moves the target up to 30 feet in any direction, and the target has the Restrained condition. If the Algorithm lifts the target into the air, it is suspended there. The target remains held until the Algorithm releases it (no action required), uses this Epic Action again, or has the Incapacitated condition.

**Deatomization**: *Constitution Saving Throw:* DC 26, one creature or object the Algorithm can see within 300 feet. *Failure:* 65 (**10d12**) Necrotic damage. If this damage reduces the target to 0 Hit Points, it dies and its body is reduced to atoms. *Failure:* Half damage.

actions.name: Reprogram (1/Round)
actions.value: *Intelligence Saving Throw:* DC 26, one creature Grappled by the algorithm. *Failure:* 55 (**10d10**) Piercing damage. If this damage reduces the target to 0 Hit Points, it dies and its brain is replaced with mechanical components. The target reanimates at the start of its next turn as a Construct under the Algorithm's control. It resembles the original creature, but its eyes glow with synthetic green light, and its body is covered in protruding wires, metal scraps, and glowing tubes.

actions.name: Assuming Direct Control (1/Round)
actions.value: The Algorithm targets a Construct within 120 feet and immediately enters and takes control of it. The Algorithm can still use its Epic Actions as normal and replaces the Construct's game statistics with its own, except the Construct's Hit Points. When the Construct is reduced to 0 Hit Points, the Algorithm reemerges in an unoccupied space within 15 feet of it.

actions.name: Epic Resistance
actions.value: The Algorithm chooses one condition, spell, or other effect currently affecting them and rolls 1d20. On an 11+, the effect ends on it. The Algorithm can use this action even if it would otherwise be unable to take actions, its actions are being controlled by another creature, or if a spell or effect alters its game statistics.

fluffInfo.name: Study the Foe
fluffInfo.value: Characters proficient in *Nature* or *Survival* gain Advantage on Intelligence (*Arcana*) checks when they take the Study action to examine the Duchess. They learn the following information based on their check result.

fluffInfo.name: (10+) Eldritch Abomination
fluffInfo.value: You understand her Resistances and Immunities.

fluffInfo.name: (15+) Thought Control
fluffInfo.value: You recognize her Deep Domination ability.

fluffInfo.name: (20+) Water Affinity
fluffInfo.value: You learn of the Duchess's Moisture Regeneration ability.

fluffInfo.name: Combat Tactics
fluffInfo.value: The Duchess never confronts her enemies on their terms, preferring to stay in her lair where it is safe. She ventures as far as the edges of contaminated water, knowing full well that the water sustains her. When confronting foes in combat, she uses her Deep Domination on her enemies while calling in reinforcements with Call of the Deep. She grabs foes and flings them away to keep her enemies focused on her dominated minions.

Unless in her lair, she flees the moment she doesn't like the odds of a fight. If she is in her lair, she flees only if she is reduced below 100 Hit Points to attempt to find a new location in contaminated water to build a new lair.

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.value: The Duchess can breathe air and water.

traits.name: Aura of the Deep
traits.value: A creature that starts its turn within 60 feet of the Duchess takes 14 (**4d6**) Psychic damage.

traits.name: Delerium Healing
traits.value: As an action, a creature can touch one of the Duchess's Delerium shards to regain 10 (3d6) Hit Points. Once a Delerium shard restores Hit Points in this way, it can't do so again for 24 hours.

traits.name: Fully Contaminated
traits.value: The Dutchess is immune to Contamination and has Advantage on saving throws against contaminated spells. The Dutchess may cast contaminated spells even though it does not gain Contamination levels.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.value: The Duchess has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Moisture Regeneration
traits.value: The Duchess regains 20 Hit Points at the start of each of her turns if she is submerged at least partially in water. She dies only if she starts her turn at 0 Hit Points and does not regenerate.

actions.name: The Duchess always takes her turn on Initiative count 20
actions.value: On her turn, the Duchess can use her movement and interaction as normal. However, she does not take an action or Bonus Action on her turn unless forced to do so by a spell or other effect. Instead, the Duchess takes one of the following Epic Actions at the end of each player character's turn:

actions.name: Bite
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +12, reach 10 ft. *Hit:* 16 (**3d6 + 6**) Piercing damage.

actions.name: Tentacle
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +12, reach 20 ft. *Hit:* 20 (**4d6 + 6**) Bludgeoning damage, and if the target is a Huge or smaller creature, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 20). The Duchess can have up to four creatures Grappled at a time.
At the start of each of its turns until the grapple ends, the target is subjected to the following effect. *Constitution Saving Throw:* DC 17. *Failure:* The target gains one Contamination level.

actions.name: Fling
actions.value: One Large or smaller object held or creature Grappled by the Duchess is thrown up to 60 feet in a direction of the Duchess's choice and has the Prone condition. If a thrown target strikes a solid surface, the target takes 3 (**1d6**) Bludgeoning damage for every 10 feet it was thrown. If the target is thrown at another creature, that creature must succeed on a DC 20 Dexterity saving throw or take the same damage and have the Prone condition.

actions.name: Deep Domination (1/Round)
actions.value: *Wisdom Saving Throw:* DC 20, one creature The Duchess can see. *Failure:* The target has the Charmed condition. The target is under the Duchess's control and can't take Reactions. The Duchess and the target can communicate telepathically over any distance.

Whenever the target takes damage, it repeats the save, ending the effect on itself on a success. On a failure, it gains one Contamination level. Once every 24 hours, if the creature is at least 1 mile away from the Duchess, it can repeat the saving throw.
If the target undergoes a Monstrous Transformation, it becomes a __Deep Dreg Warrior__, a __Deep Knight__, or a __Deep Siren__, and is forever in thrall to the Duchess.

actions.name: Call of the Deep (1/Round)
actions.value: The Duchess calls forth up to five __Deep Dregs__ or one __Deep Knight__. The creatures appear in unoccupied spaces within 30 feet of the Duchess and remain until destroyed. The creatures act after the Duchess on the same Initiative count and are under her control.

actions.name: Epic Resistance
actions.value: The Duchess chooses one condition, spell, or other effect currently affecting her and rolls 1d20. On an 11+, the effect ends on her. The Duchess can use this action even if she would otherwise be unable to take actions, her actions are being controlled by another creature, or if a spell or effect alters her game statistics.

traits.name: Dying Gasp
traits.value: When the Horror dies, they begin to rupture in a vile explosion of viscera and necrotic energy. The creature who reduced the Horror to 0 hit points can make a DC 15 Charisma (*Persuasion*) check to appeal to Elyas's departing soul (no action required). On a successful check, his soul transforms the explosion and each enemy of the Grave Order within 30 feet of the Horror gains 7 (2d6) temporary hit points. On a failed check (or if no check is made), each creature within 15 feet of the Horror must make a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw, taking 4 (**1d8**) acid damage plus 4 (**1d8**) necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

actions.name: Spine Cleaver
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 8 (**1d8 + 4**) slashing damage, or 13 (**2d8 + 4**) slashing damage against a grappled target.

actions.name: Bone Hook
actions.value: *Ranged Weapon Attack:* +6 to hit, range 15 ft., one target. *Hit:* 7 (**1d6 + 4**) piercing damage. If the target is Medium or smaller, they are grappled (escape DC 14) and the Horror can pull the target up to 15 feet toward them.
Until this grapple ends, the Horror can't make a Bone Hook attack against another target.

bonusActions.name: Valor's Death
bonusActions.value: Each enemy within 10 feet of the Horror who can hear the Horror must succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened of the Horror for 1 minute (save ends at end of turn). If a creature's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for them, the creature is immune to the Horror's Valor's Death for 24 hours.

fluffInfo.name: Roleplaying Traits
fluffInfo.value: Capable of sustaining multiple separate telepathic conversations at once, The Whispered Promise addresses each character individually. They show images of the characters' desires and dreams, depicting them with outrageous fortunes and with immense power.

entries: **Personality Trait:** I whisper softly in mortal's ears... What do you yearn for? I have no interest in using it against you... only in making it a reality. Indulge yourself for a change...
**Ideal:** I want one thing, and one thing only... to provide you the thing you want most. Ask me, and I'll give it to you. What can I give you that you truly desire?
**Bond:** If there's ever a stranger you can trust, it's me. Any deal we made would be signed and sealed. Other demons may utter lies, but I whisper promises... and I keep my promises.
**Flaw:** Are you certain you would deny me? I dislike being turned down...why wait for what you deserve? If you change your mind...you need only whisper...and I'll be there...

fluffInfo.name: Study the Foe
fluffInfo.value: Characters proficient in *Arcana* or *History* gain Advantage on Intelligence (*Religion*) checks when they take the Study action to examine The Whispered Promise, learning the following based on the result:

fluffInfo.name: (20+) Demonic Power
fluffInfo.value: You are aware of its Truesight and Telepathy, its Immunities, and Epic Resistance. You also know this eldritch entity is beyond life and death and can reform years later if killed.

fluffInfo.name: (25+) Enraptured Presence
fluffInfo.value: You are aware of the creature's Alluring Aura trait.

fluffInfo.name: (30+) Powerful Presence
fluffInfo.value: You know The Whispered Promise's highest and lowest ability scores and saving throws.

fluffInfo.name: Combat Tactics
fluffInfo.value: The Whispered Promise regards battle as a physical expression of their ability to control others. It uses Alluring Aura to prevent attacks and they negate resistances to its psychic onslaught by grappling with its Unravelling Resolve trait. They sow discord using __Mass Suggestion__, __Dominate Monster__, and their Dominate power, revealing in the resentment, jealousy, disdain, envy, and anger its foes have towards one another.

fluffInfo.name: Animus:
fluffInfo.value: Fiend.

fluffInfo.name: Fluid:
fluffInfo.value: Monster Blood.

fluffInfo.name: Organs:
fluffInfo.value: Heart.

fluffInfo.name: Natural Weapons:
fluffInfo.value: Teeth, Claws.

fluffInfo.name: Hide:
fluffInfo.value: Skin.

entries: **Immunities**: poison, psychic; charmed, exhaustion, frightened, poisoned

traits.name: Alluring Aura
traits.value: The Whispered Promise projects a 30-foot Emanation of beguiling enchantment. A creature that ends its turn in the Emanation has the Charmed condition for 1 hour. Each time the creature takes damage other than Psychic damage, it makes a DC 25 Wisdom saving throw. On a success, the Charmed condition ends for that creature, and it is immune to the Alluring Aura of the Whispered Promise for 24 hours.

traits.name: Change Shape
traits.value: The Whispered Promise has no true form and chooses how they manifest to each creature (no action required). Their form can be anything they wish; they can appear like a creature, object, or even as a multisensory representation of an abstract concept. They can appear to be any form that is Large or smaller, but their game statistics are the same in each form.

traits.name: Inscrutable
traits.value: The Whispered Promise is immune to any effect that would sense their emotions or read their thoughts, as well as any divination spell that they refuse. Wisdom (*Insight*) checks made to ascertain the Whispered Promise's intentions or sincerity have Disadvantage.

traits.name: Glibness
traits.value: When they make a Charisma (*Deception*) check, the Whispered Promise treats any roll of 14 or less on the d20 as 15.

traits.name: Unravelling Resolve
traits.value: Creatures grappled by the Whispered Promise can't benefit from Resistance and Immunity to Psychic damage or the Charmed condition.

actions.name: The Whispered Promise always takes their turn on Initiative count 20
actions.value: On their turn, the Whispered Promise can use their movement and interaction as normal. However, they do not take an action or Bonus Action on their turn unless forced to do so by a spell or other effect. Instead, the Whispered Promise takes one of the following Epic Actions at the end of each player character's turn:

entries: **Tendril**: *Melee Attack Roll:* +17, reach 10 ft. *Hit:* 28 (**4d8 + 10**) Force damage, and the target has the Grappled condition (escape DC 25). While Grappled, the target has the Restrained condition.

**Whispers (1/Round)**: *Intelligence Saving Throw:* DC 25. one creature the Whispered Promise can see within 300 feet. *Failure:* 35 (**10d6**) Psychic damage, and the target is Dazed (save ends). *Success* Half damage. Failure by five or more: Double damage, and the target is Stunned until the end of its next turn.

actions.name: Promises (1/Round)
actions.value: *Charisma Saving Throw:* DC 25, one creature the Whispered Promise can see within 300 feet. *Failure:* 35 (**10d6**) Psychic damage, and the target is Jinxed (1d10) (save ends). *Success* Half damage. Failure by 5 or more: Double damage, and the target becomes cursed. While cursed, the target can't regain Hit Points and gains no benefits from taking a Short or Long Rest.

actions.name: Unfettered Glide
actions.value: The Whispered Promise moves up to their Speed without provoking Opportunity Attack action.

actions.name: Dominate (1/Round)
actions.value: *Wisdom Saving Throw:* DC 25, one creature the Whispered Promise can see within 300 feet. *Failure:* The creature has the Charmed condition until the end of its next turn. While Charmed, the target obeys the Whispered Promise's commands and can't take Reactions. Failure by 5 or More: The Charmed condition instead lasts for 24 hours or until the Whispered Promise is reduced to 0 Hit Points. Each time the target takes damage, it repeats the save, ending the effect on itself on a success. *Success* The target has Disadvantage on its next attack roll against the Whispered Promise.

actions.name: Epic Resistances
actions.value: The Whispered Promise chooses one condition, spell, or other effect currently affecting them and rolls 1d20. On an 11+, the effect ends on them. The Whispered Promise can use this action even if they would otherwise be unable to take actions, their actions are being controlled by another creature, or if a spell or effect alters their game statistics.

traits.name: Delerium Storm Aura
traits.value: A creature that starts its turn within 120 feet of the World Ender takes 21 (**6d6**) Lightning damage and is subjected to the following effect. *Constitution Saving Throw:* DC 24. *Failure:* The target gains one Contamination level.

traits.name: Immutable Form
traits.value: The World Ender is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form.

traits.name: Mutations Abound
traits.value: A creature that gains a Contamination level from the World Ender's Delerium Storm Aura must roll 2d6 and take the lower result to determine if they mutate. Whenever a creature within the aura gains a mutation, that creature must roll twice on the [Mutations](https://5e.tools/tables.html#mutations_monstersofdrakkenheim) table and gains both mutations.

traits.name: Rejuvenation
traits.value: If the World Ender is destroyed, it regains all of its Hit Points in 1 hour unless a __Wish__ spell is used to prevent it from rejuvenating. This is a stressful use of the __Wish__ spell.

traits.name: Siege Monster
traits.value: The World Ender deals double damage to objects and structures.

traits.name: Unbound Arcana
traits.value: Whenever the World Ender is the target of a spell, an [Arcane Anomalies](https://5e.tools/tables.html#arcane%20anomalies_monstersofdrakkenheim) is triggered on the caster.

actions.name: The World Ender always takes its turn on Initiative count 20
actions.value: On its turn, the World Ender can use its movement and interaction as normal. However, it does not take an action or Bonus Action on its turn unless forced to do so by a spell or other effect. Instead, the World Ender takes one of the following Epic Actions at the end of each player character's turn:

actions.name: Necrotic Claw
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +19, reach 15 ft. *Hit:* 37 (**5d10 + 10**) Necrotic damage.

actions.name: Bite (1/Round)
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +19, reach 15 ft. *Hit:* 26 (**3d10 + 10**) Piercing damage, and if the target is a creature, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 27). While Grappled, the target has the Restrained condition and the World Ender can't Bite another target.

actions.name: Charge Eradication Beam (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: Octarine energy ripples through the body of the World Ender from its tail up to its head. The World Ender's Eradication Beam recharges, and it chooses the direction it will face to unleash its Eradication Beam.

The World Ender can only use this Epic Action if it's the first Epic Action it has taken this round. After using this Epic Action, The World Ender can't use Bite, Bellowing Roar, or Devour until the start of the next round.

actions.name: Eradication Beam (Special Recharge)
actions.value: The World Ender can only use this Epic Action if it's the last Epic Action it takes this round. *Constitution Saving Throw:* DC 27, each creature and object in a 1000-foot long, 20-foot wide Line. *Failure:* 110 (**20d10**) Force damage. *Success* Half damage. *Failure or Success*: A creature is disintegrated along with anything it is wearing or carrying if this damage leaves it with 0 Hit Points, and can't be revived except by a __Wish__ spell.
The Eradication Beam destroys any __Wall of Force__, __Forcecage__, or __Prismatic Wall__ spell within its area. It also damages unattended magic items in its area, including artifacts.

actions.name: Octarine Lightning Strike
actions.value: *Dexterity Saving Throw:* DC 27, each creature in a 10-foot radius Sphere centered on a point within 500 feet. *Failure:* 54 (**12d8**) Lightning damage, and the target has the Shocked condition until the start of its next turn. *Success* Half damage only.

actions.name: Bellowing Roar (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
actions.value: *Wisdom Saving Throw:* DC 27, each creature in a 120-foot Emanation originating from the World Ender that can hear it. *Failure:* The target has the Deafened condition (save ends). While Deafened, the target has Disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks.

actions.name: Ground Slam (1/Round)
actions.value: *Strength Saving Throw:* DC 27, each creature on the ground in a 30-foot Cone. *Failure:* 26 (**4d12**) Bludgeoning damage, and the target is pushed 10 feet away from the World Ender and has the Prone condition. *Failure or Success*: The Cone becomes Difficult Terrain until the start of the World Ender's next turn.

actions.name: Devour
actions.value: The World Ender can't take this Epic Action if it has used its Bite Epic Action this round. The World ender makes a Bite attack against a Large or smaller creature it has Grappled. If the attack hits, the target takes the Bite's damage, the target is swallowed, and the grapple ends. While swallowed, the creature has the Blinded and Restrained conditions, it has Total Cover against effects originating from outside the World Ender, and it takes 56 (**16d6**) Acid damage and gains a Contamination level at the start of each of the World Ender's turns.

If the World Ender takes 60 damage or more on a single turn from a creature inside it, the World Ender must succeed on a DC 20 Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate all swallowed creatures, which land in unoccupied spaces within 10 feet of the World Ender with the Prone condition. If the World Ender dies, a swallowed creature no longer has the Restrained condition and can escape from the corpse by using 30 feet of movement, exiting with the Prone condition.

actions.name: Epic Resistance
actions.value: The World Ender chooses one condition, spell, or other effect currently affecting them and rolls 1d20. On an 11+, the effect ends on it. The World Ender can use this Epic Action even if it would otherwise be unable to take actions, its actions are being controlled by another creature, or if a spell or effect alters its game statistics.

fluffInfo.name: Roleplaying Traits
fluffInfo.value: This cosmic entity's interactions are marked by caprice and whimsy.

entries: **Personality Trait:** One moment, I might bestow affectionte purrs and nuzzles; the next, I display utter aloofness or sudden ire, swiping with claws of dark matter that rend the veil between sanity and madness.
**Ideal:** My actions are neither cruel nor kind. Mortals cannot know my unfathomable perspective, and that is why they will always be inferior.
**Bond:** I am endlessly entertained by the unpredictability of mortals; their fears, their surprises, and their schemes are like strings of yarn I cannot resist batting at with my cosmic paws.
**Flaw:** My boundless curiosity and the mere whim to explore the forbidden often lead me to stir chaos in realms both mortal and divine, sometimes unraveling threads better left untouched

fluffInfo.name: Study the Foe
fluffInfo.value: Characters proficient in *History* or *Religion* gain Advantage on Intelligence (*Arcana*) checks when they take the Study action to examine the Thing with the Writhing Tail, learning the following based on their result:

fluffInfo.name: (20+) Eldritch Aberration
fluffInfo.value: You are aware of its Truesight and Telepathy, its Immunities, and its Epic Resistance. You also know this eldritch entity is beyond life and death and can reform years later if killed.

fluffInfo.name: (25+) Fear and Madness
fluffInfo.value: You learn of its Purring Aura, as well as its spellcasting Epic Actions.

fluffInfo.name: (30+) Brilliant and Nimble
fluffInfo.value: You know the Thing with the Writhing Tail's highest and lowest ability scores and saving throws.

fluffInfo.name: Combat Tactics
fluffInfo.value: In battle, the Thing with the Writhing Tail uses Manifest Duplicate to create numerous copies of itself. It teleports and swaps places with its duplicates as its rends its foes apart. The many duplicates vastly expand the range of its Purring Aura, sowing terror and madness in any who try to oppose them.

The Thing with the Writhing Tail may grow suddenly bored in the middle of combat, deciding to inexplicably flee or change tactics to a new fixation. Other times, it plays cat and mouse with its foes, toying with them like living balls of yarn.

fluffInfo.name: Animus:
fluffInfo.value: Aberration.

fluffInfo.name: Fluid:
fluffInfo.value: Monster Blood.

fluffInfo.name: Organs:
fluffInfo.value: Heart, Eyes.

fluffInfo.name: Natural Weapons:
fluffInfo.value: Teeth, Claws.

fluffInfo.name: Hide:
fluffInfo.value: Fur.

traits.name: Avoidance
traits.value: If the Thing with the Writhing Tail is subjected to an effect that allows it to make a saving throw to take only half damage, it instead takes no damage if it succeeds on the saving throw, and only half damage if it fails.

traits.name: Incorporeal Movement
traits.value: The Thing with the Writhing Tail can move through other creatures and objects as if they were Difficult Terrain. It takes 5 (**1d10**) Force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

traits.name: Inscrutable
traits.value: The Thing with the Writhing Tail is immune to any effect that would sense its emotions or read its thoughts, as well as any divination spell that it refuses. Wisdom (*Insight*) checks made to ascertain the being's intentions or sincerity have Disadvantage.

traits.name: Purring Aura
traits.value: The Thing with the Writhing Tail projects a 30-foot Emanation of madness and dread. A creature that ends its turn in the Emanation has the Frightened condition for 1 hour. A creature can take an action to attempt to overcome its fear, making a DC 25 Wisdom saving throw. *Failure:* The target takes 27 (**5d10**) Psychic damage. *Success* The Frightened condition ends for that creature, and it becomes immune to the Purring Aura of the Thing with the Writhing Tail for 24 hours.

traits.name: Quantum Displacement
traits.value: The Thing with the Writhing Tail shifts between realities and timelines. Attack rolls against it have Disadvantage, and it has Advantage on saving throws. If it is hit by an attack or fails a saving throw, this trait is disrupted until it uses Phase Displacement. This trait is also disrupted while the Thing with the Writhing Tail has the Incapacitated condition or a Speed of 0.

actions.name: The Thing with the Writhing Tail always takes its turn on Initiative count 20
actions.value: On its turn, The Thing with the Writhing Tail can use its movement and interaction as normal. However, it does not take an action or Bonus Action on its turn unless forced to do so by a spell or other effect. Instead, The Thing with the Writhing Tail takes one of the following Epic Actions at the end of each player character's turn:

actions.name: Cosmic Claw
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +15, reach 10 ft. *Hit:* 29 (**4d10 + 8**) Force damage.

actions.name: Tail Whip
actions.value: *Intelligence Saving Throw:* DC 26, one creature the Thing with the Writhing Tail can see within 30 feet. *Failure:* 35 (**10d6**) Psychic damage, and the target has the Dazed condition (save ends). Failure by 5 or More: 70 (**20d6**) Psychic damage, and the target instead has the Stunned condition (save ends). *Success* Half damage only.

actions.name: Manifest Duplicate (1/Round)
actions.value: The Thing with the Writhing Tail creates a perfect visual illusion of itself in an unoccupied space it can see within 300 feet. The illusion is intangible and doesn't occupy its space. The duplicate lasts for 1 minute, but it ends early if the Thing with the Writhing Tail dismisses it (no action required) or has the Incapacitated condition. The Thing with the Writhing Tail can have a up to eight illusory duplicates at a time. While it has one or more duplicates, it has the following benefits:

actions.name: Attacks and Spells
actions.value: The Thing with the Writhing Tail can cast spells, use Tail Whip, and make Claw attacks as if was in an illusory duplicate's space.

actions.name: Aura Expansion
actions.value: Each illusory duplicate emanates a Purring Aura. The effects of multiple overlapping auras do not stack; a creature is only affected once by the Purring Aura even if it is within range of multiple Emanations.

actions.name: Move
actions.value: Each time the Thing with the Writhing Tail takes this Epic Action, it can move any number of illusions up to 60 feet to unoccupied spaces within 300 feet of itself.

actions.name: Distract
actions.value: When both the Thing with the Writhing Tail and one of its illusory duplicates are within 10 feet of a creature that can see them, the Thing with the Writhing Tail has Advantage on attack rolls against that creature.

actions.name: Sense
actions.value: The Thing with the Writhing Tail can see and hear through each of its illusory duplicates.

actions.name: Phase Displacement
actions.value: The Thing with the Writhing Tail teleports, swapping places with one of its illusory duplicates. If its Quantum Displacement trait was disrupted, it is no longer disrupted.

actions.name: Epic Resistance
actions.value: The Thing with the Writhing Tail chooses one condition, spell, or other effect currently affecting it and rolls 1d20. On an 11+, the effect ends on it. The Thing with the Writhing Tail can use this action even if it would otherwise be unable to take actions, its actions are being controlled by another creature, or if a spell or effect alters its game statistics.

entries: **Personality Trait:** Too many thoughts, all the time, my mind is free, uncontained!
**Bond:** I did what I had to! My mind was too valuable to let go to waste, I had to preserve it, to improve it!
**Ideal:** I avoided death to continue to pursue the vast unknown of my scientific study. My research will change the world, I just need more time!
**Flaw:** I cannot fathom the monster I have become, and to witness myself is a horror I cannot endure.

fluffInfo.name: Study the Foe
fluffInfo.value: Characters proficient in *Medicine* gain Advantage on Wisdom (*Insight*) or Intelligence (*Investigation*) checks to Study the Think Tank, learning the following based on the result:

fluffInfo.name: (15+) Tear the Mind
fluffInfo.value: You recognize the Think Tank's Nightmare Aura.

fluffInfo.name: (20+) Gravity Control
fluffInfo.value: You know of the Think Tank's Unbind Gravity Epic Action.

fluffInfo.name: (25+) Protected Regenerator
fluffInfo.value: You learn of its Shield Generator and Life Support System traits and identifies its location.

fluffInfo.name: Combat Tactics
fluffInfo.value: Due to the nature of its Life Support System, the Think Tank is seldom encountered outside its lair, which is always a well-defended and secret location. The mastermind surrounds itself with powerful abominations, and protects its sanctum with traps, defensible locations, and escape routes. A Think Tank's lair may include elements that are outright hostile to living organisms, such as radiation, contamination, or deadly neurotoxin. As such, player characters encountering the Think Tank in combat must have already outmaneuvered it somehow to gain access to its innermost lair.

The Think Tank makes for a climatic encounter against a villainous foe. Before the player characters even get close to the Think Tank, it will have tested their abilities many times against its minions, using its telepathic eavesdropping to learn everything it can about them. The Think Tank knows when they are coming, how they are approaching, as well as their abilities, spells, equipment, and their expected tactics.

The Think Tank uses Unbind Gravity and Mind Cage to control the battlefield, while using Pluck the Puppet Strings to turn any remaining targets against its other foes. Its Telekinetic Grip can help it further control enemy positions while using Contaminated Blast to slowly contaminate them to death, picking on whoever has the most Contamination going into the encounter.

fluffInfo.name: Animus:
fluffInfo.value: Monstrosity.

fluffInfo.name: Fluid:
fluffInfo.value: Contaminated Ichor, Chemical Solution.

fluffInfo.name: Organs:
fluffInfo.value: Brain.

fluffInfo.name: Bones:
fluffInfo.value: Skull, Spine.

fluffInfo.name: Natural Weapons:
fluffInfo.value: Tentacles.

fluffInfo.name: Hide:
fluffInfo.value: Plates.

traits.name: Fully Contaminated
traits.value: The Think Tank is immune to Contamination and has Advantage on saving throws against contaminated spells. The Think Tank may cast contaminated spells even though it does not gain Contamination levels.

traits.name: Life Support System
traits.value: The Think Tank is protected by three machine nodes that make up its Life Support System. The nodes are positioned in a triangle, each no further than 30 feet apart from the rest. Each node is a Large object with AC 20, 25 Hit Points per player character, and Immunity to Poison and Psychic damage. The Think Tank can't move or be moved more than 60 feet away from any two of its Life Support System nodes.

traits.name: Nightmare Aura
traits.value: A creature that starts its turn within 120 feet of the Think Tank takes 14 (**4d6**) Psychic damage.

traits.name: Shield Generator
traits.value: As long as at least one machine node in the Life Support System remains, the Think Tank's Immunities can't be ignored except by effects caused by level 9 spells or artifacts. If all nodes are destroyed, the Think Tank loses its Immunities.

traits.name: Telepathic Eavesdropping
traits.value: The Think Tank can project its consciousness to see and hear any creature or location within 5 miles as if it had cast __Scrying__ (no action required). It can read the thoughts of creatures in this area, communicate with them telepathically, and listen in on telepathic communications which occur between other creatures in the region. It remains aware of its own surroundings while doing so. It cannot observe the area within a Private Sanctum spell or locations and creatures protected by magic which blocks divination or scrying sensors.

actions.name: The Think Tank always takes its turn on Initiative count 20
actions.value: On its turn, the Think Tank can use its movement and interaction as normal. However, it does not take an action or Bonus Action on its turn unless forced to do so by a spell or other effect. Instead, the Think Tank takes one of the following Epic Actions at the end of each player character's turn:

entries: **Contaminated Blast**: *Melee or Ranged Attack Roll:* +12, reach 10 ft., or range 120 ft. *Hit:* 32 (**4d12 + 6**) Necrotic damage. *Constitution Saving Throw:* DC 20. *Failure:* The target gains a Contamination level.

**Telekinetic Grip**: The Think Tank reaches out with its mind to hold one creature or object it can see within 120 feet of it in its psychic grasp. If the target is a creature, it is subjected to the following effect. *Strength Saving Throw:* DC 20. *Failure:* 28 (**8d6**) Force damage, and the target is moved up to 30 feet in any direction and has the Restrained condition until it escapes or the Think Tank has the Incapacitated condition. The Think Tank can hold up to two creatures or objects in its grip at one time. On its turn, a held creature can take an action to repeat the save, escaping the grip on a success.
If the target is an object weighing 1,000 pounds or less that isn't being worn or carried, it is telekinetically moved up to 30 feet in any direction. The Think Tank can also exert fine control on objects with its telekinesis, such as manipulating surgical tools or opening a door or a container.

**Pluck the Puppet Strings**: *Wisdom Saving Throw:* DC 20, one creature within 120 feet of the Think Tank. *Failure:* 14 (**4d6**) Psychic damage, and the target must use its Reaction to move up to its Speed directly toward a creature of the Think Tank's choice. If the target ends this movement within reach of the chosen creature, it must make a melee weapon attack against that creature with Advantage.

actions.name: Mind Cage (1/Round)
actions.value: *Intelligence Saving Throw:* DC 20, one creature the Think Tank can see within 120 feet. *Success* 33 (**6d10**) Psychic damage. *Failure:* 33 (**6d10**) Psychic damage, and the target perceives itself to be trapped within a nightmare conjured forth from the depths of its own psyche until it escapes. While trapped, the target has the Immobilized, Blinded, and Deafened conditions. On its turn, the target can take an action to repeat the save. Each time it does, it takes 33 (**6d10**) psychic damage. On a success, the effect ends for it.

actions.name: Unbind Gravity (1/Round)
actions.value: The Think Tank controls gravity in a 200-foot Cube centered on itself until the end of the next round. Each time the Think Tank uses this Epic Action, it decides which direction gravity pulls within the area. All creatures and objects that aren't somehow anchored to the ground in the area fall in the chosen direction until they reach the edge of the area. A creature can make a DC 20 Dexterity saving throw to grab onto a fixed object it can reach, avoiding the fall on a success.

If some solid object (such as a ceiling) is encountered in this fall, falling objects and creatures strike it just as they would during a normal downward fall. If an object or creature reaches the edge of the area without striking anything, it remains there, oscillating slightly, for the duration.

Alternatively, the Think Tank can decide to prevent gravity from acting within the area. When it does, creatures within the area without a Fly Speed levitate in midair, and must move by pushing or pulling against a fixed object or surface within reach (such as a wall or a ceiling), which allows them to move as if they were climbing. Unattended objects float around randomly.
If the Think Tank doesn't use this Epic Action during the next round, the effect ends and affected objects and creatures fall back down.

actions.name: Epic Resistance
actions.value: The Think Tank chooses one condition, spell, or other effect currently affecting them and rolls 1d20. On an 11+, the effect ends on it. The Think Tank can use this action even if it would otherwise be unable to take actions, its actions are being controlled by another creature, or if a spell or effect alters its game statistics.

entries: **Resistances**: cold, lightning; bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from mundane attacks
**Immunities**: poison, psychic; charmed, dazed, flanked, frightened, grappled, poisoned, prone, stunned

traits.name: Corpse Retreat (1/Day)
traits.value: The thornblood is a mass of thick, thorny vines that grow from a Medium humanoid corpse. When the thornblood is reduced to 0 hit points, they are reduced to 1 hit point instead and retreat into the corpse that grew them.

The thornblood becomes immune to all damage until the end of their next turn. Additionally, until the thornblood finishes a long rest, their size becomes Medium, their walking and climbing speeds become 60 feet, and they can't make Throttle attacks or benefit from the Overgrowth trait.

traits.name: Overgrowth
traits.value: The thornblood can move their vines through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing. The thornblood can occupy another creature's space and vice versa.

traits.name: Supernatural Resistance
traits.value: The thornblood has advantage on saving throws against powers, spells, and other supernatural effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The thornblood makes four attacks using Vinerip, Throttle, or both.

actions.name: Vinerip

fluffInfo.name: (5+) Resistant Form
fluffInfo.value: You know the creature's Resistances and Immunities.

fluffInfo.name: (10+) Ceaseless Pursuit
fluffInfo.value: You learn of the creature's Faultless
Tracker trait.

fluffInfo.name: (15+) Simple-Minded Construct

fluffInfo.name: Combat Tactics
fluffInfo.value: Tower Dragons defend strategic locations along the city walls. Most notably, these dragons animate to attack those who try to enter the city via the rivers, or any who attempt to fly above the walls of Castle Drakken. They are also drawn towards any extended engagement with Wall Gargoyles. Combat encounters lasting more than a minute against a gargoyles near the city walls will likely attract a Tower Dragon.

Typically, Tower Dragons attack from above, using their crackling breath weapons to devastate targets. Once animated, a Tower Dragon does not give up pursuit of their target until either it or is quarry is destroyed.

traits.value: When the troll is reduced to 0 hit points by any damage other than acid or fire damage, they don't die or fall unconscious, and can continue moving and taking actions as usual. The troll only dies if they end their turn with 0 hit points, if acid or fire damage reduces them to 0 hit points, or if they take acid or fire damage while they have 0 hit points.

traits.name: Sluggish
traits.value: For 1 hour after sleep or another period of unconsciousness, the troll's speed is halved and they can't use Multiattack.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The troll makes one Bite attack and two Claw attacks.

actions.name: Bite
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. *Hit:* 14 (**3d6 + 4**) piercing damage. If the target is not a Construct, an Elemental, or a Plant, the troll regains hit points equal to the damage dealt. If this attack reduces the target to 0 hit points, the troll regains twice as many hit points as they otherwise would with this attack.

actions.name: Claw
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. *Hit:* 7 (**1d6 + 4**) slashing damage.

actions.name: Crash Through
actions.value: The troll moves up to their speed in a straight line, smashing through mundane obstacles in their path. The troll can enter the spaces of Large or smaller creatures during this movement, forcing those creatures to make a DC 15 Strength saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 14 (**4d6**) bludgeoning damage and falls prone. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage and doesn't fall prone.

During this move, mundane objects that aren't worn or carried by a creature take 14 (**4d6**) damage when the troll enters their space. If the troll moves into the space of a Large or larger object and this damage doesn't destroy it, the troll's movement stops and they are stunned until the end of their next turn.

fluffInfo.name: Mothers of Mushrooms
fluffInfo.value: The Troll Hags are the keepers of fungus in the Trogrowth Forest of Caspia, and swamps all around the continent. They tend to mushroom gardens and carry large iron cauldrons filled with strange brews that they use to turn ordinary fungus into Trollings. Their gardens are family, and they protect them with their lives. If you go tromping through mushroom patches in a swamp, you best be ready to face the wrath of these mothers of mushrooms.

fluffInfo.name: Covens and Community
fluffInfo.value: Some Troll Hags are happy to live out their days undisturbed in the deepest reaches of dark forests and smelly swamps. They infest the forests with mushrooms and mycelia and keep their Trollings as family. Troll Hags have, in rare cases, formed covens of three. When these covens form it is often a problem, as three Troll Hags will overflow their territory with fungal growths, causing entire swamps and forests to decay, spilling hordes of __Fungal Trolls__ into nearby villages and towns.

fluffInfo.name: Roleplaying Traits
fluffInfo.value: The following traits can be used to inspire roleplaying a Troll Hag:

entries: **Personality Trait**: "I care for the fungal growths of the forest as if they were my own dear children. I speak to them, sing to them, and care for them as a mother would."
**Ideal**: "I will protect my mushroom children with my life, for they are the sole reason I am here"
**Bond**: "All things rot and decay. I am the one who aids the forest in that natural process."
**Epic Resistance**: "I will not tolerate those who do not respect the forests and swamps. I will seek vengeance on any who harm the fungus."

fluffInfo.name: (25+) Special Weakness

fluffInfo.name: Combat Tactics

traits.name: Apotheosis (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
traits.value: If the koboldzilla would be reduced to 0 hit points, its current hit point total instead resets to 462 hit points, it recharges its Dragon Breath, its Dexterity increases to 27 (+8), and its Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma increase to 20 (+5). Additionally, all kobold pilots are incinerated in the process, it can't use its Koboldapult legendary action until it finishes a short or long rest, and the koboldzilla can use the options in the "Mythic Actions" section for 1 hour. Award a party an additional 105,000 XP (210,000 XP total) for defeating the koboldzilla after its Apotheosis activates.

traits.name: Constructed Weakness
traits.value: The koboldzilla has the following flaws:

entries: **Arcanothermic Engine**: If the koboldzilla takes 30 or more cold damage in a single turn, it can't recharge its Dragon Breath action until the end of its next turn.
**Rustable**: If the koboldzilla takes 30 or more acid damage in a single turn, it becomes restrained until the end of its next turn.

traits.name: Immutable Form
traits.value: The koboldzilla is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.value: If the koboldzilla fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Loose Plating
traits.value: When the koboldzilla is reduce to 231 hit points or fewer for the first time since it last finished a long rest, it loses some of its armour plating. Its AC is reduced to 20, its walking speed is doubled, and its Dexterity increases to 20 (+5). These effects last until it finishes a long rest.

traits.name: Siege Monster
traits.value: The koboldzilla deals double damage to objects and structures.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The koboldzilla makes three attacks: one with its Dragon Bite, one with its Gazebo Smash, and one with its Tail. It can use Dragon Breath in place of its Dragon Bite.

actions.name: Dragon Bite
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +16 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. *Hit:* 30 (**4d10 + 8**) piercing damage.

actions.name: Gazebo Smash
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +16 to hit, reach 10 ft., each target within a 5-foot-radius circle. *Hit:* 26 (**4d8 + 8**) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Tail
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +16 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. *Hit:* 30 (**4d10 + 8**) slashing damage.

actions.name: Dragon Breath (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: The koboldzilla exhales fire in a 90-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 22 Dexterity saving throw, taking 63 (**18d6**) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

entries: **Resistances**: bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from mundane attacks
**Senses**: blindsight 60 ft. (blind beyond this radius), soulsight 30 ft.

traits.name: Lethe
traits.value: When the demon's soul count is 0, they have advantage on attack rolls, disadvantage on saving throws, and their Intelligence score becomes 3 (-4). Additionally, the demon must use their movement on each of their turns to move as close as possible to the nearest creature they can sense with their soulsight, and then if they are able, they must use their action to attack and attempt to kill that creature. The demon can't act with any other purpose until they add 1 to their soul count.

traits.name: Soul Devourer
traits.value: When the demon reduces a creature who isn't a Construct or an Undead to 0 hit points or deals damage to a dying creature, the creature must make a DC 11 Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the demon consumes the creature's soul and adds 1 to the demon's soul count. A creature whose soul is consumed in this way immediately dies, and they can't be restored to life by any means short of a __wish__ spell.

traits.name: Trample
traits.value: The demon can move through the spaces of Large or smaller creatures as if they were difficult terrain. When the demon enters a creature's space for the first time on the demon's turn, the demon can make a Stomp attack against that creature (no action required). Additionally, the demon can end their turn in the space of a prone creature who is Medium or smaller, and that creature can't stand up while in the demon's space.

actions.name: Gore
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. *Hit:* 19 (**3d8 + 6**) piercing damage. The demon can burn 1 soul to push the target up to 40 feet directly away from the demon.

actions.name: Stomp
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 13 (**2d6 + 6**) bludgeoning damage, and if the target is a Medium or smaller creature, they must succeed on a DC 17 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

actions.name: Tongue
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +9 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. *Hit:* 16 (**3d6 + 6**) slashing damage, and if the target is a creature, they must succeed on a DC 17 Strength saving throw or be pulled up to 10 feet toward the demon.

traits.name: Elf Glamour (1/Day)
traits.value: When a creature targets Tuval-Uthriar with an attack, power, or spell, the creature must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or be charmed by him until the end of his next turn (no action required).

traits.name: Supernatural Resistance
traits.value: Tuval-Uthriar has advantage on saving throws against powers, spells, and other supernatural effects.

traits.name: Wheel of Ire
traits.value: Each enemy within 30 feet of Tuval-Uthriar has disadvantage on attacks against creatures other than him.

actions.name: Multiattack

actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 9 (**1d8 + 5**) slashing damage, or 10 (**1d10 + 5**) slashing damage if used with two hands.

actions.name: Call Lightning (3/Day; 3rd-Level Spell)
actions.value: A magical bolt of lightning flashes down from the sky to a point Tuval-Uthriar can see within 120 feet of him. Each creature within 5 feet of that point must make a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw, taking 16 (**3d10**) lightning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

actions.name: Eye of Sunrise (1/Day)
actions.value: Tuval-Uthriar's gauntlet emits a fiery explosion in a 30-foot cone. The explosion can be heard 300 feet away. Each creature in that area must make a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw, taking 17 (**5d6**) fire damage plus 17 (**5d6**) force damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. Each structure and mundane object in the area that isn't being worn or carried takes 35 (**10d6**) fire damage plus 35 (**10d6**) force damage.

bonusActions.value: Tuval-Uthriar targets one creature who isn't a Construct or an Undead who he can see within 60 feet of him. The target regains 8 (2d4 + 3) hit points.

traits.name: Absorbing Flesh
traits.value: A creature reduced to 0 Hit Points by the growth is absorbed into its body and dies. When it absorbs a creature, the growth's size increases by one category. If the growth finishes a Long Rest and hasn't absorbed a body since its last Long Rest, its size decreases by one category.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The growth makes a number of attacks based on its size: two (Medium), three (Large), four (Huge) or five (Gargantuan).

actions.name: Assimilating Pseudopod
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +8, reach 10 ft. *Hit:* 14 (**2d8 + 5**) Necrotic damage, and if the target is smaller than the growth, it is subjected to the following effect. *Dexterity Saving Throw:* DC 16. *Failure:* The target is swallowed by the growth. A swallowed creature has the Blinded and Restrained conditions, has Total Cover from attacks and effects outside the growth, and takes 18 (**4d8**) Necrotic damage and the start of each of the growth's turns. The growth regains Hit Points equal to the amount of Necrotic damage dealt, and excess healing increases its Hit Point Maximum.

If the growth takes 20 damage or more on a single turn from a creature inside it, the growth must succeed on a DC 17 Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate all swallowed creatures, which land with the Prone condition in unoccupied spaces within 10 feet of the growth. If the growth dies, a swallowed creature no longer has the Restrained condition and can escape from the corpse using 20 feet of movement, exiting with the Prone condition.

fluffInfo.name: Combat Tactics

Undulating Polyps are not combatants and will do their best to escape combat if they feel threatened.

If the polyp takes damage, this trait ceases to function until the start of its next turn. This trait is suppressed while the polyp has the Incapacitated or Restrained conditions or is otherwise unable to move.

actions.value: The valochera douses a creature they have grappled with acid and then takes a bite. The target must make a DC 16 Dexterity saving throw, taking 22 (**4d10**) acid damage plus 14 (**2d8 + 5**) piercing damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

actions.name: Poison Glob (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: The valochera spits a glob of noxious sludge at a point they can see within 30 feet of them.

Each creature in a 5-foot-radius sphere centered on that point must make a DC 16 Constitution saving throw, taking 33 (**6d10**) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

traits.name: Radiant Aversion
traits.value: Each time the vampire takes radiant damage, they take an extra 10 radiant damage.

traits.name: Resting Place
traits.value: When the vampire drops to 0 hit points and is not in sunlight, running water, or their resting place, the vampire teleports to their resting place. While in their resting place, the vampire is stable. After spending 1 hour in their resting place with 0 hit points, they regain 1 hit point.

traits.name: Turn Resistance
traits.value: The vampire has advantage on saving throws against any effect that turns undead.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The vampire makes two Claw attacks and, if possible, a Bite attack.

actions.name: Claw
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 12 (**2d6 + 5**) slashing damage plus 10 (**3d6**) necrotic damage. If the target is Large or smaller, they are grappled (escape DC 18). While grappled in this way, the target is restrained. Moving while grappling a Medium or smaller creature doesn't halve the vampire's speed. A vampire can have only one target grappled in this way at a time.

actions.name: Bite
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature who is grappled by the vampire, incapacitated, or restrained. *Hit:* 8 (**1d6 + 5**) piercing damage plus 10 (**3d6**) necrotic damage. The target's hit point maximum is reduced by a number equal to the necrotic damage taken, and the vampire regains hit points equal to that number. The reduction lasts until reversed by a cure ailment power of 4th order or higher, a __greater restoration__ spell, or a similar supernatural effect. The target dies if this attack reduces their hit point maximum to 0. A Humanoid slain in this way rises the following midnight as a vampire spawn under the vampire's control.

actions.name: Exsanguinating Mist (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: The vampire, along with anything they are wearing or carrying, turns into a cloud of blood-sucking mist. When they do, they release any creature they were grappling, and if the vampire was grappled or restrained, that effect ends for them. Then the vampire flies up to twice their speed to an unoccupied space. During this move, the vampire ignores difficult terrain, doesn't provoke opportunity attacks, and can move through creatures and objects. Each creature the vampire passes through must make a DC 18 Constitution saving throw, taking 35 (**10d6**) necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. At the end of this movement, the vampire transforms back into their previous form.

bonusActions.name: Beguile
bonusActions.value: The vampire targets one creature they can see within 30 feet of them and who can see them. The target must make a DC 18 Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the target uses their reaction, if available, to move up to their speed to a location chosen by the vampire, then either makes a melee attack against a target of the vampire's choice or falls prone (vampire's choice).
Creatures who can't be charmed automatically succeed on this saving throw, and creatures who have advantage on saving throws against being charmed make this saving throw with advantage.

bonusActions.name: Inhuman Agility
bonusActions.value: The vampire moves up to their speed without provoking opportunity attacks.

traits.value: The Veiled Lady's telepathy extends throughout its lair. It communicates using images and emotion.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.value: If the Veiled Lady fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Mycelial Form
traits.value: The Veiled Lady can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check, and can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

traits.name: Sun Sickness
traits.value: While in sunlight, or if it takes 15 or more radiant damage in a single turn, the Veiled Lady has disadvantage on ability checks, attack rolls, and saving throws until the end of its next turn. The Veiled Lady dies if it spends more than 1 hour in direct sunlight.

traits.name: Symbiotic Vigour (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
traits.value: If the Veiled Lady would be reduced to 0 hit points, its current hit point total instead resets to 138 hit points, it gains 138 temporary hit points as beetles, hyphae, and grubs swarm over it, and it recharges its Infectious Spores and Shackles of Pain actions. Additionally, the Veiled Lady can use the options in the "Mythic Actions" section for 1 hour. Award a party an additional 18,000 XP (29,500 XP total) for defeating the Veiled Lady after its Symbiotic Vigour activates.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The Veiled Lady uses either its Infectious Spores or Shackles of Pain, if available, then makes two Halluciwhip attacks.

actions.name: Halluciwhip
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. *Hit:* 11 (**3d4 + 4**) slashing damage plus 10 (**3d6**) poison damage and the target must succeed on a DC 18 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned until the end of its next turn.

actions.name: Infectious Spores (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: The Veiled Lady exhales a cloud of spores at a creature it can see within 30 feet of it. The creature must succeed on a DC 18 Constitution saving throw or become afflicted as by the fungal infection* spell cast at 6th level for 1 minute. An affected creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.

actions.name: Shackles of Pain (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: The Veiled Lady exhales a cloud of spores at a creature it can see within 30 feet of it. The creature must succeed on a DC 18 Wisdom saving throw or become afflicted by the shackles of pain* spell. The Veiled Lady can have only one creature afflicted by Shackles of Pain at a time.

bonusActions.name: Detritivore
bonusActions.value: As a bonus action, the Veiled Lady can target one Small or larger corpse not under the effects of the gentle repose spell within 15 feet of it, draining it of its essence and regaining 21 (**6d6**) hit points. Once a corpse has been targeted by this feature, it becomes desiccated and can't be targeted again.

actions.value: The artillerist psionically plunders the mind of a creature they can see within 30 feet of them. The target must make a DC 17 Intelligence saving throw. On a successful save, a target takes half as much damage and doesn't have their proficiency bonus reduced.
A creature whose proficiency bonus drops to 0 can't form new thoughts or speak, and they have disadvantage on ability checks, attack rolls, and saving throws.

actions.name: Guise (3rd-Order Power)
actions.value: The artillerist projects a psionic image over their body, transforming their appearance for 1 hour into that of a Medium creature they have seen. When they manifest this power, they can also change the appearance of any equipment they carry for the duration.

The changes wrought by this power fail to hold up to physical inspection. A creature can use an action to inspect the artillerist's appearance and make a DC 17 Intelligence (*Investigation*) check, noticing the image is a projection on a success.

bonusActions.name: *Vanish for One (3/Day; 3rd-Order Power; Concentration)
bonusActions.value: The artillerist cloaks themself from the sight of a creature the artillerist can see within 60 feet of them. The creature must succeed on a DC 17 Wisdom saving throw or the artillerist becomes invisible to the creature for 1 minute (save ends at end of turn). This effect ends early if the artillerist attacks the creature, deals damage to them, or creates an effect that forces them to make a saving throw.

traits.name: Minion
traits.value: If the graywarper takes damage from an attack or as the result of a failed saving throw, their hit points are reduced to 0. If the graywarper takes damage from another effect, they die if the damage equals or exceeds their hit point maximum; otherwise they take no damage.

traits.name: Psionic Nexus
traits.value: When a non-minion voiceless talker within 30 feet of the graywarper uses telepathy or manifests a psionic power, they can do so as if they were in the graywarper's space.

actions.name: Phase Chant (Group Attack)
actions.value: *Melee or Ranged Power Attack:* +7 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 60 ft., one target. *Hit:* 4 psychic damage. If the target is a creature and if three or more graywarpers joined the attack, the target must make a Charisma saving throw. The DC for this saving throw is 11 plus the number of graywarpers who joined the attack. On a failed save, the target becomes phased until the end of their next turn. While phased, the creature is translucent and immaterial, and they deal half damage with weapon attacks and unarmed strikes.

fluffInfo.name: Stronger Together
fluffInfo.value: These altered survivors can no longer return to the Mortal World and need the chaotic contaminated environment to survive, but they are also regarded as foreign entities within the Space Between Worlds. Thus, many of the alien creatures inhabiting the twisted landscapes will attack, abduct, or obliterate them on sight.

These survivors have banded together into roving groups of scavengers, pirates, or gangs. They traverse the Void Sea upon scraped-together starships powered by elemental magics. These Void Pirates search and plunder the ancient ruins, caverns, and debris fields looking for anything that will help them survive. They wage war against alien entities and feed on the flesh of their kills, further inducing the never-ending descent into madness and contamination.

When they encounter mortals from another plane, Void Pirates are unpredictable. Sometimes they help lost sailors navigate the sea, hoping the dangerous voyage fails, and a new recruit can join their company. Other times, the pirates are less outwardly kind, kidnapping newcomers and holding them in cells upon their vessels. They use them as a distraction when they come across some horrible entity looking to eat, or as a bargaining chip amongst the other pirates, or even as payment to Far Dwellers for safe passage. A mortal life seems to be of value to many of the strange creatures, so having a few in reserve is often a key to survival.

fluffInfo.name: Ships of the Void Sea
fluffInfo.value: The vessels used by Void Pirates vary from group to group. They range from a small skiff with a sail and winged oars, housing a few pirates, to massive floating castles with elementally fueled propulsion systems housing hundreds.

Some void pirate ships resemble traditional pirate ships, while others appear as floating rafts with makeshift homes, or a series of roped together platforms drifting along. All these ships are bound together in a crude construction made up of junk and debris that has formed randomly in the Space Between Worlds or drifted into the void through Thin Places. Pirates hunt for better parts, or stronger materials to upgrade their vessels to defend against threats, or to exploit the other gangs of the sea.
Void Pirate ships are often equipped with extra nets, and sometimes ballistae or canons. Some even have more bizarre weaponry befitting the Space Between Worlds

fluffInfo.name: Myriad Forms of Chaos
fluffInfo.value: Void Pirates take on all manner of unusual quirks and physical attributes that represent their prolonged exposure to the shifting chaos of the Space Between Worlds.

fluffInfo.name: 1. No Face
fluffInfo.value: It has no face, only a smooth fleshy surface.

fluffInfo.name: 2. Eyes!
fluffInfo.value: Either not enough, or far too many, glow with an octarine haze.

fluffInfo.name: 3. Twinsies
fluffInfo.value: Two of these creatures are identical in every way.
They in fact are the same creature fractured in time.

fluffInfo.name: 4. Disjointed
fluffInfo.value: The creature's limbs have extra joints, or its joints bend the wrong way.

fluffInfo.name: 5. Cosmic Flesh
fluffInfo.value: The creature's flesh is a fractal distortion of light and energy.

fluffInfo.name: 6. Phasing
fluffInfo.value: The creature moves in and out of space, sometimes briefly appearing in two places at once as they walk around.

fluffInfo.name: 7. Impossible Dimensions
fluffInfo.value: The creature cannot be viewed from any perspective except straight on. Attempts to move around them fail as they seem to move with you, as if they are simply two-dimensional in a three-dimensional space.

fluffInfo.name: 8. Ventriloquist
fluffInfo.value: The sound of the creature's echoing voice seems to come from anywhere except their mouth.

fluffInfo.name: 9. Inside Out
fluffInfo.value: This creature appears to be inside out, their veins and organs exposed.

fluffInfo.name: 10. Insectoid
fluffInfo.value: This creature has taken on qualities of insects in their physical appearance, forming insect eyes, limbs, or mandibles.

fluffInfo.name: 11. Octarine Lamp
fluffInfo.value: This creature has a single eyeless socket, but instead of an eye, it emits a glowing octarine light.

fluffInfo.name: 12. Does this look infected?
fluffInfo.value: This creature is swollen and leaking puss and ooze from various open sores upon its body, at times bubbling or spurting with neon colored goop.

fluffInfo.name: Study the Foe
fluffInfo.value: Characters proficient in *History* or *Nature* gain Advantage on Intelligence (*Arcana*) checks when they take the Study action to examine a Void Pirate, learning the following based on the result.

fluffInfo.name: (5+) Mortal Survivors
fluffInfo.value: You learn the creature's type.

fluffInfo.name: (10+) Battle Readiness
fluffInfo.value: You recognize the creature's Bonus Action.

fluffInfo.name: (15+) Varied Abilities
fluffInfo.value: They learn the creature's highest and lowest ability scores.

fluffInfo.name: Combat Tactics
fluffInfo.value: Void Pirates often attempt to abduct creatures rather than kill them. They fight without honor, aiming to quickly outnumber and out maneuver opponents. Many target threatening enemies with ship-mounted weapons, or they move in close to use nets and shackles to capture other humanoids. They nearly always take prisoners unless forced to kill a target. If a creature persistently attacks or breaks free, they may decide to slit their throat and use them as bait. They flee if risking defeat. Their lives are more valuable to them than prisoners or treasure.

fluffInfo.name: Harvestable Components
fluffInfo.value: Due to their humanoid origins, these creatures cannot be harvested.

Roll 1d20 to determine what the characters can find: 1—nothing remains but broken splinters and ash; 2–9: 4d6 delerium chips; 10–12: 3d10 delerium fragments; 13–16: 2d6 delerium shards; 17–19: 1d4 delerium crystals; 20: 1 delerium geode.

fluffInfo.name: Combat Tactics
fluffInfo.value: Wall Gargoyles are found only along the city walls. They animate and attack characters who dare attempt any of the following: Climbing more than halfway up the walls or towers, flying within one hundred fifty feet of the city walls horizontally, or over them at any height, or lingering on the walls or towers for more than ten minutes.

The gargoyles attack directly, viciously, and without remorse. If they reduce their quarry to 0 Hit Points, they spend their next turn tearing apart the creature's body before moving on to another target. The gargoyles pursue their quarry into the city to any distance until they or their quarry are destroyed, but give up pursuing characters more than three hundred feet outside the city walls.

fluffInfo.name: Combat Tactics
fluffInfo.value: A Warlock of the Rat God does everything in its power to put "lesser" ratlings between it and its enemies. They deem themselves far too valuable to be put in harm's way, but are also inherently overconfident in their powers, convinced the Rat God protects them from harm.

A Warlock of the Rat God will have likely cast __Mage Armor__ on itself prior to rolling Initiative, as most keep this spell active when venturing out of their burrow, or at the first sign of danger. They conjure a Swarm of Rats to pester their enemies, and use Balefire to pummel their foes. When their defenses are exhausted they cast __Invisibility__ on themselves and attempt to flee using __Teleport__.

fluffInfo.name: (10+) Mentally Tough
fluffInfo.value: You learn the creature's Resistances and Immunities.

fluffInfo.name: (15+) Reality Distortion

fluffInfo.value: You know the creature's highest and lowest ability scores.

fluffInfo.name: Combat Tactics
fluffInfo.value: The Warp Marauder has control over the reality around it. It grabs creatures and drags them into extraplanar realities where it feeds on them. The lupine alien isn't afraid to be hit, relying on its ability to alter time and space from an incoming attack, directing an essence of chaotic circumstance back towards the creature.
Warp Marauders flee if they are reduced below half their Hit Points.

traits.name: Fully Contaminated
traits.value: The warp marauder is immune to Contamination and has Advantage on saving throws against contaminated spells. The warp marauder may cast contaminated spells even though it does not gain Contamination levels.

traits.name: Delerium Healing
traits.value: As an action, the warp marauder can touch a delerium shard to regain 10 (3d6) Hit Points. Once the warp marauder has used a delerium shard in this way, the shard can't be used in this manner again for 24 hours.

traits.name: Alien Intellect
traits.value: The warp marauder is immune to any effect that would sense its emotions or read its thoughts, as well as any divination spell that it refuses. Wisdom (*Insight*) checks made to ascertain the warp marauder's intentions or sincerity have Disadvantage.

traits.name: Extraplanar Gullet
traits.value: The warp marauder's back opens into a large mouth that leads to an extradimensional gullet. Anything it swallows is transported into this extraplanar space, which manifests as a rhizomatic network of slurping tunnels and fleshy passages. This space can hold any number of creatures of any size, and nothing inside the space can harm the warp marauder.

A creature within the gullet can take an action to attempt to escape, making a DC 15 Intelligence saving throw. On a success, it reappears in the nearest unoccupied space within 5 feet of the warp marauder. On a failure, it takes 10 (**3d6**) Psychic damage. If the warp marauder dies, everything inside the extraplanar gullet appears in the nearest unoccupied spaces to its corpse.

traits.name: Grasping Tentacles
traits.value: The warp marauder can have up to four tentacles at a time. Each tentacle has AC 20, 10 Hit Points, and Immunity to Poison and Psychic damage. Destroying a tentacle deals no damage to the warp marauder, which can extrude a replacement tentacle on its next turn. A creature within 5 feet can take an action to break a tentacle with a successful DC 15 Strength check.

traits.name: Swirling Color Field
traits.value: A field of shimmering color reverberates around the warp marauder, distorting reality. A creature that hits the warp marauder with an attack suffers one of the following effects, determined randomly (roll 1d6). A creature Grappled and adjacent to the warp marauder isn't affected by the Swirling Color Field.

traits.name: 1-2: Blue
traits.value: The attacker is teleported to an unoccupied space the warp marauder can see within 20 feet. The chosen space must be on a surface or in a liquid that can support the target. The attacker is then subjected to the following effect. *Charisma Saving Throw:* DC 15. *Failure:* The target has the Immobilized condition (save ends).

traits.name: 3-4: Yellow
traits.value: *Dexterity Saving Throw:* DC 15. *Failure:* 21 (**6d6**) Lightning damage. *Success* Half damage.

traits.name: 5-6: Red
traits.value: *Wisdom Saving Throw:* DC 15. *Failure:* The target has the Staggered condition (save ends).

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The warp marauder makes four Tentacle attacks, uses Reel, and makes one Bite attack.

actions.name: Tentacle
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +7, reach 60 ft. *Hit:* The target has the Grappled condition (escape DC 15). While Grappled, the target has the Restrained condition and has Disadvantage on Strength checks and saving throws, and the warp marauder can't use this tentacle against another target.

actions.name: Bite
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +7, reach 5 ft, one creature Grappled by the warp marauder. *Hit:* 16 (**2d10 + 5**) Piercing damage, and the warp marauder swallows the target. The target, along with everything it is wearing and carrying, appears in the warp marauder's Extraplanar Gullet.

actions.name: Reel
actions.value: The warp marauder pulls each creature Grappled by it up to 30 feet straight toward it.

bonusActions.name: Dimensional Jump
bonusActions.value: The warp marauder teleports to an unoccupied space within 120 feet. Alternatively, it travels from the Material Plane to the Space Between Worlds or vice versa.

fluffInfo.name: (10+) Mutative Control
fluffInfo.value: You recongize the creature's Possession action and Mutate Host Bonus Action, but not the means to end the possession.

fluffInfo.name: (15+) Escaping Possession
fluffInfo.value: You are aware that the Warp Witch's Possession can be ended by reducing the possessed body to 0 Hit Points, or by casting __Dispel Evil and Good__.

fluffInfo.name: Combat Tactics
fluffInfo.value: A Warp Witch begins combat by using its Psychic Scream. The witch then selects a target amongst their foes to possess.

While possessing a host, the Warp Witch will try to use the body to deceive or trick allies of its host into not attacking or harming them, trying to suggest useless, ineffective, and halfmad courses of action to "help" the host "drive out" the spirit, such whistling, dancing, clapping, singing, drawing pictures, and other bizarre commands. Meanwhile, the witch continues to use Mutate Host to contaminate them. The Warp Witch leaves the host after they undergo a Monstrous Transformation, and then moves to repeat the process with another.

traits.name: Incorporeal Movement
traits.value: The warp witch can move through other creatures and objects as if they were Difficult Terrain. It takes 5 (**1d10**) Force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

actions.name: Balefire Lantern
actions.value: *Melee or Ranged Attack Roll:* +5, reach 5 ft. or range 120 ft. *Hit:* 21 (**4d8 + 3**) Cold damage, and the target has the Slowed condition until the end of the warp witch's next turn.

actions.name: Psychic Scream
actions.value: *Intelligence Saving Throw:* DC 13, each creature in a 30-foot Cone. *Failure:* 10 (**3d6**) Psychic damage, and the target has the Frightened condition (save ends).

actions.name: Possession
actions.value: *Charisma Saving Throw:* DC 13, one Humanoid the warp witch can see within 5 feet. *Failure:* The target is possessed by the Warp Witch. The witch disappears, and the target has the Incapacitated condition and loses control of its body. The witch controls the target's body but doesn't deprive the target of awareness. The witch can't be targeted by any attack, spell, or other effect, except ones that turn undead. The witch retains its alignment, Intelligence, Wisdom, Charisma, and Immunity to the Charmed and Frightened conditions. It otherwise uses the possessed target's game statistics, but doesn't gain access to the target's knowledge, class features, or proficiencies.

The possession lasts until the body drops to 0 Hit Points, the witch ends it as a Bonus Action, or the witch is turned or forced out by an effect like the __Dispel Evil and Good__ spell. When the possession ends, the witch reappears in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the body. If the target succeeds on its save or the effect ends for it, it is immune to this warp witch's Possession for 24 hours.

bonusActions.name: Mutate Host
bonusActions.value: *Charisma Saving Throw:* DC 13, one creature the warp witch is possessing. *Failure:* The target gains one Contamination level and a mutation.
