actions.name: Frenzied Branch
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +7 to hit, reach 30 ft., one target. *Hit:* 12 (**2d6 + 5**) bludgeoning damage. If the willow is on fire, this attack deals an extra 3 (**1d6**) fire damage.

actions.name: Tugging Roots
actions.value: Roots erupt from a point on the ground the willow can see within 60 feet of them. Each creature in a 10-foot sphere centered on that point must succeed on a DC 14 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone and moved up to 30 feet toward the willow, taking 4 (**1d8**) bludgeoning damage for every 10 feet moved.

actions.name: Willow's Tears
actions.value: The willow showers salty droplets on their bower. Each creature within 15 feet of the willow must succeed on a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw or be charmed by the willow (save ends at end of turn). While charmed in this way, a creature can't willingly move more than 15 feet away from the willow. If a creature charmed in this way takes damage, the effect ends for them.

traits.name: Alluring Cry
traits.value: The cry of the Weeping Willow attracts creatures in a 120-foot Emanation from the willow. At the start of each of its turns, a creature within the area must succeed on a DC 18 Charisma save or have the Charmed condition for 1 hour. On a success, the target is immune to this Weeping Willow's Alluring Cry for 24 hours.

While Charmed, the target also has the Incapacitated condition. On each of its turns, a Charmed creature must use its movement to approach the Weeping Willow by the most direct route, stopping when it is within 5 feet of the Weeping Willow. It doesn't avoid Opportunity Attacks, but if this movement would obviously cause damage (such as by walking through fire), the creature repeats the save before entering that space.

traits.name: Deep Rooted

traits.name: Magic Resistance

fluffInfo.value: Magic is beyond the means of most commonfolk in the continent. Few can afford the services of the Amethyst Academy, and priests of the Sacred Flame and Old Gods alike are selective with their divine magic, offering their boons to devout worshippers or those in dire need only. However, apothecaries are seldom so selective, especially those who operate in remote regions or clandestinely within large cities.

fluffInfo.name: Desperate Vanity
fluffInfo.value: Lesser nobles and vain merchants occasionally seek out apothecaries not for a cure to an ailment, injury, or sickness, but in the hopes of augmenting some quality of themselves they find deficient. These individuals may come to an apothecary looking for a miraculous means to become taller or more comely, reverse aging, or even gain supernatural or magical abilities.

fluffInfo.name: Medical Malpractice
fluffInfo.value: Unfortunately for their patients, unscrupulous apothecaries may be perfectly willing to offer an experimental method or untested procedure in exchange for an affordable price, seeking an opportunity to trial their latest concoction upon a hapless yet willing subject. When these ill-conceived techniques inevitably go awry, the subjects find themselves transformed into a grotesque mockery of themselves.

fluffInfo.name: Promised Cure
fluffInfo.value: The transformation leaves the patient half-mad. Some are manipulated in the hopes of being cured one day, or tricked into believing that they must remain in the care of their "doctor" until they have "recovered" from the procedure. Many lash out in rage, fleeing into the wilderness, back alleys, or hidden away in their homes. Those unable to return to their former lives in fear or shame may remain, however.

fluffInfo.name: Useful Lackeys
fluffInfo.value: Left without the means to restore their former appearance, these wretched patients accept roles as orderlies, guards, and assistants to the apothecary responsible for their tormented contention. Truly psychotic apothecaries may increase their control over their patients through invasive brain surgery, chemical conditioning, and forced indoctrination. These terrible procedures render these unfortunate individuals fiercely loyal to the apothecary, imbuing them with a fanatical drive to protect them even at the cost of their own lives.

fluffInfo.name: The Varied Victims of Many Malpractices
fluffInfo.value: Wretched Patients represent the unfortunate victims of apothecaries' experiments. No matter their area of study, the deranged minds of evil scientists know no bounds with their experimentation on willing subjects in the name of occult science.

fluffInfo.name: Alienist
fluffInfo.value: Often those with mental instability or muddled minds turn to an Alienist. These patients are rendered into mindless and obedient servants through mind control, mental conditioning, and mind-altering procedures. Alienists have been known to go as far as remove portions of their victims' brains or remove their brains entirely while keeping the subject alive.

fluffInfo.name: Chemist
fluffInfo.value: Those looking for tinctures and tonics to ease all manner of ailments have turned to Chemists, often unaware of the danger of their compounds. These patients are often subject to new experimental procedures that leave them burned, or scarred, disfigured by chemical research. In some cases, the chemical procedures can leave the victims hairless, blind, or cause their skin to muddle and scar over completely.

fluffInfo.name: Exorcist
fluffInfo.value: An Exorcists patients seek help with possessions that may or may not be real. These haunted people can find themselves at the hands of mad scientist and spiritualist who will use the willing patient to summon or trap demonic forces. Sometimes these patients are simply what remains after a demonic or spiritual possession, where after the removal, the victim is left numb and catatonic, having lost most of themselves to the entity that inhabited them. More sinister exorcists will perform this procedure on purpose, placing powerful entities into a patient, only to remove it and render the patient hollow and willing to become a subject to the apothecary.

fluffInfo.name: Mutagenist
fluffInfo.value: The failed experiments of a Mutagenist can leave all manner of strange disfigurations and abnormalities upon their patients. Everything from unusual growths, cankers, and tumors, to fully growing extra limbs, eyes, mouths, and other such strange occurrences. These patients become hideous mockeries of their former selves and over time, become reliant on the doctor to keep their growths and mutations in check.

fluffInfo.name: Pathogenist
fluffInfo.value: When sick with disease, or dealing with unknown poisons, subjects will go to a Pathogenist. Those who take their practices too far often use subjects as vessels for experimentation. Subjects are often riddled with diseases, sores, boils, at times losing their teeth and fingernails to unnatural decay, their skin turning shades of yellow, green, or purple. They appear sickly, carrying a many pathogens, toxins, and diseases.

fluffInfo.name: Reanimator
fluffInfo.value: Reanimators are sought out when a patient has lost a limb, or had severe injury that would leave them scarred or disfigured. The Reanimators who take their practice too far will use the subject as a means of experimentation. Attaching new limbs to them, testing the lengths they can go by adding multiple limbs, or a second head, additional fingers or toes, subjects over time can become a patchwork of various parts that have been removed, reattached, or swapped.

fluffInfo.name: Combat Tactics
fluffInfo.value: Wretched Patients are simple minions. They defend themselves and reluctantly fight at the command of their creator. If their creator dies, Wretched Patients flee or cower.

actions.value: The wyvern makes a signature attack with a reach of 15 feet. On a hit, the attack deals an extra **PB** acid damage.

actions.name: 3rd Level: Liquefied Meal (5 Ferocity)
actions.value: The wyvern pounces on a Large or smaller creature within 5 feet of them, attempting to melt their prey's flesh with acid and drink it. The target must succeed on a DC 10 plus PB Dexterity saving throw or fall prone and take **1d4 plus PB** acid damage. The wyvern gains temporary hit points equal to the acid damage dealt.

actions.name: 5th Level: Tail Sweep (8 Ferocity)
actions.value: The wyvern sweeps their tail in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 10 plus PB Strength saving throw or take **PBd6** bludgeoning damage and be pushed up to 10 feet away from the wyvern.

entries: **Immunities**: lightning, thunder; charmed, dazed, frightened, paralyzed, petrified, stunned

traits.name: Static Shield (3/Day)
traits.value: When Xaantikorijek fails a saving throw, he can succeed instead. When he does, his sight, blindsight, and truesight are reduced to a range of 30 feet until the start of his next turn.

traits.name: Storm of the Gods
traits.value: Lightning and thunder damage dealt by Xaantikorijek ignore damage resistance.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: Xaantikorijek makes one Bite attack and two Claw attacks.

actions.name: Bite
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +16 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. *Hit:* 20 (**2d10 + 9**) piercing damage plus 5 (**1d10**) lightning damage, and Xaantikorijek can move the target up to 20 feet in any direction.

actions.name: Claw
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +16 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. *Hit:* 16 (**2d6 + 9**) slashing damage plus 7 (**2d6**) thunder damage, and the target is knocked prone.

actions.name: Fulminating Breath (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: Xaantikorijek exhales lightning in a line that is 120 feet long and 30 feet wide. Each creature in that area must make a DC 23 Dexterity saving throw. bonusActions.value: Xaantikorijek makes one Bite attack. On a hit, Xaantikorijek's teeth spark with energy, dealing an extra 11 (**2d10**) lightning damage to the target and to one other enemy within 60 feet of the target.

traits.name: Amorphous
traits.value: Xogomoc can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

traits.name: Discorporation
traits.value: When Xogomoc drops to 0 hit points or dies, all conditions and other effects end for him. He teleports back to the place where he slumbers, transforms into __Goxomoc__ with all his hit points, and falls unconscious.

traits.name: Disruptive Resistance (3/Day)
traits.value: If Xogomoc fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead, and his Lightning Aura doesn't function until the end of his next turn.

traits.name: Lightning Aura
traits.value: A creature who starts their turn within 60 feet of Xogomoc must make a DC 25 Dexterity saving throw, taking 22 (**4d10**) lightning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

traits.name: Power of the Storm
traits.value: Lightning and thunder damage dealt by Xogomoc ignore damage resistance.

traits.name: Siege Monster
traits.value: Xogomoc deals double damage to objects and structures.

traits.name: Supernatural Resistance
traits.value: Xogomoc has advantage on saving throws against powers, spells, and other supernatural effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: Xogomoc makes two Lightning Strike attacks.

actions.name: Lightning Strike
actions.value: *Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack:* +19 to hit, reach 15 ft. or range 600 ft., one target. *Hit:* 29 (**3d12 + 10**) lightning damage, and another target within 30 feet of the first must succeed on a DC 27 Dexterity saving throw or take the same damage.

actions.name: Energy Flow
actions.value: Xogomoc moves up to his speed without provoking opportunity attacks. During this move, he can move through the spaces of other creatures, and it doesn't count as difficult terrain. The first time he moves through each creature's space, that creature takes 22 (**4d10**) lightning damage.

actions.name: Lightning Breath (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: Xogomoc breathes lightning in a 90-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 27 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 71 (**11d12**) lightning damage and can't take reactions until the end of their next turn. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage and suffers no other effect.

bonusActions.name: Gone in a Flash
bonusActions.value: Xogomoc teleports, along with any creatures inside him (see Into the Storm), up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space he can see. Each creature within 10 feet of the space he left must make a DC 25 Constitution saving throw, taking 22 (**4d10**) thunder damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

traits.name: Painful Resistance (3/Day)
traits.value: Eight eyes float around Xorannox and create his Eye Psionics. If Xorannox fails a saving throw, he can destroy a random floating eye (chosen by rolling a d8) and succeed instead. If an eye is destroyed, a new eye pops of out of Xorannox's face to replace it 24 hours later.

actions.name: Bite
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 14 (**4d6**) piercing damage.

actions.name: Eye Psionics
actions.value: Xorannox creates three of the following psionic eye effects. Unless otherwise stated, each eye targets a creature who he can see within 120 feet of him. He can't use the same effect twice on a turn.

entries: **1. Charm Beam**: The targeted creature must succeed on a DC 17 Wisdom saving throw or be charmed by Xorannox for 1 hour, or until he harms the creature or one of their allies.

**2. Compulsion Beam**: The targeted creature must succeed on a DC 17 Intelligence saving throw or use their reaction, if available, to move up to their speed toward the closest ally they can see and make one weapon attack against them. Creatures who can't be charmed are unaffected.

**3. Memory Beam**: The targeted creature must make a DC 17 Intelligence saving throw. On a failed save, if the creature has unexpended spell slots, they expend a spell slot of their highest remaining level, with no effect. If they don't have unexpended spell slots, they instead lose proficiency with a weapon they're holding or carrying for 1 minute (save ends at end of turn).

**4. Toxic Vapors**: Xorannox chooses a point he can see within 120 feet of him. Each creature within 10 feet of the point must succeed on a DC 17 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned for 1 minute (save ends at end of turn).

**5. Telekinetic Field**: Xorannox chooses a point he can see within 120 feet of him. Each enemy within 10 feet of the point must succeed on a DC 17 Strength saving throw or be moved up to 30 feet in any direction and take 7 (**2d6**) force damage at the end of the move. Additionally, Xorannox can target any object within 10 feet of the point that weighs 300 pounds or less and isn't being worn or carried, moving it up to 30 feet in any direction. Xorannox can also exert fine control on objects with this effect, such as manipulating a simple tool or opening a door or a container.

**6. Lightning Bolt**: Xorannox shoots a 5-foot-wide, 60-foot-long line of lightning. Each creature in the line must succeed on a DC 17 Dexterity saving throw, taking 36 (**8d8**) lightning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

**7. Explosion**: Xorannox chooses a point he can see within 120 feet of him. Each creature within 10 feet of the point must make a DC 17 Dexterity saving throw, taking 36 (**8d8**) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

**8. Necrosis Beam**: The targeted creature must succeed on a DC 17 Constitution saving throw or immediately take 55 (**10d10**) necrotic damage and lose 7 (**2d6**) hit points at the start of each of their turns. If this effect reduces a target's hit points to 0, they die. The effect ends if Xorannox dies or can't see the target. This psionic effect can't be used again while this effect persists.

bonusActions.name: The Great Eye (Recharge 5-6)
bonusActions.value: Xorannox's central eye turns solid black and projects a 150-foot cone of energy. If Xorannox or any creature in that area is affected by a spell, the spell's effects immediately end for that creature.

traits.name: Fully Contaminated
traits.value: The dragon is immune to Contamination and has Advantage on saving throws against contaminated spells. The dragon may cast contaminated spells even though it does not gain Contamination levels.

traits.name: Delerium Healing
traits.value: As an action, the dragon can touch a delerium shard to regain 10 (3d6) Hit Points. Once the dragon has used a delerium shard in this way, the shard can't be used in this manner again for 24 hours.

traits.name: Alien Intellect
traits.value: The dragon is immune to any effect that would sense its emotions or read its thoughts, as well as any divination spell that it refuses. Wisdom (*Insight*) checks made to ascertain the dragon's intentions or sincerity have Disadvantage.

traits.name: Haze Aura
traits.value: A creature that starts its turn within 30 feet of the dragon takes 10 (**3d6**) Necrotic damage.

actions.name: The dragon always takes its turn on Initiative count 20
actions.value: On its turn, the dragon can use its movement and interaction as normal. However, it does not take an action or Bonus Action on its turn unless forced to do so by a spell or other effect. Instead, the dragon takes one of the following Epic Actions at the end of each player character's turn:

entries: **Bite**: *Melee Attack Roll:* +10, reach 10 ft. *Hit:* 17 (**2d10 + 6**) Force damage, and if the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 18). While Grappled, the target has the Restrained condition.
**Contaminated Rend**: *Constitution Saving Throw:* DC 18, one creature within 5 feet of the dragon. *Failure:* 14 (**4d6**) Necrotic damage, and the target gains one Contamination level.

**Tail**: *Strength Saving Throw:* DC 18, one creature within 20 feet of the dragon. *Failure:* 14 (**4d6**) Force damage, and if the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the Prone condition.

actions.name: Octarine Breath (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: *Dexterity Saving Throw:* DC 18, each creature in a 30-foot Cone. *Failure:* 14 (**4d6**) Necrotic damage plus 14 (**4d6**) Psychic damage plus 14 (**4d6**) Radiant damage. *Success* Half damage.

actions.name: Dimension Hop (1/Round)
actions.value: The dragon teleports to an unoccupied space it can see within 30 feet.

actions.name: Epic Resistance
actions.value: The dragon chooses one condition, spell, or other effect currently affecting them and rolls 1d20. On an 11+, the effect ends on it. The dragon can use this action even if it would otherwise be unable to take actions, its actions are being controlled by another creature, or if a spell or effect alters its game statistics.

traits.name: Arcanomagnetic Repulsion
traits.value: Attacks against the weapon made with ferrous weapons or ammunition are made at disadvantage.
The area within 15 feet of the dragon is difficult terrain for creatures wearing ferrous armour.

traits.name: Superconductor
traits.value: If the dragon takes 5 or more fire damage in a single instance, its flying speed is reduced by 30 feet until the end of its next turn. If its flying speed is reduced to 0 feet, it immediately falls 100 feet, and falls a further 100 feet at the start of its next turn.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The dragon makes two attacks: one with its Bite and one with its Claws, or two with its Sword Shot:

actions.name: Bite
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +6 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. *Hit:* 14 (**2d10 + 3**) piercing damage.

actions.name: Claws
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +6 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. *Hit:* 14 (**2d10 + 3**) slashing damage.

actions.name: Sword Shot
actions.value: *Ranged Weapon Attack:* +6 to hit, range 40/120 ft., one target. *Hit:* 7 (**1d8+3**) piercing damage.

actions.name: Breath Weapons (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: The dragon uses one of the following breath weapons.

actions.name: Storm of Swords
actions.value: The dragon fires a torrent of sharp metal objects in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw, taking 21 **6d6** piercing damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

actions.name: Repulsion Breath
actions.value: The dragon exhales repulsion energy in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 14 Strength saving throw. On a failed save, the creature is pushed up to 40 feet away from the dragon. A creature wearing ferrous armour has disadvantage on this saving throw.

traits.name: Observer Mimic
traits.value: If the owlbear is in dim light or darkness, it appears to be an observer, a type of powerful, floating eye tyrant.

traits.name: Photometabolise
traits.value: If the owlbear is in direct sunlight, it regains 5 hit points at the start of its turn.

traits.name: Radiant Absorption
traits.value: Whenever the owlbear is subjected to radiant damage, it takes no damage and instead regains a number of hit points equal to the radiant damage dealt.

traits.name: Supernova (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
traits.value: If the owlbear would be reduced to 0 hit points, its current hit point total instead resets to 52 hit points, it recharges its Solar Beam, it immediately uses its Blinding Flash legendary action option (without expending any actions), and a small sun coalesces 10 feet above the owlbear and follows it for the next hour, shedding bright sunlight in a 30-foot radius. Additionally, the owlbear can use the options in the "Mythic Actions" section for 1 hour. Award a party an additional 700 XP (1,400 XP total) for defeating the owlbear after its Supernova activates.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The owlbear makes two attacks: one with its Beak and one with its Claws.

actions.name: Beak
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 8 (**1d10 + 3**) piercing damage.

actions.name: Claws
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 6 (**1d6 + 3**) slashing damage.

actions.name: Solar Beam (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: The owlbear exhales a beam of irradiating energy in a 5-foot-wide, 60-foot-long line. Each creature in the area must make a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw, taking 10 (**3d6**) radiant damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.

traits.value: Yserthrax can breathe air and water.

traits.name: Corruption
traits.value: Poison damage dealt by Yserthrax ignores damage resistance and treats damage immunity as damage resistance. Whenever Yserthrax deals poison damage to a creature who isn't a Construct or an Undead, that creature must succeed on a DC 19 Constitution saving throw or be corrupted (save ends at end of turn). The corruption lasts until cured by a cure ailment power, __lesser restoration__ spell, or similar supernatural effect.

While corrupted, a creature takes 14 (**4d6**) psychic damage at the start of each of their turns as their mind and body are ravaged by reality-warping anomalies. If a creature dies while corrupted, their body melts into a gruesome puddle, becoming a __gibbering mouther__ under Yserthrax's control.

traits.name: Withering Resistance (3/Day)
traits.value: When Yserthrax fails a saving throw, she can take 16 (**3d10**) necrotic damage and succeed instead.

actions.name: Claw
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +16 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. *Hit:* 16 (**2d6 + 9**) slashing damage, and Yserthrax can move the target up to 15 feet horizontally.

actions.name: Corrupting Breath (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: Yserthrax exhales poison in a 90-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 22 Constitution saving throw. bonusActions.value: Yserthrax magically aggravates a creature she can see within 60 feet of her who is corrupted by her Corruption trait. The target must succeed on a DC 19 Constitution saving throw or be dazed until the end of their next turn.

traits.name: Death Wail
traits.value: When the yumgrub dies, they let out a distressing screech. Each creature within 15 feet who can hear the yumgrub takes 1 psychic damage. Yumgrubs and creatures who have eaten a yumgrub within the last minute are immune to this damage.

traits.name: Minion
traits.value: If the yumgrub takes damage from an attack or as the result of a failed saving throw, their hit points are reduced to 0. If the yumgrub takes damage from another effect, they die if the damage equals or exceeds their hit point maximum; otherwise they take no damage.

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.value: The yumgrub can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

traits.name: Yum
traits.value: A Small or larger creature can use an action to consume a living yumgrub within 5 feet of them. The yumgrub dies, and for 1 minute, the consuming creature's speed is doubled and they gain a +4 bonus to their Strength score and a +2 bonus to AC. When the effect ends, the creature gains two levels of exhaustion.

actions.name: Bite (Group Attack)
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* -1 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 1 piercing damage.

traits.name: Unshakeable Faith (1/Day)
traits.value: When the zealot would fail a saving throw, it can reroll the save with Advantage. It must use the new roll.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The zealot makes two Greatsword attacks.

actions.name: Greatsword
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +5, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 10 (**2d6 + 3**) Slashing damage plus 7 (**2d6**) Radiant damage.

bonusActions.name: For the Flame (1/Day)
bonusActions.value: Allies of the zealot within 60 feet of it that can hear it gain Advantage on attack rolls and saving throws until the start of the zealot's next turn.

fluffInfo.name: Study the Foe
fluffInfo.value: Characters proficient in *Arcana* or *Religion* gain Advantage on Wisdom (*Insight*) or Intelligence (*Investigation*) checks when taking the Study action to examine it, learning the following based on the result:

fluffInfo.name: (10+) Angry Undead
fluffInfo.value: You recognize the creature's Morrigan's
Fury bonus action.

fluffInfo.name: (15+) Rejuvenating Violence
fluffInfo.value: You learn of the creature's Blood Shield trait.

fluffInfo.name: (20+) Swift and Strong
fluffInfo.value: You know the creature's highest and lowest ability scores as well as its Vampire Weaknesses

fluffInfo.name: Combat Tactics
fluffInfo.value: As soon as a Zealot of Morrigan gets the scent of combat, they use their Bonus Action to enter Morrigan's Fury, amplifying their damage and bolstering them against assault. With their superior speed, they zone in on the easiest meal within range, assailing them with their claws and fangs. The blood spilt from these attacks then serves as a buffer, fueling their Blood Shield. In their fury, the zealots have no sense of survival or self-preservation, as they fight to the death.

fluffInfo.name: Animus:
fluffInfo.value: Undead.

fluffInfo.name: Fluid:
fluffInfo.value: Monster Blood.

fluffInfo.name: Organs:
fluffInfo.value: Eyes, Heart, Brain, Guts, Flesh.

fluffInfo.name: Bones:
fluffInfo.value: Skull, Spine, Ribs.

fluffInfo.name: Natural Weapons:
fluffInfo.value: Teeth, Claws.

fluffInfo.name: Hair:
fluffInfo.value: Hair

fluffInfo.name: Hide:
fluffInfo.value: Skin.

fluffInfo.name: Dust:
fluffInfo.value: Undead Dust.

traits.name: Blood Frenzy
traits.value: The vampire has Advantage on melee attack rolls against a creature with the *Bloodied* condition.

traits.name: Blood Shield
traits.value: Whenever the vampire damages a creature that has blood, the vampire gains 15 Temporary Hit Points.

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.value: The vampire regains 10 Hit Points at the start of its turn if it has at least 1 Hit Point and isn't in sunlight or running water. If the vampire takes Radiant damage or damage from holy water, this trait doesn't function at the start of the vampire's next turn.

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.value: The vampire can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

traits.name: Vampire Weaknesses
traits.value: The vampire has the traits described in the "Vampire Weaknesses" sidebar in the Monsters of Drakkenheim.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The vampire makes three attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Bite.

actions.name: Claws
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +8, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 10 (**2d4 + 5**) Slashing damage, and if the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 21).

actions.name: Bite
actions.value: *Constitution Saving Throw:* DC 16, one creature within 5 feet that is willing or has the Grappled, Incapacitated, or Restrained condition. *Failure:* 15 (**3d6 + 5**) Necrotic damage. The target's Hit Point Maximum decreases by an amount equal to the Necrotic damage taken, and the vampire regains Hit Points equal to that amount.

bonusActions.name: Morrigan's Fury (1/Short Rest)
bonusActions.value: The vampire howls at the moon, gaining Resistance to all damage except Acid and Radiant damage for 1 minute or until it has the Incapacitated condition. As part of this Bonus Action, the vampire moves up to half its Speed toward a Hostile creature without provoking Opportunity Attack action.

traits.name: Battle Tranquility (3/Day)
traits.value: When Aastrika fails a saving throw, she can choose to succeed instead. When she does so, she can't use Sweltering Heat until the end of her next turn.

traits.name: Molten Flesh
traits.value: The first time a creature other than a fire giant touches Aastrika or hits her with a melee attack on a turn, that creature takes 7 (**2d6**) fire damage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: Aastrika takes the Disengage action and makes up to three attacks using Unarmed Strike, Hurl Flame, or both.

actions.name: Unarmed Strike
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +11 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. *Hit:* 21 (**4d6 + 7**) bludgeoning damage plus 7 (**2d6**) fire damage. If the target is a creature, they are outlined in red light until the start of Aastrika's next turn, and for the duration, attack rolls against them have advantage.

actions.name: Hurl Flame
actions.value: *Ranged Spell Attack:* +10 to hit, range 180 ft., one target. *Hit:* 20 (**4d6 + 6**) fire damage.

actions.name: Lava Pillar (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: Aastrika causes a 20-foot-radius, 60-foot-high cylinder of lava to erupt from the ground at a point she can see within 120 feet of her. Each creature in that area must make a DC 18 Dexterity saving throw, taking 38 (**11d6**) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

bonusActions.name: Sweltering Heat
bonusActions.value: Aastrika's inner flame pulses harshly. Each creature within 20 feet of her who doesn't have resistance or immunity to fire damage must succeed on a DC 18 Constitution saving throw or gain a level of exhaustion.

traits.name: Negative Nerves
traits.value: Whenever a creature deals 5 damage or less to the zombie, the zombie takes no damage instead.

actions.name: Slam
actions.value: *Melee Weapon Attack:* +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 4 (**1d4 + 2**) bludgeoning damage.
